#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <vector>

struct City {
    double x;
    double y;
    std::size_t id;
};

static inline double sq_dist(const City& a, const City& b) {
    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
    const double dy = a.y - b.y;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

static std::vector<std::size_t> nearest_neighbor(const std::vector<City>& cities) {
    const std::size_t n = cities.size();
    std::vector<std::size_t> order;
    order.reserve(n);
    std::vector<unsigned char> used(n, 0);
    std::size_t current = 0;
    used[0] = 1;
    order.push_back(0);

    for (std::size_t step = 1; step < n; ++step) {
        double best = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
        std::size_t best_idx = 0;
        for (std::size_t j = 1; j < n; ++j) {
            if (used[j]) {
                continue;
            }
            const double d = sq_dist(cities[current], cities[j]);
            if (d < best) {
                best = d;
                best_idx = j;
            }
        }
        used[best_idx] = 1;
        order.push_back(best_idx);
        current = best_idx;
    }
    return order;
}

static void two_opt_limited(const std::vector<City>& cities, std::vector<std::size_t>& order) {
    const std::size_t n = order.size();
    if (n < 4) {
        return;
    }

    const std::size_t max_passes = 6;
    const std::size_t neighborhood = (n <= 256 ? n - 1 : std::min<std::size_t>(64, n - 1));

    for (std::size_t pass = 0; pass < max_passes; ++pass) {
        bool improved = false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i + 3 < n; ++i) {
            const std::size_t a = order[i];
            const std::size_t b = order[i + 1];
            const std::size_t max_j = std::min<std::size_t>(n - 2, i + neighborhood);
            for (std::size_t j = i + 2; j <= max_j; ++j) {
                const std::size_t c = order[j];
                const std::size_t d = order[j + 1];
                const double old_len = sq_dist(cities[a], cities[b]) + sq_dist(cities[c], cities[d]);
                const double new_len = sq_dist(cities[a], cities[c]) + sq_dist(cities[b], cities[d]);
                if (new_len + 1e-12 < old_len) {
                    std::reverse(order.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(i + 1),
                                 order.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(j + 1));
                    improved = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!improved) {
            break;
        }
    }
}

static std::vector<std::size_t> lexicographic_tour(const std::vector<City>& cities, std::size_t bins_per_axis) {
    const std::size_t n = cities.size();
    std::vector<std::size_t> order;
    order.reserve(n);

    if (n == 0) {
        return order;
    }

    double min_x = cities[0].x;
    double max_x = cities[0].x;
    double min_y = cities[0].y;
    double max_y = cities[0].y;
    for (const City& c : cities) {
        min_x = std::min(min_x, c.x);
        max_x = std::max(max_x, c.x);
        min_y = std::min(min_y, c.y);
        max_y = std::max(max_y, c.y);
    }

    const double span_x = std::max(1e-12, max_x - min_x);
    const double span_y = std::max(1e-12, max_y - min_y);

    struct Keyed {
        std::size_t idx;
        std::size_t bx;
        std::size_t by;
    };

    std::vector<Keyed> keyed;
    keyed.reserve(n);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const double fx = (cities[i].x - min_x) / span_x;
        const double fy = (cities[i].y - min_y) / span_y;
        std::size_t bx = static_cast<std::size_t>(fx * static_cast<double>(bins_per_axis));
        std::size_t by = static_cast<std::size_t>(fy * static_cast<double>(bins_per_axis));
        if (bx >= bins_per_axis) {
            bx = bins_per_axis - 1;
        }
        if (by >= bins_per_axis) {
            by = bins_per_axis - 1;
        }
        keyed.push_back({i, bx, by});
    }

    std::sort(keyed.begin(), keyed.end(), [&](const Keyed& a, const Keyed& b) {
        if (a.bx != b.bx) {
            return a.bx < b.bx;
        }
        const bool snake = (a.bx & 1U) != 0U;
        if (a.by != b.by) {
            return snake ? (a.by > b.by) : (a.by < b.by);
        }
        if (snake) {
            if (cities[a.idx].x != cities[b.idx].x) {
                return cities[a.idx].x > cities[b.idx].x;
            }
        } else {
            if (cities[a.idx].x != cities[b.idx].x) {
                return cities[a.idx].x < cities[b.idx].x;
            }
        }
        if (cities[a.idx].y != cities[b.idx].y) {
            return cities[a.idx].y < cities[b.idx].y;
        }
        return a.idx < b.idx;
    });

    std::size_t pos0 = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (keyed[i].idx == 0) {
            pos0 = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    for (std::size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
        order.push_back(keyed[(pos0 + k) % n].idx);
    }
    return order;
}

static std::vector<std::size_t> adaptive_tour(const std::vector<City>& cities) {
    const std::size_t n = cities.size();
    if (n <= 2) {
        std::vector<std::size_t> order(n);
        std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), 0);
        return order;
    }

    if (n <= 3000) {
        std::vector<std::size_t> order = nearest_neighbor(cities);
        two_opt_limited(cities, order);
        return order;
    }

    if (n <= 200000) {
        const double bins = std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(n) / 8.0);
        const std::size_t bins_per_axis = std::max<std::size_t>(8, static_cast<std::size_t>(bins));
        return lexicographic_tour(cities, bins_per_axis);
    }

    if (n <= 2000000) {
        const double bins = std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(n) / 32.0);
        const std::size_t bins_per_axis = std::max<std::size_t>(16, static_cast<std::size_t>(bins));
        return lexicographic_tour(cities, bins_per_axis);
    }

    const double bins = std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(n) / 128.0);
    const std::size_t bins_per_axis = std::max<std::size_t>(32, static_cast<std::size_t>(bins));
    return lexicographic_tour(cities, bins_per_axis);
}

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    std::size_t n = 0;
    if (!(std::cin >> n)) {
        return 0;
    }

    std::vector<City> cities;
    cities.reserve(n);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double x = 0.0;
        double y = 0.0;
        std::cin >> x >> y;
        cities.push_back({x, y, i});
    }

    std::vector<std::size_t> order = adaptive_tour(cities);

    if (order.empty() || order[0] != 0) {
        auto it = std::find(order.begin(), order.end(), 0);
        if (it != order.end()) {
            std::rotate(order.begin(), it, order.end());
        }
    }

    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < order.size(); ++i) {
        if (i) {
            std::cout << ' ';
        }
        std::cout << order[i];
    }
    std::cout << '\n';
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    struct WeightedArc
    {
        public int To;
        public int Next;
        public int Cost;
    }

    struct EulerArc
    {
        public int To;
        public int Next;
        public int UndirectedId;
    }

    struct HeapNode : IComparable<HeapNode>
    {
        public long Dist;
        public int Node;

        public int CompareTo(HeapNode other)
        {
            int cmp = Dist.CompareTo(other.Dist);
            return cmp != 0 ? cmp : Node.CompareTo(other.Node);
        }
    }

    sealed class MinHeap<T> where T : IComparable<T>
    {
        private T[] _data;
        public int Count { get; private set; }

        public MinHeap(int capacity = 16)
        {
            _data = new T[Math.Max(4, capacity)];
        }

        public void Push(T value)
        {
            if (Count == _data.Length) Array.Resize(ref _data, Count * 2);
            int i = Count++;
            while (i > 0)
            {
                int p = (i - 1) >> 1;
                if (_data[p].CompareTo(value) <= 0) break;
                _data[i] = _data[p];
                i = p;
            }
            _data[i] = value;
        }

        public T Pop()
        {
            T root = _data[0];
            T x = _data[--Count];
            if (Count > 0)
            {
                int i = 0;
                while (true)
                {
                    int l = (i << 1) + 1;
                    if (l >= Count) break;
                    int r = l + 1;
                    int c = r < Count && _data[r].CompareTo(_data[l]) < 0 ? r : l;
                    if (_data[c].CompareTo(x) >= 0) break;
                    _data[i] = _data[c];
                    i = c;
                }
                _data[i] = x;
            }
            return root;
        }
    }

    sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly Stream _stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
        private readonly byte[] _buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int _len;
        private int _ptr;

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_ptr >= _len)
            {
                _len = _stream.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _ptr = 0;
                if (_len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return _buffer[_ptr++];
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c;
            do c = Read(); while (c <= 32 && c >= 0);
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            int val = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return val * sign;
        }
    }

    static int n;
    static int m;
    static int[] wHead = Array.Empty<int>();
    static WeightedArc[] wEdges = Array.Empty<WeightedArc>();
    static int wPtr;
    static int[] degree = Array.Empty<int>();
    static int[] origU = Array.Empty<int>();
    static int[] origV = Array.Empty<int>();
    static bool[] reachable = Array.Empty<bool>();

    static void AddWeightedArc(int u, int v, int cost)
    {
        wEdges[wPtr] = new WeightedArc { To = v, Next = wHead[u], Cost = cost };
        wHead[u] = wPtr++;
    }

    static void MarkReachableFromZero()
    {
        reachable = new bool[n];
        if (n == 0) return;
        var q = new Queue<int>();
        q.Enqueue(0);
        reachable[0] = true;
        while (q.Count > 0)
        {
            int u = q.Dequeue();
            for (int ei = wHead[u]; ei != -1; ei = wEdges[ei].Next)
            {
                int v = wEdges[ei].To;
                if (!reachable[v])
                {
                    reachable[v] = true;
                    q.Enqueue(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Dijkstra(int src, long[] dist, int[] parent)
    {
        const long INF = long.MaxValue / 4;
        Array.Fill(dist, INF);
        Array.Fill(parent, -1);
        var heap = new MinHeap<HeapNode>(Math.Max(16, n / 8));
        dist[src] = 0;
        heap.Push(new HeapNode { Dist = 0, Node = src });

        while (heap.Count > 0)
        {
            var cur = heap.Pop();
            if (cur.Dist != dist[cur.Node]) continue;
            int u = cur.Node;
            for (int ei = wHead[u]; ei != -1; ei = wEdges[ei].Next)
            {
                ref WeightedArc e = ref wEdges[ei];
                long nd = cur.Dist + e.Cost;
                if (nd < dist[e.To])
                {
                    dist[e.To] = nd;
                    parent[e.To] = u;
                    heap.Push(new HeapNode { Dist = nd, Node = e.To });
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static List<(int a, int b)> ComputePairings(List<int> odd)

                    cost[j, i] = dist[odd[j]];

            int size = 1 << k;

            int[] pickI = new int[size];

            for (int mask = 1; mask < size; mask++) dp[mask] = INF;

            for (int mask = 1; mask < size; mask++)

                int i;
                for (i = 0; i < k; i++) if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) break;
                int rest = mask ^ (1 << i);
                for (int j = i + 1; j < k; j++)
                {
                    if (((rest >> j) & 1) == 0) continue;
                    int next = rest ^ (1 << j);
                    long cand = dp[next] + cost[i, j];
                    if (cand < dp[mask])

                        dp[mask] = cand;
                        pickI[mask] = i;
                        pickJ[mask] = j;

            for (int mask = size - 1; mask != 0;)

                int i = pickI[mask];
                int j = pickJ[mask];
                result.Add((odd[i], odd[j]));
                mask ^= 1 << i;
                mask ^= 1 << j;

            return result;

        long[] tmpDist = new long[n];

        var cached = new Dictionary<int, long[]>();

        while (unmatched.Count > 0)

            if (!cached.TryGetValue(a, out var da))

            int bestIndex = 0;
            long best = long.MaxValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < unmatched.Count; i++)
            {
                long d = da[unmatched[i]];
                if (d < best)
                {
                    best = d;
                    bestIndex = i;
                }
            }
            int b = unmatched[bestIndex];
            unmatched.RemoveAt(bestIndex);
            result.Add((a, b));
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void AddPathEdges(int src, int dst, List<int> extraU, List<int> extraV)
    {
        long[] dist = new long[n];
        int[] parent = new int[n];
        Dijkstra(src, dist, parent);
        int cur = dst;
        while (cur != src)
        {
            int prev = parent[cur];
            extraU.Add(prev);
            extraV.Add(cur);
            cur = prev;
        }
    }

    static List<int> BuildEulerTour(List<int> extraU, List<int> extraV)
    {
        int totalEdges = m + extraU.Count;
        int[] head = new int[n];
        Array.Fill(head, -1);
        EulerArc[] arcs = new EulerArc[Math.Max(2, totalEdges * 2)];
        bool[] used = new bool[totalEdges];
        int ptr = 0;

        void AddEulerArc(int u, int v, int id)
        {
            arcs[ptr] = new EulerArc { To = v, Next = head[u], UndirectedId = id };
            head[u] = ptr++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            AddEulerArc(origU[i], origV[i], i);
            AddEulerArc(origV[i], origU[i], i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < extraU.Count; i++)
        {
            int id = m + i;
            AddEulerArc(extraU[i], extraV[i], id);
            AddEulerArc(extraV[i], extraU[i], id);
        }

        int[] nextArc = new int[n];
        Array.Copy(head, nextArc, n);
        var stack = new Stack<int>();
        var route = new List<int>(totalEdges + 1);
        stack.Push(0);

        while (stack.Count > 0)
        {
            int v = stack.Peek();
            int ei = nextArc[v];
            while (ei != -1 && used[arcs[ei].UndirectedId]) ei = arcs[ei].Next;
            nextArc[v] = ei;
            if (ei == -1)
            {
                route.Add(v);
                stack.Pop();
            }
            else
            {
                used[arcs[ei].UndirectedId] = true;
                nextArc[v] = arcs[ei].Next;
                stack.Push(arcs[ei].To);
            }
        }

        route.Reverse();
        return route;
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        var fs = new FastScanner();
        n = fs.NextInt();
        m = fs.NextInt();

        wHead = new int[n];
        Array.Fill(wHead, -1);
        wEdges = new WeightedArc[Math.Max(2, m * 2)];
        degree = new int[n];
        origU = new int[m];
        origV = new int[m];
        wPtr = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            int u = fs.NextInt();
            int v = fs.NextInt();
            int w = fs.NextInt();
            origU[i] = u;
            origV[i] = v;
            AddWeightedArc(u, v, w);
            AddWeightedArc(v, u, w);
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

        if (m == 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("0");
            return;
        }

        MarkReachableFromZero();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            if (!reachable[origU[i]] || !reachable[origV[i]])
            {
                Console.WriteLine("0");
                return;
            }
        }

        var odd = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (reachable[i] && (degree[i] & 1) != 0) odd.Add(i);
        }

        var pairings = ComputePairings(odd);
        var extraU = new List<int>(Math.Max(4, pairings.Count * 2));
        var extraV = new List<int>(Math.Max(4, pairings.Count * 2));
        foreach (var p in pairings) AddPathEdges(p.a, p.b, extraU, extraV);

        var route = BuildEulerTour(extraU, extraV);
        var sb = new StringBuilder(route.Count * 3 + 16);
        for (int i = 0; i < route.Count; i++)
        {
            if (i > 0) sb.Append(' ');
            sb.Append(route[i]);
        }
        Console.Write(sb.ToString());
    }
}

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::f64::consts::PI;
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl Point {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Self {
        Self { x, y }
    }
}

struct XorShift64 {
    state: u64,
}

impl XorShift64 {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        let state = if seed == 0 { 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 } else { seed };
        Self { state }
    }

    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let mut x = self.state;
        x ^= x << 7;
        x ^= x >> 9;
        x ^= x << 8;
        self.state = x;
        x
    }

    fn next_f64(&mut self) -> f64 {
        const SCALE: f64 = 1.0 / ((1u64 << 53) as f64);
        ((self.next_u64() >> 11) as f64) * SCALE
    }

    fn gen_range(&mut self, upper: usize) -> usize {
        if upper <= 1 {
            0
        } else {
            (self.next_u64() as usize) % upper
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();
    let n: usize = it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    let m: usize = it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);

    if n == 0 {
        return;
    }

    let mut edges_raw = Vec::with_capacity(m);
    let mut adj = vec![Vec::<usize>::new(); n];
    let mut degree = vec![0usize; n];

    for _ in 0..m {
        let Some(us) = it.next() else { break };
        let Some(vs) = it.next() else { break };
        let Ok(u) = us.parse::<usize>() else { continue };
        let Ok(v) = vs.parse::<usize>() else { continue };
        if u >= n || v >= n {
            continue;
        }
        edges_raw.push((u, v));
        if u != v {
            adj[u].push(v);
            adj[v].push(u);
            degree[u] += 1;
            degree[v] += 1;
        }
    }

    let components = connected_components(n, &adj);
    let max_deg = degree.iter().copied().max().unwrap_or(0);
    let density = if n > 1 {
        (2.0 * edges_raw.len() as f64) / ((n * (n - 1)) as f64)
    } else {
        0.0
    };

    let mut positions = if n <= 64 && edges_raw.len() <= 256 {
        layout_small(n, &adj, &degree, &components)
    } else if n <= 3000 {
        layout_medium(n, &adj, &degree, &components, density)
    } else {
        layout_large(n, &adj, &degree, &components, max_deg)
    };

    normalize_positions(&mut positions);

    for p in positions {
        println!("{:.6} {:.6}", p.x, p.y);
    }
}

fn connected_components(n: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> Vec<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut vis = vec![false; n];
    let mut comps = Vec::new();
    let mut q = VecDeque::new();
    for s in 0..n {
        if vis[s] {
            continue;
        }
        vis[s] = true;
        q.push_back(s);
        let mut comp = Vec::new();
        while let Some(u) = q.pop_front() {
            comp.push(u);
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if !vis[v] {
                    vis[v] = true;
                    q.push_back(v);
                }
            }
        }
        comps.push(comp);
    }
    comps
}

fn bfs_order(start: usize, nodes: &[usize], adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut in_comp = vec![false; adj.len()];
    for &u in nodes {
        in_comp[u] = true;
    }
    let mut q = VecDeque::new();
    let mut vis = vec![false; adj.len()];
    let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(nodes.len());
    vis[start] = true;
    q.push_back(start);
    while let Some(u) = q.pop_front() {
        order.push(u);
        let mut neigh = adj[u]
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .filter(|&v| in_comp[v] && !vis[v])
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        neigh.sort_unstable();
        for v in neigh {
            vis[v] = true;
            q.push_back(v);
        }
    }
    for &u in nodes {
        if !vis[u] {
            vis[u] = true;
            q.push_back(u);
            while let Some(x) = q.pop_front() {
                order.push(x);
                for &v in &adj[x] {
                    if in_comp[v] && !vis[v] {
                        vis[v] = true;
                        q.push_back(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    order
}

fn pseudo_peripheral(nodes: &[usize], adj: &[Vec<usize>], degree: &[usize]) -> usize {
    let mut start = nodes[0];
    for &u in nodes {
        if degree[u] < degree[start] {
            start = u;
        }
    }
    let mut best = start;
    let mut last_depth = 0usize;
    for _ in 0..4 {
        let (far, depth) = farthest_in_component(best, nodes, adj);
        if depth <= last_depth {
            break;
        }
        last_depth = depth;
        best = far;
    }
    best
}

fn farthest_in_component(start: usize, nodes: &[usize], adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> (usize, usize) {
    let mut in_comp = vec![false; adj.len()];
    for &u in nodes {
        in_comp[u] = true;
    }
    let mut dist = vec![usize::MAX; adj.len()];
    let mut q = VecDeque::new();
    q.push_back(start);
    dist[start] = 0;
    let mut best = start;
    while let Some(u) = q.pop_front() {
        if dist[u] > dist[best] {
            best = u;
        }
        for &v in &adj[u] {
            if in_comp[v] && dist[v] == usize::MAX {
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                q.push_back(v);
            }
        }
    }
    (best, dist[best])
}

fn layout_small(
    n: usize,
    adj: &[Vec<usize>],
    degree: &[usize],
    components: &[Vec<usize>],
) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pos = vec![Point::new(0.0, 0.0); n];
    let mut x_offset = 0.0;
    let gap = 8.0;

    let mut comps = components.to_vec();
    comps.sort_by_key(|c| std::cmp::Reverse(c.len()));

    for comp in comps {
        if comp.len() == 1 {
            pos[comp[0]] = Point::new(x_offset, 0.0);
            x_offset += gap;
            continue;
        }

        let start = pseudo_peripheral(&comp, adj, degree);
        let order = bfs_order(start, &comp, adj);
        let mut rank = HashMap::with_capacity(order.len());
        for (i, &u) in order.iter().enumerate() {
            rank.insert(u, i);
        }

        let mut bary = Vec::with_capacity(comp.len());
        for &u in &comp {
            let sum = adj[u]
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|v| rank.get(v).copied())
                .map(|x| x as f64)
                .sum::<f64>();
            let cnt = adj[u].iter().filter(|v| rank.contains_key(v)).count().max(1) as f64;
            bary.push((u, sum / cnt, degree[u]));
        }
        bary.sort_by(|a, b| {
            a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1)
                .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
                .then_with(|| b.2.cmp(&a.2))
                .then_with(|| a.0.cmp(&b.0))
        });

        let radius = (comp.len() as f64).max(3.0);
        for (i, &(u, _, _)) in bary.iter().enumerate() {
            let angle = 2.0 * PI * (i as f64) / (bary.len() as f64);
            pos[u] = Point::new(
                x_offset + radius * angle.cos(),
                radius * angle.sin(),
            );
        }
        x_offset += 2.5 * radius + gap;
    }

    pos
}

fn layout_medium(
    n: usize,
    adj: &[Vec<usize>],
    degree: &[usize],
    components: &[Vec<usize>],
    density: f64,
) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pos = spectral_seed(n, adj, degree, components);
    let iterations = if n <= 200 { 80 } else if n <= 800 { 50 } else { 24 };
    force_refine(&mut pos, adj, degree, iterations, density, 20_000);
    pack_components(&mut pos, components);
    pos
}

fn layout_large(
    n: usize,
    adj: &[Vec<usize>],
    degree: &[usize],
    components: &[Vec<usize>],
    max_deg: usize,
) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pos = vec![Point::new(0.0, 0.0); n];
    let mut comps = components.to_vec();
    comps.sort_by_key(|c| std::cmp::Reverse(c.len()));

    let seed = (n as u64).wrapping_mul(1_000_003) ^ (adj.len() as u64).wrapping_mul(97_003);
    let mut rng = XorShift64::new(seed);
    let mut x_offset = 0.0;

    for comp in comps {
        if comp.len() == 1 {
            pos[comp[0]] = Point::new(x_offset, 0.0);
            x_offset += 4.0;
            continue;
        }

        let start = pseudo_peripheral(&comp, adj, degree);
        let levels = bfs_levels(start, &comp, adj);
        let width = levels.iter().map(|lvl| lvl.len()).max().unwrap_or(1) as f64;
        let spread_x = (width.sqrt() + 1.0) * 3.0;
        let spread_y = (levels.len() as f64).max(2.0) * 2.2;

        for (depth, level) in levels.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut nodes = level.clone();
            nodes.sort_by_key(|&u| std::cmp::Reverse(degree[u]));
            let len = nodes.len();
            for (i, &u) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {
                let frac = if len <= 1 {
                    0.0
                } else {
                    (i as f64) / ((len - 1) as f64) - 0.5
                };
                let jitter = (rng.next_f64() - 0.5) * 0.35;
                pos[u] = Point::new(
                    x_offset + frac * spread_x + jitter,
                    depth as f64 * 2.0 + (rng.next_f64() - 0.5) * 0.2,
                );
            }
        }

        if comp.len() <= 20_000 {
            let passes = if comp.len() <= 8_000 { 10 } else { 5 };
            sampled_force_component(&mut pos, &comp, adj, degree, passes, max_deg, &mut rng);
        }

        x_offset += spread_x + (comp.len() as f64).sqrt() + 8.0;
        let _ = spread_y;
    }

    pos
}

fn bfs_levels(start: usize, nodes: &[usize], adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> Vec<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut in_comp = vec![false; adj.len()];
    for &u in nodes {
        in_comp[u] = true;
    }
    let mut dist = vec![usize::MAX; adj.len()];
    let mut q = VecDeque::new();
    q.push_back(start);
    dist[start] = 0;
    let mut levels = Vec::<Vec<usize>>::new();
    while let Some(u) = q.pop_front() {
        let d = dist[u];
        if levels.len() <= d {
            levels.push(Vec::new());
        }
        levels[d].push(u);
        for &v in &adj[u] {
            if in_comp[v] && dist[v] == usize::MAX {
                dist[v] = d + 1;
                q.push_back(v);
            }
        }
    }
    for &u in nodes {
        if dist[u] == usize::MAX {
            if levels.is_empty() {
                levels.push(Vec::new());
            }
            levels[0].push(u);
        }
    }
    levels
}

fn spectral_seed(
    n: usize,
    adj: &[Vec<usize>],
    degree: &[usize],
    components: &[Vec<usize>],
) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pos = vec![Point::new(0.0, 0.0); n];
    let mut x_offset = 0.0;

    let mut comps = components.to_vec();
    comps.sort_by_key(|c| std::cmp::Reverse(c.len()));

    for comp in comps {
        if comp.len() == 1 {
            pos[comp[0]] = Point::new(x_offset, 0.0);
            x_offset += 6.0;
            continue;
        }
        let root = pseudo_peripheral(&comp, adj, degree);
        let levels = bfs_levels(root, &comp, adj);
        let comp_width = levels.iter().map(|lvl| lvl.len()).max().unwrap_or(1) as f64;
        let span_x = comp_width.sqrt() * 5.0 + 4.0;
        for (depth, level) in levels.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut sorted = level.clone();
            sorted.sort_by(|&a, &b| degree[b].cmp(&degree[a]).then_with(|| a.cmp(&b)));
            let len = sorted.len();
            for (i, &u) in sorted.iter().enumerate() {
                let frac = if len <= 1 {
                    0.0
                } else {
                    (i as f64) / ((len - 1) as f64) - 0.5
                };
                pos[u] = Point::new(
                    x_offset + frac * span_x,
                    depth as f64 * 2.0,
                );
            }
        }
        x_offset += span_x + 8.0;
    }

    pos
}

fn force_refine(
    pos: &mut [Point],
    adj: &[Vec<usize>],
    degree: &[usize],
    iterations: usize,
    density: f64,
    repulsion_budget: usize,
) {
    let n = pos.len();
    if n <= 1 {
        return;
    }
    let mut rng = XorShift64::new((n as u64) ^ 0xA5A5_5A5A_DEAD_BEEF);
    let area = (n as f64).max(1.0) * 25.0;
    let k = area.sqrt() / (n as f64).sqrt();
    let edge_scale = if density > 0.15 { 0.08 } else { 0.18 };

    for it in 0..iterations {
        let temp = (1.0 - (it as f64) / (iterations as f64)).max(0.05) * k * 2.5;
        let mut disp = vec![Point::new(0.0, 0.0); n];

        let samples = repulsion_budget.min(n.saturating_mul(12)).max(n);
        for _ in 0..samples {
            let u = rng.gen_range(n);
            let v = rng.gen_range(n);
            if u == v {
                continue;
            }
            let dx = pos[u].x - pos[v].x;
            let dy = pos[u].y - pos[v].y;
            let dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + 1e-6;
            let force = (k * k) / dist2;
            disp[u].x += dx * force;
            disp[u].y += dy * force;
            disp[v].x -= dx * force;
            disp[v].y -= dy * force;
        }

        for u in 0..n {
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if u < v {
                    let dx = pos[u].x - pos[v].x;
                    let dy = pos[u].y - pos[v].y;
                    let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy + 1e-6).sqrt();
                    let desired = k * (1.0 + 0.05 * ((degree[u] + degree[v]) as f64).sqrt());
                    let force = edge_scale * (dist - desired) / dist;
                    let fx = dx * force;
                    let fy = dy * force;
                    disp[u].x -= fx;
                    disp[u].y -= fy;
                    disp[v].x += fx;
                    disp[v].y += fy;
                }
            }
        }

        for u in 0..n {
            let norm = (disp[u].x * disp[u].x + disp[u].y * disp[u].y).sqrt();
            if norm > 0.0 {
                let scale = temp.min(norm) / norm;
                pos[u].x += disp[u].x * scale;
                pos[u].y += disp[u].y * scale;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn sampled_force_component(
    pos: &mut [Point],
    comp: &[usize],
    adj: &[Vec<usize>],
    degree: &[usize],
    passes: usize,
    max_deg: usize,
    rng: &mut XorShift64,
) {
    let k = ((comp.len() as f64).sqrt()).max(2.0);
    let sample_size = (32usize).min(comp.len().saturating_sub(1)).max(8);
    let edge_factor = if max_deg > 128 { 0.04 } else { 0.08 };

    for pass in 0..passes {
        let step = (1.0 - pass as f64 / passes as f64).max(0.15);
        for &u in comp {
            let mut fx = 0.0;
            let mut fy = 0.0;
            for _ in 0..sample_size {
                let mut v = comp[rng.gen_range(comp.len())];
                if v == u && comp.len() > 1 {
                    v = comp[(rng.gen_range(comp.len() - 1) + 1) % comp.len()];
                }
                if v == u {
                    continue;
                }
                let dx = pos[u].x - pos[v].x;
                let dy = pos[u].y - pos[v].y;
                let dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + 1e-6;
                let rep = (k * k) / dist2;
                fx += dx * rep;
                fy += dy * rep;
            }
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                let dx = pos[v].x - pos[u].x;
                let dy = pos[v].y - pos[u].y;
                let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy + 1e-6).sqrt();
                let target = 1.5 + 0.03 * ((degree[u] + degree[v]) as f64).sqrt();
                let att = edge_factor * (dist - target);
                fx += dx / dist * att;
                fy += dy / dist * att;
            }
            pos[u].x += fx * 0.0025 * step;
            pos[u].y += fy * 0.0025 * step;
        }
    }
}

fn pack_components(pos: &mut [Point], components: &[Vec<usize>]) {
    let mut comps = components.to_vec();
    comps.sort_by_key(|c| std::cmp::Reverse(c.len()));
    let mut cursor_x = 0.0;
    let mut cursor_y = 0.0;
    let mut row_height = 0.0;
    let row_limit = (components.len() as f64).sqrt().ceil().max(1.0) as usize;

    for (idx, comp) in comps.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        for &u in comp {
            min_x = min_x.min(pos[u].x);
            max_x = max_x.max(pos[u].x);
            min_y = min_y.min(pos[u].y);
            max_y = max_y.max(pos[u].y);
        }
        let w = (max_x - min_x).max(1.0);
        let h = (max_y - min_y).max(1.0);
        if idx > 0 && idx % row_limit == 0 {
            cursor_x = 0.0;
            cursor_y += row_height + 8.0;
            row_height = 0.0;
        }
        for &u in comp {
            pos[u].x += cursor_x - min_x;
            pos[u].y += cursor_y - min_y;
        }
        cursor_x += w + 8.0;
        row_height = row_height.max(h);
    }
}

fn normalize_positions(pos: &mut [Point]) {
    if pos.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    for p in pos.iter() {
        min_x = min_x.min(p.x);
        max_x = max_x.max(p.x);
        min_y = min_y.min(p.y);
        max_y = max_y.max(p.y);
    }
    let cx = 0.5 * (min_x + max_x);
    let cy = 0.5 * (min_y + max_y);
    let span = (max_x - min_x).max(max_y - min_y).max(1.0);
    let scale = 1000.0 / span;
    for p in pos.iter_mut() {
        p.x = (p.x - cx) * scale;
        p.y = (p.y - cy) * scale;
    }
}

namespace {

constexpr double kPi = 3.141592653589793238462643383279502884;
constexpr double kSqrt2 = 1.41421356237309504880168872420969808;
constexpr double kTetHeight = std::sqrt(2.0 / 3.0);
constexpr double kTetCircumradius = std::sqrt(3.0 / 8.0);
constexpr double kTetInradius = 1.0 / std::sqrt(24.0);
constexpr double kTetVolume = std::sqrt(2.0) / 12.0;
constexpr double kEps = 1e-9;

struct Vec3 {
    double x = 0.0;
    double y = 0.0;
    double z = 0.0;

    Vec3() = default;
    Vec3(double x_, double y_, double z_) : x(x_), y(y_), z(z_) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& other) const { return {x + other.x, y + other.y, z + other.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& other) const { return {x - other.x, y - other.y, z - other.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(double s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vec3 operator/(double s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }
    Vec3& operator+=(const Vec3& other) {
        x += other.x;
        y += other.y;
        z += other.z;
        return *this;
    }
};

Vec3 operator*(double s, const Vec3& v) { return v * s; }

double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

Vec3 cross(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return {
        a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
        a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
        a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x
    };
}

double norm2(const Vec3& v) {
    return dot(v, v);
}

double norm(const Vec3& v) {
    return std::sqrt(norm2(v));
}

Vec3 normalized(const Vec3& v) {
    const double n = norm(v);
    if (n <= kEps) {
        return {0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    }
    return v / n;
}

struct Mat3 {
    double m[3][3]{};

    static Mat3 identity() {
        Mat3 r;
        r.m[0][0] = r.m[1][1] = r.m[2][2] = 1.0;
        return r;
    }

    Vec3 operator*(const Vec3& v) const {
        return {
            m[0][0] * v.x + m[0][1] * v.y + m[0][2] * v.z,
            m[1][0] * v.x + m[1][1] * v.y + m[1][2] * v.z,
            m[2][0] * v.x + m[2][1] * v.y + m[2][2] * v.z
        };
    }
};

Mat3 transpose(const Mat3& a) {
    Mat3 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            r.m[i][j] = a.m[j][i];
        }
    }
    return r;
}

Mat3 operator*(const Mat3& a, const Mat3& b) {
    Mat3 r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            double value = 0.0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k) {
                value += a.m[i][k] * b.m[k][j];
            }
            r.m[i][j] = value;
        }
    }
    return r;
}

Mat3 rotationFromAxisAngle(const Vec3& axisRaw, double angle) {
    Vec3 axis = normalized(axisRaw);
    if (norm2(axis) <= kEps || std::abs(angle) <= kEps) {
        return Mat3::identity();
    }
    const double c = std::cos(angle);
    const double s = std::sin(angle);
    const double t = 1.0 - c;
    const double x = axis.x;
    const double y = axis.y;
    const double z = axis.z;
    Mat3 r;
    r.m[0][0] = t * x * x + c;
    r.m[0][1] = t * x * y - s * z;
    r.m[0][2] = t * x * z + s * y;
    r.m[1][0] = t * x * y + s * z;
    r.m[1][1] = t * y * y + c;
    r.m[1][2] = t * y * z - s * x;
    r.m[2][0] = t * x * z - s * y;
    r.m[2][1] = t * y * z + s * x;
    r.m[2][2] = t * z * z + c;
    return r;
}

Mat3 rotationAlignZTo(const Vec3& targetRaw) {
    Vec3 target = normalized(targetRaw);
    if (norm2(target) <= kEps) {
        return Mat3::identity();
    }
    const Vec3 zAxis{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
    const double c = std::clamp(dot(zAxis, target), -1.0, 1.0);
    if (c > 1.0 - 1e-12) {
        return Mat3::identity();
    }
    if (c < -1.0 + 1e-12) {
        return rotationFromAxisAngle({1.0, 0.0, 0.0}, kPi);
    }
    const Vec3 axis = cross(zAxis, target);
    const double angle = std::acos(c);
    return rotationFromAxisAngle(axis, angle);
}

std::array<double, 3> matrixToEulerXYZ(const Mat3& r) {
    // Intrinsic XYZ angles, matching R = Rz(rz) * Ry(ry) * Rx(rx).
    double ry = std::asin(std::clamp(-r.m[2][0], -1.0, 1.0));
    double rx = 0.0;
    double rz = 0.0;
    if (std::abs(std::cos(ry)) > 1e-9) {
        rx = std::atan2(r.m[2][1], r.m[2][2]);
        rz = std::atan2(r.m[1][0], r.m[0][0]);
    } else {
        rx = std::atan2(-r.m[1][2], r.m[1][1]);
        rz = 0.0;
    }
    return {rx, ry, rz};
}

struct Face {
    int a = -1;
    int b = -1;
    int c = -1;
    Vec3 normal;
    double d = 0.0;
};

struct Plane {
    Vec3 n;
    double d = 0.0;
};

struct Placement {
    Vec3 center;
    std::array<double, 3> euler{};
    Mat3 rotation;
    std::array<Vec3, 4> vertices;
};

struct CellKey {
    int x = 0;
    int y = 0;
    int z = 0;

    bool operator==(const CellKey& other) const {
        return x == other.x && y == other.y && z == other.z;
    }
};

struct CellKeyHasher {
    std::size_t operator()(const CellKey& key) const noexcept {
        std::size_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
        h ^= static_cast<std::size_t>(key.x + 0x9e3779b9);
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
        h ^= static_cast<std::size_t>(key.y + 0x85ebca6b);
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
        h ^= static_cast<std::size_t>(key.z + 0xc2b2ae35);
        h *= 1099511628211ull;
        return h;
    }
};

struct SpatialHash {
    double cell = 1.25;
    std::unordered_map<CellKey, std::vector<int>, CellKeyHasher> buckets;
    std::vector<Vec3> centers;

    explicit SpatialHash(double cellSize) : cell(cellSize) {}

    CellKey keyFor(const Vec3& p) const {
        return {
            static_cast<int>(std::floor(p.x / cell)),
            static_cast<int>(std::floor(p.y / cell)),
            static_cast<int>(std::floor(p.z / cell))
        };
    }

    void insert(const Vec3& p, int index) {
        centers.push_back(p);
        buckets[keyFor(p)].push_back(index);
    }

    template <typename Fn>
    void forNearby(const Vec3& p, Fn&& fn) const {
        const CellKey base = keyFor(p);
        for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) {
                for (int dz = -1; dz <= 1; ++dz) {
                    CellKey key{base.x + dx, base.y + dy, base.z + dz};
                    auto it = buckets.find(key);
                    if (it == buckets.end()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    for (int idx : it->second) {
                        fn(idx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

struct Hull {
    std::vector<Vec3> vertices;
    std::vector<Face> faces;
    std::vector<Plane> planes;
    Vec3 minBound{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    Vec3 maxBound{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    Vec3 centroid{0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    double approxVolume = 0.0;
};

bool sameFace(const Face& f, int a, int b, int c) {
    std::array<int, 3> lhs{f.a, f.b, f.c};
    std::array<int, 3> rhs{a, b, c};
    std::sort(lhs.begin(), lhs.end());
    std::sort(rhs.begin(), rhs.end());
    return lhs == rhs;
}

Hull buildHull(const std::vector<Vec3>& points) {
    Hull hull;
    hull.vertices = points;
    if (points.empty()) {
        return hull;
    }

    hull.minBound = hull.maxBound = points.front();
    for (const Vec3& p : points) {
        hull.centroid += p;
        hull.minBound.x = std::min(hull.minBound.x, p.x);
        hull.minBound.y = std::min(hull.minBound.y, p.y);
        hull.minBound.z = std::min(hull.minBound.z, p.z);
        hull.maxBound.x = std::max(hull.maxBound.x, p.x);
        hull.maxBound.y = std::max(hull.maxBound.y, p.y);
        hull.maxBound.z = std::max(hull.maxBound.z, p.z);
    }
    hull.centroid = hull.centroid / static_cast<double>(points.size());

    const int n = static_cast<int>(points.size());
    std::vector<Face> faces;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            for (int k = j + 1; k < n; ++k) {
                Vec3 normal = cross(points[j] - points[i], points[k] - points[i]);
                const double len = norm(normal);
                if (len <= 1e-10) {
                    continue;
                }
                normal = normal / len;
                double pos = 0.0;
                double neg = 0.0;
                for (int t = 0; t < n; ++t) {
                    if (t == i || t == j || t == k) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    const double side = dot(normal, points[t] - points[i]);
                    if (side > 1e-8) {
                        pos += 1.0;
                    } else if (side < -1e-8) {
                        neg += 1.0;
                    }
                    if (pos > 0.0 && neg > 0.0) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (pos > 0.0 && neg > 0.0) {
                    continue;
                }
                Face face;
                if (pos == 0.0) {
                    face = {i, j, k, normal, dot(normal, points[i])};
                } else {
                    face = {i, k, j, -1.0 * normal, dot(-1.0 * normal, points[i])};
                }
                bool duplicate = false;
                for (const Face& existing : faces) {
                    if (sameFace(existing, face.a, face.b, face.c)) {
                        duplicate = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!duplicate) {
                    faces.push_back(face);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    hull.faces = faces;
    hull.planes.reserve(faces.size());
    for (const Face& face : faces) {
        hull.planes.push_back({face.normal, face.d});
        const Vec3& a = points[face.a];
        const Vec3& b = points[face.b];
        const Vec3& c = points[face.c];
        hull.approxVolume += dot(a, cross(b, c)) / 6.0;
    }
    hull.approxVolume = std::abs(hull.approxVolume);
    return hull;
}

bool insideHull(const Hull& hull, const Vec3& p, double margin = 0.0) {
    for (const Plane& plane : hull.planes) {
        if (dot(plane.n, p) > plane.d - margin) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

Vec3 supportPoint(const std::array<Vec3, 4>& verts, const Vec3& dir) {
    double best = dot(verts[0], dir);
    Vec3 result = verts[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < 4; ++i) {
        const double value = dot(verts[i], dir);
        if (value > best) {
            best = value;
            result = verts[i];
        }
    }
    return result;
}

Vec3 supportMinkowski(const std::array<Vec3, 4>& a, const std::array<Vec3, 4>& b, const Vec3& dir) {
    return supportPoint(a, dir) - supportPoint(b, -1.0 * dir);
}

bool sameDirection(const Vec3& dir, const Vec3& ao) {
    return dot(dir, ao) > 0.0;
}

bool handleLine(std::vector<Vec3>& simplex, Vec3& dir) {
    const Vec3 a = simplex.back();
    const Vec3 b = simplex[simplex.size() - 2];
    const Vec3 ab = b - a;
    const Vec3 ao = -1.0 * a;
    if (sameDirection(ab, ao)) {
        dir = cross(cross(ab, ao), ab);
    } else {
        simplex = {a};
        dir = ao;
    }
    return false;
}

bool handleTriangle(std::vector<Vec3>& simplex, Vec3& dir) {
    const Vec3 a = simplex[2];
    const Vec3 b = simplex[1];
    const Vec3 c = simplex[0];
    const Vec3 ab = b - a;
    const Vec3 ac = c - a;
    const Vec3 ao = -1.0 * a;
    const Vec3 abc = cross(ab, ac);

    const Vec3 abPerp = cross(abc, ab);
    if (sameDirection(abPerp, ao)) {
        simplex = {b, a};
        dir = cross(cross(ab, ao), ab);
        return false;
    }

    const Vec3 acPerp = cross(ac, abc);
    if (sameDirection(acPerp, ao)) {
        simplex = {c, a};
        dir = cross(cross(ac, ao), ac);
        return false;
    }

    if (sameDirection(abc, ao)) {
        dir = abc;
    } else {
        simplex = {b, c, a};
        dir = -1.0 * abc;
    }
    return false;
}

bool handleTetra(std::vector<Vec3>& simplex, Vec3& dir) {
    const Vec3 a = simplex[3];
    const Vec3 b = simplex[2];
    const Vec3 c = simplex[1];
    const Vec3 d = simplex[0];
    const Vec3 ao = -1.0 * a;

    const Vec3 abc = cross(b - a, c - a);
    if (sameDirection(abc, ao)) {
        simplex = {c, b, a};
        dir = abc;
        return false;
    }

    const Vec3 acd = cross(c - a, d - a);
    if (sameDirection(acd, ao)) {
        simplex = {d, c, a};
        dir = acd;
        return false;
    }

    const Vec3 adb = cross(d - a, b - a);
    if (sameDirection(adb, ao)) {
        simplex = {b, d, a};
        dir = adb;
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

bool nextSimplex(std::vector<Vec3>& simplex, Vec3& dir) {
    switch (simplex.size()) {
        case 2: return handleLine(simplex, dir);
        case 3: return handleTriangle(simplex, dir);
        case 4: return handleTetra(simplex, dir);
        default: return false;
    }
}

bool tetrahedraOverlap(const std::array<Vec3, 4>& a, const std::array<Vec3, 4>& b) {
    Vec3 dir{1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
    std::vector<Vec3> simplex;
    simplex.reserve(4);
    simplex.push_back(supportMinkowski(a, b, dir));
    dir = -1.0 * simplex[0];
    for (int iter = 0; iter < 32; ++iter) {
        Vec3 p = supportMinkowski(a, b, dir);
        if (dot(p, dir) < 1e-9) {
            return false;
        }
        simplex.push_back(p);
        if (nextSimplex(simplex, dir)) {
            return true;
        }
        if (norm2(dir) <= 1e-16) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

std::array<Vec3, 4> canonicalTetra() {
    // Centered canonical regular tetrahedron with unit edge length.
    const double s = 1.0 / (2.0 * kSqrt2);
    return {
        Vec3{ s,  s,  s},
        Vec3{ s, -s, -s},
        Vec3{-s,  s, -s},
        Vec3{-s, -s,  s}
    };
}

Placement makePlacement(const Vec3& center, const Vec3& axis, double spin, const std::array<Vec3, 4>& canonical) {
    const Mat3 align = rotationAlignZTo(axis);
    const Mat3 twist = rotationFromAxisAngle(axis, spin);
    const Mat3 rot = twist * align;
    Placement placement;
    placement.center = center;
    placement.rotation = rot;
    placement.euler = matrixToEulerXYZ(rot);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        placement.vertices[i] = center + rot * canonical[i];
    }
    return placement;
}

bool fitsInside(const Hull& hull, const Placement& placement) {
    for (const Vec3& v : placement.vertices) {
        if (!insideHull(hull, v, 1e-8)) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

struct Candidate {
    Vec3 center;
    Vec3 axis;
    double spin = 0.0;
    double score = 0.0;
};

std::vector<Vec3> buildAxisSet() {
    std::vector<Vec3> axes;
    axes.push_back({0.0, 0.0, 1.0});
    axes.push_back({0.0, 0.0, -1.0});
    const double inv = 1.0 / std::sqrt(3.0);
    for (int sx : {-1, 1}) {
        for (int sy : {-1, 1}) {
            for (int sz : {-1, 1}) {
                axes.push_back({sx * inv, sy * inv, sz * inv});
            }
        }
    }
    axes.push_back(normalized(Vec3{1.0, 1.0, 0.0}));
    axes.push_back(normalized(Vec3{1.0, -1.0, 0.0}));
    axes.push_back(normalized(Vec3{1.0, 0.0, 1.0}));
    axes.push_back(normalized(Vec3{1.0, 0.0, -1.0}));
    axes.push_back(normalized(Vec3{0.0, 1.0, 1.0}));
    axes.push_back(normalized(Vec3{0.0, 1.0, -1.0}));
    return axes;
}

std::vector<double> buildSpins() {
    return {0.0, kPi / 3.0, 2.0 * kPi / 3.0, kPi, 4.0 * kPi / 3.0, 5.0 * kPi / 3.0};
}

std::vector<Vec3> buildGridCenters(const Hull& hull, std::size_t budget) {
    std::vector<Vec3> centers;
    const Vec3 size = hull.maxBound - hull.minBound;
    const double volumeBox = std::max(1e-9, size.x * size.y * size.z);
    double spacing = std::cbrt(volumeBox / std::max<std::size_t>(budget, 1));
    spacing = std::max(0.55, spacing);
    spacing = std::min(spacing, 2.5);

    for (double z = hull.minBound.z + kTetCircumradius; z <= hull.maxBound.z - kTetCircumradius + 1e-9; z += spacing) {
        for (double y = hull.minBound.y + kTetCircumradius; y <= hull.maxBound.y - kTetCircumradius + 1e-9; y += spacing) {
            for (double x = hull.minBound.x + kTetCircumradius; x <= hull.maxBound.x - kTetCircumradius + 1e-9; x += spacing) {
                Vec3 p{x, y, z};
                if (insideHull(hull, p, kTetCircumradius + 1e-6)) {
                    centers.push_back(p);
                    if (centers.size() >= budget) {
                        return centers;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return centers;
}

std::vector<Vec3> buildFaceOffsets(const Hull& hull) {
    std::vector<Vec3> points;
    points.reserve(hull.faces.size());
    for (const Face& face : hull.faces) {
        const Vec3 a = hull.vertices[face.a];
        const Vec3 b = hull.vertices[face.b];
        const Vec3 c = hull.vertices[face.c];
        const Vec3 centroid = (a + b + c) / 3.0;
        const Vec3 inward = centroid - face.normal * (kTetCircumradius + 0.05);
        if (insideHull(hull, inward, kTetInradius)) {
            points.push_back(inward);
        }
    }
    return points;
}

std::vector<Vec3> buildVertexOffsets(const Hull& hull) {
    std::vector<Vec3> points;
    points.reserve(hull.vertices.size());
    for (const Vec3& v : hull.vertices) {
        Vec3 dir = normalized(hull.centroid - v);
        Vec3 p = v + dir * (kTetCircumradius + 0.05);
        if (insideHull(hull, p, kTetInradius)) {
            points.push_back(p);
        }
    }
    return points;
}

bool conflictWithExisting(const Placement& candidate, const std::vector<Placement>& accepted, const SpatialHash& hash) {
    bool conflict = false;
    hash.forNearby(candidate.center, [&](int idx) {
        if (conflict) {
            return;
        }
        const Vec3 delta = accepted[idx].center - candidate.center;
        if (norm2(delta) > 2.1 * 2.1) {
            return;
        }
        if (tetrahedraOverlap(candidate.vertices, accepted[idx].vertices)) {
            conflict = true;
        }
    });
    return conflict;
}

std::vector<Placement> greedyPack(const Hull& hull, std::size_t targetCount, double timeLimitSeconds) {
    const auto canonical = canonicalTetra();
    const auto axes = buildAxisSet();
    const auto spins = buildSpins();

    std::vector<Vec3> seeds;
    const std::size_t gridBudget = std::min<std::size_t>(std::max<std::size_t>(targetCount * 3, 128), 250000);
    std::vector<Vec3> gridCenters = buildGridCenters(hull, gridBudget);
    std::vector<Vec3> faceCenters = buildFaceOffsets(hull);
    std::vector<Vec3> vertexCenters = buildVertexOffsets(hull);
    seeds.reserve(faceCenters.size() + vertexCenters.size() + gridCenters.size() + 1);
    seeds.push_back(hull.centroid);
    seeds.insert(seeds.end(), faceCenters.begin(), faceCenters.end());
    seeds.insert(seeds.end(), vertexCenters.begin(), vertexCenters.end());
    seeds.insert(seeds.end(), gridCenters.begin(), gridCenters.end());

    std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
    candidates.reserve(std::min<std::size_t>(seeds.size() * 4, 400000));
    for (const Vec3& seed : seeds) {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < axes.size(); ++i) {
            const Vec3& axis = axes[i];
            const double spin = spins[i % spins.size()];
            double wallClearance = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
            for (const Plane& plane : hull.planes) {
                wallClearance = std::min(wallClearance, plane.d - dot(plane.n, seed));
            }
            double score = seed.z * 0.05 + wallClearance;
            candidates.push_back({seed, axis, spin, score});
        }
    }

    std::sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const Candidate& lhs, const Candidate& rhs) {
        return lhs.score > rhs.score;
    });

    const auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    std::vector<Placement> accepted;
    accepted.reserve(targetCount);
    SpatialHash hash(1.25);

    for (const Candidate& cand : candidates) {
        const double elapsed = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();
        if (elapsed > timeLimitSeconds) {
            break;
        }
        if (accepted.size() >= targetCount) {
            break;
        }
        Placement placement = makePlacement(cand.center, cand.axis, cand.spin, canonical);
        if (!fitsInside(hull, placement)) {
            continue;
        }
        if (conflictWithExisting(placement, accepted, hash)) {
            continue;
        }
        hash.insert(placement.center, static_cast<int>(accepted.size()));
        accepted.push_back(placement);
    }

    return accepted;
}

} // namespace

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int vCount = 0;
    double edgeLength = 1.0;
    if (!(std::cin >> vCount >> edgeLength)) {
        return 0;
    }

    std::vector<Vec3> points;
    points.reserve(std::max(vCount, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < vCount; ++i) {
        double x = 0.0;
        double y = 0.0;
        double z = 0.0;
        std::cin >> x >> y >> z;
        points.push_back({x, y, z});
    }

    if (points.size() < 4) {
        std::cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    Hull hull = buildHull(points);
    if (hull.faces.empty() || hull.approxVolume <= 1e-12) {
        std::cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    const double scale = edgeLength;
    hull.minBound = hull.minBound / scale;
    hull.maxBound = hull.maxBound / scale;
    hull.centroid = hull.centroid / scale;
    for (Vec3& p : hull.vertices) {
        p = p / scale;
    }
    hull.faces.clear();
    hull.planes.clear();
    hull = buildHull(hull.vertices);

    const double theoreticalMax = hull.approxVolume / kTetVolume;
    std::size_t targetCount = 0;
    if (theoreticalMax < 50.0) {
        targetCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(theoreticalMax * 1.2 + 32.0);
    } else if (theoreticalMax < 5000.0) {
        targetCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::sqrt(theoreticalMax) * 20.0 + 128.0);
    } else {
        targetCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min(200000.0, 512.0 + 12.0 * std::cbrt(theoreticalMax) * std::cbrt(theoreticalMax)));
    }
    targetCount = std::max<std::size_t>(targetCount, 32);

    const double timeLimitSeconds = (theoreticalMax > 1e6) ? 8.0 : 18.0;
    std::vector<Placement> placements = greedyPack(hull, targetCount, timeLimitSeconds);

    std::cout << placements.size() << '\n';
    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(9);
    for (const Placement& placement : placements) {
        const Vec3 outCenter = placement.center * scale;
        std::cout << outCenter.x << ' ' << outCenter.y << ' ' << outCenter.z << ' '
                  << placement.euler[0] << ' ' << placement.euler[1] << ' ' << placement.euler[2] << '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}

use std::cmp::Reverse;
use std::collections::{BinaryHeap, HashSet, VecDeque};
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Hash, Ord, PartialOrd)]
struct Pos {
    x: i32,
    y: i32,
}

impl Pos {
    fn manhattan(self, other: Pos) -> i32 {
        (self.x - other.x).abs() + (self.y - other.y).abs()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Grid {
    w: usize,
    h: usize,
    blocked: Vec<bool>,
}

impl Grid {
    fn new(w: usize, h: usize, blocked: Vec<bool>) -> Self {
        Self { w, h, blocked }
    }

    fn inside(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> bool {
        x >= 0 && y >= 0 && (x as usize) < self.w && (y as usize) < self.h
    }

    fn idx(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> usize {
        y as usize * self.w + x as usize
    }

    fn is_free(&self, x: i32, y: i32) -> bool {
        self.inside(x, y) && !self.blocked[self.idx(x, y)]
    }

    fn neighbors(&self, p: Pos) -> impl Iterator<Item = Pos> + '_ {
        const DIRS: [(i32, i32); 4] = [(1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)];
        IntoIterator::into_iter(DIRS).filter_map(move |(dx, dy)| {
            let np = Pos {
                x: p.x + dx,
                y: p.y + dy,
            };
            self.is_free(np.x, np.y).then_some(np)
        })
    }

    fn free_cells(&self) -> Vec<Pos> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for y in 0..self.h as i32 {
            for x in 0..self.w as i32 {
                if self.is_free(x, y) {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            }
        }
        out
    }

    fn free_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.blocked.iter().filter(|&&b| !b).count()
    }
}

fn is_adj(a: Pos, b: Pos) -> bool {
    a.manhattan(b) == 1
}

fn bipartite_counts(grid: &Grid) -> (usize, usize) {
    let mut a = 0usize;
    let mut b = 0usize;
    for p in grid.free_cells() {
        if ((p.x + p.y) & 1) == 0 {
            a += 1;
        } else {
            b += 1;
        }
    }
    (a, b)
}

fn reachable_component(grid: &Grid, start: Pos) -> HashSet<Pos> {
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    if !grid.is_free(start.x, start.y) {
        return seen;
    }
    let mut q = VecDeque::new();
    seen.insert(start);
    q.push_back(start);
    while let Some(p) = q.pop_front() {
        for n in grid.neighbors(p) {
            if seen.insert(n) {
                q.push_back(n);
            }
        }
    }
    seen
}

fn connected_all(grid: &Grid, start: Pos) -> bool {
    reachable_component(grid, start).len() == grid.free_count()
}

fn degree_in_remaining(grid: &Grid, p: Pos, used: &[bool]) -> usize {
    grid.neighbors(p)
        .filter(|n| !used[grid.idx(n.x, n.y)])
        .count()
}

fn remaining_connected(grid: &Grid, current: Pos, used: &[bool]) -> bool {
    let mut seed = None;
    for y in 0..grid.h as i32 {
        for x in 0..grid.w as i32 {
            if grid.is_free(x, y) && !used[grid.idx(x, y)] {
                seed = Some(Pos { x, y });
                break;
            }
        }
        if seed.is_some() {
            break;
        }
    }
    let Some(seed) = seed else {
        return true;
    };
    let mut q = VecDeque::new();
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    q.push_back(seed);
    seen.insert(seed);
    while let Some(p) = q.pop_front() {
        for n in grid.neighbors(p) {
            if !used[grid.idx(n.x, n.y)] && seen.insert(n) {
                q.push_back(n);
            }
        }
    }
    for y in 0..grid.h as i32 {
        for x in 0..grid.w as i32 {
            let p = Pos { x, y };
            if grid.is_free(x, y) && !used[grid.idx(x, y)] && !seen.contains(&p) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = current;
    true
}

fn exact_dfs(
    grid: &Grid,
    require_cycle: bool,
    path: &mut Vec<Pos>,
    used: &mut [bool],
    left: usize,
) -> bool {
    let cur = *path.last().unwrap();
    if left == 0 {
        return !require_cycle || is_adj(cur, path[0]);
    }

    let mut forced = Vec::new();
    for n in grid.neighbors(cur) {
        if !used[grid.idx(n.x, n.y)] {
            let deg = degree_in_remaining(grid, n, used);
            forced.push((deg, n.manhattan(path[0]), n));
        }
    }
    forced.sort_unstable();

    for (_, _, nxt) in forced {
        let idx = grid.idx(nxt.x, nxt.y);
        used[idx] = true;
        path.push(nxt);

        let mut ok = true;
        if left > 1 {
            let mut endpoints = 0usize;
            for y in 0..grid.h as i32 {
                for x in 0..grid.w as i32 {
                    if grid.is_free(x, y) && !used[grid.idx(x, y)] {
                        let d = degree_in_remaining(grid, Pos { x, y }, used);
                        if d == 0 {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                        if d == 1 {
                            endpoints += 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if !ok {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ok && endpoints > 2 {
                ok = false;
            }
            if ok && !remaining_connected(grid, nxt, used) {
                ok = false;
            }
        }

        if ok && exact_dfs(grid, require_cycle, path, used, left - 1) {
            return true;
        }
        path.pop();
        used[idx] = false;
    }
    false
}

fn solve_exact(grid: &Grid, require_cycle: bool) -> Option<Vec<Pos>> {
    let total = grid.free_count();
    let start = Pos { x: 0, y: 0 };
    if !grid.is_free(0, 0) {
        return None;
    }
    if total == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    if !connected_all(grid, start) {
        return None;
    }
    let (a, b) = bipartite_counts(grid);
    if require_cycle {
        if total % 2 == 1 || a != b {
            return None;
        }
    } else if (a as i32 - b as i32).abs() > 1 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut used = vec![false; grid.w * grid.h];
    used[grid.idx(0, 0)] = true;
    let mut path = vec![start];
    if exact_dfs(grid, require_cycle, &mut path, &mut used, total - 1) {
        Some(path)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn empty_serpentine_path(w: usize, h: usize) -> Vec<Pos> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(w * h);
    if h == 0 || w == 0 {
        return out;
    }
    if h % 2 == 0 {
        for y in 0..h as i32 {
            if y % 2 == 0 {
                for x in 0..w as i32 {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            } else {
                for x in (0..w as i32).rev() {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        for x in 0..w as i32 {
            if x % 2 == 0 {
                for y in 0..h as i32 {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            } else {
                for y in (0..h as i32).rev() {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

fn empty_cycle_path(w: usize, h: usize) -> Option<Vec<Pos>> {
    if w == 1 || h == 1 || (w * h) % 2 == 1 {
        return None;
    }
    if h % 2 == 0 {
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(w * h);
        for y in 0..h as i32 {
            if y == 0 {
                for x in 0..w as i32 {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            } else if y % 2 == 1 {
                out.push(Pos {
                    x: (w - 1) as i32,
                    y,
                });
            } else {
                out.push(Pos { x: 1, y });
                for x in 2..w as i32 {
                    out.push(Pos { x, y });
                }
            }
        }
        for y in (1..h as i32).rev() {
            if y % 2 == 0 {
                out.push(Pos { x: 0, y });
            } else {
                for x in (0..(w as i32 - 1)).rev() {
                    if x != 1 || y != 1 {
                        out.push(Pos { x, y });
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        out.dedup();
        if out.len() == w * h
            && is_adj(out[0], *out.last().unwrap())
            && out.windows(2).all(|ab| is_adj(ab[0], ab[1]))
        {
            return Some(out);
        }
    }
    if w % 2 == 0 {
        let rot = empty_cycle_path(h, w)?;
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(rot.len());
        for p in rot {
            out.push(Pos { x: p.y, y: p.x });
        }
        return Some(out);
    }
    None
}

fn greedy_path(grid: &Grid, require_cycle: bool) -> Option<Vec<Pos>> {
    let total = grid.free_count();
    let start = Pos { x: 0, y: 0 };
    if !grid.is_free(0, 0) || !connected_all(grid, start) {
        return None;
    }
    let (a, b) = bipartite_counts(grid);
    if require_cycle {
        if total % 2 == 1 || a != b {
            return None;
        }
    } else if (a as i32 - b as i32).abs() > 1 {
        return None;
    }

    let mut used = vec![false; grid.w * grid.h];
    let mut path = vec![start];
    used[grid.idx(0, 0)] = true;

    while path.len() < total {
        let cur = *path.last().unwrap();
        let mut cands = Vec::new();
        for n in grid.neighbors(cur) {
            let idx = grid.idx(n.x, n.y);
            if used[idx] {
                continue;
            }
            let deg = degree_in_remaining(grid, n, &used);
            let mut tmp = used.clone();
            tmp[idx] = true;
            let conn_penalty = if remaining_connected(grid, n, &tmp) { 0 } else { 1000 };
            let close_start = if require_cycle { n.manhattan(start) } else { 0 };
            cands.push((conn_penalty, deg, close_start, n));
        }
        cands.sort_unstable();
        let mut advanced = false;
        for (_, _, _, n) in cands {
            let idx = grid.idx(n.x, n.y);
            used[idx] = true;
            path.push(n);
            if remaining_connected(grid, n, &used) {
                advanced = true;
                break;
            }
            path.pop();
            used[idx] = false;
        }
        if !advanced {
            return None;
        }
    }
    if require_cycle && !is_adj(*path.last().unwrap(), start) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(path)
}

fn ida_search(grid: &Grid, require_cycle: bool, limit_ms: u128) -> Option<Vec<Pos>> {
    let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();
    let total = grid.free_count();
    let start = Pos { x: 0, y: 0 };
    if !grid.is_free(0, 0) || !connected_all(grid, start) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut used = vec![false; grid.w * grid.h];
    let path = vec![start];
    used[grid.idx(0, 0)] = true;
    let mut heap = BinaryHeap::new();
    heap.push((Reverse(0usize), path.clone(), used.clone()));

    while let Some((_, cur_path, cur_used)) = heap.pop() {
        if start_time.elapsed().as_millis() > limit_ms {
            break;
        }
        if cur_path.len() == total {
            if !require_cycle || is_adj(*cur_path.last().unwrap(), start) {
                return Some(cur_path);
            }
            continue;
        }
        let cur = *cur_path.last().unwrap();
        let mut cands = Vec::new();
        for n in grid.neighbors(cur) {
            let idx = grid.idx(n.x, n.y);
            if cur_used[idx] {
                continue;
            }
            let deg = degree_in_remaining(grid, n, &cur_used);
            cands.push((deg, n.manhattan(start), n));
        }
        cands.sort_unstable();
        for (deg, dist, n) in cands {
            let idx = grid.idx(n.x, n.y);
            let mut next_used = cur_used.clone();
            next_used[idx] = true;
            if !remaining_connected(grid, n, &next_used) {
                continue;
            }
            let mut next_path = cur_path.clone();
            next_path.push(n);
            let score = deg + dist as usize + (total - next_path.len());
            heap.push((Reverse(score), next_path, next_used));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn solve(grid: &Grid, require_cycle: bool) -> Option<Vec<Pos>> {
    if !grid.is_free(0, 0) {
        return None;
    }
    let total = grid.free_count();
    if total == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    if grid.blocked.iter().all(|&b| !b) {
        if require_cycle {
            if let Some(p) = empty_cycle_path(grid.w, grid.h) {
                return Some(p);
            }
        } else {
            return Some(empty_serpentine_path(grid.w, grid.h));
        }
    }
    if total <= 28 {
        if let Some(p) = solve_exact(grid, require_cycle) {
            return Some(p);
        }
    }
    if total <= 120 {
        if let Some(p) = ida_search(grid, require_cycle, 10_000) {
            return Some(p);
        }
        if let Some(p) = greedy_path(grid, require_cycle) {
            return Some(p);
        }
    } else if let Some(p) = greedy_path(grid, require_cycle) {
        return Some(p);
    }

    // Fallback: try solving exact on the reachable component if the obstacle pattern
    // effectively reduces the instance, otherwise report failure conservatively.
    if total <= 40 {
        solve_exact(grid, require_cycle)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn validate(grid: &Grid, require_cycle: bool, path: &[Pos]) -> bool {
    if path.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    if path[0] != (Pos { x: 0, y: 0 }) {
        return false;
    }
    if path.len() != grid.free_count() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    for &p in path {
        if !grid.is_free(p.x, p.y) || !seen.insert(p) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    for ab in path.windows(2) {
        if !is_adj(ab[0], ab[1]) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if require_cycle && !is_adj(*path.last().unwrap(), path[0]) {
        return false;
    }
    true
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();
    let w: usize = match it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => return,
    };
    let h: usize = match it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => return,
    };
    let obstacle_count: usize = match it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => return,
    };
    let require_cycle = match it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok()) {
        Some(v) => v != 0,
        None => return,
    };

    let mut blocked = vec![false; w * h];
    for _ in 0..obstacle_count {
        let x: i32 = match it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()) {
            Some(v) => v,
            None => return,
        };
        let y: i32 = match it.next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()) {
            Some(v) => v,
            None => return,
        };
        if x >= 0 && y >= 0 && (x as usize) < w && (y as usize) < h {
            blocked[y as usize * w + x as usize] = true;
        }
    }

    let grid = Grid::new(w, h, blocked);
    let ans = solve(&grid, require_cycle);
    match ans {
        Some(path) if validate(&grid, require_cycle, &path) => {
            println!("{}", path.len());
            for p in path {
                println!("{} {}", p.x, p.y);
            }
        }
        _ => {
            println!("0");
        }
    }
}
