using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

public static class Program
{
    private const double EarthRadius = 6371.0;
    private const double TinyEpsilon = 1e-9;

    public static void Main()
    {
        var scanner = new FastScanner();
        int n = scanner.NextInt();
        double mu = scanner.NextDouble();

        State start = ReadState(scanner);
        var stations = new State[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            stations[i] = ReadState(scanner);
        }

        var planner = new OrbitalPlanner(mu, start, stations);
        int[] order = planner.Solve();
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", order));
    }

    private static State ReadState(FastScanner scanner)
    {
        return new State(
            new Vec3(scanner.NextDouble(), scanner.NextDouble(), scanner.NextDouble()),
            new Vec3(scanner.NextDouble(), scanner.NextDouble(), scanner.NextDouble()));
    }

    private readonly struct State
    {
        public readonly Vec3 Position;
        public readonly Vec3 Velocity;

        public State(Vec3 position, Vec3 velocity)
        {
            Position = position;
            Velocity = velocity;
        }
    }

    private readonly struct Vec3
    {
        public readonly double X;
        public readonly double Y;
        public readonly double Z;

        public Vec3(double x, double y, double z)
        {
            X = x;
            Y = y;
            Z = z;
        }

        public static Vec3 operator +(Vec3 a, Vec3 b) => new Vec3(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
        public static Vec3 operator -(Vec3 a, Vec3 b) => new Vec3(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
        public static Vec3 operator *(Vec3 a, double k) => new Vec3(a.X * k, a.Y * k, a.Z * k);
        public static Vec3 operator /(Vec3 a, double k) => new Vec3(a.X / k, a.Y / k, a.Z / k);

        public double Dot(Vec3 other) => X * other.X + Y * other.Y + Z * other.Z;

        public Vec3 Cross(Vec3 other)
        {
            return new Vec3(
                Y * other.Z - Z * other.Y,
                Z * other.X - X * other.Z,
                X * other.Y - Y * other.X);
        }

        public double Norm() => Math.Sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);

        public Vec3 Normalize()
        {
            double norm = Norm();
            if (norm < TinyEpsilon) return new Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            return this / norm;
        }
    }

    private sealed class OrbitalPlanner
    {
        private readonly double _mu;
        private readonly State _start;
        private readonly State[] _stations;
        private readonly OrbitalFeatures _startFeatures;
        private readonly OrbitalFeatures[] _stationFeatures;
        private readonly double[,] _cost;

        public OrbitalPlanner(double mu, State start, State[] stations)
        {
            _mu = mu;
            _start = start;
            _stations = stations;
            _startFeatures = OrbitalFeatures.FromState(start, mu);
            _stationFeatures = stations.Select(s => OrbitalFeatures.FromState(s, mu)).ToArray();
            _cost = BuildCostMatrix();
        }

        public int[] Solve()
        {
            int n = _stations.Length;
            if (n <= 1)
            {
                return n == 0 ? Array.Empty<int>() : new[] { 0 };
            }

            if (n <= 8)
            {
                return SolveExact();
            }

            int[] best = BuildGreedySeed();
            best = ImproveWithTwoOpt(best, maxPasses: n <= 20 ? 12 : 6);

            if (n <= 14)
            {
                best = ImproveWithRelocate(best, maxPasses: 6);
            }
            else
            {
                int[] alt = BuildFeatureSortedSeed();
                alt = ImproveWithTwoOpt(alt, maxPasses: 4);
                if (RouteCost(alt) < RouteCost(best))
                {
                    best = alt;
                }
            }

            if (n >= 25)
            {
                best = ImproveBySegmentReinsertion(best, samples: Math.Min(96, n * 2));
            }

            return best;
        }

        private int[] SolveExact()
        {
            int n = _stations.Length;
            var used = new bool[n];
            var current = new int[n];
            var best = new int[n];
            double bestCost = double.PositiveInfinity;

            void Dfs(int depth, int last, double acc)
            {
                if (acc >= bestCost)
                {
                    return;
                }

                if (depth == n)
                {
                    bestCost = acc;
                    Array.Copy(current, best, n);
                    return;
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                {
                    if (used[i]) continue;
                    used[i] = true;
                    current[depth] = i;
                    double stepCost = depth == 0 ? StartCost(i) : _cost[last, i];
                    Dfs(depth + 1, i, acc + stepCost);
                    used[i] = false;
                }
            }

            Dfs(0, -1, 0.0);
            return best;
        }

        private int[] BuildGreedySeed()
        {
            int n = _stations.Length;
            var used = new bool[n];
            var route = new int[n];

            int current = FindBestStartNode();
            route[0] = current;
            used[current] = true;

            for (int pos = 1; pos < n; pos++)
            {
                int next = -1;
                double best = double.PositiveInfinity;
                for (int candidate = 0; candidate < n; candidate++)
                {
                    if (used[candidate]) continue;
                    double score = _cost[current, candidate];
                    score += 0.03 * Math.Abs(_stationFeatures[current].MeanMotion - _stationFeatures[candidate].MeanMotion);
                    if (score < best)
                    {
                        best = score;
                        next = candidate;
                    }
                }

                route[pos] = next;
                used[next] = true;
                current = next;
            }

            return route;
        }

        private int[] BuildFeatureSortedSeed()
        {
            int n = _stations.Length;
            var keys = new (double Key, int Idx)[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                var f = _stationFeatures[i];
                keys[i] = (f.CompositeOrderKey, i);
            }

            Array.Sort(keys, (a, b) => a.Key.CompareTo(b.Key));
            return keys.Select(k => k.Idx).ToArray();
        }

        private int FindBestStartNode()
        {
            int n = _stations.Length;
            int bestIndex = 0;
            double bestScore = double.PositiveInfinity;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                double score = StartCost(i);
                score += 0.2 * Math.Abs(_startFeatures.Inclination - _stationFeatures[i].Inclination);
                score += 0.2 * Math.Abs(WrapAngle(_startFeatures.RightAscension - _stationFeatures[i].RightAscension));
                if (score < bestScore)
                {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestIndex = i;
                }
            }

            return bestIndex;
        }

        private int[] ImproveWithTwoOpt(int[] route, int maxPasses)
        {
            int n = route.Length;
            if (n < 4) return route;

            var best = (int[])route.Clone();
            for (int pass = 0; pass < maxPasses; pass++)
            {
                bool improved = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++)
                {
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < n - 1; j++)
                    {
                        double before = EdgeCost(best, i - 1, i) + EdgeCost(best, j, j + 1);
                        double after = EdgeCostSwap(best, i - 1, j) + EdgeCostSwap(best, i, j + 1);
                        if (after + 1e-8 < before)
                        {
                            Array.Reverse(best, i, j - i + 1);
                            improved = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!improved) break;
            }

            return best;
        }

        private int[] ImproveWithRelocate(int[] route, int maxPasses)
        {
            int n = route.Length;
            var best = (int[])route.Clone();
            for (int pass = 0; pass < maxPasses; pass++)
            {
                bool improved = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                    {
                        if (i == j || i + 1 == j) continue;
                        int moved = best[i];
                        var candidate = new List<int>(best);
                        candidate.RemoveAt(i);
                        int insertAt = j > i ? j - 1 : j;
                        candidate.Insert(insertAt, moved);
                        double candCost = RouteCost(candidate);
                        double bestCost = RouteCost(best);
                        if (candCost + 1e-8 < bestCost)
                        {
                            best = candidate.ToArray();
                            improved = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!improved) break;
            }

            return best;
        }

        private int[] ImproveBySegmentReinsertion(int[] route, int samples)
        {
            int n = route.Length;
            var best = (int[])route.Clone();
            double bestCost = RouteCost(best);
            int segmentLength = Math.Max(2, n / 12);
            if (segmentLength >= n) return best;

            for (int s = 0; s < samples; s++)
            {
                int start = (s * 7919) % (n - segmentLength + 1);
                int insert = (s * 1543 + 7) % (n - segmentLength + 1);
                if (insert >= start && insert <= start + segmentLength) continue;

                var candidate = new List<int>(n);
                for (int i = 0; i < start; i++) candidate.Add(best[i]);
                for (int i = start + segmentLength; i < n; i++) candidate.Add(best[i]);

                var seg = best.Skip(start).Take(segmentLength).ToArray();
                int actualInsert = Math.Min(insert, candidate.Count);
                candidate.InsertRange(actualInsert, seg);

                double candCost = RouteCost(candidate);
                if (candCost + 1e-8 < bestCost)
                {
                    best = candidate.ToArray();
                    bestCost = candCost;
                }
            }

            return best;
        }

        private double RouteCost(IReadOnlyList<int> route)
        {
            if (route.Count == 0) return 0.0;
            double total = StartCost(route[0]);
            for (int i = 1; i < route.Count; i++)
            {
                total += _cost[route[i - 1], route[i]];
            }
            return total;
        }

        private double EdgeCost(int[] route, int aPos, int bPos)
        {
            if (bPos < 0 || bPos >= route.Length) return 0.0;
            int b = route[bPos];
            if (aPos < 0) return StartCost(b);
            return _cost[route[aPos], b];
        }

        private double EdgeCostSwap(int[] route, int aPos, int bPos)
        {
            if (bPos < 0 || bPos >= route.Length) return 0.0;
            int b = route[bPos];
            if (aPos < 0) return StartCost(b);
            return _cost[route[aPos], b];
        }

        private double StartCost(int stationIndex)
        {
            return EstimateTransferCost(_startFeatures, _stationFeatures[stationIndex], true);
        }

        private double[,] BuildCostMatrix()
        {
            int n = _stations.Length;
            var matrix = new double[n, n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                {
                    matrix[i, j] = i == j ? 0.0 : EstimateTransferCost(_stationFeatures[i], _stationFeatures[j], false);
                }
            }

            return matrix;
        }

        private double EstimateTransferCost(OrbitalFeatures a, OrbitalFeatures b, bool isStart)
        {
            double radiusA = a.Radius;
            double radiusB = b.Radius;
            double circularA = Math.Sqrt(_mu / Math.Max(radiusA, EarthRadius + 120.0));
            double circularB = Math.Sqrt(_mu / Math.Max(radiusB, EarthRadius + 120.0));

            double hohmann1 = circularA * Math.Abs(Math.Sqrt(2.0 * radiusB / (radiusA + radiusB)) - 1.0);
            double hohmann2 = circularB * Math.Abs(1.0 - Math.Sqrt(2.0 * radiusA / (radiusA + radiusB)));
            double radialCost = hohmann1 + hohmann2;

            double planeAngle = PlaneAngle(a.PlaneNormal, b.PlaneNormal);
            double planeSpeed = 0.5 * (circularA + circularB);
            double planeCost = 2.0 * planeSpeed * Math.Sin(planeAngle * 0.5);

            double phaseAngle = Math.Abs(WrapAngle(a.TrueLongitude - b.TrueLongitude));
            double phaseCost = 0.12 * planeSpeed * phaseAngle;

            double eccCost = 0.35 * planeSpeed * Math.Abs(a.Eccentricity - b.Eccentricity);
            double shapeCost = 0.06 * planeSpeed * Math.Abs(a.ArgumentOfLatitude - b.ArgumentOfLatitude);
            double motionCost = 180.0 * Math.Abs(a.MeanMotion - b.MeanMotion);

            double total = radialCost + planeCost + phaseCost + eccCost + shapeCost + motionCost;

            if (isStart)
            {
                total *= 0.97;
            }

            return total;
        }

        private static double PlaneAngle(Vec3 a, Vec3 b)
        {
            double denom = a.Norm() * b.Norm();
            if (denom < TinyEpsilon) return 0.0;
            double c = Clamp(a.Dot(b) / denom, -1.0, 1.0);
            return Math.Acos(c);
        }

        private static double Clamp(double value, double lo, double hi)
        {
            if (value < lo) return lo;
            if (value > hi) return hi;
            return value;
        }

        private static double WrapAngle(double angle)
        {
            while (angle <= -Math.PI) angle += 2.0 * Math.PI;
            while (angle > Math.PI) angle -= 2.0 * Math.PI;
            return angle;
        }
    }

    private readonly struct OrbitalFeatures
    {
        public readonly double Radius;
        public readonly double Inclination;
        public readonly double RightAscension;
        public readonly double Eccentricity;
        public readonly double TrueLongitude;
        public readonly double ArgumentOfLatitude;
        public readonly double MeanMotion;
        public readonly Vec3 PlaneNormal;
        public readonly double CompositeOrderKey;

        public OrbitalFeatures(
            double radius,
            double inclination,
            double rightAscension,
            double eccentricity,
            double trueLongitude,
            double argumentOfLatitude,
            double meanMotion,
            Vec3 planeNormal,
            double compositeOrderKey)
        {
            Radius = radius;
            Inclination = inclination;
            RightAscension = rightAscension;
            Eccentricity = eccentricity;
            TrueLongitude = trueLongitude;
            ArgumentOfLatitude = argumentOfLatitude;
            MeanMotion = meanMotion;
            PlaneNormal = planeNormal;
            CompositeOrderKey = compositeOrderKey;
        }

        public static OrbitalFeatures FromState(State state, double mu)
        {
            Vec3 r = state.Position;
            Vec3 v = state.Velocity;
            double radius = r.Norm();
            double speed2 = v.Dot(v);
            Vec3 h = r.Cross(v);
            double hNorm = h.Norm();
            Vec3 n = new Vec3(-h.Y, h.X, 0.0);
            double nNorm = n.Norm();
            Vec3 eVec = (v.Cross(h) / mu) - (r / Math.Max(radius, TinyEpsilon));
            double e = eVec.Norm();
            double inclination = Math.Acos(Clamp(h.Z / Math.Max(hNorm, TinyEpsilon), -1.0, 1.0));

            double raan = 0.0;
            if (nNorm > TinyEpsilon)
            {
                raan = Math.Atan2(n.Y, n.X);
            }

            Vec3 p = nNorm > TinyEpsilon ? n / nNorm : new Vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
            Vec3 q = hNorm > TinyEpsilon ? h.Cross(p).Normalize() : new Vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
            double argLat = Math.Atan2(r.Dot(q), r.Dot(p));
            double lon = Math.Atan2(r.Y, r.X);

            double aInv = 2.0 / Math.Max(radius, TinyEpsilon) - speed2 / mu;
            double meanMotion = aInv > TinyEpsilon ? Math.Sqrt(mu * aInv * aInv * aInv) : 0.0;

            double composite =
                2.1 * radius +
                900.0 * inclination +
                500.0 * raan +
                300.0 * argLat +
                1200.0 * e;

            return new OrbitalFeatures(
                radius,
                inclination,
                raan,
                e,
                lon,
                argLat,
                meanMotion,
                hNorm > TinyEpsilon ? h / hNorm : new Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
                composite);
        }

        private static double Clamp(double value, double lo, double hi)
        {
            if (value < lo) return lo;
            if (value > hi) return hi;
            return value;
        }
    }

    private sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly string[] _tokens;
        private int _index;

        public FastScanner()
        {
            _tokens = Console.In
                .ReadToEnd()
                .Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            _index = 0;
        }

        public int NextInt() => int.Parse(_tokens[_index++], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

        public double NextDouble() => double.Parse(_tokens[_index++], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <queue>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

namespace {

constexpr double kEps = 1e-9;

struct Vec3 {
    double x = 0.0;
    double y = 0.0;
    double z = 0.0;

    Vec3() = default;
    Vec3(double xx, double yy, double zz) : x(xx), y(yy), z(zz) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& other) const { return {x + other.x, y + other.y, z + other.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& other) const { return {x - other.x, y - other.y, z - other.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(double s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vec3 operator/(double s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }
};

double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

Vec3 cross(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return {
        a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
        a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
        a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x
    };
}

double length(const Vec3& v) {
    return std::sqrt(dot(v, v));
}

Vec3 min_vec(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return {std::min(a.x, b.x), std::min(a.y, b.y), std::min(a.z, b.z)};
}

Vec3 max_vec(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return {std::max(a.x, b.x), std::max(a.y, b.y), std::max(a.z, b.z)};
}

struct Triangle {
    int a = 0;
    int b = 0;
    int c = 0;
};

struct Mesh {
    vector<Vec3> vertices;
    vector<Triangle> faces;
};

struct AABB {
    Vec3 mn;
    Vec3 mx;
};

AABB compute_bounds(const Mesh& mesh) {
    AABB box;
    if (mesh.vertices.empty()) {
        box.mn = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
        box.mx = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
        return box;
    }
    box.mn = mesh.vertices.front();
    box.mx = mesh.vertices.front();
    for (const Vec3& v : mesh.vertices) {
        box.mn = min_vec(box.mn, v);
        box.mx = max_vec(box.mx, v);
    }
    return box;
}

bool point_in_aabb(const Vec3& p, const AABB& box, double pad = 0.0) {
    return p.x >= box.mn.x - pad && p.x <= box.mx.x + pad &&
           p.y >= box.mn.y - pad && p.y <= box.mx.y + pad &&
           p.z >= box.mn.z - pad && p.z <= box.mx.z + pad;
}

bool ray_intersects_triangle(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir, const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {
    const Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
    const Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
    const Vec3 pvec = cross(dir, e2);
    const double det = dot(e1, pvec);
    if (std::abs(det) < kEps) {
        return false;
    }
    const double inv_det = 1.0 / det;
    const Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
    const double u = dot(tvec, pvec) * inv_det;
    if (u < -kEps || u > 1.0 + kEps) {
        return false;
    }
    const Vec3 qvec = cross(tvec, e1);
    const double v = dot(dir, qvec) * inv_det;
    if (v < -kEps || u + v > 1.0 + kEps) {
        return false;
    }
    const double t = dot(e2, qvec) * inv_det;
    return t > kEps;
}

bool point_inside_mesh(const Vec3& p, const Mesh& mesh, const AABB& box) {
    if (!point_in_aabb(p, box, kEps)) {
        return false;
    }
    const Vec3 dir{1.0, 0.17364817766, 0.31830988618};
    int hits = 0;
    for (const Triangle& tri : mesh.faces) {
        const Vec3& v0 = mesh.vertices[tri.a];
        const Vec3& v1 = mesh.vertices[tri.b];
        const Vec3& v2 = mesh.vertices[tri.c];
        if (ray_intersects_triangle(p, dir, v0, v1, v2)) {
            ++hits;
        }
    }
    return (hits & 1) != 0;
}

Vec3 triangle_centroid(const Mesh& mesh, const Triangle& tri) {
    return (mesh.vertices[tri.a] + mesh.vertices[tri.b] + mesh.vertices[tri.c]) / 3.0;
}

double triangle_area(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c) {
    return 0.5 * length(cross(b - a, c - a));
}

Mesh deduplicate_vertices(const Mesh& mesh) {
    struct Key {
        long long x, y, z;
        bool operator==(const Key& other) const {
            return x == other.x && y == other.y && z == other.z;
        }
    };
    struct KeyHasher {
        size_t operator()(const Key& k) const noexcept {
            size_t h = std::hash<long long>{}(k.x);
            h ^= std::hash<long long>{}(k.y) + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
            h ^= std::hash<long long>{}(k.z) + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
            return h;
        }
    };

    AABB box = compute_bounds(mesh);
    const double span = std::max({box.mx.x - box.mn.x, box.mx.y - box.mn.y, box.mx.z - box.mn.z, 1.0});
    const double scale = 1e8 / span;

    unordered_map<Key, int, KeyHasher> map_idx;
    vector<Vec3> out_vertices;
    out_vertices.reserve(mesh.vertices.size());
    vector<int> remap(mesh.vertices.size(), -1);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < mesh.vertices.size(); ++i) {
        const Vec3& v = mesh.vertices[i];
        Key key{
            llround(v.x * scale),
            llround(v.y * scale),
            llround(v.z * scale)
        };
        auto it = map_idx.find(key);
        if (it == map_idx.end()) {
            int idx = static_cast<int>(out_vertices.size());
            out_vertices.push_back(v);
            map_idx.emplace(key, idx);
            remap[i] = idx;
        } else {
            remap[i] = it->second;
        }
    }

    vector<Triangle> out_faces;
    out_faces.reserve(mesh.faces.size());
    for (const Triangle& tri : mesh.faces) {
        Triangle mapped{remap[tri.a], remap[tri.b], remap[tri.c]};
        if (mapped.a == mapped.b || mapped.b == mapped.c || mapped.c == mapped.a) {
            continue;
        }
        const Vec3& a = out_vertices[mapped.a];
        const Vec3& b = out_vertices[mapped.b];
        const Vec3& c = out_vertices[mapped.c];
        if (triangle_area(a, b, c) <= kEps) {
            continue;
        }
        out_faces.push_back(mapped);
    }

    return {std::move(out_vertices), std::move(out_faces)};
}

Mesh build_union_surface(const Mesh& a, const Mesh& b) {
    const AABB box_a = compute_bounds(a);
    const AABB box_b = compute_bounds(b);

    Mesh out;
    out.vertices.reserve(a.vertices.size() + b.vertices.size());
    out.faces.reserve(a.faces.size() + b.faces.size());

    auto append_if_outside = [&](const Mesh& src, const Mesh& other, const AABB& other_box) {
        vector<int> local_to_global(src.vertices.size(), -1);
        for (const Triangle& tri : src.faces) {
            const Vec3 centroid = triangle_centroid(src, tri);
            if (point_inside_mesh(centroid, other, other_box)) {
                continue;
            }
            const int ids[3] = {tri.a, tri.b, tri.c};
            Triangle new_tri;
            int* dst[3] = {&new_tri.a, &new_tri.b, &new_tri.c};
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                int src_idx = ids[i];
                if (local_to_global[src_idx] == -1) {
                    local_to_global[src_idx] = static_cast<int>(out.vertices.size());
                    out.vertices.push_back(src.vertices[src_idx]);
                }
                *dst[i] = local_to_global[src_idx];
            }
            out.faces.push_back(new_tri);
        }
    };

    append_if_outside(a, b, box_b);
    append_if_outside(b, a, box_a);
    return deduplicate_vertices(out);
}

}  // namespace

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int VA, FA, VB, FB;
    if (!(cin >> VA >> FA >> VB >> FB)) {
        return 0;
    }

    Mesh a, b;
    a.vertices.resize(VA);
    a.faces.resize(FA);
    b.vertices.resize(VB);
    b.faces.resize(FB);

    for (int i = 0; i < VA; ++i) {
        cin >> a.vertices[i].x >> a.vertices[i].y >> a.vertices[i].z;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < FA; ++i) {
        cin >> a.faces[i].a >> a.faces[i].b >> a.faces[i].c;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < VB; ++i) {
        cin >> b.vertices[i].x >> b.vertices[i].y >> b.vertices[i].z;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < FB; ++i) {
        cin >> b.faces[i].a >> b.faces[i].b >> b.faces[i].c;
    }

    Mesh result = build_union_surface(a, b);

    cout << result.vertices.size() << ' ' << result.faces.size() << '\n';
    cout << std::setprecision(17);
    for (const Vec3& v : result.vertices) {
        cout << v.x << ' ' << v.y << ' ' << v.z << '\n';
    }
    for (const Triangle& tri : result.faces) {
        cout << tri.a << ' ' << tri.b << ' ' << tri.c << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

Find the shortest path through a maze from a start cell to an end cell. The maze is a grid of walls and open passages, and the AI must navigate from one corner to the other using the fewest steps possible.

Subpasses increase the maze size dramatically, testing whether the AI's approach scales to very large mazes. The baseline finds the true shortest path using breadth-first search.

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::io::{self, Read};

const DIRS: [(isize, isize); 4] = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)];
const OPPOSITE: [u8; 4] = [1, 0, 3, 2];
const NONE: u8 = 255;

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    if input.trim().is_empty() {
        return;
    }

    let mut lines = input.lines();
    let header = match lines.next() {
        Some(line) => line,
        None => return,
    };

    let mut hw = header.split_whitespace();
    let h: usize = match hw.next().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => return,
    };
    let w: usize = match hw.next().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => return,
    };

    if h == 0 || w == 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let total = match h.checked_mul(w) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };

    let mut grid = vec![b'#'; total];
    let mut start = None;
    let mut goal = None;

    for r in 0..h {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap_or("");
        let bytes = line.as_bytes();
        for c in 0..w {
            let ch = *bytes.get(c).unwrap_or(&b' ');
            let idx = r * w + c;
            grid[idx] = ch;
            if ch == b'A' {
                start = Some(idx);
            } else if ch == b'B' {
                goal = Some(idx);
            }
        }
    }

    let start = match start {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };
    let goal = match goal {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };

    if start == goal {
        let (x, y) = (start / w, start % w);
        println!("1");
        println!("{} {}", x, y);
        return;
    }

    let mut state = vec![0u8; total];
    let mut parent_from_start = vec![NONE; total];
    let mut parent_from_goal = vec![NONE; total];
    let mut q_start = VecDeque::new();
    let mut q_goal = VecDeque::new();

    state[start] |= 1;
    state[goal] |= 2;
    q_start.push_back(start);
    q_goal.push_back(goal);

    let mut meet = None;

    while !q_start.is_empty() && !q_goal.is_empty() && meet.is_none() {
        if q_start.len() <= q_goal.len() {
            meet = expand_frontier(
                &grid,
                w,
                h,
                &mut q_start,
                &mut state,
                &mut parent_from_start,
                1,
                2,
            );
        } else {
            meet = expand_frontier(
                &grid,
                w,
                h,
                &mut q_goal,
                &mut state,
                &mut parent_from_goal,
                2,
                1,
            );
        }
    }

    let meet = match meet {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };

    let path = reconstruct_path(meet, start, goal, w, &parent_from_start, &parent_from_goal);
    println!("{}", path.len());
    for idx in path {
        println!("{} {}", idx / w, idx % w);
    }
}

fn expand_frontier(
    grid: &[u8],
    w: usize,
    h: usize,
    queue: &mut VecDeque<usize>,
    state: &mut [u8],
    parent: &mut [u8],
    own_bit: u8,
    other_bit: u8,
) -> Option<usize> {
    let level_size = queue.len();
    for _ in 0..level_size {
        let cur = queue.pop_front().unwrap();
        let r = cur / w;
        let c = cur % w;

        for (dir, (dr, dc)) in DIRS.iter().enumerate() {
            let nr = r as isize + dr;
            let nc = c as isize + dc;
            if nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr >= h as isize || nc >= w as isize {
                continue;
            }

            let next = nr as usize * w + nc as usize;
            if grid[next] == b'#' {
                continue;
            }

            let seen = state[next];
            if seen & own_bit != 0 {
                continue;
            }

            parent[next] = OPPOSITE[dir];
            if seen & other_bit != 0 {
                return Some(next);
            }

            state[next] = seen | own_bit;
            queue.push_back(next);
        }
    }
    None
}

fn reconstruct_path(
    meet: usize,
    start: usize,
    goal: usize,
    w: usize,
    parent_from_start: &[u8],
    parent_from_goal: &[u8],
) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut left = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = meet;
    loop {
        left.push(cur);
        if cur == start {
            break;
        }
        cur = step(cur, w, parent_from_start[cur]);
    }
    left.reverse();

    let mut right = Vec::new();
    cur = meet;
    while cur != goal {
        cur = step(cur, w, parent_from_goal[cur]);
        right.push(cur);
    }

    left.extend(right);
    left
}

fn step(idx: usize, w: usize, dir: u8) -> usize {
    match dir {
        0 => idx - w,
        1 => idx + w,
        2 => idx - 1,
        3 => idx + 1,
        _ => unreachable!(),
    }
}

Given fixed-length stock material and a shopping list of smaller pieces to cut, use as few stock pieces as possible. Every requested piece must be cut from somewhere, but any leftover material is wasted — so packing the cuts tightly matters.

This is essentially a bin-packing problem and is NP-hard. Subpasses scale from a handful of cuts up to millions, forcing the AI to write code that is both correct and fast. The baseline uses a simple first-fit-decreasing heuristic.

Cutting Stock - 5 cuts, stock=100

View Code (6073 chars)
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        var reader = new FastReader(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int n = reader.NextInt();
        int stockLength = reader.NextInt();

        var cuts = new Cut[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            int length = reader.NextInt();
            if (length > stockLength)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Cut length exceeds stock length.");
            }

            cuts[i] = new Cut(length, i);
        }

        Array.Sort(cuts, static (a, b) =>
        {
            int cmp = b.Length.CompareTo(a.Length);
            return cmp != 0 ? cmp : a.Index.CompareTo(b.Index);
        });

        var bins = new List<Bin>(Math.Max(4, n / 4));
        var tree = new BinTree(Math.Max(4, n));

        for (int i = 0; i < cuts.Length; i++)
        {
            ref readonly var cut = ref cuts[i];
            int binIndex = tree.FindFirstBinWithCapacity(cut.Length);
            if (binIndex < 0)
            {
                binIndex = bins.Count;
                bins.Add(new Bin(stockLength));
                tree.AddBin(stockLength);
            }

            bins[binIndex].Cuts.Add(cut.Index);
            bins[binIndex].Remaining -= cut.Length;
            tree.Update(binIndex, bins[binIndex].Remaining);
        }

        var output = new StringBuilder(Math.Max(32, n * 4));
        output.Append(bins.Count).Append('\n');
        for (int i = 0; i < bins.Count; i++)
        {
            var assigned = bins[i].Cuts;
            for (int j = 0; j < assigned.Count; j++)
            {
                if (j > 0)
                {
                    output.Append(' ');
                }

                output.Append(assigned[j]);
            }

            output.Append('\n');
        }

        Console.Write(output.ToString());
    }

    private readonly struct Cut
    {
        public readonly int Length;
        public readonly int Index;

        public Cut(int length, int index)
        {
            Length = length;
            Index = index;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Bin
    {
        public int Remaining;
        public readonly List<int> Cuts;

        public Bin(int stockLength)
        {
            Remaining = stockLength;
            Cuts = new List<int>();
        }
    }

    private sealed class BinTree
    {
        private int _size;
        private int _count;
        private int[] _tree;

        public BinTree(int capacity)
        {
            _size = 1;
            while (_size < capacity)
            {
                _size <<= 1;
            }

            _tree = new int[_size << 1];
        }

        public void AddBin(int remaining)
        {
            EnsureCapacity(_count + 1);
            Update(_count, remaining);
            _count++;
        }

        public void Update(int index, int remaining)
        {
            int pos = index + _size;
            _tree[pos] = remaining;
            pos >>= 1;

            while (pos > 0)
            {
                int left = pos << 1;
                int right = left | 1;
                _tree[pos] = _tree[left] >= _tree[right] ? _tree[left] : _tree[right];
                pos >>= 1;
            }
        }

        public int FindFirstBinWithCapacity(int needed)
        {
            if (_count == 0 || _tree[1] < needed)
            {
                return -1;
            }

            int node = 1;
            while (node < _size)
            {
                int left = node << 1;
                if (_tree[left] >= needed)
                {
                    node = left;
                }
                else
                {
                    node = left | 1;
                }
            }

            int index = node - _size;
            return index < _count ? index : -1;
        }

        private void EnsureCapacity(int neededCount)
        {
            if (neededCount <= _size)
            {
                return;
            }

            int newSize = _size;
            while (newSize < neededCount)
            {
                newSize <<= 1;
            }

            var newTree = new int[newSize << 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++)
            {
                newTree[newSize + i] = _tree[_size + i];
            }

            for (int i = newSize - 1; i > 0; i--)
            {
                int left = i << 1;
                int right = left | 1;
                newTree[i] = newTree[left] >= newTree[right] ? newTree[left] : newTree[right];
            }

            _size = newSize;
            _tree = newTree;
        }
    }

    private sealed class FastReader
    {
        private readonly Stream _stream;
        private readonly byte[] _buffer;
        private int _length;
        private int _position;

        public FastReader(Stream stream, int bufferSize = 1 << 16)
        {
            _stream = stream;
            _buffer = new byte[bufferSize];
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c;
            do
            {
                c = Read();
                if (c < 0)
                {
                    throw new EndOfStreamException();
                }
            } while (c <= 32);

            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int value = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }

            return value * sign;
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_position >= _length)
            {
                _length = _stream.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _position = 0;
                if (_length == 0)
                {
                    return -1;
                }
            }

            return _buffer[_position++];
        }
    }
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <set>
#include <tuple>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

struct RectInput {
    int w = 0;
    int h = 0;
    int id = -1;
    long long area = 0;
    int max_side = 0;
};

struct Placement {
    int board = -1;
    int x = 0;
    int y = 0;
    int rotated = 0;
};

struct FreeRect {
    int x = 0;
    int y = 0;
    int w = 0;
    int h = 0;
};

struct Board {
    std::vector<FreeRect> free_rects;
};

static inline bool contains_rect(const FreeRect& a, const FreeRect& b) {
    return a.x <= b.x && a.y <= b.y &&
           a.x + a.w >= b.x + b.w &&
           a.y + a.h >= b.y + b.h;
}

static void prune_free_rects(std::vector<FreeRect>& rects) {
    std::vector<FreeRect> filtered;
    filtered.reserve(rects.size());
    for (const auto& r : rects) {
        if (r.w > 0 && r.h > 0) {
            filtered.push_back(r);
        }
    }

    std::vector<char> removed(filtered.size(), 0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < filtered.size(); ++i) {
        if (removed[i]) {
            continue;
        }
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < filtered.size(); ++j) {
            if (removed[j]) {
                continue;
            }
            if (contains_rect(filtered[i], filtered[j])) {
                removed[j] = 1;
            } else if (contains_rect(filtered[j], filtered[i])) {
                removed[i] = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    rects.clear();
    rects.reserve(filtered.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < filtered.size(); ++i) {
        if (!removed[i]) {
            rects.push_back(filtered[i]);
        }
    }
}

static bool insert_into_board(Board& board, int bw, int bh, const RectInput& rect, Placement& out) {
    long long best_score = std::numeric_limits<long long>::max();
    int best_idx = -1;
    int best_rw = 0;
    int best_rh = 0;
    int best_rot = 0;

    const int try_count_limit = 96;
    const int scan_count = static_cast<int>(board.free_rects.size());
    const int start = scan_count > try_count_limit ? scan_count - try_count_limit : 0;

    for (int i = start; i < scan_count; ++i) {
        const FreeRect& fr = board.free_rects[i];
        for (int rot = 0; rot < 2; ++rot) {
            int rw = rot ? rect.h : rect.w;
            int rh = rot ? rect.w : rect.h;
            if (rw > fr.w || rh > fr.h) {
                continue;
            }
            int leftover_w = fr.w - rw;
            int leftover_h = fr.h - rh;
            long long short_side = std::min(leftover_w, leftover_h);
            long long long_side = std::max(leftover_w, leftover_h);
            long long waste = 1LL * fr.w * fr.h - 1LL * rw * rh;
            long long score = (short_side << 40) + (long_side << 24) + waste;
            if (score < best_score) {
                best_score = score;
                best_idx = i;
                best_rw = rw;
                best_rh = rh;
                best_rot = rot;
            }
        }
    }

    if (best_idx < 0) {
        return false;
    }

    FreeRect used = board.free_rects[best_idx];
    board.free_rects.erase(board.free_rects.begin() + best_idx);

    out.x = used.x;
    out.y = used.y;
    out.rotated = best_rot;

    int right_w = used.w - best_rw;
    int below_h = used.h - best_rh;

    if (right_w > 0) {
        board.free_rects.push_back({used.x + best_rw, used.y, right_w, best_rh});
    }
    if (below_h > 0) {
        board.free_rects.push_back({used.x, used.y + best_rh, used.w, below_h});
    }

    if (right_w > 0 && below_h > 0) {
        // Keep the split guillotine-compatible and add the larger remainder first
        // so recent rectangles are more promising candidates for the bounded scan.
        const int n = static_cast<int>(board.free_rects.size());
        const FreeRect& a = board.free_rects[n - 2];
        const FreeRect& b = board.free_rects[n - 1];
        long long area_a = 1LL * a.w * a.h;
        long long area_b = 1LL * b.w * b.h;
        if (area_a < area_b) {
            std::swap(board.free_rects[n - 2], board.free_rects[n - 1]);
        }
    }

    if (board.free_rects.size() > 256) {
        prune_free_rects(board.free_rects);
    }

    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n = 0;
    int board_w = 0;
    int board_h = 0;
    if (!(std::cin >> n >> board_w >> board_h)) {
        return 0;
    }

    std::vector<RectInput> rects(n);
    long long total_area = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int w, h;
        std::cin >> w >> h;
        rects[i] = {w, h, i, 1LL * w * h, std::max(w, h)};
        total_area += rects[i].area;
    }

    for (const auto& r : rects) {
        bool fits = (r.w <= board_w && r.h <= board_h) || (r.h <= board_w && r.w <= board_h);
        if (!fits) {
            std::cout << -1 << '\n';
            return 0;
        }
    }

    std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [](const RectInput& a, const RectInput& b) {
        if (a.max_side != b.max_side) return a.max_side > b.max_side;
        if (a.area != b.area) return a.area > b.area;
        if (a.h != b.h) return a.h > b.h;
        if (a.w != b.w) return a.w > b.w;
        return a.id < b.id;
    });

    std::vector<Placement> answer(n);
    std::vector<Board> boards;
    boards.reserve(std::max(4, static_cast<int>(total_area / std::max(1LL, 1LL * board_w * board_h)) + 8));

    std::set<std::pair<int, int>> candidates;

    auto refresh_board_candidate = [&](int idx) {
        auto it_low = candidates.lower_bound({idx, std::numeric_limits<int>::min()});
        while (it_low != candidates.end() && it_low->first == idx) {
            it_low = candidates.erase(it_low);
        }

        int best_max = -1;
        for (const auto& fr : boards[idx].free_rects) {
            best_max = std::max(best_max, std::max(fr.w, fr.h));
        }
        if (best_max >= 0) {
            candidates.insert({idx, -best_max});
        }
    };

    for (const auto& rect : rects) {
        Placement placed;
        bool ok = false;

        std::vector<int> board_order;
        board_order.reserve(std::min<size_t>(candidates.size(), 64));
        for (const auto& entry : candidates) {
            board_order.push_back(entry.first);
            if (board_order.size() >= 64) {
                break;
            }
        }

        for (int idx : board_order) {
            if (insert_into_board(boards[idx], board_w, board_h, rect, placed)) {
                placed.board = idx;
                refresh_board_candidate(idx);
                ok = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!ok) {
            Board b;
            b.free_rects.push_back({0, 0, board_w, board_h});
            boards.push_back(std::move(b));
            int idx = static_cast<int>(boards.size()) - 1;
            bool inserted = insert_into_board(boards[idx], board_w, board_h, rect, placed);
            if (!inserted) {
                std::cout << -1 << '\n';
                return 0;
            }
            placed.board = idx;
            refresh_board_candidate(idx);
        }

        answer[rect.id] = placed;
    }

    std::cout << boards.size() << '\n';
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const auto& p = answer[i];
        std::cout << p.board << ' ' << p.x << ' ' << p.y << ' ' << p.rotated << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::f64::consts::{FRAC_PI_2, PI};
use std::io::{self, Read};

const EPS: f64 = 1e-9;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl Point {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Self {
        Self { x, y }
    }

    fn add(self, other: Point) -> Self {
        Self::new(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    }

    fn sub(self, other: Point) -> Self {
        Self::new(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    }

    fn dot(self, other: Point) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y
    }

    fn cross(self, other: Point) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.y - self.y * other.x
    }

    fn rotate(self, angle: f64) -> Self {
        let (s, c) = angle.sin_cos();
        Self::new(self.x * c - self.y * s, self.x * s + self.y * c)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct BBox {
    min_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    max_x: f64,
    max_y: f64,
}

impl BBox {
    fn width(&self) -> f64 {
        self.max_x - self.min_x
    }

    fn height(&self) -> f64 {
        self.max_y - self.min_y
    }

    fn intersects(&self, other: &BBox) -> bool {
        self.min_x < other.max_x - EPS
            && self.max_x > other.min_x + EPS
            && self.min_y < other.max_y - EPS
            && self.max_y > other.min_y + EPS
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Polygon {
    pts: Vec<Point>,
    bbox: BBox,
    area: f64,
}

impl Polygon {
    fn new(pts: Vec<Point>) -> Self {
        let bbox = bbox_of(&pts);
        let area = polygon_area(&pts).abs();
        Self { pts, bbox, area }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct OrientedPiece {
    polygon: Polygon,
    width: f64,
    height: f64,
    angle: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Piece {
    original_index: usize,
    variants: Vec<OrientedPiece>,
    area: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Placement {
    stock_index: usize,
    translation: Point,
    rotation: f64,
    placed_polygon: Polygon,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Occupied {
    bbox: BBox,
    poly: Polygon,
}

struct StockState {
    occupied: Vec<Occupied>,
    skyline: Vec<Shelf>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Shelf {
    y: f64,
    height: f64,
    x: f64,
}

fn polygon_area(pts: &[Point]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    for i in 0..pts.len() {
        let a = pts[i];
        let b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.len()];
        area += a.cross(b);
    }
    area * 0.5
}

fn bbox_of(pts: &[Point]) -> BBox {
    let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    for p in pts {
        min_x = min_x.min(p.x);
        min_y = min_y.min(p.y);
        max_x = max_x.max(p.x);
        max_y = max_y.max(p.y);
    }
    BBox {
        min_x,
        min_y,
        max_x,
        max_y,
    }
}

fn normalize_polygon(pts: &[Point]) -> Vec<Point> {
    let bbox = bbox_of(pts);
    pts.iter()
        .map(|p| Point::new(p.x - bbox.min_x, p.y - bbox.min_y))
        .collect()
}

fn transform_polygon(pts: &[Point], angle: f64, shift: Point) -> Vec<Point> {
    pts.iter().map(|p| p.rotate(angle).add(shift)).collect()
}

fn point_on_segment(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point) -> bool {
    let ab = b.sub(a);
    let ap = p.sub(a);
    let cross = ab.cross(ap).abs();
    if cross > 1e-7 {
        return false;
    }
    let dot = ap.dot(p.sub(b));
    dot <= 1e-7
}

fn point_in_polygon(poly: &[Point], p: Point) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
        if point_on_segment(p, a, b) {
            return true;
        }
        let intersects = ((a.y > p.y) != (b.y > p.y))
            && (p.x < (b.x - a.x) * (p.y - a.y) / (b.y - a.y) + a.x);
        if intersects {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    inside
}

fn orient(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) -> f64 {
    b.sub(a).cross(c.sub(a))
}

fn segments_intersect(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point, d: Point) -> bool {
    let o1 = orient(a, b, c);
    let o2 = orient(a, b, d);
    let o3 = orient(c, d, a);
    let o4 = orient(c, d, b);

    if o1.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(c, a, b) {
        return true;
    }
    if o2.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(d, a, b) {
        return true;
    }
    if o3.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(a, c, d) {
        return true;
    }
    if o4.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(b, c, d) {
        return true;
    }

    (o1 > 0.0) != (o2 > 0.0) && (o3 > 0.0) != (o4 > 0.0)
}

fn polygons_overlap(a: &[Point], b: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let bb_a = bbox_of(a);
    let bb_b = bbox_of(b);
    if !bb_a.intersects(&bb_b) {
        return false;
    }
    for i in 0..a.len() {
        let a1 = a[i];
        let a2 = a[(i + 1) % a.len()];
        for j in 0..b.len() {
            let b1 = b[j];
            let b2 = b[(j + 1) % b.len()];
            if segments_intersect(a1, a2, b1, b2) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    point_in_polygon(a, b[0]) || point_in_polygon(b, a[0])
}

fn polygon_inside(stock: &[Point], poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    poly.iter().all(|&p| point_in_polygon(stock, p))
}

fn candidate_angles(poly: &[Point], large_mode: bool) -> Vec<f64> {
    let mut angles = vec![0.0, FRAC_PI_2];
    if !large_mode {
        angles.extend([PI, 3.0 * FRAC_PI_2]);
        if poly.len() <= 32 {
            for i in 0..poly.len() {
                let a = poly[i];
                let b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
                let edge = b.sub(a);
                if edge.x.abs() + edge.y.abs() > EPS {
                    let ang = (-edge.y).atan2(edge.x);
                    let canon = canonical_angle(ang);
                    angles.push(canon);
                    angles.push(canonical_angle(canon + FRAC_PI_2));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    angles.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    angles.dedup_by(|a, b| (*a - *b).abs() < 1e-8);
    angles
}

fn canonical_angle(mut a: f64) -> f64 {
    while a < 0.0 {
        a += 2.0 * PI;
    }
    while a >= 2.0 * PI {
        a -= 2.0 * PI;
    }
    a
}

fn build_piece(poly: Polygon, original_index: usize, large_mode: bool) -> Piece {
    let normalized = normalize_polygon(&poly.pts);
    let angles = candidate_angles(&normalized, large_mode);
    let mut variants = Vec::new();
    for angle in angles {
        let rotated: Vec<Point> = normalized.iter().map(|p| p.rotate(angle)).collect();
        let placed = normalize_polygon(&rotated);
        let polygon = Polygon::new(placed);
        variants.push(OrientedPiece {
            width: polygon.bbox.width(),
            height: polygon.bbox.height(),
            angle,
            polygon,
        });
    }
    variants.sort_by(|a, b| {
        (a.width * a.height)
            .partial_cmp(&(b.width * b.height))
            .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
    });
    variants.dedup_by(|a, b| {
        (a.width - b.width).abs() < 1e-7
            && (a.height - b.height).abs() < 1e-7
            && a.polygon.pts.len() == b.polygon.pts.len()
    });
    Piece {
        original_index,
        variants,
        area: poly.area,
    }
}

fn stock_bounds(stock: &Polygon) -> (f64, f64) {
    (stock.bbox.width(), stock.bbox.height())
}

fn try_place_in_stock(
    stock_poly: &Polygon,
    stock_state: &mut StockState,
    piece: &Piece,
    stock_index: usize,
    coarse_only: bool,
) -> Option<Placement> {
    let (stock_w, stock_h) = stock_bounds(stock_poly);
    let coarse_positions = if coarse_only { 16 } else { 64 };

    let mut variant_order: Vec<&OrientedPiece> = piece.variants.iter().collect();
    variant_order.sort_by(|a, b| {
        let da = (a.width * a.height)
            .partial_cmp(&(b.width * b.height))
            .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal);
        da
    });

    for variant in variant_order {
        if variant.width > stock_w + EPS || variant.height > stock_h + EPS {
            continue;
        }

        for shelf_idx in 0..stock_state.skyline.len() {
            let shelf = stock_state.skyline[shelf_idx];
            if variant.height <= shelf.height + EPS && shelf.x + variant.width <= stock_w + EPS {
                let candidate = Point::new(shelf.x, shelf.y);
                if let Some(pl) = validate_candidate(stock_poly, stock_state, variant, candidate, stock_index) {
                    stock_state.skyline[shelf_idx].x += variant.width;
                    return Some(pl);
                }
            }
        }

        let current_top = stock_state
            .skyline
            .iter()
            .map(|s| s.y + s.height)
            .fold(0.0, f64::max);
        if current_top + variant.height <= stock_h + EPS {
            let candidate = Point::new(0.0, current_top);
            if let Some(pl) = validate_candidate(stock_poly, stock_state, variant, candidate, stock_index) {
                stock_state.skyline.push(Shelf {
                    y: current_top,
                    height: variant.height,
                    x: variant.width,
                });
                return Some(pl);
            }
        }

        let x_steps = ((stock_w - variant.width).max(0.0) / variant.width.max(1.0)).ceil() as usize + 1;
        let y_steps = ((stock_h - variant.height).max(0.0) / variant.height.max(1.0)).ceil() as usize + 1;
        let x_steps = x_steps.min(coarse_positions);
        let y_steps = y_steps.min(coarse_positions);

        for yi in 0..y_steps {
            let y = if y_steps <= 1 {
                0.0
            } else {
                (stock_h - variant.height) * yi as f64 / (y_steps - 1) as f64
            };
            for xi in 0..x_steps {
                let x = if x_steps <= 1 {
                    0.0
                } else {
                    (stock_w - variant.width) * xi as f64 / (x_steps - 1) as f64
                };
                if let Some(pl) = validate_candidate(stock_poly, stock_state, variant, Point::new(x, y), stock_index) {
                    return Some(pl);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn validate_candidate(
    stock_poly: &Polygon,
    stock_state: &mut StockState,
    variant: &OrientedPiece,
    candidate: Point,
    stock_index: usize,
) -> Option<Placement> {
    let pts = transform_polygon(&variant.polygon.pts, 0.0, candidate);
    if !polygon_inside(&stock_poly.pts, &pts) {
        return None;
    }
    let poly = Polygon::new(pts);
    for occ in &stock_state.occupied {
        if occ.bbox.intersects(&poly.bbox) && polygons_overlap(&occ.poly.pts, &poly.pts) {
            return None;
        }
    }
    stock_state.occupied.push(Occupied {
        bbox: poly.bbox,
        poly: poly.clone(),
    });
    Some(Placement {
        stock_index,
        translation: candidate,
        rotation: variant.angle,
        placed_polygon: poly,
    })
}

fn solve(stock: Polygon, raw_pieces: Vec<Polygon>) -> Vec<Placement> {
    let np = raw_pieces.len();
    let large_mode = np > 200 || raw_pieces.iter().map(|p| p.pts.len()).sum::<usize>() > 20_000;
    let mut pieces: Vec<Piece> = raw_pieces
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, p)| build_piece(p, i, large_mode))
        .collect();

    pieces.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.area
            .partial_cmp(&a.area)
            .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| {
                let ab = a.variants[0].width.max(a.variants[0].height);
                let bb = b.variants[0].width.max(b.variants[0].height);
                bb.partial_cmp(&ab).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
            })
    });

    let mut placements: Vec<Option<Placement>> = vec![None; np];
    let mut stocks: Vec<StockState> = Vec::new();
    let coarse_only = large_mode;

    for piece in &pieces {
        let mut placed = None;
        for stock_index in 0..stocks.len() {
            if let Some(pl) = try_place_in_stock(&stock, &mut stocks[stock_index], piece, stock_index, coarse_only) {
                placed = Some(pl);
                break;
            }
        }
        if placed.is_none() {
            let mut new_stock = StockState {
                occupied: Vec::new(),
                skyline: Vec::new(),
            };
            let stock_index = stocks.len();
            if let Some(pl) = try_place_in_stock(&stock, &mut new_stock, piece, stock_index, coarse_only) {
                stocks.push(new_stock);
                placed = Some(pl);
            }
        }

        if let Some(final_placement) = placed {
            placements[piece.original_index] = Some(final_placement);
        } else {
            let stock_index = stocks.len();
            let mut placed_any = None;
            for variant in &piece.variants {
                let pts = transform_polygon(&variant.polygon.pts, 0.0, Point::new(0.0, 0.0));
                if polygon_inside(&stock.pts, &pts) {
                    let poly = Polygon::new(pts);
                    let new_stock = StockState {
                        occupied: vec![Occupied {
                            bbox: poly.bbox,
                            poly: poly.clone(),
                        }],
                        skyline: vec![Shelf {
                            y: 0.0,
                            height: variant.height,
                            x: variant.width,
                        }],
                    };
                    stocks.push(new_stock);
                    placed_any = Some(Placement {
                        stock_index,
                        translation: Point::new(0.0, 0.0),
                        rotation: variant.angle,
                        placed_polygon: poly,
                    });
                    break;
                }
            }
            let placement = placed_any.expect("piece does not fit inside stock polygon in any supported orientation");
            placements[piece.original_index] = Some(placement);
        }
    }

    placements.into_iter().map(|p| p.unwrap()).collect()
}

fn read_input() -> (Polygon, Vec<Polygon>) {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();

    let sv: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let np: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    let mut stock_pts = Vec::with_capacity(sv);
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let x: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        stock_pts.push(Point::new(x, y));
    }

    let mut pieces = Vec::with_capacity(np);
    for _ in 0..np {
        let pv: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let mut pts = Vec::with_capacity(pv);
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let x: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            let y: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            pts.push(Point::new(x, y));
        }
        pieces.push(Polygon::new(pts));
    }

    (Polygon::new(stock_pts), pieces)
}

fn main() {
    let (stock, pieces) = read_input();
    let placements = solve(stock, pieces);
    let num_stocks = placements
        .iter()
        .map(|p| p.stock_index)
        .max()
        .map(|m| m + 1)
        .unwrap_or(0);
    println!("{}", num_stocks);
    for pl in placements {
        let _ = pl.placed_polygon.bbox.width();
        println!(
            "{} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9}",
            pl.stock_index, pl.translation.x, pl.translation.y, pl.rotation
        );
    }
}

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::f64::consts::{FRAC_PI_2, PI};
use std::io::{self, Read};

const EPS: f64 = 1e-9;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl Point {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Self {
        Self { x, y }
    }

    fn add(self, other: Point) -> Self {
        Self::new(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    }

    fn sub(self, other: Point) -> Self {
        Self::new(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    }

    fn dot(self, other: Point) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y
    }

    fn cross(self, other: Point) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.y - self.y * other.x
    }

    fn rotate(self, angle: f64) -> Self {
        let (s, c) = angle.sin_cos();
        Self::new(self.x * c - self.y * s, self.x * s + self.y * c)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct BBox {
    min_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    max_x: f64,
    max_y: f64,
}

impl BBox {
    fn width(&self) -> f64 {
        self.max_x - self.min_x
    }

    fn height(&self) -> f64 {
        self.max_y - self.min_y
    }

    fn intersects(&self, other: &BBox) -> bool {
        self.min_x < other.max_x - EPS
            && self.max_x > other.min_x + EPS
            && self.min_y < other.max_y - EPS
            && self.max_y > other.min_y + EPS
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Polygon {
    pts: Vec<Point>,
    bbox: BBox,
    area: f64,
}

impl Polygon {
    fn new(pts: Vec<Point>) -> Self {
        let bbox = bbox_of(&pts);
        let area = polygon_area(&pts).abs();
        Self { pts, bbox, area }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct OrientedPiece {
    polygon: Polygon,
    width: f64,
    height: f64,
    angle: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Piece {
    original_index: usize,
    variants: Vec<OrientedPiece>,
    area: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Placement {
    stock_index: usize,
    translation: Point,
    rotation: f64,
    placed_polygon: Polygon,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Occupied {
    bbox: BBox,
    poly: Polygon,
}

struct StockState {
    occupied: Vec<Occupied>,
    skyline: Vec<Shelf>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Shelf {
    y: f64,
    height: f64,
    x: f64,
}

fn polygon_area(pts: &[Point]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    for i in 0..pts.len() {
        let a = pts[i];
        let b = pts[(i + 1) % pts.len()];
        area += a.cross(b);
    }
    area * 0.5
}

fn bbox_of(pts: &[Point]) -> BBox {
    let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    for p in pts {
        min_x = min_x.min(p.x);
        min_y = min_y.min(p.y);
        max_x = max_x.max(p.x);
        max_y = max_y.max(p.y);
    }
    BBox {
        min_x,
        min_y,
        max_x,
        max_y,
    }
}

fn normalize_polygon(pts: &[Point]) -> Vec<Point> {
    let bbox = bbox_of(pts);
    pts.iter()
        .map(|p| Point::new(p.x - bbox.min_x, p.y - bbox.min_y))
        .collect()
}

fn transform_polygon(pts: &[Point], angle: f64, shift: Point) -> Vec<Point> {
    pts.iter().map(|p| p.rotate(angle).add(shift)).collect()
}

fn point_on_segment(p: Point, a: Point, b: Point) -> bool {
    let ab = b.sub(a);
    let ap = p.sub(a);
    let cross = ab.cross(ap).abs();
    if cross > 1e-7 {
        return false;
    }
    let dot = ap.dot(p.sub(b));
    dot <= 1e-7
}

fn point_in_polygon(poly: &[Point], p: Point) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
        if point_on_segment(p, a, b) {
            return true;
        }
        let intersects = ((a.y > p.y) != (b.y > p.y))
            && (p.x < (b.x - a.x) * (p.y - a.y) / (b.y - a.y) + a.x);
        if intersects {
            inside = !inside;
        }
    }
    inside
}

fn orient(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point) -> f64 {
    b.sub(a).cross(c.sub(a))
}

fn segments_intersect(a: Point, b: Point, c: Point, d: Point) -> bool {
    let o1 = orient(a, b, c);
    let o2 = orient(a, b, d);
    let o3 = orient(c, d, a);
    let o4 = orient(c, d, b);

    if o1.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(c, a, b) {
        return true;
    }
    if o2.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(d, a, b) {
        return true;
    }
    if o3.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(a, c, d) {
        return true;
    }
    if o4.abs() <= 1e-7 && point_on_segment(b, c, d) {
        return true;
    }

    (o1 > 0.0) != (o2 > 0.0) && (o3 > 0.0) != (o4 > 0.0)
}

fn polygons_overlap(a: &[Point], b: &[Point]) -> bool {
    let bb_a = bbox_of(a);
    let bb_b = bbox_of(b);
    if !bb_a.intersects(&bb_b) {
        return false;
    }
    for i in 0..a.len() {
        let a1 = a[i];
        let a2 = a[(i + 1) % a.len()];
        for j in 0..b.len() {
            let b1 = b[j];
            let b2 = b[(j + 1) % b.len()];
            if segments_intersect(a1, a2, b1, b2) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    point_in_polygon(a, b[0]) || point_in_polygon(b, a[0])
}

fn polygon_inside(stock: &[Point], poly: &[Point]) -> bool {
    poly.iter().all(|&p| point_in_polygon(stock, p))
}

fn candidate_angles(poly: &[Point], large_mode: bool) -> Vec<f64> {
    let mut angles = vec![0.0, FRAC_PI_2];
    if !large_mode {
        angles.extend([PI, 3.0 * FRAC_PI_2]);
        if poly.len() <= 32 {
            for i in 0..poly.len() {
                let a = poly[i];
                let b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
                let edge = b.sub(a);
                if edge.x.abs() + edge.y.abs() > EPS {
                    let ang = (-edge.y).atan2(edge.x);
                    let canon = canonical_angle(ang);
                    angles.push(canon);
                    angles.push(canonical_angle(canon + FRAC_PI_2));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    angles.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    angles.dedup_by(|a, b| (*a - *b).abs() < 1e-8);
    angles
}

fn canonical_angle(mut a: f64) -> f64 {
    while a < 0.0 {
        a += 2.0 * PI;
    }
    while a >= 2.0 * PI {
        a -= 2.0 * PI;
    }
    a
}

fn build_piece(poly: Polygon, original_index: usize, large_mode: bool) -> Piece {

}

    let coarse_only = large_mode;

    for piece in &pieces {
        let mut placed = None;
        for stock_index in 0..stocks.len() {
            if let Some(pl) = try_place_in_stock(&stock, &mut stocks[stock_index], piece, stock_index, coarse_only) {
                placed = Some(pl);
                break;
            }
        }
        if placed.is_none() {
            let mut new_stock = StockState {
                occupied: Vec::new(),
                skyline: Vec::new(),
            };
            let stock_index = stocks.len();
            if let Some(pl) = try_place_in_stock(&stock, &mut new_stock, piece, stock_index, coarse_only) {
                stocks.push(new_stock);
                placed = Some(pl);
            }
        }

        if let Some(final_placement) = placed {
            placements[piece.original_index] = Some(final_placement);
        } else {
            let stock_index = stocks.len();
            let mut placed_any = None;
            for variant in &piece.variants {
                let pts = transform_polygon(&variant.polygon.pts, 0.0, Point::new(0.0, 0.0));
                if polygon_inside(&stock.pts, &pts) {
                    let poly = Polygon::new(pts);
                    let new_stock = StockState {
                        occupied: vec![Occupied {
                            bbox: poly.bbox,
                            poly: poly.clone(),
                        }],
                        skyline: vec![Shelf {
                            y: 0.0,
                            height: variant.height,
                            x: variant.width,
                        }],
                    };
                    stocks.push(new_stock);
                    placed_any = Some(Placement {
                        stock_index,
                        translation: Point::new(0.0, 0.0),
                        rotation: variant.angle,
                        placed_polygon: poly,
                    });
                    break;
                }
            }
            let placement = placed_any.expect("piece does not fit inside stock polygon in any supported orientation");
            placements[piece.original_index] = Some(placement);
        }
    }

    placements.into_iter().map(|p| p.unwrap()).collect()
}

fn read_input() -> (Polygon, Vec<Polygon>) {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();

    let sv: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let np: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    let mut stock_pts = Vec::with_capacity(sv);
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let x: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let y: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        stock_pts.push(Point::new(x, y));
    }

    let mut pieces = Vec::with_capacity(np);
    for _ in 0..np {
        let pv: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let mut pts = Vec::with_capacity(pv);
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let x: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            let y: f64 = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
            pts.push(Point::new(x, y));
        }
        pieces.push(Polygon::new(pts));
    }

    (Polygon::new(stock_pts), pieces)
}

fn main() {
    let (stock, pieces) = read_input();
    let placements = solve(stock, pieces);
    let num_stocks = placements
        .iter()
        .map(|p| p.stock_index)
        .max()
        .map(|m| m + 1)
        .unwrap_or(0);
    println!("{}", num_stocks);
    for pl in placements {
        let _ = pl.placed_polygon.bbox.width();
        println!(
            "{} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9}",
            pl.stock_index, pl.translation.x, pl.translation.y, pl.rotation
        );
    }
}
