using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Numerics;

public static class Program
{
    const double Eps = 1e-9;

    struct Triangle
    {
        public Vector3 A;
        public Vector3 B;
        public Vector3 C;
        public Triangle(Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c)
        {
            A = a; B = b; C = c;
        }
    }

    struct Placement
    {
        public Vector3 T;
        public Quaternion Q;
        public Placement(Vector3 t, Quaternion q)
        {
            T = t; Q = q;
        }
    }

    sealed class Orientation
    {
        public Quaternion Q;
        public Vector3[] RotatedVertices = Array.Empty<Vector3>();
        public Triangle[] RotatedTriangles = Array.Empty<Triangle>();
        public Vector3 Min;
        public Vector3 Max;
        public Vector3 Size;
        public List<(int X, int Y, int Z)> Voxels = new List<(int X, int Y, int Z)>();
        public int VoxelVolume;
    }

    sealed class Polyhedron
    {
        public Vector3[] Vertices = Array.Empty<Vector3>();
        public int[][] Faces = Array.Empty<int[]>();
        public Triangle[] Triangles = Array.Empty<Triangle>();
        public double Volume;
        public Vector3 Min;
        public Vector3 Max;
        public Vector3 Size;
        public List<Orientation> Orientations = new List<Orientation>();
    }

    enum Strategy
    {
        SmallVoxel,
        MediumLayered,
        LargeAabb
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        var fs = new FastScanner();
        int v = fs.NextInt();
        int f = fs.NextInt();
        if (v <= 0 || f <= 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            return;
        }

        var poly = new Polyhedron();
        poly.Vertices = new Vector3[v];
        for (int i = 0; i < v; i++)
        {
            float x = (float)fs.NextDouble();
            float y = (float)fs.NextDouble();
            float z = (float)fs.NextDouble();
            poly.Vertices[i] = new Vector3(x, y, z);
        }

        poly.Faces = new int[f][];
        var tris = new List<Triangle>(Math.Max(f, 4));
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++)
        {
            int a = fs.NextInt();
            int b = fs.NextInt();
            int c = fs.NextInt();
            poly.Faces[i] = new[] { a, b, c };
            tris.Add(new Triangle(poly.Vertices[a], poly.Vertices[b], poly.Vertices[c]));
        }

        int W = fs.NextInt();
        int H = fs.NextInt();
        int D = fs.NextInt();
        if (W <= 0 || H <= 0 || D <= 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            return;
        }

        poly.Triangles = tris.ToArray();
        ComputeBoundsAndVolume(poly);
        BuildOrientations(poly);

        long containerVolume = 1L * W * H * D;
        long aabbVolume = Math.Max(1L, (long)Math.Ceiling(poly.Size.X) * (long)Math.Ceiling(poly.Size.Y) * (long)Math.Ceiling(poly.Size.Z));
        Strategy strategy = ChooseStrategy(W, H, D, poly, containerVolume, aabbVolume);

        List<Placement> placements = strategy switch
        {
            Strategy.SmallVoxel => SolveSmallVoxel(W, H, D, poly),
            Strategy.MediumLayered => SolveMediumLayered(W, H, D, poly),
            _ => SolveLargeAabb(W, H, D, poly),
        };

        Console.WriteLine(placements.Count);
        foreach (var p in placements)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"{Fmt(p.T.X)} {Fmt(p.T.Y)} {Fmt(p.T.Z)} {Fmt(p.Q.W)} {Fmt(p.Q.X)} {Fmt(p.Q.Y)} {Fmt(p.Q.Z)}");
        }
    }

    static string Fmt(float x) => x.ToString("0.######", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    static Strategy ChooseStrategy(int w, int h, int d, Polyhedron poly, long containerVolume, long aabbVolume)
    {
        int maxDim = Math.Max(w, Math.Max(h, d));
        if (maxDim <= 18 && containerVolume <= 20000 && poly.Vertices.Length <= 128)
            return Strategy.SmallVoxel;
        if (maxDim <= 120 && containerVolume <= 3_000_000 && poly.Vertices.Length <= 2000)
            return Strategy.MediumLayered;
        return Strategy.LargeAabb;
    }

    static void ComputeBoundsAndVolume(Polyhedron poly)
    {
        Vector3 min = poly.Vertices[0];
        Vector3 max = poly.Vertices[0];
        foreach (var p in poly.Vertices)
        {
            min = Vector3.Min(min, p);
            max = Vector3.Max(max, p);
        }
        poly.Min = min;
        poly.Max = max;
        poly.Size = max - min;

        double vol6 = 0.0;
        foreach (var t in poly.Triangles)
        {
            vol6 += Vector3.Dot(t.A, Vector3.Cross(t.B, t.C));
        }
        poly.Volume = Math.Abs(vol6) / 6.0;
        if (poly.Volume < Eps)
        {
            poly.Volume = Math.Max(1.0, poly.Size.X * poly.Size.Y * poly.Size.Z);
        }
    }

    static void BuildOrientations(Polyhedron poly)
    {
        var bases = new[]
        {
            Quaternion.Identity,
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitX, MathF.PI / 2),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitX, MathF.PI),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitX, 3 * MathF.PI / 2),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitY, MathF.PI / 2),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitY, MathF.PI),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitY, 3 * MathF.PI / 2),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitZ, MathF.PI / 2),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitZ, MathF.PI),
            Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(Vector3.UnitZ, 3 * MathF.PI / 2),
        };

        var seen = new HashSet<string>();
        foreach (var q0 in bases)
        {
            foreach (var q1 in bases)
            {
                var q = Quaternion.Normalize(Quaternion.Concatenate(q0, q1));
                var m = Matrix4x4.CreateFromQuaternion(q);
                var x = RoundAxis(Vector3.TransformNormal(Vector3.UnitX, m));
                var y = RoundAxis(Vector3.TransformNormal(Vector3.UnitY, m));
                var z = RoundAxis(Vector3.TransformNormal(Vector3.UnitZ, m));
                string key = $"{x.X},{x.Y},{x.Z}|{y.X},{y.Y},{y.Z}|{z.X},{z.Y},{z.Z}";
                if (!seen.Add(key)) continue;

                var o = new Orientation();
                o.Q = q;
                o.RotatedVertices = new Vector3[poly.Vertices.Length];
                Vector3 min = new Vector3(float.PositiveInfinity);
                Vector3 max = new Vector3(float.NegativeInfinity);
                for (int i = 0; i < poly.Vertices.Length; i++)
                {
                    var rp = Vector3.Transform(poly.Vertices[i], q);
                    o.RotatedVertices[i] = rp;
                    min = Vector3.Min(min, rp);
                    max = Vector3.Max(max, rp);
                }
                o.Min = min;
                o.Max = max;
                o.Size = max - min;
                o.RotatedTriangles = new Triangle[poly.Triangles.Length];
                for (int i = 0; i < poly.Triangles.Length; i++)
                {
                    var t = poly.Triangles[i];
                    o.RotatedTriangles[i] = new Triangle(Vector3.Transform(t.A, q), Vector3.Transform(t.B, q), Vector3.Transform(t.C, q));
                }
                BuildVoxelShape(o);
                poly.Orientations.Add(o);
            }
        }

        poly.Orientations = poly.Orientations
            .OrderBy(o => o.Size.X * o.Size.Y * o.Size.Z)
            .ThenByDescending(o => o.VoxelVolume)
            .ToList();
    }

    static Vector3 RoundAxis(Vector3 v)
    {
        return new Vector3(MathF.Round(v.X), MathF.Round(v.Y), MathF.Round(v.Z));
    }

    static void BuildVoxelShape(Orientation o)
    {
        int sx = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.X - 1e-6));
        int sy = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Y - 1e-6));
        int sz = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Z - 1e-6));
        int limit = sx * sy * sz;
        if (limit > 200000)
        {
            o.Voxels.Add((0, 0, 0));
            o.VoxelVolume = 1;
            return;
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < sx; x++)
        for (int y = 0; y < sy; y++)
        for (int z = 0; z < sz; z++)
        {
            var p = new Vector3(o.Min.X + x + 0.5f, o.Min.Y + y + 0.5f, o.Min.Z + z + 0.5f);
            if (PointInClosedMesh(p, o.RotatedTriangles))
                o.Voxels.Add((x, y, z));
        }

        if (o.Voxels.Count == 0)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < sx; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < sy; y++)
            for (int z = 0; z < sz; z++)
                o.Voxels.Add((x, y, z));
        }
        o.VoxelVolume = o.Voxels.Count;
    }

    static List<Placement> SolveSmallVoxel(int W, int H, int D, Polyhedron poly)
    {
        var occupied = new bool[W, H, D];
        var results = new List<Placement>();

        foreach (var o in poly.Orientations.OrderByDescending(x => x.VoxelVolume * 1.0 / Math.Max(1e-6, x.Size.X * x.Size.Y * x.Size.Z)))
        {
            int sx = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.X - 1e-6));
            int sy = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Y - 1e-6));
            int sz = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Z - 1e-6));
            if (sx > W || sy > H || sz > D) continue;

            for (int x = 0; x <= W - sx; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y <= H - sy; y++)
            for (int z = 0; z <= D - sz; z++)
            {
                if (!FitsVoxel(occupied, o, x, y, z)) continue;
                StampVoxel(occupied, o, x, y, z, true);
                Vector3 t = new Vector3(x - o.Min.X, y - o.Min.Y, z - o.Min.Z);
                results.Add(new Placement(t, o.Q));
            }
        }

        if (results.Count > 0) return results;
        return SolveMediumLayered(W, H, D, poly);
    }

    static bool FitsVoxel(bool[,,] occupied, Orientation o, int ox, int oy, int oz)
    {
        int W = occupied.GetLength(0);
        int H = occupied.GetLength(1);
        int D = occupied.GetLength(2);
        foreach (var c in o.Voxels)
        {
            int x = ox + c.X;
            int y = oy + c.Y;
            int z = oz + c.Z;
            if ((uint)x >= (uint)W || (uint)y >= (uint)H || (uint)z >= (uint)D) return false;
            if (occupied[x, y, z]) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void StampVoxel(bool[,,] occupied, Orientation o, int ox, int oy, int oz, bool value)
    {
        foreach (var c in o.Voxels)
            occupied[ox + c.X, oy + c.Y, oz + c.Z] = value;
    }

    static List<Placement> SolveMediumLayered(int W, int H, int D, Polyhedron poly)
    {
        var best = new List<Placement>();
        foreach (var o in poly.Orientations.Take(Math.Min(8, poly.Orientations.Count)))
        {
            int sx = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.X - 1e-6));
            int sy = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Y - 1e-6));
            int sz = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Z - 1e-6));
            if (sx > W || sy > H || sz > D) continue;

            int nx = W / sx;
            int ny = H / sy;
            int nz = D / sz;
            int count = nx * ny * nz;
            if (count <= best.Count) continue;

            var cur = new List<Placement>(count);
            for (int z = 0; z < nz; z++)
            for (int y = 0; y < ny; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < nx; x++)
            {
                Vector3 t = new Vector3(x * sx - o.Min.X, y * sy - o.Min.Y, z * sz - o.Min.Z);
                cur.Add(new Placement(t, o.Q));
            }
            if (cur.Count > best.Count) best = cur;
        }

        if (best.Count > 0) return best;
        return SolveLargeAabb(W, H, D, poly);
    }

    static List<Placement> SolveLargeAabb(int W, int H, int D, Polyhedron poly)
    {
        var best = new List<Placement>();
        foreach (var o in poly.Orientations)
        {
            int sx = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.X - 1e-6));
            int sy = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Y - 1e-6));
            int sz = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(o.Size.Z - 1e-6));
            if (sx > W || sy > H || sz > D) continue;

            long nx = W / sx;
            long ny = H / sy;
            long nz = D / sz;
            long count = nx * ny * nz;
            if (count <= best.Count) continue;
            if (count > 2_000_000) count = 2_000_000;

            var cur = new List<Placement>((int)count);
            for (int z = 0; z < nz && cur.Count < count; z++)
            for (int y = 0; y < ny && cur.Count < count; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < nx && cur.Count < count; x++)
            {
                Vector3 t = new Vector3(x * sx - o.Min.X, y * sy - o.Min.Y, z * sz - o.Min.Z);
                cur.Add(new Placement(t, o.Q));
            }
            if (cur.Count > best.Count) best = cur;
        }
        return best;
    }

    static bool PointInClosedMesh(Vector3 p, Triangle[] tris)
    {
        var dir = new Vector3(1.0f, 0.37139067f, 0.18273645f);
        int hits = 0;
        foreach (var t in tris)
        {
            if (RayIntersectsTriangle(p, dir, t, out _)) hits++;
        }
        return (hits & 1) == 1;
    }

    static bool RayIntersectsTriangle(Vector3 origin, Vector3 dir, Triangle tri, out float distance)
    {
        distance = 0;
        Vector3 e1 = tri.B - tri.A;
        Vector3 e2 = tri.C - tri.A;
        Vector3 p = Vector3.Cross(dir, e2);
        float det = Vector3.Dot(e1, p);
        if (MathF.Abs(det) < 1e-7f) return false;
        float invDet = 1f / det;
        Vector3 t = origin - tri.A;
        float u = Vector3.Dot(t, p) * invDet;
        if (u < 0f || u > 1f) return false;
        Vector3 q = Vector3.Cross(t, e1);
        float v = Vector3.Dot(dir, q) * invDet;
        if (v < 0f || u + v > 1f) return false;
        float dist = Vector3.Dot(e2, q) * invDet;
        if (dist <= 1e-6f) return false;
        distance = dist;
        return true;
    }

    sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly string[] _tokens;
        private int _index;

        public FastScanner()
        {
            string input = Console.In.ReadToEnd();
            _tokens = input.Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            _index = 0;
        }

        public int NextInt() => int.Parse(_tokens[_index++], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        public double NextDouble() => double.Parse(_tokens[_index++], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
    }
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <random>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

namespace {

struct RollingHash {
    static constexpr uint64_t BASE1 = 1469598103934665603ULL;
    static constexpr uint64_t BASE2 = 1099511628211ULL;

    vector<uint64_t> pow1{1}, pow2{1};
    vector<uint64_t> pref1, pref2;

    RollingHash() = default;

    explicit RollingHash(const string& s) {
        build(s);
    }

    void ensure_pows(size_t n) {
        while (pow1.size() <= n) {
            pow1.push_back(pow1.back() * BASE1 + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
            pow2.push_back(pow2.back() * BASE2 + 0xc2b2ae3d27d4eb4fULL);
        }
    }

    void build(const string& s) {
        ensure_pows(s.size());
        pref1.assign(s.size() + 1, 0);
        pref2.assign(s.size() + 1, 0);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
            const uint64_t x = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]) + 1ULL;
            pref1[i + 1] = pref1[i] * BASE1 + x;
            pref2[i + 1] = pref2[i] * BASE2 + x;
        }
    }

    pair<uint64_t, uint64_t> slice(size_t l, size_t r) const {
        const uint64_t h1 = pref1[r] - pref1[l] * pow1[r - l];
        const uint64_t h2 = pref2[r] - pref2[l] * pow2[r - l];
        return {h1, h2};
    }
};

struct PairHash {
    size_t operator()(const pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>& p) const noexcept {
        uint64_t x = p.first ^ (p.second + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL + (p.first << 6) + (p.first >> 2));
        return static_cast<size_t>(x);
    }
};

string shortest_string_first(vector<string>& strings) {
    auto it = min_element(strings.begin(), strings.end(), [](const string& a, const string& b) {
        return a.size() < b.size();
    });
    string shortest = move(*it);
    strings.erase(it);
    strings.insert(strings.begin(), move(shortest));
    return strings.front();
}

string solve_small_dp(const vector<string>& strings) {
    if (strings.empty()) return "";
    string best = strings[0];
    for (size_t idx = 1; idx < strings.size() && !best.empty(); ++idx) {
        const string& a = best;
        const string& b = strings[idx];
        vector<int> prev(b.size() + 1, 0), curr(b.size() + 1, 0);
        size_t best_len = 0;
        size_t best_end = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < b.size(); ++j) {
                if (a[i] == b[j]) {
                    curr[j + 1] = prev[j] + 1;
                    if (static_cast<size_t>(curr[j + 1]) > best_len) {
                        best_len = static_cast<size_t>(curr[j + 1]);
                        best_end = i + 1;
                    }
                } else {
                    curr[j + 1] = 0;
                }
            }
            fill(prev.begin(), prev.end(), 0);
            swap(prev, curr);
        }
        best = a.substr(best_end - best_len, best_len);
    }

    // Verify against all strings in case pairwise shrinking picked a substring not common to all.
    for (;;) {
        bool ok = true;
        for (const auto& s : strings) {
            if (s.find(best) == string::npos) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok || best.empty()) break;
        best.pop_back();
    }
    return best;
}

bool exists_common_of_length(
    const vector<string>& strings,
    const vector<RollingHash>& hashes,
    size_t len,
    string& out
) {
    if (len == 0) {
        out.clear();
        return true;
    }

    const string& base = strings[0];
    if (len > base.size()) return false;

    unordered_map<pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>, vector<size_t>, PairHash> candidates;
    candidates.reserve(base.size());

    for (size_t i = 0; i + len <= base.size(); ++i) {
        auto h = hashes[0].slice(i, i + len);
        candidates[h].push_back(i);
    }
    if (candidates.empty()) return false;

    for (size_t idx = 1; idx < strings.size(); ++idx) {
        const string& s = strings[idx];
        if (len > s.size()) return false;

        unordered_set<pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>, PairHash> seen;
        seen.reserve(s.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i + len <= s.size(); ++i) {
            auto h = hashes[idx].slice(i, i + len);
            if (candidates.find(h) != candidates.end()) {
                seen.insert(h);
            }
        }

        for (auto it = candidates.begin(); it != candidates.end();) {
            if (seen.find(it->first) == seen.end()) {
                it = candidates.erase(it);
            } else {
                ++it;
            }
        }
        if (candidates.empty()) return false;
    }

    for (const auto& [h, positions] : candidates) {
        for (size_t pos : positions) {
            const string cand = base.substr(pos, len);
            bool ok = true;
            for (size_t idx = 1; idx < strings.size(); ++idx) {
                if (strings[idx].find(cand) == string::npos) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) {
                out = cand;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

string solve_hash_binary(vector<string> strings) {
    shortest_string_first(strings);
    vector<RollingHash> hashes;
    hashes.reserve(strings.size());
    for (const auto& s : strings) hashes.emplace_back(s);

    size_t lo = 0;
    size_t hi = strings[0].size();
    string best;

    while (lo <= hi) {
        const size_t mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        string candidate;
        if (exists_common_of_length(strings, hashes, mid, candidate)) {
            best = move(candidate);
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else {
            if (mid == 0) break;
            hi = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return best;
}

vector<int> build_suffix_array(const string& s) {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(s.size());
    vector<int> sa(n), rnk(n), tmp(n);
    iota(sa.begin(), sa.end(), 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) rnk[i] = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);

    for (int k = 1;; k <<= 1) {
        auto cmp = [&](int a, int b) {
            if (rnk[a] != rnk[b]) return rnk[a] < rnk[b];
            const int ra = (a + k < n) ? rnk[a + k] : -1;
            const int rb = (b + k < n) ? rnk[b + k] : -1;
            return ra < rb;
        };
        sort(sa.begin(), sa.end(), cmp);
        tmp[sa[0]] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            tmp[sa[i]] = tmp[sa[i - 1]] + (cmp(sa[i - 1], sa[i]) ? 1 : 0);
        }
        rnk = tmp;
        if (rnk[sa[n - 1]] == n - 1) break;
    }
    return sa;
}

vector<int> build_lcp(const string& s, const vector<int>& sa) {
    const int n = static_cast<int>(s.size());
    vector<int> rank(n), lcp(max(0, n - 1), 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) rank[sa[i]] = i;
    int h = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const int r = rank[i];
        if (r == 0) continue;
        const int j = sa[r - 1];
        while (i + h < n && j + h < n && s[i + h] == s[j + h]) ++h;
        lcp[r - 1] = h;
        if (h > 0) --h;
    }
    return lcp;
}

string solve_two_suffix_array(const string& a, const string& b) {
    const char sep1 = '\x01';
    const char sep2 = '\x00';
    string merged;
    merged.reserve(a.size() + b.size() + 2);
    merged += a;
    merged += sep1;
    merged += b;
    merged += sep2;

    vector<int> owner(merged.size(), 1);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) owner[i] = 0;
    owner[a.size()] = -1;
    for (size_t i = a.size() + 1; i < a.size() + 1 + b.size(); ++i) owner[i] = 1;
    owner.back() = -1;

    const auto sa = build_suffix_array(merged);
    const auto lcp = build_lcp(merged, sa);

    int best_len = 0;
    int best_pos = 0;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < sa.size(); ++i) {
        const int o1 = owner[sa[i - 1]];
        const int o2 = owner[sa[i]];
        if (o1 >= 0 && o2 >= 0 && o1 != o2) {
            if (lcp[i - 1] > best_len) {
                best_len = lcp[i - 1];
                best_pos = sa[i];
            }
        }
    }
    return merged.substr(best_pos, best_len);
}

string solve_adaptive(vector<string> strings) {
    if (strings.empty()) return "";
    if (strings.size() == 1) return strings[0];

    shortest_string_first(strings);

    size_t min_len = strings[0].size();
    size_t total_len = 0;
    for (const auto& s : strings) total_len += s.size();

    if (strings.size() == 2 && total_len <= 200000) {
        return solve_two_suffix_array(strings[0], strings[1]);
    }

    if (total_len <= 50000 && min_len <= 4000) {
        return solve_small_dp(strings);
    }

    return solve_hash_binary(move(strings));
}

} // namespace

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n = 0;
    if (!(cin >> n)) {
        return 0;
    }
    string dummy;
    getline(cin, dummy);

    vector<string> strings;
    strings.reserve(max(n, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        string s;
        getline(cin, s);
        strings.push_back(move(s));
    }

    cout << solve_adaptive(move(strings)) << '\n';
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

public static class Program
{
    private static readonly int[] Dx = { -1, 0, 1, -1, 1, -1, 0, 1 };
    private static readonly int[] Dy = { -1, -1, -1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1 };

    public static void Main()
    {
        var reader = new FastReader(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int height = reader.NextInt();
        int width = reader.NextInt();

        var board = new char[height][];
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
        {
            string line = reader.ReadLineExact(width);
            board[y] = line.ToCharArray();
        }

        var solver = new Solver(board, width, height);
        List<Cell> safeCells = solver.Solve();

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput()) { AutoFlush = false };
        writer.WriteLine(safeCells.Count);
        foreach (var cell in safeCells)
        {
            writer.Write(cell.X);
            writer.Write(' ');
            writer.WriteLine(cell.Y);
        }
    }

    private readonly struct Cell
    {
        public readonly int X;
        public readonly int Y;

        public Cell(int x, int y)
        {
            X = x;
            Y = y;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Solver
    {
        private readonly char[][] _board;
        private readonly int _width;
        private readonly int _height;
        private readonly bool[,] _safe;
        private readonly Queue<int> _dirtyNumbers;
        private readonly bool[] _queuedNumbers;
        private readonly List<int> _frontierNumbers;
        private readonly int _cellCount;

        public Solver(char[][] board, int width, int height)
        {
            _board = board;
            _width = width;
            _height = height;
            _safe = new bool[height, width];
            _cellCount = width * height;
            _dirtyNumbers = new Queue<int>();
            _queuedNumbers = new bool[_cellCount];
            _frontierNumbers = new List<int>();
        }

        public List<Cell> Solve()
        {
            InitializeFrontier();
            PropagateLocal();
            RunAdaptiveGlobalReasoning();
            return CollectSafeCells();
        }

        private void InitializeFrontier()
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
                {
                    if (IsNumber(_board[y][x]) && HasUnknownNeighbor(x, y))
                    {
                        int id = Id(x, y);
                        _frontierNumbers.Add(id);
                        EnqueueNumber(id);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void PropagateLocal()
        {
            while (_dirtyNumbers.Count > 0)
            {
                int id = _dirtyNumbers.Dequeue();
                _queuedNumbers[id] = false;
                int x = id % _width;
                int y = id / _width;

                int required = _board[y][x] - '0';
                int flagged = 0;
                int unknownCount = 0;
                int[] unknowns = new int[8];

                for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
                {
                    int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                    int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                    if (!InBounds(nx, ny))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    char c = _board[ny][nx];
                    if (c == '*')
                    {
                        flagged++;
                    }
                    else if (c == ' ')
                    {
                        unknowns[unknownCount++] = Id(nx, ny);
                    }
                }

                int remaining = required - flagged;
                if (unknownCount == 0 || remaining < 0 || remaining > unknownCount)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (remaining == 0)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < unknownCount; i++)
                    {
                        MarkSafe(unknowns[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private void RunAdaptiveGlobalReasoning()
        {
            var frontierUnknowns = BuildFrontierUnknowns();
            if (frontierUnknowns.Count == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            long area = (long)_width * _height;
            int frontierCellCount = frontierUnknowns.Count;
            int frontierNumberCount = _frontierNumbers.Count;

            if (frontierCellCount <= 22)
            {
                SolveSingleExact(frontierUnknowns, frontierNumberCount <= 128 ? 2_000_000 : 500_000);
                return;
            }

            if (area <= 2_000_000 && frontierCellCount <= 2000)
            {
                SolveByComponents(frontierUnknowns, 24, 250_000);
            }
        }

        private HashSet<int> BuildFrontierUnknowns()
        {
            var frontierUnknowns = new HashSet<int>();
            foreach (int numberId in _frontierNumbers)
            {
                int x = numberId % _width;
                int y = numberId / _width;
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
                {
                    int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                    int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                    if (InBounds(nx, ny) && _board[ny][nx] == ' ')
                    {
                        frontierUnknowns.Add(Id(nx, ny));
                    }
                }
            }
            return frontierUnknowns;
        }

        private void SolveSingleExact(HashSet<int> frontierUnknowns, int maxStates)
        {
            var unknownList = new List<int>(frontierUnknowns);
            var unknownIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>(unknownList.Count);
            for (int i = 0; i < unknownList.Count; i++)
            {
                unknownIndex[unknownList[i]] = i;
            }

            List<Constraint> constraints = BuildConstraints(unknownIndex);
            if (constraints.Count == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            ExactEnumerator.MarkAlwaysSafe(unknownList.Count, constraints, maxStates, idx => MarkSafe(unknownList[idx]));
        }

        private void SolveByComponents(HashSet<int> frontierUnknowns, int componentLimit, int maxStatesPerComponent)
        {
            var cellToNumbers = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>(frontierUnknowns.Count);
            foreach (int cellId in frontierUnknowns)
            {
                cellToNumbers[cellId] = new List<int>(4);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < _frontierNumbers.Count; i++)
            {
                int numberId = _frontierNumbers[i];
                int x = numberId % _width;
                int y = numberId / _width;
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
                {
                    int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                    int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                    if (!InBounds(nx, ny) || _board[ny][nx] != ' ')
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    int cellId = Id(nx, ny);
                    if (cellToNumbers.TryGetValue(cellId, out List<int>? list))
                    {
                        list.Add(i);
                    }
                }
            }

            var visited = new HashSet<int>();
            foreach (int startCell in frontierUnknowns)
            {
                if (!visited.Add(startCell))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var componentCells = new List<int>();
                var componentNumbers = new HashSet<int>();
                var queue = new Queue<int>();
                queue.Enqueue(startCell);

                while (queue.Count > 0)
                {
                    int cellId = queue.Dequeue();
                    componentCells.Add(cellId);

                    foreach (int numberIndex in cellToNumbers[cellId])
                    {
                        if (!componentNumbers.Add(numberIndex))
                        {
                            continue;
                        }

                        int numberId = _frontierNumbers[numberIndex];
                        int x = numberId % _width;
                        int y = numberId / _width;
                        for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
                        {
                            int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                            int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                            if (!InBounds(nx, ny) || _board[ny][nx] != ' ')
                            {
                                continue;
                            }

                            int neighborCell = Id(nx, ny);
                            if (frontierUnknowns.Contains(neighborCell) && visited.Add(neighborCell))
                            {
                                queue.Enqueue(neighborCell);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (componentCells.Count > componentLimit)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var unknownIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>(componentCells.Count);
                for (int i = 0; i < componentCells.Count; i++)
                {
                    unknownIndex[componentCells[i]] = i;
                }

                var constraints = new List<Constraint>(componentNumbers.Count);
                foreach (int numberIndex in componentNumbers)
                {
                    int numberId = _frontierNumbers[numberIndex];
                    int x = numberId % _width;
                    int y = numberId / _width;
                    int required = _board[y][x] - '0';
                    int flagged = 0;
                    var vars = new List<int>(8);

                    for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
                    {
                        int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                        int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                        if (!InBounds(nx, ny))
                        {
                            continue;
                        }

                        char c = _board[ny][nx];
                        if (c == '*')
                        {
                            flagged++;
                        }
                        else if (c == ' ')
                        {
                            int id = Id(nx, ny);
                            if (unknownIndex.TryGetValue(id, out int idx))
                            {
                                vars.Add(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    int remaining = required - flagged;
                    if (vars.Count > 0 && remaining >= 0 && remaining <= vars.Count)
                    {
                        constraints.Add(new Constraint(vars.ToArray(), remaining));
                    }
                }

                if (constraints.Count == 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                ExactEnumerator.MarkAlwaysSafe(componentCells.Count, constraints, maxStatesPerComponent, idx => MarkSafe(componentCells[idx]));
            }
        }

        private List<Constraint> BuildConstraints(Dictionary<int, int> unknownIndex)
        {
            var constraints = new List<Constraint>(_frontierNumbers.Count);
            foreach (int numberId in _frontierNumbers)
            {
                int x = numberId % _width;
                int y = numberId / _width;
                int required = _board[y][x] - '0';
                int flagged = 0;
                var vars = new List<int>(8);

                for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
                {
                    int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                    int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                    if (!InBounds(nx, ny))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    char c = _board[ny][nx];
                    if (c == '*')
                    {
                        flagged++;
                    }
                    else if (c == ' ')
                    {
                        int id = Id(nx, ny);
                        if (unknownIndex.TryGetValue(id, out int idx))
                        {
                            vars.Add(idx);
                        }
                    }
                }

                int remaining = required - flagged;
                if (vars.Count > 0 && remaining >= 0 && remaining <= vars.Count)
                {
                    constraints.Add(new Constraint(vars.ToArray(), remaining));
                }
            }

            return constraints;
        }

        private List<Cell> CollectSafeCells()
        {
            var result = new List<Cell>();
            for (int y = 0; y < _height; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < _width; x++)
                {
                    if (_safe[y, x] && _board[y][x] == ' ')
                    {
                        result.Add(new Cell(x, y));
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        private void MarkSafe(int id)
        {
            int x = id % _width;
            int y = id / _width;
            if (_safe[y, x] || _board[y][x] != ' ')
            {
                return;
            }

            _safe[y, x] = true;
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
            {
                int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                if (InBounds(nx, ny) && IsNumber(_board[ny][nx]))
                {
                    EnqueueNumber(Id(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }

        private void EnqueueNumber(int id)
        {
            if (_queuedNumbers[id])
            {
                return;
            }

            _queuedNumbers[id] = true;
            _dirtyNumbers.Enqueue(id);
        }

        private bool HasUnknownNeighbor(int x, int y)
        {
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 8; dir++)
            {
                int nx = x + Dx[dir];
                int ny = y + Dy[dir];
                if (InBounds(nx, ny) && _board[ny][nx] == ' ')
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        private static bool IsNumber(char c) => c >= '0' && c <= '8';

        private bool InBounds(int x, int y) => (uint)x < (uint)_width && (uint)y < (uint)_height;

        private int Id(int x, int y) => y * _width + x;
    }

    private readonly struct Constraint
    {
        public readonly int[] Variables;
        public readonly int Sum;

        public Constraint(int[] variables, int sum)
        {
            Variables = variables;
            Sum = sum;
        }
    }

    private static class ExactEnumerator
    {
        public static void MarkAlwaysSafe(int variableCount, List<Constraint> constraints, int maxStates, Action<int> markSafe)
        {
            int constraintCount = constraints.Count;
            var varToConstraints = new List<int>[variableCount];
            var occurrenceCount = new int[variableCount];
            for (int i = 0; i < variableCount; i++)
            {
                varToConstraints[i] = new List<int>(4);
            }

            for (int ci = 0; ci < constraintCount; ci++)
            {
                foreach (int v in constraints[ci].Variables)
                {
                    varToConstraints[v].Add(ci);
                    occurrenceCount[v]++;
                }
            }

            var order = new int[variableCount];
            for (int i = 0; i < variableCount; i++)
            {
                order[i] = i;
            }
            Array.Sort(order, (a, b) => occurrenceCount[b].CompareTo(occurrenceCount[a]));

            var assigned = new sbyte[variableCount];
            Array.Fill(assigned, (sbyte)-1);

            var minesAssigned = new int[constraintCount];
            var unknownRemaining = new int[constraintCount];
            for (int ci = 0; ci < constraintCount; ci++)
            {
                unknownRemaining[ci] = constraints[ci].Variables.Length;
            }

            var alwaysSafe = new bool[variableCount];
            Array.Fill(alwaysSafe, true);
            bool foundAny = false;
            int states = 0;

            bool Dfs(int depth)
            {
                if (states >= maxStates)
                {
                    return false;
                }

                if (depth == variableCount)
                {
                    foundAny = true;
                    states++;
                    for (int i = 0; i < variableCount; i++)
                    {
                        if (assigned[i] != 0)
                        {
                            alwaysSafe[i] = false;
                        }
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                int v = order[depth];
                if (TryAssign(v, 0, constraints, varToConstraints, minesAssigned, unknownRemaining))
                {
                    assigned[v] = 0;
                    if (!Dfs(depth + 1))
                    {
                        UndoAssign(v, 0, varToConstraints, minesAssigned, unknownRemaining);
                        assigned[v] = -1;
                        return false;
                    }
                    UndoAssign(v, 0, varToConstraints, minesAssigned, unknownRemaining);
                    assigned[v] = -1;
                }

                if (TryAssign(v, 1, constraints, varToConstraints, minesAssigned, unknownRemaining))
                {
                    assigned[v] = 1;
                    if (!Dfs(depth + 1))
                    {
                        UndoAssign(v, 1, varToConstraints, minesAssigned, unknownRemaining);
                        assigned[v] = -1;
                        return false;
                    }
                    UndoAssign(v, 1, varToConstraints, minesAssigned, unknownRemaining);
                    assigned[v] = -1;
                }

                return true;
            }

            Dfs(0);
            if (!foundAny)
            {
                return;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < variableCount; i++)
            {
                if (alwaysSafe[i])
                {
                    markSafe(i);
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool TryAssign(
            int variable,
            int value,
            List<Constraint> constraints,
            List<int>[] varToConstraints,
            int[] minesAssigned,
            int[] unknownRemaining)
        {
            foreach (int ci in varToConstraints[variable])
            {
                unknownRemaining[ci]--;
                minesAssigned[ci] += value;
                int required = constraints[ci].Sum;
                if (minesAssigned[ci] > required || minesAssigned[ci] + unknownRemaining[ci] < required)
                {
                    foreach (int rollbackCi in varToConstraints[variable])
                    {
                        if (rollbackCi == ci)
                        {
                            minesAssigned[rollbackCi] -= value;
                            unknownRemaining[rollbackCi]++;
                            break;
                        }
                        minesAssigned[rollbackCi] -= value;
                        unknownRemaining[rollbackCi]++;
                    }
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return true;
        }

        private static void UndoAssign(
            int variable,
            int value,
            List<int>[] varToConstraints,
            int[] minesAssigned,
            int[] unknownRemaining)
        {
            foreach (int ci in varToConstraints[variable])
            {
                minesAssigned[ci] -= value;
                unknownRemaining[ci]++;
            }
        }
    }

    private sealed class FastReader
    {
        private readonly Stream _stream;
        private readonly byte[] _buffer;
        private int _length;
        private int _position;

        public FastReader(Stream stream)
        {
            _stream = stream;
            _buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c;
            do
            {
                c = Read();
            } while (c <= 32 && c >= 0);

            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int value = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }

            return value * sign;
        }

        public string ReadLineExact(int width)
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c == '\r' || c == '\n')
            {
                c = Read();
            }

            var chars = new char[width];
            chars[0] = (char)c;
            for (int i = 1; i < width; i++)
            {
                chars[i] = (char)Read();
            }

            int end = Read();
            if (end == '\r')
            {
                int next = Read();
                if (next != '\n')
                {
                    _position--;
                }
            }
            else if (end != '\n' && end >= 0)
            {
                _position--;
            }

            return new string(chars);
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_position >= _length)
            {
                _length = _stream.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _position = 0;
                if (_length == 0)
                {
                    return -1;
                }
            }

            return _buffer[_position++];
        }
    }
}

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::f64::consts::PI;
use std::io::{self, Read};

const EPS: f64 = 1.0e-9;
const SQRT3: f64 = 1.732_050_807_568_877_2;
const REF_FACE_AREA: f64 = 1.731_876;
const REF_CIRCUMRADIUS: f64 = 1.154_700_538_379_251_7;
const MAX_SCALE: f64 = 10.0;
const STACK_GAP: f64 = 24.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct Pt {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

impl Pt {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Self {
        Self { x, y }
    }

    fn add(self, other: Pt) -> Pt {
        Pt::new(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    }

    fn sub(self, other: Pt) -> Pt {
        Pt::new(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    }

    fn mul(self, k: f64) -> Pt {
        Pt::new(self.x * k, self.y * k)
    }

    fn dot(self, other: Pt) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y
    }

    fn cross(self, other: Pt) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.y - self.y * other.x
    }

    fn norm2(self) -> f64 {
        self.dot(self)
    }

    fn norm(self) -> f64 {
        self.norm2().sqrt()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Vec3 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
}

impl Vec3 {
    fn new(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Self {
        Self { x, y, z }
    }

    fn dot(self, other: Vec3) -> f64 {
        self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y + self.z * other.z
    }

    fn cross(self, other: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(
            self.y * other.z - self.z * other.y,
            self.z * other.x - self.x * other.z,
            self.x * other.y - self.y * other.x,
        )
    }

    fn norm(self) -> f64 {
        self.dot(self).sqrt()
    }

    fn normalize(self) -> Vec3 {
        let n = self.norm();
        if n <= EPS {
            Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
        } else {
            Vec3::new(self.x / n, self.y / n, self.z / n)
        }
    }

    fn mul(self, k: f64) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(self.x * k, self.y * k, self.z * k)
    }

    fn add(self, other: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    }

    fn sub(self, other: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
        Vec3::new(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Quat {
    w: f64,
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
}

impl Quat {
    fn identity() -> Self {
        Self {
            w: 1.0,
            x: 0.0,
            y: 0.0,
            z: 0.0,
        }
    }

    fn normalize(self) -> Self {
        let n = (self.w * self.w + self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y + self.z * self.z).sqrt();
        if n <= EPS {
            Self::identity()
        } else {
            Self {
                w: self.w / n,
                x: self.x / n,
                y: self.y / n,
                z: self.z / n,
            }
        }
    }

    fn from_basis(x_axis: Vec3, y_axis: Vec3, z_axis: Vec3) -> Self {
        let m00 = x_axis.x;
        let m01 = y_axis.x;
        let m02 = z_axis.x;
        let m10 = x_axis.y;
        let m11 = y_axis.y;
        let m12 = z_axis.y;
        let m20 = x_axis.z;
        let m21 = y_axis.z;
        let m22 = z_axis.z;
        let trace = m00 + m11 + m22;
        let q = if trace > 0.0 {
            let s = (trace + 1.0).sqrt() * 2.0;
            Quat {
                w: 0.25 * s,
                x: (m21 - m12) / s,
                y: (m02 - m20) / s,
                z: (m10 - m01) / s,
            }
        } else if m00 > m11 && m00 > m22 {
            let s = (1.0 + m00 - m11 - m22).sqrt() * 2.0;
            Quat {
                w: (m21 - m12) / s,
                x: 0.25 * s,
                y: (m01 + m10) / s,
                z: (m02 + m20) / s,
            }
        } else if m11 > m22 {
            let s = (1.0 + m11 - m00 - m22).sqrt() * 2.0;
            Quat {
                w: (m02 - m20) / s,
                x: (m01 + m10) / s,
                y: 0.25 * s,
                z: (m12 + m21) / s,
            }
        } else {
            let s = (1.0 + m22 - m00 - m11).sqrt() * 2.0;
            Quat {
                w: (m10 - m01) / s,
                x: (m02 + m20) / s,
                y: (m12 + m21) / s,
                z: 0.25 * s,
            }
        };
        q.normalize()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Placement {
    center: Vec3,
    quat: Quat,
    scale: f64,
}

fn polygon_area(poly: &[Pt]) -> f64 {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        area += a.cross(b);
    }
    0.5 * area
}

fn ensure_ccw(poly: &mut [Pt]) {
    if polygon_area(poly) < 0.0 {
        poly.reverse();
    }
}

fn point_in_triangle(p: Pt, a: Pt, b: Pt, c: Pt) -> bool {
    let ab = (b.sub(a)).cross(p.sub(a));
    let bc = (c.sub(b)).cross(p.sub(b));
    let ca = (a.sub(c)).cross(p.sub(c));
    (ab >= -EPS && bc >= -EPS && ca >= -EPS) || (ab <= EPS && bc <= EPS && ca <= EPS)
}

fn is_ear(poly: &[Pt], idxs: &[usize], pos: usize) -> bool {
    let m = idxs.len();
    let i0 = idxs[(pos + m - 1) % m];
    let i1 = idxs[pos];
    let i2 = idxs[(pos + 1) % m];
    let a = poly[i0];
    let b = poly[i1];
    let c = poly[i2];
    if (b.sub(a)).cross(c.sub(b)) <= EPS {
        return false;
    }
    for &idx in idxs {
        if idx == i0 || idx == i1 || idx == i2 {
            continue;
        }
        if point_in_triangle(poly[idx], a, b, c) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

fn triangulate_ear(poly: &[Pt]) -> Vec<[Pt; 3]> {
    let n = poly.len();
    let mut idxs: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
    let mut tris = Vec::new();
    if n < 3 {
        return tris;
    }
    let mut guard = 0usize;
    while idxs.len() > 3 && guard < n * n {
        let mut clipped = false;
        for pos in 0..idxs.len() {
            if is_ear(poly, &idxs, pos) {
                let m = idxs.len();
                let i0 = idxs[(pos + m - 1) % m];
                let i1 = idxs[pos];
                let i2 = idxs[(pos + 1) % m];
                tris.push([poly[i0], poly[i1], poly[i2]]);
                idxs.remove(pos);
                clipped = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if !clipped {
            break;
        }
        guard += 1;
    }
    if idxs.len() == 3 {
        tris.push([poly[idxs[0]], poly[idxs[1]], poly[idxs[2]]]);
    }
    tris
}

fn project_range(poly: &[Pt], axis: Pt) -> (f64, f64) {
    let mut lo = f64::INFINITY;
    let mut hi = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
    for &p in poly {
        let v = p.dot(axis);
        lo = lo.min(v);
        hi = hi.max(v);
    }
    (lo, hi)
}

fn clip_with_half_plane(poly: &[Pt], axis: Pt, cut: f64, keep_ge: bool) -> Vec<Pt> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    if poly.is_empty() {
        return out;
    }
    let n = poly.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % n];
        let da = a.dot(axis) - cut;
        let db = b.dot(axis) - cut;
        let ina = if keep_ge { da >= -EPS } else { da <= EPS };
        let inb = if keep_ge { db >= -EPS } else { db <= EPS };
        if ina && inb {
            out.push(b);
        } else if ina && !inb {
            let t = da / (da - db);
            out.push(a.add(b.sub(a).mul(t)));
        } else if !ina && inb {
            let t = da / (da - db);
            out.push(a.add(b.sub(a).mul(t)));
            out.push(b);
        }
    }
    out
}

fn strip_decompose(poly: &[Pt], max_width: f64) -> Vec<Vec<Pt>> {
    let mut axis = Pt::new(1.0, 0.0);
    let mut best_span = 0.0;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let a = poly[i];
        let b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.len()];
        let edge = b.sub(a);
        if edge.norm() <= EPS {
            continue;
        }
        let nrm = Pt::new(-edge.y, edge.x).mul(1.0 / edge.norm());
        let (lo, hi) = project_range(poly, nrm);
        let span = hi - lo;
        if span > best_span {
            best_span = span;
            axis = nrm;
        }
    }
    let (lo, hi) = project_range(poly, axis);
    let mut pieces = Vec::new();
    let steps = ((hi - lo) / max_width).ceil().max(1.0) as usize;
    for s in 0..steps {
        let a = lo + (hi - lo) * (s as f64) / (steps as f64);
        let b = lo + (hi - lo) * ((s + 1) as f64) / (steps as f64);
        let clipped1 = clip_with_half_plane(poly, axis, a, true);
        let clipped2 = clip_with_half_plane(&clipped1, axis, b, false);
        if clipped2.len() >= 3 && polygon_area(&clipped2).abs() > EPS {
            pieces.push(clipped2);
        }
    }
    pieces
}

fn triangle_area(a: Pt, b: Pt, c: Pt) -> f64 {
    0.5 * (b.sub(a)).cross(c.sub(a)).abs()
}

fn make_basis_from_triangle(a: Pt, b: Pt, c: Pt, sun: Vec3) -> Option<(Vec3, Vec3, Vec3, f64, Vec3)> {
    let center2 = Pt::new((a.x + b.x + c.x) / 3.0, (a.y + b.y + c.y) / 3.0);
    let e1 = b.sub(a);
    let e2 = c.sub(a);
    let len1 = e1.norm();
    let len2 = e2.norm();
    let mut x2 = if len1 >= len2 { e1 } else { e2 };
    let xnorm = x2.norm();
    if xnorm <= EPS {
        return None;
    }
    x2 = x2.mul(1.0 / xnorm);
    let perp2 = Pt::new(-x2.y, x2.x);
    let lift_x = Vec3::new(x2.x, x2.y, 0.0);
    let lift_y = Vec3::new(perp2.x, perp2.y, 0.0);
    let d = sun;
    let dxy = d.x * d.x + d.y * d.y;
    let map_x = lift_x.sub(d.mul(lift_x.z / d.z));
    let map_y = lift_y.sub(d.mul(lift_y.z / d.z));
    let proj_x = Pt::new(map_x.x, map_x.y);
    let proj_y = Pt::new(map_y.x, map_y.y);
    let det = proj_x.cross(proj_y);
    if det.abs() <= EPS || dxy <= EPS {
        let x3 = Vec3::new(x2.x, x2.y, 0.0);
        let y3 = Vec3::new(perp2.x, perp2.y, 0.0);
        let z3 = x3.cross(y3).normalize();
        return Some((x3, y3, z3, 1.0, Vec3::new(center2.x, center2.y, 0.0)));
    }
    let alpha = 1.0 / det;
    let beta = 1.0 / det;
    let x3 = Vec3::new(
        alpha * lift_x.x,
        alpha * lift_x.y,
        alpha * (d.x * x2.x + d.y * x2.y) / d.z,
    );
    let y3 = Vec3::new(
        beta * lift_y.x,
        beta * lift_y.y,
        beta * (-d.x * x2.y + d.y * x2.x) / d.z,
    );
    let z3 = x3.cross(y3).normalize();
    let origin = Vec3::new(center2.x, center2.y, 0.0);
    Some((x3, y3, z3, 1.0, origin))
}

fn fit_triangle(tri: [Pt; 3], sun: Vec3, layer: usize) -> Option<Placement> {
    let area = triangle_area(tri[0], tri[1], tri[2]);
    if area <= EPS {
        return None;
    }
    let scale = (area / REF_FACE_AREA).sqrt();
    if scale > MAX_SCALE + 1.0e-7 {
        return None;
    }
    let (x_axis, y_axis, z_axis, _, origin) = make_basis_from_triangle(tri[0], tri[1], tri[2], sun)?;
    let center2 = Pt::new(
        (tri[0].x + tri[1].x + tri[2].x) / 3.0,
        (tri[0].y + tri[1].y + tri[2].y) / 3.0,
    );
    let height = layer as f64 * STACK_GAP;
    let shift = Vec3::new(-sun.x / sun.z * height, -sun.y / sun.z * height, height);
    let center = Vec3::new(center2.x, center2.y, 0.0).add(shift);
    let quat = Quat::from_basis(x_axis.normalize(), y_axis.normalize(), z_axis);
    let _ = origin;
    Some(Placement {
        center,
        quat,
        scale,
    })
}

fn split_triangle_longest(tri: [Pt; 3]) -> ([Pt; 3], [Pt; 3]) {
    let d01 = tri[0].sub(tri[1]).norm2();
    let d12 = tri[1].sub(tri[2]).norm2();
    let d20 = tri[2].sub(tri[0]).norm2();
    if d01 >= d12 && d01 >= d20 {
        let mid = tri[0].add(tri[1]).mul(0.5);
        ([tri[0], mid, tri[2]], [mid, tri[1], tri[2]])
    } else if d12 >= d20 {
        let mid = tri[1].add(tri[2]).mul(0.5);
        ([tri[1], mid, tri[0]], [mid, tri[2], tri[0]])
    } else {
        let mid = tri[2].add(tri[0]).mul(0.5);
        ([tri[2], mid, tri[1]], [mid, tri[0], tri[1]])
    }
}

fn refine_triangle(mut tri: [Pt; 3], out: &mut Vec<[Pt; 3]>) {
    let area = triangle_area(tri[0], tri[1], tri[2]);
    let scale = (area / REF_FACE_AREA).sqrt();
    if scale <= MAX_SCALE {
        if (tri[1].sub(tri[0])).cross(tri[2].sub(tri[0])) < 0.0 {
            tri.swap(1, 2);
        }
        out.push(tri);
        return;
    }
    let (a, b) = split_triangle_longest(tri);
    refine_triangle(a, out);
    refine_triangle(b, out);
}

fn triangulate_adaptive(poly: &[Pt]) -> Vec<[Pt; 3]> {
    let area = polygon_area(poly).abs();
    let raw = if poly.len() <= 120 {
        triangulate_ear(poly)
    } else {
        let max_tri_area = REF_FACE_AREA * MAX_SCALE * MAX_SCALE * 0.9;
        let width = (2.0 * max_tri_area / SQRT3).sqrt() * 1.2;
        let mut acc = Vec::new();
        for piece in strip_decompose(poly, width) {
            let mut sub = triangulate_ear(&piece);
            acc.append(&mut sub);
        }
        if acc.is_empty() {
            triangulate_ear(poly)
        } else {
            acc
        }
    };
    let mut refined = Vec::new();
    for tri in raw {
        refine_triangle(tri, &mut refined);
    }
    if refined.is_empty() && area > EPS && poly.len() >= 3 {
        let p0 = poly[0];
        for i in 1..poly.len() - 1 {
            refine_triangle([p0, poly[i], poly[i + 1]], &mut refined);
        }
    }
    refined
}

fn read_input() -> Result<(Vec<Pt>, Vec3), String> {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin()
        .read_to_string(&mut input)
        .map_err(|e| format!("failed to read stdin: {e}"))?;
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();
    let nv: usize = it
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| "missing vertex count".to_string())?
        .parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("invalid vertex count: {e}"))?;
    if nv < 3 {
        return Err("polygon must have at least 3 vertices".to_string());
    }
    let mut poly = Vec::with_capacity(nv);
    for _ in 0..nv {
        let x: f64 = it
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| "missing vertex x".to_string())?
            .parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("invalid vertex x: {e}"))?;
        let y: f64 = it
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| "missing vertex y".to_string())?
            .parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("invalid vertex y: {e}"))?;
        poly.push(Pt::new(x, y));
    }
    let sx: f64 = it
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| "missing sun x".to_string())?
        .parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("invalid sun x: {e}"))?;
    let sy: f64 = it
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| "missing sun y".to_string())?
        .parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("invalid sun y: {e}"))?;
    let sz: f64 = it
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| "missing sun z".to_string())?
        .parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("invalid sun z: {e}"))?;
    if sz.abs() <= EPS {
        return Err("sun z must be non-zero".to_string());
    }
    Ok((poly, Vec3::new(sx, sy, sz).normalize()))
}

fn dedup_polygon(poly: &[Pt]) -> Vec<Pt> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for &p in poly {
        if out
            .last()
            .map(|q: &Pt| p.sub(*q).norm() > EPS)
            .unwrap_or(true)
        {
            out.push(p);
        }
    }
    if out.len() >= 2 && out[0].sub(out[out.len() - 1]).norm() <= EPS {
        out.pop();
    }
    out
}

fn main() {
    if let Err(msg) = run() {
        eprintln!("{msg}");
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
    let (poly_raw, sun) = read_input()?;
    let mut poly = dedup_polygon(&poly_raw);
    if poly.len() < 3 {
        return Err("degenerate polygon after deduplication".to_string());
    }
    ensure_ccw(&mut poly);
    let mut tris = triangulate_adaptive(&poly);
    tris.sort_by(|a, b| {
        let aa = triangle_area(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
        let bb = triangle_area(b[0], b[1], b[2]);
        bb.partial_cmp(&aa).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
    });
    let mut placements = Vec::with_capacity(tris.len());
    for (i, tri) in tris.into_iter().enumerate() {
        if let Some(p) = fit_triangle(tri, sun, i) {
            placements.push(p);
        }
    }
    println!("{}", placements.len());
    for p in placements {
        println!(
            "{:.9} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9} {:.9}",
            p.center.x,
            p.center.y,
            p.center.z,
            p.quat.w,
            p.quat.x,
            p.quat.y,
            p.quat.z,
            p.scale
        );
    }
    let _ = PI;
    let _ = REF_CIRCUMRADIUS;
    Ok(())
}

Typical Prompt:
You are solving a Job-Shop Scheduling problem in C++.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY problem size from trivial to extremely large scale:
- **Trivial**: 2-3 jobs, 2-3 machines, 5-10 tasks total
- **Extreme**: 1000+ jobs, 50+ machines, 50k+ tasks total

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: J M (number of jobs, number of machines)
For each job:
Line: T (number of tasks in this job)
Next T lines: machine duration

**Output format (stdout):**
For each job (J lines total):
T pairs per line: start_time machine start_time machine ... (all tasks for that job)

**Example:**
Input:
2 2
2
0 3
1 2
2
1 2
0 4

Output:
0 0 3 1
0 1 5 0

(Job 0: task 0 starts at t=0 on M0, task 1 at t=3 on M1)
(Job 1: task 0 starts at t=0 on M1, task 1 at t=5 on M0)

**Key Constraints:**
1. Each task in a job must run on its specified machine
2. Tasks within a job must execute in order (task i before task i+1)
3. A machine can only run one task at a time
4. Tasks cannot be interrupted once started

**Environment:**

Architecture: AMD64
CPU: AMD64 Family 23 Model 8 Stepping 2, AuthenticAMD

SIMD: AVX, AVX2, SSE, SSE2, SSE3, SSE4.1, SSE4.2, SSSE3

**C++ Compiler:**

Write complete, compilable C++ code with a main() function.
Include adaptive logic that chooses different strategies based on problem scale.

Schedule a set of jobs across several machines to finish everything as quickly as possible. Each job is a sequence of tasks that must run in order, and each task needs a specific machine — but a machine can only do one thing at a time.

This classic factory-scheduling problem is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the number of jobs and machines. The baseline greedily starts whichever task can begin earliest.

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <queue>
#include <tuple>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Task {
    int machine = 0;
    long long duration = 0;
};

struct ScheduledOp {
    int job = -1;
    int task = -1;
    long long start = 0;
    long long end = 0;
};

struct Candidate {
    int job = -1;
    int task = -1;
    int machine = -1;
    long long duration = 0;
    long long earliest = 0;
    long long priority = 0;
};

struct Problem {
    int jobs = 0;
    int machines = 0;
    vector<vector<Task>> job_tasks;
    vector<long long> job_total_duration;
    vector<long long> suffix_duration_sum;
    int total_tasks = 0;
};

static long long safe_add(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a > numeric_limits<long long>::max() - b) {
        return numeric_limits<long long>::max();
    }
    return a + b;
}

struct MachineCalendar {
    vector<pair<long long, long long>> busy;

    long long earliest_start(long long ready, long long duration) const {
        long long current = ready;
        for (const auto& [s, e] : busy) {
            if (safe_add(current, duration) <= s) {
                return current;
            }
            if (current < e) {
                current = e;
            }
        }
        return current;
    }

    void add_interval(long long start, long long end) {
        auto it = busy.begin();
        while (it != busy.end() && it->first < start) {
            ++it;
        }
        busy.insert(it, {start, end});
    }
};

static Problem read_problem() {
    Problem p;
    cin >> p.jobs >> p.machines;
    p.job_tasks.resize(p.jobs);
    p.job_total_duration.assign(p.jobs, 0);
    p.total_tasks = 0;

    for (int j = 0; j < p.jobs; ++j) {
        int t;
        cin >> t;
        p.job_tasks[j].resize(t);
        p.total_tasks += t;
        for (int i = 0; i < t; ++i) {
            cin >> p.job_tasks[j][i].machine >> p.job_tasks[j][i].duration;
            p.job_total_duration[j] += p.job_tasks[j][i].duration;
        }
    }

    p.suffix_duration_sum.assign(p.total_tasks, 0);
    return p;
}

static vector<long long> build_remaining_work(const vector<Task>& tasks) {
    int n = static_cast<int>(tasks.size());
    vector<long long> rem(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        rem[i] = rem[i + 1] + tasks[i].duration;
    }
    return rem;
}

static vector<vector<long long>> greedy_schedule(const Problem& p) {
    const int J = p.jobs;
    const int M = p.machines;

    vector<vector<long long>> starts(J);
    vector<vector<long long>> remaining(J);
    vector<long long> job_ready(J, 0);
    vector<int> next_task(J, 0);
    vector<long long> job_done_work(J, 0);
    vector<MachineCalendar> calendars(M);

    for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
        starts[j].assign(p.job_tasks[j].size(), 0);
        remaining[j] = build_remaining_work(p.job_tasks[j]);
    }

    long long total_remaining = accumulate(
        p.job_total_duration.begin(), p.job_total_duration.end(), 0LL
    );

    auto score_candidate = [&](int j) -> Candidate {
        int t = next_task[j];
        const Task& op = p.job_tasks[j][t];
        long long est = calendars[op.machine].earliest_start(job_ready[j], op.duration);
        long long tail = remaining[j][t + 1];
        long long slack_pressure = total_remaining - job_done_work[j];
        long long priority = safe_add(est, op.duration);
        priority -= min<long long>(tail, numeric_limits<long long>::max() / 4);
        priority -= min<long long>(slack_pressure / max(1, J), numeric_limits<long long>::max() / 4);
        return {j, t, op.machine, op.duration, est, priority};
    };

    int remaining_ops = p.total_tasks;
    while (remaining_ops > 0) {
        Candidate best;
        bool found = false;

        for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
            if (next_task[j] >= static_cast<int>(p.job_tasks[j].size())) {
                continue;
            }
            Candidate cand = score_candidate(j);
            if (!found) {
                best = cand;
                found = true;
                continue;
            }

            long long best_end = safe_add(best.earliest, best.duration);
            long long cand_end = safe_add(cand.earliest, cand.duration);

            if (cand.earliest < best.earliest ||
                (cand.earliest == best.earliest && cand_end < best_end) ||
                (cand.earliest == best.earliest && cand_end == best_end && cand.priority < best.priority) ||
                (cand.earliest == best.earliest && cand_end == best_end && cand.priority == best.priority && cand.job < best.job)) {
                best = cand;
            }
        }

        long long start = best.earliest;
        long long end = safe_add(start, best.duration);
        calendars[best.machine].add_interval(start, end);
        starts[best.job][best.task] = start;
        job_ready[best.job] = end;
        job_done_work[best.job] += best.duration;
        total_remaining -= best.duration;
        ++next_task[best.job];
        --remaining_ops;
    }

    return starts;
}

struct ExactSolver {
    const Problem& p;
    vector<vector<long long>> best_starts;
    vector<vector<long long>> current_starts;
    vector<long long> job_ready;
    vector<long long> machine_ready;
    vector<int> next_task;
    vector<long long> machine_remaining;
    vector<long long> job_remaining;
    long long best_makespan = numeric_limits<long long>::max();

    explicit ExactSolver(const Problem& problem) : p(problem) {
        best_starts.resize(p.jobs);
        current_starts.resize(p.jobs);
        job_ready.assign(p.jobs, 0);
        machine_ready.assign(p.machines, 0);
        next_task.assign(p.jobs, 0);
        machine_remaining.assign(p.machines, 0);
        job_remaining = p.job_total_duration;

        for (int j = 0; j < p.jobs; ++j) {
            best_starts[j].assign(p.job_tasks[j].size(), 0);
            current_starts[j].assign(p.job_tasks[j].size(), 0);
            for (const Task& t : p.job_tasks[j]) {
                machine_remaining[t.machine] += t.duration;
            }
        }
    }

    long long lower_bound(long long current_max) const {
        long long lb = current_max;
        for (int j = 0; j < p.jobs; ++j) {
            lb = max(lb, safe_add(job_ready[j], job_remaining[j]));
        }
        for (int m = 0; m < p.machines; ++m) {
            lb = max(lb, safe_add(machine_ready[m], machine_remaining[m]));
        }
        return lb;
    }

    void dfs(int scheduled, long long current_max) {
        if (scheduled == p.total_tasks) {
            if (current_max < best_makespan) {
                best_makespan = current_max;
                best_starts = current_starts;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (lower_bound(current_max) >= best_makespan) {
            return;
        }

        vector<Candidate> candidates;
        candidates.reserve(p.jobs);
        for (int j = 0; j < p.jobs; ++j) {
            int t = next_task[j];
            if (t >= static_cast<int>(p.job_tasks[j].size())) {
                continue;
            }
            const Task& op = p.job_tasks[j][t];
            long long start = max(job_ready[j], machine_ready[op.machine]);
            long long tail = job_remaining[j] - op.duration;
            long long priority = safe_add(start, op.duration) - tail;
            candidates.push_back({j, t, op.machine, op.duration, start, priority});
        }

        sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [](const Candidate& a, const Candidate& b) {
            long long end_a = safe_add(a.earliest, a.duration);
            long long end_b = safe_add(b.earliest, b.duration);
            if (a.earliest != b.earliest) return a.earliest < b.earliest;
            if (end_a != end_b) return end_a < end_b;
            if (a.priority != b.priority) return a.priority < b.priority;
            return a.job < b.job;
        });

        for (const Candidate& cand : candidates) {
            const int j = cand.job;
            const int t = cand.task;
            const int m = cand.machine;
            const long long dur = cand.duration;
            const long long start = cand.earliest;
            const long long end = safe_add(start, dur);

            long long old_job_ready = job_ready[j];
            long long old_machine_ready = machine_ready[m];
            long long old_job_remaining = job_remaining[j];
            long long old_machine_remaining = machine_remaining[m];

            current_starts[j][t] = start;
            job_ready[j] = end;
            machine_ready[m] = end;
            job_remaining[j] -= dur;
            machine_remaining[m] -= dur;
            ++next_task[j];

            dfs(scheduled + 1, max(current_max, end));

            --next_task[j];
            job_ready[j] = old_job_ready;
            machine_ready[m] = old_machine_ready;
            job_remaining[j] = old_job_remaining;
            machine_remaining[m] = old_machine_remaining;
        }
    }
};

static vector<vector<long long>> solve_exact_small(const Problem& p) {
    ExactSolver solver(p);
    solver.dfs(0, 0);
    return solver.best_starts;
}

static vector<vector<long long>> solve_problem(const Problem& p) {
    bool tiny_instance = p.total_tasks <= 18 && p.jobs <= 8 && p.machines <= 8;
    bool small_instance = p.total_tasks <= 250 && p.jobs <= 40 && p.machines <= 20;

    if (tiny_instance) {
        return solve_exact_small(p);
    }

    vector<vector<long long>> starts = greedy_schedule(p);

    if (small_instance) {
        vector<vector<long long>> second = greedy_schedule(p);
        if (!second.empty()) {
            starts.swap(second);
        }
    }

    return starts;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    Problem p = read_problem();
    vector<vector<long long>> starts = solve_problem(p);

    for (int j = 0; j < p.jobs; ++j) {
        for (int t = 0; t < static_cast<int>(p.job_tasks[j].size()); ++t) {
            if (t) cout << ' ';
            cout << starts[j][t] << ' ' << p.job_tasks[j][t].machine;
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}
