using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

public static class Program
{
    private sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly System.IO.Stream _stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
        private readonly byte[] _buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int _len;
        private int _ptr;

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_ptr >= _len)
            {
                _len = _stream.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _ptr = 0;
                if (_len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return _buffer[_ptr++];
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c;
            do
            {
                c = Read();
            } while (c <= ' ' && c >= 0);

            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int value = 0;
            while (c > ' ')
            {
                value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return value * sign;
        }
    }

    private struct Orientation
    {
        public int W;
        public int H;
        public int D;

        public Orientation(int w, int h, int d)
        {
            W = w;
            H = h;
            D = d;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Box
    {
        public int Index;
        public int W;
        public int H;
        public int D;
        public long Volume;
        public Orientation[] Orientations = Array.Empty<Orientation>();
    }

    private sealed class Placement
    {
        public int BoxIndex;
        public int X;
        public int Y;
        public int Z;
        public int W;
        public int H;
        public int D;
    }

    private struct FreeRect
    {
        public int X;
        public int Z;
        public int W;
        public int D;

        public FreeRect(int x, int z, int w, int d)
        {
            X = x;
            Z = z;
            W = w;
            D = d;
        }
    }

    private sealed class LayerPacker
    {
        private readonly int _width;
        private readonly int _depth;
        private readonly List<FreeRect> _freeRects = new List<FreeRect>();

        public LayerPacker(int width, int depth)
        {
            _width = width;
            _depth = depth;
            Reset();
        }

        public void Reset()
        {
            _freeRects.Clear();
            _freeRects.Add(new FreeRect(0, 0, _width, _depth));
        }

        public bool TryPlace(int w, int d, out int x, out int z)
        {
            int bestIndex = -1;
            long bestScore = long.MaxValue;
            int bestX = 0;
            int bestZ = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < _freeRects.Count; i++)
            {
                var rect = _freeRects[i];
                if (w > rect.W || d > rect.D) continue;

                long shortSide = Math.Min(rect.W - w, rect.D - d);
                long longSide = Math.Max(rect.W - w, rect.D - d);
                long score = (shortSide << 32) + longSide;
                if (score < bestScore || (score == bestScore && (rect.Z < bestZ || (rect.Z == bestZ && rect.X < bestX))))
                {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestIndex = i;
                    bestX = rect.X;
                    bestZ = rect.Z;
                }
            }

            if (bestIndex < 0)
            {
                x = 0;
                z = 0;
                return false;
            }

            x = bestX;
            z = bestZ;
            Split(bestIndex, w, d);
            return true;
        }

        private void Split(int index, int usedW, int usedD)
        {
            var rect = _freeRects[index];
            _freeRects.RemoveAt(index);

            int rightW = rect.W - usedW;
            int topD = rect.D - usedD;

            if (rightW > 0)
            {
                _freeRects.Add(new FreeRect(rect.X + usedW, rect.Z, rightW, usedD));
            }
            if (topD > 0)
            {
                _freeRects.Add(new FreeRect(rect.X, rect.Z + usedD, rect.W, topD));
            }
            if (rightW > 0 && topD > 0)
            {
                _freeRects.Add(new FreeRect(rect.X + usedW, rect.Z + usedD, rightW, topD));
            }

            Prune();
        }

        private void Prune()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _freeRects.Count; i++)
            {
                var a = _freeRects[i];
                for (int j = _freeRects.Count - 1; j > i; j--)
                {
                    var b = _freeRects[j];
                    if (Contains(a, b))
                    {
                        _freeRects.RemoveAt(j);
                    }
                    else if (Contains(b, a))
                    {
                        _freeRects[i] = _freeRects[_freeRects.Count - 1];
                        _freeRects.RemoveAt(_freeRects.Count - 1);
                        i--;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool Contains(FreeRect a, FreeRect b)
        {
            return b.X >= a.X && b.Z >= a.Z && b.X + b.W <= a.X + a.W && b.Z + b.D <= a.Z + a.D;
        }
    }

    private sealed class Candidate
    {
        public int BoxIndex;
        public Orientation Orientation;
        public long Score;
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        var fs = new FastScanner();
        int n = fs.NextInt();
        int containerW = fs.NextInt();
        int containerH = fs.NextInt();
        int containerD = fs.NextInt();

        var boxes = new Box[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            int w = fs.NextInt();
            int h = fs.NextInt();
            int d = fs.NextInt();
            boxes[i] = new Box
            {
                Index = i,
                W = w,
                H = h,
                D = d,
                Volume = (long)w * h * d,
                Orientations = BuildOrientations(w, h, d)
            };
        }

        var placements = Solve(boxes, containerW, containerH, containerD);

        Console.WriteLine(placements.Count.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        foreach (var p in placements)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{p.BoxIndex} {p.X} {p.Y} {p.Z}"));
        }
    }

    private static List<Placement> Solve(Box[] boxes, int containerW, int containerH, int containerD)
    {
        bool smallInstance = boxes.Length <= 64 && (long)containerW * containerH * containerD <= 2_000_000L;
        var layerHeights = CollectLayerHeights(boxes, containerH, smallInstance ? 10 : 6);
        if (layerHeights.Count == 0)
        {
            return new List<Placement>();
        }

        List<Placement>? best = null;
        int bestCount = -1;
        long bestVolume = -1;

        foreach (var orderMode in smallInstance ? new[] { 0, 1, 2, 3 } : new[] { 0, 1 })
        {
            var current = PackByLayers(boxes, containerW, containerH, containerD, layerHeights, orderMode, smallInstance);
            long volume = 0;
            foreach (var p in current) volume += (long)p.W * p.H * p.D;
            if (current.Count > bestCount || (current.Count == bestCount && volume > bestVolume))
            {
                best = current;
                bestCount = current.Count;
                bestVolume = volume;
            }
        }

        return best ?? new List<Placement>();
    }

    private static List<Placement> PackByLayers(Box[] boxes, int containerW, int containerH, int containerD, List<int> layerHeights, int orderMode, bool smallInstance)
    {
        var used = new bool[boxes.Length];
        var placements = new List<Placement>(boxes.Length);
        var packer = new LayerPacker(containerW, containerD);
        int y = 0;

        while (y < containerH)
        {
            int bestLayer = -1;
            List<Candidate>? bestCandidates = null;
            long bestVolume = -1;
            int bestCount = -1;

            foreach (int layerH in layerHeights)
            {
                if (layerH <= 0 || y + layerH > containerH) continue;
                var candidates = BuildCandidates(boxes, used, layerH, containerW, containerD, orderMode, smallInstance);
                if (candidates.Count == 0) continue;

                packer.Reset();
                var tentative = new List<Candidate>();
                long volume = 0;
                foreach (var c in candidates)
                {
                    if (packer.TryPlace(c.Orientation.W, c.Orientation.D, out _, out _))
                    {
                        tentative.Add(c);
                        volume += (long)c.Orientation.W * c.Orientation.H * c.Orientation.D;
                    }
                }

                if (tentative.Count > bestCount || (tentative.Count == bestCount && volume > bestVolume))
                {
                    bestCount = tentative.Count;
                    bestVolume = volume;
                    bestLayer = layerH;
                    bestCandidates = tentative;
                }
            }

            if (bestLayer < 0 || bestCandidates == null || bestCandidates.Count == 0)
            {
                break;
            }

            packer.Reset();
            foreach (var c in bestCandidates)
            {
                if (!used[c.BoxIndex] && packer.TryPlace(c.Orientation.W, c.Orientation.D, out int x, out int z))
                {
                    used[c.BoxIndex] = true;
                    placements.Add(new Placement
                    {
                        BoxIndex = c.BoxIndex,
                        X = x,
                        Y = y,
                        Z = z,
                        W = c.Orientation.W,
                        H = c.Orientation.H,
                        D = c.Orientation.D
                    });
                }
            }

            y += bestLayer;
        }

        return placements;
    }

    private static List<Candidate> BuildCandidates(Box[] boxes, bool[] used, int layerH, int containerW, int containerD, int orderMode, bool smallInstance)
    {
        var candidates = new List<Candidate>(boxes.Length);
        for (int i = 0; i < boxes.Length; i++)
        {
            if (used[i]) continue;
            Orientation best = default;
            bool found = false;
            long bestScore = long.MinValue;

            foreach (var o in boxes[i].Orientations)
            {
                if (o.H != layerH) continue;
                if (o.W > containerW || o.D > containerD) continue;
                long footprint = (long)o.W * o.D;
                long score = orderMode switch
                {
                    0 => footprint * 16L - o.W - o.D,
                    1 => footprint * 8L - Math.Abs(o.W - o.D),
                    2 => boxes[i].Volume * 4L - footprint,
                    _ => footprint * 8L - Math.Max(o.W, o.D)
                };
                if (!found || score > bestScore)
                {
                    best = o;
                    bestScore = score;
                    found = true;
                }
            }

            if (!found) continue;
            candidates.Add(new Candidate
            {
                BoxIndex = boxes[i].Index,
                Orientation = best,
                Score = CandidatePriority(boxes[i], best, orderMode, smallInstance)
            });
        }

        candidates.Sort((a, b) => b.Score.CompareTo(a.Score));
        return candidates;
    }

    private static long CandidatePriority(Box box, Orientation o, int mode, bool smallInstance)
    {
        long footprint = (long)o.W * o.D;
        long volume = (long)o.W * o.H * o.D;
        return mode switch
        {
            0 => volume * 32L + footprint * 4L - (o.W + o.D),
            1 => footprint * 64L + volume - Math.Abs(o.W - o.D),
            2 => (smallInstance ? 128L : 32L) * volume - 2L * Math.Max(o.W, o.D),
            _ => volume * 16L + 8L * Math.Min(o.W, o.D) - Math.Max(o.W, o.D)
        };
    }

    private static List<int> CollectLayerHeights(Box[] boxes, int containerH, int perBoxLimit)
    {
        var set = new HashSet<int>();
        foreach (var box in boxes)
        {
            int added = 0;
            foreach (var o in box.Orientations)
            {
                if (o.H <= containerH && set.Add(o.H))
                {
                    added++;
                    if (added >= perBoxLimit) break;
                }
            }
        }

        var list = set.ToList();
        list.Sort((a, b) => a.CompareTo(b));
        return list;
    }

    private static Orientation[] BuildOrientations(int w, int h, int d)
    {
        var set = new HashSet<(int, int, int)>();
        var list = new List<Orientation>(6);
        AddOrientation(w, h, d, set, list);
        AddOrientation(w, d, h, set, list);
        AddOrientation(h, w, d, set, list);
        AddOrientation(h, d, w, set, list);
        AddOrientation(d, w, h, set, list);
        AddOrientation(d, h, w, set, list);
        list.Sort((a, b) =>
        {
            int c = a.H.CompareTo(b.H);
            if (c != 0) return c;
            c = ((long)a.W * a.D).CompareTo((long)b.W * b.D);
            if (c != 0) return c;
            c = a.W.CompareTo(b.W);
            if (c != 0) return c;
            return a.D.CompareTo(b.D);
        });
        return list.ToArray();
    }

    private static void AddOrientation(int w, int h, int d, HashSet<(int, int, int)> set, List<Orientation> list)
    {
        if (set.Add((w, h, d)))
        {
            list.Add(new Orientation(w, h, d));
        }
    }
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <queue>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    uint32_t u = 0;
    uint32_t v = 0;
};

struct AdjEdge {
    uint32_t to = 0;
    uint32_t id = 0;
};

struct Solver {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    uint64_t m = 0;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<vector<AdjEdge>> adj;

    vector<uint32_t> get_cut_from_component(const vector<char>& side) const {
        vector<uint32_t> cut;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < static_cast<uint32_t>(edges.size()); ++i) {
            const auto& e = edges[i];
            if (side[e.u] != side[e.v]) cut.push_back(i);
        }
        return cut;
    }

    vector<uint32_t> find_bridge_cut() const {
        vector<uint32_t> tin(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low(n, 0);
        vector<uint32_t> parent_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        uint32_t timer = 0;
        uint32_t bridge_id = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();

        struct Frame {
            uint32_t u;
            uint32_t parent;
            size_t it;
        };

        for (uint32_t root = 0; root < n && bridge_id == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max(); ++root) {
            if (tin[root] != numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) continue;
            vector<Frame> st;
            st.push_back({root, root, 0});
            tin[root] = low[root] = timer++;
            while (!st.empty() && bridge_id == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                Frame& fr = st.back();
                uint32_t u = fr.u;
                if (fr.it == adj[u].size()) {
                    st.pop_back();
                    if (!st.empty()) {
                        uint32_t p = st.back().u;
                        low[p] = min(low[p], low[u]);
                        if (low[u] > tin[p]) {
                            bridge_id = parent_edge[u];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                AdjEdge ae = adj[u][fr.it++];
                if (ae.id == parent_edge[u]) continue;
                uint32_t v = ae.to;
                if (tin[v] == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                    parent_edge[v] = ae.id;
                    tin[v] = low[v] = timer++;
                    st.push_back({v, u, 0});
                } else {
                    low[u] = min(low[u], tin[v]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (bridge_id == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) return {};
        return {bridge_id};
    }

    vector<uint32_t> find_two_edge_cut() const {
        vector<uint32_t> tin(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low1(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low2(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low1_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low2_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> parent(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> parent_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        uint32_t timer = 0;

        auto push_low = [&](uint32_t u, uint32_t val, uint32_t edge_id) {
            if (val < low1[u]) {
                if (edge_id != low1_edge[u]) {
                    low2[u] = low1[u];
                    low2_edge[u] = low1_edge[u];
                }
                low1[u] = val;
                low1_edge[u] = edge_id;
            } else if (edge_id != low1_edge[u] && val < low2[u]) {
                low2[u] = val;
                low2_edge[u] = edge_id;
            }
        };

        struct Frame {
            uint32_t u;
            size_t it;
        };

        for (uint32_t root = 0; root < n; ++root) {
            if (tin[root] != numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) continue;
            vector<Frame> st;
            st.push_back({root, 0});
            parent[root] = root;
            tin[root] = timer++;
            low1[root] = tin[root];
            low1_edge[root] = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();

            while (!st.empty()) {
                Frame& fr = st.back();
                uint32_t u = fr.u;
                if (fr.it == adj[u].size()) {
                    st.pop_back();
                    if (u != root) {
                        uint32_t p = parent[u];
                        push_low(p, low1[u], low1_edge[u]);
                        if (low2[u] != numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                            push_low(p, low2[u], low2_edge[u]);
                        }
                        if (low1[u] == tin[p] && low2[u] >= tin[u]) {
                            return {parent_edge[u], low2_edge[u]};
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                AdjEdge ae = adj[u][fr.it++];
                if (ae.id == parent_edge[u]) continue;
                uint32_t v = ae.to;
                if (tin[v] == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    parent_edge[v] = ae.id;
                    tin[v] = timer++;
                    low1[v] = tin[v];
                    low1_edge[v] = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
                    st.push_back({v, 0});
                } else if (tin[v] < tin[u]) {
                    push_low(u, tin[v], ae.id);
                }
            }
        }
        return {};
    }

    vector<uint32_t> stoer_wagner_exact() const {
        vector<vector<uint32_t>> w(n, vector<uint32_t>(n, 0));
        for (const auto& e : edges) {
            if (e.u == e.v) continue;
            ++w[e.u][e.v];
            ++w[e.v][e.u];
        }

        vector<uint32_t> verts(n);
        iota(verts.begin(), verts.end(), 0);
        vector<vector<uint32_t>> groups(n);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) groups[i] = {i};

        uint32_t best = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
        vector<char> best_side(n, 0);

        while (verts.size() > 1) {
            vector<uint32_t> weight(n, 0);
            vector<char> added(n, 0);
            uint32_t prev = verts[0];
            for (size_t it = 0; it < verts.size(); ++it) {
                uint32_t sel = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
                uint32_t best_w = 0;
                for (uint32_t v : verts) {
                    if (!added[v] && weight[v] >= best_w) {
                        best_w = weight[v];
                        sel = v;
                    }
                }
                if (it + 1 == verts.size()) {
                    if (best_w < best) {
                        best = best_w;
                        fill(best_side.begin(), best_side.end(), 0);
                        for (uint32_t x : groups[sel]) best_side[x] = 1;
                    }
                    if (best == 0) break;
                    for (uint32_t v : verts) {
                        if (v == sel || v == prev) continue;
                        w[prev][v] += w[sel][v];
                        w[v][prev] = w[prev][v];
                    }
                    auto& gp = groups[prev];
                    gp.insert(gp.end(), groups[sel].begin(), groups[sel].end());
                    verts.erase(remove(verts.begin(), verts.end(), sel), verts.end());
                    break;
                }
                added[sel] = 1;
                prev = sel;
                for (uint32_t v : verts) {
                    if (!added[v]) weight[v] += w[sel][v];
                }
            }
        }

        return get_cut_from_component(best_side);
    }

    vector<uint32_t> solve() const {
        if (n <= 1) return {};

        if (auto cut = find_bridge_cut(); !cut.empty()) return cut;
        if (auto cut = find_two_edge_cut(); !cut.empty()) return cut;

        return stoer_wagner_exact();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    Solver solver;
    uint64_t m64 = 0;
    if (!(cin >> solver.n >> m64)) {
        return 0;
    }
    solver.m = m64;
    solver.edges.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(m64));
    solver.adj.assign(solver.n, {});

    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < m64; ++i) {
        uint32_t u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        solver.edges.push_back({u, v});
        uint32_t id = static_cast<uint32_t>(i);
        solver.adj[u].push_back({v, id});
        solver.adj[v].push_back({u, id});
    }

    vector<uint32_t> cut = solver.solve();
    cout << cut.size() << '\n';
    for (uint32_t id : cut) {
        const auto& e = solver.edges[id];
        cout << e.u << ' ' << e.v << '\n';
    }
    return 0;
}

        vector<vector<uint32_t>> w(n, vector<uint32_t>(n, 0));
        for (const auto& e : edges) {
            if (e.u == e.v) continue;
            ++w[e.u][e.v];
            ++w[e.v][e.u];
        }

        vector<uint32_t> verts(n);
        iota(verts.begin(), verts.end(), 0);
        vector<vector<uint32_t>> groups(n);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) groups[i] = {i};

        uint32_t best = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
        vector<char> best_side(n, 0);

        while (verts.size() > 1) {
            vector<uint32_t> weight(n, 0);
            vector<char> added(n, 0);
            uint32_t prev = verts[0];
            for (size_t it = 0; it < verts.size(); ++it) {
                uint32_t sel = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
                uint32_t best_w = 0;
                for (uint32_t v : verts) {
                    if (!added[v] && weight[v] >= best_w) {
                        best_w = weight[v];
                        sel = v;
                    }
                }
                if (it + 1 == verts.size()) {
                    if (best_w < best) {
                        best = best_w;
                        fill(best_side.begin(), best_side.end(), 0);
                        for (uint32_t x : groups[sel]) best_side[x] = 1;
                    }
                    if (best == 0) break;
                    for (uint32_t v : verts) {
                        if (v == sel || v == prev) continue;
                        w[prev][v] += w[sel][v];
                        w[v][prev] = w[prev][v];
                    }
                    auto& gp = groups[prev];
                    gp.insert(gp.end(), groups[sel].begin(), groups[sel].end());
                    verts.erase(remove(verts.begin(), verts.end(), sel), verts.end());
                    break;
                }
                added[sel] = 1;
                prev = sel;
                for (uint32_t v : verts) {
                    if (!added[v]) weight[v] += w[sel][v];
                }
            }
        }

        return get_cut_from_component(best_side);
    }

    vector<uint32_t> solve() const {
        if (n <= 1) return {};

        if (auto cut = find_bridge_cut(); !cut.empty()) return cut;
        if (auto cut = find_two_edge_cut(); !cut.empty()) return cut;

        return stoer_wagner_exact();
    }
};

    uint32_t to = 0;

    vector<uint32_t> get_cut_from_component(const vector<char>& side) const {
        vector<uint32_t> cut;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < static_cast<uint32_t>(edges.size()); ++i) {
            const auto& e = edges[i];
            if (side[e.u] != side[e.v]) cut.push_back(i);
        }
        return cut;
    }

    vector<uint32_t> find_bridge_cut() const {
        vector<uint32_t> tin(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low(n, 0);
        vector<uint32_t> parent_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        uint32_t timer = 0;
        uint32_t bridge_id = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();

        struct Frame {
            uint32_t u;
            uint32_t parent;
            size_t it;
        };

        for (uint32_t root = 0; root < n && bridge_id == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max(); ++root) {
            if (tin[root] != numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) continue;
            vector<Frame> st;
            st.push_back({root, root, 0});
            tin[root] = low[root] = timer++;
            while (!st.empty() && bridge_id == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                Frame& fr = st.back();
                uint32_t u = fr.u;
                if (fr.it == adj[u].size()) {
                    st.pop_back();
                    if (!st.empty()) {
                        uint32_t p = st.back().u;
                        low[p] = min(low[p], low[u]);
                        if (low[u] > tin[p]) {
                            bridge_id = parent_edge[u];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                AdjEdge ae = adj[u][fr.it++];
                if (ae.id == parent_edge[u]) continue;
                uint32_t v = ae.to;
                if (tin[v] == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                    parent_edge[v] = ae.id;
                    tin[v] = low[v] = timer++;
                    st.push_back({v, u, 0});
                } else {
                    low[u] = min(low[u], tin[v]);
                }
            }
        }

        if (bridge_id == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) return {};
        return {bridge_id};
    }

    vector<uint32_t> find_two_edge_cut() const {
        vector<uint32_t> tin(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low1(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low2(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low1_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> low2_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> parent(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        vector<uint32_t> parent_edge(n, numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max());
        uint32_t timer = 0;

        auto push_low = [&](uint32_t u, uint32_t val, uint32_t edge_id) {
            if (val < low1[u]) {
                if (edge_id != low1_edge[u]) {
                    low2[u] = low1[u];
                    low2_edge[u] = low1_edge[u];
                }
                low1[u] = val;
                low1_edge[u] = edge_id;
            } else if (edge_id != low1_edge[u] && val < low2[u]) {
                low2[u] = val;
                low2_edge[u] = edge_id;
            }
        };

        struct Frame {
            uint32_t u;
            size_t it;
        };

        for (uint32_t root = 0; root < n; ++root) {
            if (tin[root] != numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) continue;
            vector<Frame> st;
            st.push_back({root, 0});
            parent[root] = root;
            tin[root] = timer++;
            low1[root] = tin[root];
            low1_edge[root] = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();

            while (!st.empty()) {
                Frame& fr = st.back();
                uint32_t u = fr.u;
                if (fr.it == adj[u].size()) {
                    st.pop_back();
                    if (u != root) {
                        uint32_t p = parent[u];
                        push_low(p, low1[u], low1_edge[u]);
                        if (low2[u] != numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                            push_low(p, low2[u], low2_edge[u]);
                        }
                        if (low1[u] == tin[p] && low2[u] >= tin[u]) {
                            return {parent_edge[u], low2_edge[u]};
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                AdjEdge ae = adj[u][fr.it++];
                if (ae.id == parent_edge[u]) continue;
                uint32_t v = ae.to;
                if (tin[v] == numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    parent_edge[v] = ae.id;
                    tin[v] = timer++;
                    low1[v] = tin[v];
                    low1_edge[v] = numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
                    st.push_back({v, 0});
                } else if (tin[v] < tin[u]) {
                    push_low(u, tin[v], ae.id);
                }
            }
        }
        return {};
    }

    vector<uint32_t> stoer_wagner_exact() const {
        vector<vector<uint32_t>> w(n, vector<uint32_t>(n, 0));
        for (const auto& e : edges) {
            if (e.u == e.v) continue;

You are writing a C# program to solve a mining problem in a simplified 3D voxel space.

**Constraints:**
1. Can only dig dirt that is exposed from above or a side.
2. Dug dirt must be dumped somewhere - at a location not blocking future digging
3. Maximum uphill slope - 1 Z voxel per X/Y voxel.
4. Dumped dirt becomes a new obstacle (plan carefully!)
5. Goal is to get valuable ore to a processing plant located at x=0, y=0
6. Ground is stable and solid, and you can dig under any voxel without fear of it collapsing
so long as it's connected to the earth. If you disconnect a voxel(s), it will collapse.

The voxel grid size has 10x more precision in Z than X/Y. So 10x10x100 is a cube.

**Input header format (stdin - space delimited. Ends with newline):**
```
XVoxelCount YVoxelCount ZVoxelCount XBlockSize YBlockSize ZBlockSize
```
Counts are human readable integers. BlockSize are human readable decimal numbers.

After the newline, voxels then follow in bytes, like this python psuedocode:
```
for x in range(XVoxelCount):
for y in range(YVoxelCount):
for z in range(ZVoxelCount):
d = readByte(stdin)
massInTonnes = d % 16
valuePerTonne = d // 16
addVoxel(d)
```

Each peice of dirt needs to be moved to its new location - you need to trace the
path in X and Y (4-connected / manhatten steps) and ensure that the path doesn't climb uphill
or downhill more than 1 Z voxel for every X/Y voxel.

**Output format (stdout / newline seperated):**
```
M (number of operations)
N digX digY digZ stepX1 stepY1 stepX2 stepY2 (N steps) destX destY (for each operation)
```

If dumping valuable ore at the processing plant, the voxel ceases to exist. If a voxel is
dumped elsewhere, it is dumped on top of the ground, raising the ground by 1 voxel. It can
be dug again and moved later if required.

Every unit of mass requires $1 of fuel to move one voxel in X or Y when flat, or $5 of fuel
to go up a 10% slope. Downhill is free.

Getting valuable ore to your processing plant pays $1000 per unit of mass per unit of value.
The most valuable ore (#15) pays $15,000 per ton, so the most a single dump truck load can gross
is $225,000.

(Dumping junk ore at the processing plant causes damage to the plant, costing $1000 per ton.)

**Requirements:**
1. Program must compile with .NET/csc
2. Read from stdin, write to stdout
3. World size could be anything from 10x10x10 to 5000x5000x5000, your code should handle both extremes.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    private const int MaxStoredOperations = 200000;

    public static void Main()
    {
        var scanner = new FastScanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int xCount = scanner.NextInt();
        int yCount = scanner.NextInt();
        int zCount = scanner.NextInt();
        double xBlockSize = scanner.NextDouble();
        double yBlockSize = scanner.NextDouble();
        double zBlockSize = scanner.NextDouble();

        long cellCount = (long)xCount * yCount;
        bool storeHeights = cellCount <= 12_000_000;
        int[] heights = storeHeights ? new int[cellCount] : Array.Empty<int>();

        bool aggressive = cellCount <= 2_000_000 && zCount <= 4096;
        int targetOreOps = aggressive ? MaxStoredOperations : Math.Min(50000, MaxStoredOperations);
        var operations = new List<MoveOp>(Math.Min(targetOreOps, 16384));

        double verticalRatioX = zBlockSize / Math.Max(1e-9, xBlockSize);
        double verticalRatioY = zBlockSize / Math.Max(1e-9, yBlockSize);
        int maxRisePerX = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor(1.0 / verticalRatioX + 1e-9));
        int maxRisePerY = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor(1.0 / verticalRatioY + 1e-9));
        int maxRisePerStep = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(maxRisePerX, maxRisePerY));

        int bestDumpX = xCount > 1 ? xCount - 1 : 0;
        int bestDumpY = yCount > 1 ? yCount - 1 : 0;

        for (int x = 0; x < xCount; x++)
        {
            for (int y = 0; y < yCount; y++)
            {
                long index = (long)x * yCount + y;
                int columnHeight = 0;
                int topOreZ = -1;
                int topOreValue = 0;
                long topOreScore = long.MinValue;

                for (int z = 0; z < zCount; z++)
                {
                    int d = scanner.NextByteOrThrow();
                    int mass = d & 15;
                    int value = d >> 4;
                    if (mass > 0)
                    {
                        columnHeight = z + 1;
                    }

                    if (value > 0 && mass > 0)
                    {
                        int horizontal = x + y;
                        long revenue = 1000L * mass * value;
                        long moveCost = EstimateMoveCost(mass, horizontal, z, maxRisePerStep);
                        long score = revenue - moveCost;
                        if (score > topOreScore)
                        {
                            topOreScore = score;
                            topOreZ = z;
                            topOreValue = value;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (storeHeights)
                {
                    heights[index] = columnHeight;
                }

                if (topOreZ >= 0 && topOreScore > 0 && operations.Count < targetOreOps)
                {
                    int digZ = topOreZ;
                    if (storeHeights)
                    {
                        digZ = heights[index] - 1;
                    }

                    if (digZ >= 0)
                    {
                        bool sendToPlant = topOreValue > 0;
                        var path = BuildAdaptivePath(x, y, digZ, maxRisePerStep);
                        if (path.Count > 0 || (x == 0 && y == 0 && sendToPlant))
                        {
                            operations.Add(new MoveOp(x, y, digZ, path, sendToPlant ? 0 : bestDumpX, sendToPlant ? 0 : bestDumpY));
                            if (storeHeights)
                            {
                                heights[index] = Math.Max(0, heights[index] - 1);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        EmitOperations(operations);
    }

    private static long EstimateMoveCost(int mass, int horizontalDistance, int z, int maxRisePerStep)
    {
        if (horizontalDistance == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        int climbsNeeded = (z + Math.Max(1, maxRisePerStep) - 1) / Math.Max(1, maxRisePerStep);
        climbsNeeded = Math.Min(climbsNeeded, horizontalDistance);
        int flatSteps = horizontalDistance - climbsNeeded;
        return mass * (5L * climbsNeeded + flatSteps);
    }

    private static List<Step> BuildAdaptivePath(int x, int y, int z, int maxRisePerStep)
    {
        if (x == 0 && y == 0)
        {
            return new List<Step>();
        }

        if (z == 0 || z <= (x + y) * maxRisePerStep)
        {
            return BuildDirectPath(x, y);
        }

        return BuildSwitchbackPath(x, y, z, maxRisePerStep);
    }

    private static List<Step> BuildDirectPath(int x, int y)
    {
        var steps = new List<Step>(x + y);
        int cx = x;
        int cy = y;

        while (cx > 0)
        {
            cx--;
            steps.Add(new Step(cx, cy));
        }

        while (cy > 0)
        {
            cy--;
            steps.Add(new Step(cx, cy));
        }

        return steps;
    }

    private static List<Step> BuildSwitchbackPath(int x, int y, int z, int maxRisePerStep)
    {
        int neededLength = (z + maxRisePerStep - 1) / maxRisePerStep;
        int directLength = x + y;
        int extra = neededLength - directLength;
        if (extra <= 0)
        {
            return BuildDirectPath(x, y);
        }

        int loops = (extra + 1) / 2;
        int laneY = y > 0 ? y : 0;
        int startX = x;
        var steps = new List<Step>(directLength + loops * 2 + 4);
        int cx = startX;
        int cy = laneY;

        bool canLoopX = x + 1 < int.MaxValue && x > 0;
        if (!canLoopX)
        {
            return BuildDirectPath(x, y);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < loops; i++)
        {
            steps.Add(new Step(cx + 1, cy));
            steps.Add(new Step(cx, cy));
        }

        while (cx > 0)
        {
            cx--;
            steps.Add(new Step(cx, cy));
        }

        while (cy > 0)
        {
            cy--;
            steps.Add(new Step(cx, cy));
        }

        return steps;
    }

    private static void EmitOperations(List<MoveOp> operations)
    {
        var output = new StringBuilder();
        output.Append(operations.Count).Append('\n');
        foreach (var op in operations)
        {
            output.Append(op.Path.Count)
                .Append(' ').Append(op.DigX)
                .Append(' ').Append(op.DigY)
                .Append(' ').Append(op.DigZ);

            for (int i = 0; i < op.Path.Count; i++)
            {
                output.Append(' ').Append(op.Path[i].X)
                    .Append(' ').Append(op.Path[i].Y);
            }

            output.Append(' ').Append(op.DestX)
                .Append(' ').Append(op.DestY)
                .Append('\n');
        }

        Console.Write(output.ToString());
    }

    private readonly struct Step
    {
        public Step(int x, int y)
        {
            X = x;
            Y = y;
        }

        public int X { get; }
        public int Y { get; }
    }

    private readonly struct MoveOp
    {
        public MoveOp(int digX, int digY, int digZ, List<Step> path, int destX, int destY)
        {
            DigX = digX;
            DigY = digY;
            DigZ = digZ;
            Path = path;
            DestX = destX;
            DestY = destY;
        }

        public int DigX { get; }
        public int DigY { get; }
        public int DigZ { get; }
        public List<Step> Path { get; }
        public int DestX { get; }
        public int DestY { get; }
    }

    private sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly Stream _stream;
        private readonly byte[] _buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int _length;
        private int _position;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream)
        {
            _stream = stream;
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c = SkipWhitespace();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int value = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }

            return value * sign;
        }

        public double NextDouble()
        {
            int c = SkipWhitespace();
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            while (c > 32)
            {
                sb.Append((char)c);
                c = Read();
            }

            return double.Parse(sb.ToString(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        public int NextByteOrThrow()
        {
            int c = Read();
            if (c < 0)
            {
                throw new EndOfStreamException();
            }

            return c;
        }

        private int SkipWhitespace()
        {
            int c;
            do
            {
                c = Read();
            } while (c >= 0 && c <= 32);

            return c;
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_position >= _length)
            {
                _length = _stream.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _position = 0;
                if (_length <= 0)
                {
                    return -1;
                }
            }

            return _buffer[_position++];
        }
    }
}

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Sample {
    hole_idx: usize,
    hole_id: String,
    sample_idx: usize,
    point: [f64; 3],
    values: Vec<Option<f64>>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct PropertyStats {
    median: f64,
    mad_sigma: f64,
    q1: f64,
    q3: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct GridEntry {
    point: [f64; 3],
    sample_idx: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Suspect {
    hole_id: String,
    sample_idx: usize,
    property_name: String,
    confidence: f64,
}

fn parse_f64(token: Option<&str>) -> Option<f64> {
    let s = token?;
    if s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("na")
        || s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("nan")
        || s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("null")
        || s.eq_ignore_ascii_case("missing")
        || s == "-"
    {
        return None;
    }
    match s.parse::<f64>() {
        Ok(v) if v.is_finite() => Some(v),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn quantile(sorted: &[f64], p: f64) -> f64 {
    if sorted.is_empty() {
        return 0.0;
    }
    if sorted.len() == 1 {
        return sorted[0];
    }
    let pos = p.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * (sorted.len() - 1) as f64;
    let lo = pos.floor() as usize;
    let hi = pos.ceil() as usize;
    if lo == hi {
        sorted[lo]
    } else {
        let t = pos - lo as f64;
        sorted[lo] * (1.0 - t) + sorted[hi] * t
    }
}

fn median(sorted: &[f64]) -> f64 {
    quantile(sorted, 0.5)
}

fn compute_property_stats(samples: &[Sample], prop_count: usize) -> Vec<PropertyStats> {
    let mut stats = Vec::with_capacity(prop_count);
    for p in 0..prop_count {
        let mut vals: Vec<f64> = samples.iter().filter_map(|s| s.values[p]).collect();
        vals.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
        if vals.is_empty() {
            stats.push(PropertyStats {
                median: 0.0,
                mad_sigma: 1.0,
                q1: 0.0,
                q3: 0.0,
            });
            continue;
        }
        let med = median(&vals);
        let mut devs: Vec<f64> = vals.iter().map(|v| (v - med).abs()).collect();
        devs.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
        let mad = median(&devs);
        let q1 = quantile(&vals, 0.25);
        let q3 = quantile(&vals, 0.75);
        let iqr_sigma = ((q3 - q1) / 1.349).abs();
        let mad_sigma = (mad * 1.4826).max(iqr_sigma * 0.5).max(1e-9);
        stats.push(PropertyStats {
            median: med,
            mad_sigma,
            q1,
            q3,
        });
    }
    stats
}

fn dist2(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    let dx = a[0] - b[0];
    let dy = a[1] - b[1];
    let dz = a[2] - b[2];
    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
}

fn nearest_neighbors_bruteforce(samples: &[Sample], idx: usize, k: usize, radius2: f64) -> Vec<usize> {
    let p = samples[idx].point;
    let mut candidates: Vec<(f64, usize)> = Vec::new();
    for j in 0..samples.len() {
        if j == idx {
            continue;
        }
        let d2 = dist2(p, samples[j].point);
        if d2 <= radius2 {
            candidates.push((d2, j));
        }
    }
    candidates.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    candidates.into_iter().take(k).map(|x| x.1).collect()
}

fn grid_key(point: [f64; 3], cell: f64) -> (i32, i32, i32) {
    (
        (point[0] / cell).floor() as i32,
        (point[1] / cell).floor() as i32,
        (point[2] / cell).floor() as i32,
    )
}

fn build_grid(samples: &[Sample], cell: f64) -> HashMap<(i32, i32, i32), Vec<GridEntry>> {
    let mut grid: HashMap<(i32, i32, i32), Vec<GridEntry>> = HashMap::new();
    for (i, s) in samples.iter().enumerate() {
        grid.entry(grid_key(s.point, cell))
            .or_default()
            .push(GridEntry {
                point: s.point,
                sample_idx: i,
            });
    }
    grid
}

fn nearest_neighbors_grid(
    samples: &[Sample],
    idx: usize,
    grid: &HashMap<(i32, i32, i32), Vec<GridEntry>>,
    cell: f64,
    k: usize,
    radius2: f64,
) -> Vec<usize> {
    let p = samples[idx].point;
    let base = grid_key(p, cell);
    let reach = ((radius2.sqrt() / cell).ceil() as i32).max(1);
    let mut candidates: Vec<(f64, usize)> = Vec::new();
    for dx in -reach..=reach {
        for dy in -reach..=reach {
            for dz in -reach..=reach {
                let key = (base.0 + dx, base.1 + dy, base.2 + dz);
                if let Some(bucket) = grid.get(&key) {
                    for item in bucket {
                        if item.sample_idx == idx {
                            continue;
                        }
                        let d2 = dist2(p, item.point);
                        if d2 <= radius2 {
                            candidates.push((d2, item.sample_idx));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    candidates.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    candidates.truncate(k);
    candidates.into_iter().map(|x| x.1).collect()
}

fn robust_local_score(target: f64, neighbor_values: &[f64], global: &PropertyStats) -> Option<f64> {
    if neighbor_values.len() < 3 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut vals = neighbor_values.to_vec();
    vals.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    let med = median(&vals);
    let mut devs: Vec<f64> = vals.iter().map(|v| (v - med).abs()).collect();
    devs.sort_by(|a, b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    let local_sigma = (median(&devs) * 1.4826).max(global.mad_sigma * 0.2).max(1e-9);
    let diff = (target - med).abs();
    let local_z = diff / local_sigma;
    let global_z = (target - global.median).abs() / global.mad_sigma.max(1e-9);
    let iqr = (global.q3 - global.q1).abs();
    let distribution_bonus = if iqr > 0.0 && (target < global.q1 - 3.0 * iqr || target > global.q3 + 3.0 * iqr) {
        0.75
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    Some(local_z * 0.8 + global_z * 0.2 + distribution_bonus)
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut lines = input.lines();

    let header = match lines.next() {
        Some(h) => h,
        None => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };
    let mut header_it = header.split_whitespace();
    let num_holes = header_it.next().and_then(|x| x.parse::<usize>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    let num_properties = header_it.next().and_then(|x| x.parse::<usize>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    if num_holes == 0 || num_properties == 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let property_names: Vec<String> = match lines.next() {
        Some(line) => line
            .split_whitespace()
            .take(num_properties)
            .map(|s| s.to_string())
            .collect(),
        None => {
            println!("0");
            return;
        }
    };
    if property_names.len() != num_properties {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let mut samples: Vec<Sample> = Vec::new();
    let mut hole_count = 0usize;
    let mut duplicate_guard: HashMap<(String, i64), usize> = HashMap::new();

    while hole_count < num_holes {
        let hole_line = match lines.next() {
            Some(line) if !line.trim().is_empty() => line,
            Some(_) => continue,
            None => break,
        };
        let parts: Vec<&str> = hole_line.split_whitespace().collect();
        if parts.len() < 9 {
            break;
        }
        let hole_id = parts[0].to_string();
        let sx = parse_f64(parts.get(1).copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let sy = parse_f64(parts.get(2).copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let sz = parse_f64(parts.get(3).copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let dx = parse_f64(parts.get(4).copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let dy = parse_f64(parts.get(5).copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let dz = parse_f64(parts.get(6).copied()).unwrap_or(1.0);
        let length = parse_f64(parts.get(7).copied()).unwrap_or(0.0).max(0.0);
        let num_samples = parts.get(8).and_then(|x| x.parse::<usize>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        let norm = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();
        let dir = if norm > 0.0 {
            [dx / norm, dy / norm, dz / norm]
        } else {
            [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
        };

        for sample_idx in 0..num_samples {
            let sample_line = match lines.next() {
                Some(line) => line,
                None => break,
            };
            let cols: Vec<&str> = sample_line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if cols.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let mut depth = parse_f64(cols.first().copied()).unwrap_or(0.0);
            if !depth.is_finite() {
                depth = 0.0;
            }
            depth = depth.clamp(0.0, length);
            let point = [
                sx + dir[0] * depth,
                sy + dir[1] * depth,
                sz + dir[2] * depth,
            ];
            let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(num_properties);
            for p in 0..num_properties {
                values.push(parse_f64(cols.get(p + 1).copied()));
            }

            let dedup_key = (hole_id.clone(), (depth * 1000.0).round() as i64);
            if duplicate_guard.insert(dedup_key, samples.len()).is_some() {
                continue;
            }

            samples.push(Sample {
                hole_idx: hole_count,
                hole_id: hole_id.clone(),
                sample_idx,
                point,
                values,
            });
        }

        hole_count += 1;
    }

    if samples.len() < 4 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let total_samples = samples.len();
    let stats = compute_property_stats(&samples, num_properties);

    let mut bbox_min = [f64::INFINITY; 3];
    let mut bbox_max = [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 3];
    for s in &samples {
        for a in 0..3 {
            bbox_min[a] = bbox_min[a].min(s.point[a]);
            bbox_max[a] = bbox_max[a].max(s.point[a]);
        }
    }
    let extent = [
        (bbox_max[0] - bbox_min[0]).max(1.0),
        (bbox_max[1] - bbox_min[1]).max(1.0),
        (bbox_max[2] - bbox_min[2]).max(1.0),
    ];
    let volume = extent[0] * extent[1] * extent[2];
    let density = (total_samples as f64 / volume).max(1e-12);
    let target_neighbors = if total_samples < 5_000 {
        12usize
    } else if total_samples < 50_000 {
        10usize
    } else {
        8usize
    };
    let radius = ((target_neighbors as f64 / density).cbrt() * 1.75).max(1.0);
    let radius2 = radius * radius;
    let use_grid = total_samples > 12_000;
    let cell = radius.max(1.0);
    let grid = if use_grid {
        Some(build_grid(&samples, cell))
    } else {
        None
    };

    let mut suspects: Vec<Suspect> = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..samples.len() {
        let neighbors = if let Some(ref g) = grid {
            nearest_neighbors_grid(&samples, i, g, cell, target_neighbors, radius2)
        } else {
            nearest_neighbors_bruteforce(&samples, i, target_neighbors, radius2)
        };
        if neighbors.len() < 3 {
            continue;
        }

        for p in 0..num_properties {
            let target = match samples[i].values[p] {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => continue,
            };
            let mut neighbor_values = Vec::with_capacity(neighbors.len());
            for &j in &neighbors {
                if let Some(v) = samples[j].values[p] {
                    neighbor_values.push(v);
                }
            }
            let Some(score) = robust_local_score(target, &neighbor_values, &stats[p]) else {
                continue;
            };

            let same_hole_penalty = neighbors
                .iter()
                .filter(|&&j| samples[j].hole_idx == samples[i].hole_idx)
                .count() as f64
                / neighbors.len() as f64;
            let adjusted = score * (1.0 - 0.15 * same_hole_penalty);
            let threshold = if total_samples < 2000 { 5.0 } else { 4.5 };
            if adjusted >= threshold {
                let confidence = (1.0 - (-adjusted / 3.0).exp()).clamp(0.0, 0.999999);
                suspects.push(Suspect {
                    hole_id: samples[i].hole_id.clone(),
                    sample_idx: samples[i].sample_idx,
                    property_name: property_names[p].clone(),
                    confidence,
                });
            }
        }
    }

    suspects.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.confidence
            .partial_cmp(&a.confidence)
            .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
            .then_with(|| a.hole_id.cmp(&b.hole_id))
            .then_with(|| a.sample_idx.cmp(&b.sample_idx))
            .then_with(|| a.property_name.cmp(&b.property_name))
    });

    let max_output = if total_samples < 20_000 {
        suspects.len()
    } else {
        suspects.len().min(total_samples / 10 + 2000)
    };
    println!("{}", max_output);
    for s in suspects.into_iter().take(max_output) {
        println!("{} {} {} {:.6}", s.hole_id, s.sample_idx, s.property_name, s.confidence);
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to play an N-Dimensional Snake Game.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY dimensional complexity from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: 2D games (eg 8x8), few obstacles, basic pathfinding
- **Medium**: 3D-4D games (eg 6x6x6 to 8x8x8x8), moderate obstacles, intermediate planning
- **Large**: 6D-8D games (eg 4x4x4x4x4x4 to 6x6x6x6x6x6x6x6), many obstacles, complex pathfinding
- **Extreme**: 10D-20D games (eg 3x3x3... to 4x4x4...)

**The Challenge:**
Your C++ snake player will be tested with games ranging from simple 2D boards to massive 20D hypercubes.
The same algorithm must work efficiently across ALL dimensionalities.

**Problem:**
Like classic Nokia snake, but generalized to arbitrary dimensions. The snake occupies a series of
connected integer grid points in N-D space, moves one step per turn along one axis (+1 or -1),
grows when eating food, and dies if it hits an obstacle or itself.

**Input format (stdin, whitespace / newline seperated):**
```
D max_turns (D = number of dimensions, max_turns = turn limit)
bounds (D integers: size of space in each dimension)
snake_length start_pos (length, then D integers for head position)
F (number of food items)
F lines: food positions (D integers each)
O (number of obstacles)
O lines: obstacle positions (D integers each)
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Each turn, output: axis direction
- axis: 0 to D-1 (which dimension to move along)
- direction: -1 or +1 (which way to move)

**Game ends when:**
- Snake eats all food (win)
- Snake hits obstacle or itself (lose)
- Max turns reached

Play the classic Snake game, but in more than two dimensions. The snake moves through an N-dimensional grid, eating food to grow while avoiding its own body and the walls. In higher dimensions the grid is enormous but self-collision becomes far trickier to reason about.

N-Dimensional Snake - 2D 20x20, 5 food, 10 obstacles

View C++ Code (11056 chars)
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <functional>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <queue>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct VecHash {
    size_t operator()(const vector<int>& v) const noexcept {
        uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
        for (int x : v) {
            uint64_t y = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(x) ^ 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
            h ^= y + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
        }
        return static_cast<size_t>(h);
    }
};

struct State {
    int D = 0;
    int max_turns = 0;
    vector<int> bounds;
    deque<vector<int>> snake;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> occupied;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> obstacles;
    vector<vector<int>> foods;
    int turns_used = 0;
};

static bool same_pos(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    return a == b;
}

static bool in_bounds(const vector<int>& p, const vector<int>& bounds) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        if (p[i] < 0 || p[i] >= bounds[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static uint64_t product_limited(const vector<int>& bounds, uint64_t cap) {
    uint64_t prod = 1;
    for (int b : bounds) {
        if (b <= 0) return 0;
        if (prod > cap / static_cast<uint64_t>(b)) return cap;
        prod *= static_cast<uint64_t>(b);
    }
    return prod;
}

static int manhattan(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    int dist = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) dist += abs(a[i] - b[i]);
    return dist;
}

static bool contains_food(const vector<vector<int>>& foods, const vector<int>& p, int* idx = nullptr) {
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(foods.size()); ++i) {
        if (foods[i] == p) {
            if (idx) *idx = i;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static vector<pair<int, int>> enumerate_moves(int D) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> moves;
    moves.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(D) * 2);
    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        moves.push_back({axis, -1});
        moves.push_back({axis, +1});
    }
    return moves;
}

static vector<int> apply_move(const vector<int>& p, int axis, int dir) {
    vector<int> q = p;
    q[axis] += dir;
    return q;
}

static bool is_legal_step(const State& st, const vector<int>& next, bool grows) {
    if (!in_bounds(next, st.bounds)) return false;
    if (st.obstacles.find(next) != st.obstacles.end()) return false;

    if (!grows && !st.snake.empty() && next == st.snake.back()) return true;
    return st.occupied.find(next) == st.occupied.end();
}

static bool step_snake(State& st, int axis, int dir) {
    vector<int> next = apply_move(st.snake.front(), axis, dir);
    int food_idx = -1;
    bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, next, &food_idx);
    if (!is_legal_step(st, next, grows)) return false;

    st.snake.push_front(next);
    st.occupied.insert(next);
    if (grows) {
        st.foods.erase(st.foods.begin() + food_idx);
    } else {
        st.occupied.erase(st.snake.back());
        st.snake.pop_back();
    }
    ++st.turns_used;
    return true;
}

struct ParentMove {
    vector<int> parent;
    int axis = -1;
    int dir = 0;
};

static bool tail_reachable_after_move(
    const State& st,
    const vector<int>& candidate,
    bool grows
) {
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> blocked = st.occupied;
    blocked.erase(st.snake.front());
    if (!grows && !st.snake.empty()) blocked.erase(st.snake.back());
    blocked.insert(candidate);

    vector<int> target = grows ? st.snake.back() : (st.snake.size() >= 2 ? st.snake[st.snake.size() - 2] : candidate);
    if (candidate == target) return true;

    queue<vector<int>> q;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> seen;
    q.push(candidate);
    seen.insert(candidate);

    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        vector<int> cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(cur, mv.first, mv.second);
            if (!in_bounds(nxt, st.bounds)) continue;
            if (st.obstacles.find(nxt) != st.obstacles.end()) continue;
            if (blocked.find(nxt) != blocked.end() && nxt != target) continue;
            if (seen.insert(nxt).second) {
                if (nxt == target) return true;
                q.push(nxt);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool find_path_to_target(
    const State& st,
    const vector<int>& target,
    vector<pair<int, int>>& path
) {
    const uint64_t volume = product_limited(st.bounds, 250000);
    if (volume >= 250000) return false;

    struct Node {
        int f = 0;
        int g = 0;
        vector<int> pos;
    };
    struct Cmp {
        bool operator()(const Node& a, const Node& b) const noexcept {
            if (a.f != b.f) return a.f > b.f;
            return a.g < b.g;
        }
    };

    priority_queue<Node, vector<Node>, Cmp> pq;
    unordered_map<vector<int>, int, VecHash> best_g;
    unordered_map<vector<int>, ParentMove, VecHash> parent;

    auto start = st.snake.front();
    pq.push({manhattan(start, target), 0, start});
    best_g[start] = 0;

    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        Node cur = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto it_g = best_g.find(cur.pos);
        if (it_g == best_g.end() || cur.g != it_g->second) continue;
        if (cur.pos == target) break;

        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(cur.pos, mv.first, mv.second);
            bool grows = (nxt == target) && contains_food(st.foods, target);
            if (!is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) continue;

            int ng = cur.g + 1;
            auto it = best_g.find(nxt);
            if (it != best_g.end() && it->second <= ng) continue;
            best_g[nxt] = ng;
            parent[nxt] = {cur.pos, mv.first, mv.second};
            pq.push({ng + manhattan(nxt, target), ng, nxt});
        }
    }

    if (best_g.find(target) == best_g.end()) return false;

    vector<pair<int, int>> rev;
    vector<int> cur = target;
    while (cur != start) {
        const auto& pm = parent[cur];
        rev.push_back({pm.axis, pm.dir});
        cur = pm.parent;
    }
    reverse(rev.begin(), rev.end());

    State sim = st;
    vector<pair<int, int>> verified;
    for (const auto& mv : rev) {
        vector<int> nxt = apply_move(sim.snake.front(), mv.first, mv.second);
        bool grows = contains_food(sim.foods, nxt);
        if (!is_legal_step(sim, nxt, grows)) return false;
        if (!tail_reachable_after_move(sim, nxt, grows) && nxt != target) return false;
        if (!step_snake(sim, mv.first, mv.second)) return false;
        verified.push_back(mv);
    }

    path = move(verified);
    return true;
}

static pair<int, int> choose_survival_move(const State& st) {
    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    vector<int> head = st.snake.front();
    pair<int, int> best = {0, 1};
    int best_score = numeric_limits<int>::min();

    vector<int> nearest_food;
    int nearest_food_dist = numeric_limits<int>::max();
    for (const auto& food : st.foods) {
        int d = manhattan(head, food);
        if (d < nearest_food_dist) {
            nearest_food_dist = d;
            nearest_food = food;
        }
    }

    for (const auto& mv : moves) {
        vector<int> nxt = apply_move(head, mv.first, mv.second);
        bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, nxt);
        if (!is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) continue;

        int score = 0;
        if (tail_reachable_after_move(st, nxt, grows)) score += 1000000;
        if (!nearest_food.empty()) score -= manhattan(nxt, nearest_food) * 100;

        int local_freedom = 0;
        for (const auto& mv2 : moves) {
            vector<int> n2 = apply_move(nxt, mv2.first, mv2.second);
            bool grows2 = contains_food(st.foods, n2);
            if (in_bounds(n2, st.bounds) &&
                st.obstacles.find(n2) == st.obstacles.end() &&
                (st.occupied.find(n2) == st.occupied.end() || (!grows && n2 == st.snake.back()))) {
                ++local_freedom;
                if (grows2) score += 5;
            }
        }
        score += local_freedom * 1000;

        int wall_margin = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < st.D; ++i) {
            wall_margin += min(nxt[i], st.bounds[i] - 1 - nxt[i]);
        }
        score += wall_margin * 10;

        if (grows) score += 25000;
        if (score > best_score) {
            best_score = score;
            best = mv;
        }
    }

using namespace std;

struct VecHash {
    size_t operator()(const vector<int>& v) const noexcept {
        uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
        for (int x : v) {
            uint64_t y = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(x) ^ 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
            h ^= y + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
        }
        return static_cast<size_t>(h);
    }
};

struct State {
    int D = 0;
    int max_turns = 0;
    vector<int> bounds;
    deque<vector<int>> snake;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> occupied;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> obstacles;
    vector<vector<int>> foods;
    int turns_used = 0;
};

static bool same_pos(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    return a == b;
}

static bool in_bounds(const vector<int>& p, const vector<int>& bounds) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        if (p[i] < 0 || p[i] >= bounds[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static uint64_t product_limited(const vector<int>& bounds, uint64_t cap) {
    uint64_t prod = 1;
    for (int b : bounds) {
        if (b <= 0) return 0;
        if (prod > cap / static_cast<uint64_t>(b)) return cap;
        prod *= static_cast<uint64_t>(b);
    }
    return prod;
}

static int manhattan(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    int dist = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) dist += abs(a[i] - b[i]);
    return dist;
}

static bool contains_food(const vector<vector<int>>& foods, const vector<int>& p, int* idx = nullptr) {
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(foods.size()); ++i) {
        if (foods[i] == p) {
            if (idx) *idx = i;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static vector<pair<int, int>> enumerate_moves(int D) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> moves;
    moves.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(D) * 2);
    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        moves.push_back({axis, -1});
        moves.push_back({axis, +1});
    }
    return moves;
}

static vector<int> apply_move(const vector<int>& p, int axis, int dir) {
    vector<int> q = p;
    q[axis] += dir;
    return q;
}

static bool is_legal_step(const State& st, const vector<int>& next, bool grows) {
    if (!in_bounds(next, st.bounds)) return false;
    if (st.obstacles.find(next) != st.obstacles.end()) return false;

    if (!grows && !st.snake.empty() && next == st.snake.back()) return true;
    return st.occupied.find(next) == st.occupied.end();
}

static bool step_snake(State& st, int axis, int dir) {
    vector<int> next = apply_move(st.snake.front(), axis, dir);
    int food_idx = -1;
    bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, next, &food_idx);
    if (!is_legal_step(st, next, grows)) return false;

    st.snake.push_front(next);
    st.occupied.insert(next);
    if (grows) {
        st.foods.erase(st.foods.begin() + food_idx);
    } else {
        st.occupied.erase(st.snake.back());
        st.snake.pop_back();
    }
    ++st.turns_used;
    return true;
}

struct ParentMove {
    vector<int> parent;
    int axis = -1;
    int dir = 0;
};

static bool tail_reachable_after_move(
    const State& st,
    const vector<int>& candidate,
    bool grows
) {
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> blocked = st.occupied;
    blocked.erase(st.snake.front());
    if (!grows && !st.snake.empty()) blocked.erase(st.snake.back());
    blocked.insert(candidate);

    vector<int> target = grows ? st.snake.back() : (st.snake.size() >= 2 ? st.snake[st.snake.size() - 2] : candidate);
    if (candidate == target) return true;

    queue<vector<int>> q;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> seen;
    q.push(candidate);
    seen.insert(candidate);

    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        vector<int> cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(cur, mv.first, mv.second);
            if (!in_bounds(nxt, st.bounds)) continue;
            if (st.obstacles.find(nxt) != st.obstacles.end()) continue;
            if (blocked.find(nxt) != blocked.end() && nxt != target) continue;
            if (seen.insert(nxt).second) {
                if (nxt == target) return true;
                q.push(nxt);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool find_path_to_target(
    const State& st,
    const vector<int>& target,
    vector<pair<int, int>>& path
) {
    const uint64_t volume = product_limited(st.bounds, 250000);
    if (volume >= 250000) return false;

    struct Node {
        int f = 0;
        int g = 0;
        vector<int> pos;
    };
    struct Cmp {
        bool operator()(const Node& a, const Node& b) const noexcept {
            if (a.f != b.f) return a.f > b.f;
            return a.g < b.g;
        }
    };

    priority_queue<Node, vector<Node>, Cmp> pq;
    unordered_map<vector<int>, int, VecHash> best_g;
    unordered_map<vector<int>, ParentMove, VecHash> parent;

    auto start = st.snake.front();
    pq.push({manhattan(start, target), 0, start});
    best_g[start] = 0;

    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        Node cur = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto it_g = best_g.find(cur.pos);
        if (it_g == best_g.end() || cur.g != it_g->second) continue;
        if (cur.pos == target) break;

        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(cur.pos, mv.first, mv.second);
            bool grows = (nxt == target) && contains_food(st.foods, target);
            if (!is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) continue;

            int ng = cur.g + 1;
            auto it = best_g.find(nxt);
            if (it != best_g.end() && it->second <= ng) continue;
            best_g[nxt] = ng;
            parent[nxt] = {cur.pos, mv.first, mv.second};
            pq.push({ng + manhattan(nxt, target), ng, nxt});
        }
    }

    if (best_g.find(target) == best_g.end()) return false;

    vector<pair<int, int>> rev;
    vector<int> cur = target;
    while (cur != start) {
        const auto& pm = parent[cur];
        rev.push_back({pm.axis, pm.dir});
        cur = pm.parent;
    }
    reverse(rev.begin(), rev.end());

    State sim = st;
    vector<pair<int, int>> verified;
    for (const auto& mv : rev) {
        vector<int> nxt = apply_move(sim.snake.front(), mv.first, mv.second);
        bool grows = contains_food(sim.foods, nxt);
        if (!is_legal_step(sim, nxt, grows)) return false;
        if (!tail_reachable_after_move(sim, nxt, grows) && nxt != target) return false;
        if (!step_snake(sim, mv.first, mv.second)) return false;
        verified.push_back(mv);
    }

    path = move(verified);
    return true;
}

static pair<int, int> choose_survival_move(const State& st) {
    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    vector<int> head = st.snake.front();
    pair<int, int> best = {0, 1};
    int best_score = numeric_limits<int>::min();

    vector<int> nearest_food;
    int nearest_food_dist = numeric_limits<int>::max();
    for (const auto& food : st.foods) {
        int d = manhattan(head, food);
        if (d < nearest_food_dist) {
            nearest_food_dist = d;
            nearest_food = food;
        }
    }

    for (const auto& mv : moves) {
        vector<int> nxt = apply_move(head, mv.first, mv.second);
        bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, nxt);
        if (!is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) continue;

        int score = 0;
        if (tail_reachable_after_move(st, nxt, grows)) score += 1000000;
        if (!nearest_food.empty()) score -= manhattan(nxt, nearest_food) * 100;

        int local_freedom = 0;
        for (const auto& mv2 : moves) {
            vector<int> n2 = apply_move(nxt, mv2.first, mv2.second);
            bool grows2 = contains_food(st.foods, n2);
            if (in_bounds(n2, st.bounds) &&
                st.obstacles.find(n2) == st.obstacles.end() &&
                (st.occupied.find(n2) == st.occupied.end() || (!grows && n2 == st.snake.back()))) {
                ++local_freedom;
                if (grows2) score += 5;
            }
        }
        score += local_freedom * 1000;

        int wall_margin = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < st.D; ++i) {
            wall_margin += min(nxt[i], st.bounds[i] - 1 - nxt[i]);
        }
        score += wall_margin * 10;

        if (grows) score += 25000;
        if (score > best_score) {
            best_score = score;
            best = mv;
        }
    }

    if (best_score == numeric_limits<int>::min()) {
        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(head, mv.first, mv.second);
            bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, nxt);
            if (is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) return mv;
        }
    }
    return best;
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
