#include <unordered_set>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct VecHash {
    size_t operator()(const vector<int>& v) const noexcept {
        uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull;
        for (int x : v) {
            uint64_t y = static_cast<uint64_t>(static_cast<int64_t>(x) ^ 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull);
            h ^= y + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull + (h << 6) + (h >> 2);
        }
        return static_cast<size_t>(h);
    }
};

struct State {
    int D = 0;
    int max_turns = 0;
    vector<int> bounds;
    deque<vector<int>> snake;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> occupied;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> obstacles;
    vector<vector<int>> foods;
    int turns_used = 0;
};

static bool same_pos(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    return a == b;
}

static bool in_bounds(const vector<int>& p, const vector<int>& bounds) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) {
        if (p[i] < 0 || p[i] >= bounds[i]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static uint64_t product_limited(const vector<int>& bounds, uint64_t cap) {
    uint64_t prod = 1;
    for (int b : bounds) {
        if (b <= 0) return 0;
        if (prod > cap / static_cast<uint64_t>(b)) return cap;
        prod *= static_cast<uint64_t>(b);
    }
    return prod;
}

static int manhattan(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    int dist = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) dist += abs(a[i] - b[i]);
    return dist;
}

static bool contains_food(const vector<vector<int>>& foods, const vector<int>& p, int* idx = nullptr) {
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(foods.size()); ++i) {
        if (foods[i] == p) {
            if (idx) *idx = i;
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static vector<pair<int, int>> enumerate_moves(int D) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> moves;
    moves.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(D) * 2);
    for (int axis = 0; axis < D; ++axis) {
        moves.push_back({axis, -1});
        moves.push_back({axis, +1});
    }
    return moves;
}

static vector<int> apply_move(const vector<int>& p, int axis, int dir) {
    vector<int> q = p;
    q[axis] += dir;
    return q;
}

static bool is_legal_step(const State& st, const vector<int>& next, bool grows) {
    if (!in_bounds(next, st.bounds)) return false;
    if (st.obstacles.find(next) != st.obstacles.end()) return false;

    if (!grows && !st.snake.empty() && next == st.snake.back()) return true;
    return st.occupied.find(next) == st.occupied.end();
}

static bool step_snake(State& st, int axis, int dir) {
    vector<int> next = apply_move(st.snake.front(), axis, dir);
    int food_idx = -1;
    bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, next, &food_idx);
    if (!is_legal_step(st, next, grows)) return false;

    st.snake.push_front(next);
    st.occupied.insert(next);
    if (grows) {
        st.foods.erase(st.foods.begin() + food_idx);
    } else {
        st.occupied.erase(st.snake.back());
        st.snake.pop_back();
    }
    ++st.turns_used;
    return true;
}

struct ParentMove {
    vector<int> parent;
    int axis = -1;
    int dir = 0;
};

static bool tail_reachable_after_move(
    const State& st,
    const vector<int>& candidate,
    bool grows
) {
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> blocked = st.occupied;
    blocked.erase(st.snake.front());
    if (!grows && !st.snake.empty()) blocked.erase(st.snake.back());
    blocked.insert(candidate);

    vector<int> target = grows ? st.snake.back() : (st.snake.size() >= 2 ? st.snake[st.snake.size() - 2] : candidate);
    if (candidate == target) return true;

    queue<vector<int>> q;
    unordered_set<vector<int>, VecHash> seen;
    q.push(candidate);
    seen.insert(candidate);

    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        vector<int> cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(cur, mv.first, mv.second);
            if (!in_bounds(nxt, st.bounds)) continue;
            if (st.obstacles.find(nxt) != st.obstacles.end()) continue;
            if (blocked.find(nxt) != blocked.end() && nxt != target) continue;
            if (seen.insert(nxt).second) {
                if (nxt == target) return true;
                q.push(nxt);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

static bool find_path_to_target(
    const State& st,
    const vector<int>& target,
    vector<pair<int, int>>& path
) {
    const uint64_t volume = product_limited(st.bounds, 250000);
    if (volume >= 250000) return false;

    struct Node {
        int f = 0;
        int g = 0;
        vector<int> pos;
    };
    struct Cmp {
        bool operator()(const Node& a, const Node& b) const noexcept {
            if (a.f != b.f) return a.f > b.f;
            return a.g < b.g;
        }
    };

    priority_queue<Node, vector<Node>, Cmp> pq;
    unordered_map<vector<int>, int, VecHash> best_g;
    unordered_map<vector<int>, ParentMove, VecHash> parent;

    auto start = st.snake.front();
    pq.push({manhattan(start, target), 0, start});
    best_g[start] = 0;

    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        Node cur = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto it_g = best_g.find(cur.pos);
        if (it_g == best_g.end() || cur.g != it_g->second) continue;
        if (cur.pos == target) break;

        for (const auto& mv : moves) {
            vector<int> nxt = apply_move(cur.pos, mv.first, mv.second);
            bool grows = (nxt == target) && contains_food(st.foods, target);
            if (!is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) continue;

            int ng = cur.g + 1;
            auto it = best_g.find(nxt);
            if (it != best_g.end() && it->second <= ng) continue;
            best_g[nxt] = ng;
            parent[nxt] = {cur.pos, mv.first, mv.second};
            pq.push({ng + manhattan(nxt, target), ng, nxt});
        }
    }

    if (best_g.find(target) == best_g.end()) return false;

    vector<pair<int, int>> rev;
    vector<int> cur = target;
    while (cur != start) {
        const auto& pm = parent[cur];
        rev.push_back({pm.axis, pm.dir});
        cur = pm.parent;
    }
    reverse(rev.begin(), rev.end());

    State sim = st;
    vector<pair<int, int>> verified;
    for (const auto& mv : rev) {
        vector<int> nxt = apply_move(sim.snake.front(), mv.first, mv.second);
        bool grows = contains_food(sim.foods, nxt);
        if (!is_legal_step(sim, nxt, grows)) return false;
        if (!tail_reachable_after_move(sim, nxt, grows) && nxt != target) return false;
        if (!step_snake(sim, mv.first, mv.second)) return false;
        verified.push_back(mv);
    }

    path = move(verified);
    return true;
}

static pair<int, int> choose_survival_move(const State& st) {
    auto moves = enumerate_moves(st.D);
    vector<int> head = st.snake.front();
    pair<int, int> best = {0, 1};
    int best_score = numeric_limits<int>::min();

            if (in_bounds(n2, st.bounds) &&

                (st.occupied.find(n2) == st.occupied.end() || (!grows && n2 == st.snake.back()))) {
                ++local_freedom;
                if (grows2) score += 5;
            }
        }
        score += local_freedom * 1000;

        int wall_margin = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < st.D; ++i) {
            wall_margin += min(nxt[i], st.bounds[i] - 1 - nxt[i]);
        }

            best = mv;
        }
    }

    if (best_score == numeric_limits<int>::min()) {
        for (const auto& mv : moves) {

            bool grows = contains_food(st.foods, nxt);
            if (is_legal_step(st, nxt, grows)) return mv;
        }
    }
    return best;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    private const int LookaheadDepthSafe = 2;
    private const int LookaheadDepthDanger = 1;

    private static readonly Dictionary<char, PieceDefinition> Pieces = CreatePieces();

    public static void Main()
    {
        var scanner = new FastScanner(Console.In);
        int width = scanner.NextInt();
        int height = scanner.NextInt();
        int numPieces = scanner.NextInt();

        var game = new TetrisGame(width, height);

        for (int i = 0; i < numPieces; i++)
        {
            string token = scanner.NextToken();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
            {
                break;
            }

            char pieceType = token[0];
            Move move = ChooseMove(game, pieceType);
            Console.WriteLine($"{move.Rotation} {move.Column}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            string result = scanner.NextToken();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result))
            {
                game.ApplyMove(pieceType, move, updateState: true);
                break;
            }

            game.ApplyMove(pieceType, move, updateState: true);
            game.ApplyExternalResult(result);

            if (result.Equals("gameover", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static Move ChooseMove(TetrisGame game, char pieceType)
    {
        var piece = Pieces[pieceType];
        var boardStats = game.GetStats();
        bool danger = boardStats.MaxHeight >= game.Height - 4 || boardStats.HoleCount > game.Width * 2;
        int depth = danger ? LookaheadDepthDanger : LookaheadDepthSafe;
        var weights = danger ? HeuristicWeights.Danger : (boardStats.MaxHeight < game.Height / 3 ? HeuristicWeights.Safe : HeuristicWeights.Normal);

        Move bestMove = default;
        double bestScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        bool found = false;

        foreach (var orientation in piece.Orientations)
        {
            int maxColumn = game.Width - orientation.Width;
            for (int col = 0; col <= maxColumn; col++)
            {
                if (!game.CanPlace(orientation, col, out int landingRow))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var sim = game.Clone();
                var placement = sim.Place(orientation, col, landingRow);
                if (!placement.Success)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                double score = EvaluateState(sim, weights, placement, depth - 1);
                score += placement.LinesCleared * placement.LinesCleared * 15.0;
                score += placement.TouchedFloor ? 1.2 : 0.0;
                score += placement.WallContacts * 0.15;
                score += placement.SupportContacts * 0.20;

                if (!found || score > bestScore)
                {
                    found = true;
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestMove = new Move(orientation.Rotation, col);
                }
            }
        }

        if (found)
        {
            return bestMove;
        }

        return new Move(0, 0);
    }

    private static double EvaluateState(TetrisGame game, HeuristicWeights weights, PlacementResult placement, int lookaheadDepth)
    {
        var stats = game.GetStats();

        double score = 0.0;
        score += stats.AggregateHeight * weights.AggregateHeight;
        score += stats.MaxHeight * weights.MaxHeight;
        score += stats.HoleCount * weights.Holes;
        score += stats.WeightedHoles * weights.WeightedHoles;
        score += stats.Bumpiness * weights.Bumpiness;
        score += stats.WellDepth * weights.Wells;
        score += stats.RowTransitions * weights.RowTransitions;
        score += stats.ColumnTransitions * weights.ColumnTransitions;
        score += stats.CoveredCells * weights.CoveredCells;
        score += stats.ClearedLinesTotal * weights.ClearedLines;
        score += placement.LinesCleared * weights.ImmediateLineClear;

        if (lookaheadDepth > 0)
        {
            double future = 0.0;
            int count = 0;
            foreach (char nextPiece in TetrisGame.PieceOrder)
            {
                future += EstimateBestFuture(game, nextPiece, weights, lookaheadDepth);
                count++;
            }

            if (count > 0)
            {
                score += (future / count) * weights.LookaheadFactor;
            }
        }

        return score;
    }

    private static double EstimateBestFuture(TetrisGame game, char pieceType, HeuristicWeights weights, int lookaheadDepth)
    {
        var piece = Pieces[pieceType];
        double bestScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        bool found = false;

        foreach (var orientation in piece.Orientations)
        {
            int maxColumn = game.Width - orientation.Width;
            for (int col = 0; col <= maxColumn; col++)
            {
                if (!game.CanPlace(orientation, col, out int landingRow))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var sim = game.Clone();
                var placement = sim.Place(orientation, col, landingRow);
                if (!placement.Success)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                double score = EvaluateState(sim, weights, placement, lookaheadDepth - 1);
                if (!found || score > bestScore)
                {
                    found = true;
                    bestScore = score;
                }
            }
        }

        return found ? bestScore : -1_000_000.0;
    }

        public static Orientation From(int rotation, string[] rows)
        {
            var cells = new List<(int X, int Y)>();
            int height = rows.Length;
            int width = rows[0].Length;

                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return new Orientation
            {
                Rotation = rotation,
                Width = width,
                Height = height,
                Cells = cells.ToArray(),
                BottomProfile = bottom

    private sealed class TetrisGame
    {
        public static readonly char[] PieceOrder = { 'I', 'O', 'T', 'S', 'Z', 'J', 'L' };

        private readonly bool[,] _grid;
        private readonly int[] _columnHeights;

        public TetrisGame(int width, int height)
        {
            Width = width;
            Height = height;
            _grid = new bool[height, width];
            _columnHeights = new int[width];
        }

        private TetrisGame(int width, int height, bool[,] grid, int[] columnHeights, int clearedLinesTotal)
        {
            Width = width;
            Height = height;
            _grid = grid;
            _columnHeights = columnHeights;
            ClearedLinesTotal = clearedLinesTotal;
        }

        public int Width { get; }
        public int Height { get; }
        public int ClearedLinesTotal { get; private set; }

        public TetrisGame Clone()
        {
            return new TetrisGame(Width, Height, (bool[,])_grid.Clone(), (int[])_columnHeights.Clone(), ClearedLinesTotal);
        }

        public bool CanPlace(Orientation orientation, int column, out int landingRow)
        {
            landingRow = -1;
            if (column < 0 || column + orientation.Width > Width)
            {
                return false;
            }

            int row = 0;
            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                int candidate = _columnHeights[column + cell.X] - cell.Y - 1;
                if (candidate > row)
                {
                    row = candidate;
                }
            }

            while (true)
            {
                if (Collides(orientation, column, row))
                {
                    if (row == 0)
                    {
                        return false;
                    }

                    landingRow = row - 1;
                    return !Collides(orientation, column, landingRow);
                }

                row++;
                if (row > Height)
                {
                    landingRow = row - 1;
                    return !Collides(orientation, column, landingRow);
                }
            }
        }

        public PlacementResult Place(Orientation orientation, int column, int row)
        {
            if (row < 0 || Collides(orientation, column, row))
            {
                return new PlacementResult(false, 0, false, 0, 0);
            }

            int wallContacts = 0;
            int supportContacts = 0;
            bool touchedFloor = false;

            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                int x = column + cell.X;
                int y = row + cell.Y;
                if (y < 0 || y >= Height)
                {
                    return new PlacementResult(false, 0, false, 0, 0);
                }

                _grid[y, x] = true;

                if (x == 0 || x == Width - 1)
                {
                    wallContacts++;
                }

                if (y == Height - 1)
                {
                    touchedFloor = true;
                }
                else if (y + 1 < Height && _grid[y + 1, x] && !ContainsCell(orientation, cell.X, cell.Y + 1))
                {
                    supportContacts++;
                }
            }

            RebuildColumnHeights();
            int cleared = ClearFullLines();
            ClearedLinesTotal += cleared;
            RebuildColumnHeights();
            return new PlacementResult(true, cleared, touchedFloor, wallContacts, supportContacts);
        }

        public void ApplyMove(char pieceType, Move move, bool updateState)
        {
            if (!updateState)
            {
                return;
            }

            var orientation = Pieces[pieceType].Orientations.First(o => o.Rotation == move.Rotation);
            if (CanPlace(orientation, move.Column, out int row))
            {
                Place(orientation, move.Column, row);
            }
        }

        public void ApplyExternalResult(string result)
        {
            if (result.StartsWith("cleared_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return;
            }
        }

        public BoardStats GetStats()
        {
            int aggregateHeight = 0;
            int maxHeight = 0;
            int bumpiness = 0;
            int holeCount = 0;
            int weightedHoles = 0;
            int coveredCells = 0;
            int rowTransitions = 0;
            int columnTransitions = 0;
            int wellDepth = 0;

            int[] heights = new int[Width];
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                heights[x] = _columnHeights[x];
                aggregateHeight += heights[x];
                if (heights[x] > maxHeight)
                {
                    maxHeight = heights[x];
                }
                if (x > 0)
                {
                    bumpiness += Math.Abs(heights[x] - heights[x - 1]);
                }
            }

            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                bool seenBlock = false;
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                {
                    if (_grid[y, x])
                    {
                        seenBlock = true;
                    }
                    else if (seenBlock)
                    {
                        holeCount++;
                        weightedHoles += Height - y;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
            {
                bool prevFilled = true;
                for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                {
                    bool filled = _grid[y, x];
                    if (filled != prevFilled)
                    {
                        rowTransitions++;
                    }
                    prevFilled = filled;
                    if (!filled)
                    {
                        bool leftFilled = x == 0 || _grid[y, x - 1];
                        bool rightFilled = x == Width - 1 || _grid[y, x + 1];
                        if (leftFilled && rightFilled)
                        {
                            int depth = 1;
                            for (int yy = y + 1; yy < Height && !_grid[yy, x]; yy++)
                            {
                                depth++;
                            }
                            wellDepth += depth;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!prevFilled)
                {
                    rowTransitions++;
                }
            }

            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                bool prevFilled = true;
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                {
                    bool filled = _grid[y, x];
                    if (filled != prevFilled)
                    {
                        columnTransitions++;
                    }
                    prevFilled = filled;
                    if (filled)
                    {
                        coveredCells += Height - y;
                    }
                }
                if (!prevFilled)
                {
                    columnTransitions++;
                }
            }

            return new BoardStats(
                aggregateHeight,
                maxHeight,
                holeCount,
                weightedHoles,
                bumpiness,
                wellDepth,
                rowTransitions,
                columnTransitions,
                coveredCells,
                ClearedLinesTotal);
        }

        private bool Collides(Orientation orientation, int column, int row)
        {
            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                int x = column + cell.X;
                int y = row + cell.Y;
                if (x < 0 || x >= Width || y >= Height)
                {
                    return true;
                }
                if (y >= 0 && _grid[y, x])
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        private int ClearFullLines()
        {
            int writeRow = Height - 1;
            int cleared = 0;

            for (int readRow = Height - 1; readRow >= 0; readRow--)
            {
                bool full = true;
                for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                {
                    if (!_grid[readRow, x])
                    {
                        full = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (full)
                {
                    cleared++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (writeRow != readRow)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                    {
                        _grid[writeRow, x] = _grid[readRow, x];
                    }
                }
                writeRow--;
            }

            for (int y = writeRow; y >= 0; y--)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                {
                    _grid[y, x] = false;
                }
            }

            return cleared;
        }

        private void RebuildColumnHeights()
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                int height = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                {
                    if (_grid[y, x])
                    {
                        height = Height - y;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                _columnHeights[x] = height;
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsCell(Orientation orientation, int x, int y)
        {
            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                if (cell.X == x && cell.Y == y)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    private sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly TextReader _reader;
        private readonly char[] _buffer = new char[1 << 16];
        private int _length;
        private int _index;

        public FastScanner(TextReader reader)
        {
            _reader = reader;
        }

        public string NextToken()
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            int ch;
            do
            {
                ch = Read();
                if (ch == -1)
                {
                    return string.Empty;
                }
            } while (char.IsWhiteSpace((char)ch));

            while (ch != -1 && !char.IsWhiteSpace((char)ch))
            {
                sb.Append((char)ch);
                ch = Read();
            }

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            string token = NextToken();
            return int.Parse(token);
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_index >= _length)
            {
                _length = _reader.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _index = 0;
                if (_length == 0)
                {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
            return _buffer[_index++];
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

public static class Program
{
    private const int LookaheadDepthSafe = 2;
    private const int LookaheadDepthDanger = 1;

    private static readonly Dictionary<char, PieceDefinition> Pieces = CreatePieces();

    public static void Main()
    {
        var scanner = new FastScanner(Console.In);
        int width = scanner.NextInt();
        int height = scanner.NextInt();
        int numPieces = scanner.NextInt();

        var game = new TetrisGame(width, height);

        for (int i = 0; i < numPieces; i++)
        {
            string token = scanner.NextToken();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
            {
                break;
            }

            char pieceType = token[0];
            Move move = ChooseMove(game, pieceType);
            Console.WriteLine($"{move.Rotation} {move.Column}");
            Console.Out.Flush();

            string result = scanner.NextToken();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result))
            {
                game.ApplyMove(pieceType, move, updateState: true);
                break;
            }

            game.ApplyMove(pieceType, move, updateState: true);
            game.ApplyExternalResult(result);

            if (result.Equals("gameover", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static Move ChooseMove(TetrisGame game, char pieceType)
    {
        var piece = Pieces[pieceType];
        var boardStats = game.GetStats();
        bool danger = boardStats.MaxHeight >= game.Height - 4 || boardStats.HoleCount > game.Width * 2;
        int depth = danger ? LookaheadDepthDanger : LookaheadDepthSafe;
        var weights = danger ? HeuristicWeights.Danger : (boardStats.MaxHeight < game.Height / 3 ? HeuristicWeights.Safe : HeuristicWeights.Normal);

        Move bestMove = default;
        double bestScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        bool found = false;

        foreach (var orientation in piece.Orientations)
        {
            int maxColumn = game.Width - orientation.Width;
            for (int col = 0; col <= maxColumn; col++)
            {
                if (!game.CanPlace(orientation, col, out int landingRow))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var sim = game.Clone();
                var placement = sim.Place(orientation, col, landingRow);
                if (!placement.Success)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                double score = EvaluateState(sim, weights, placement, depth - 1);
                score += placement.LinesCleared * placement.LinesCleared * 15.0;
                score += placement.TouchedFloor ? 1.2 : 0.0;
                score += placement.WallContacts * 0.15;
                score += placement.SupportContacts * 0.20;

                if (!found || score > bestScore)
                {
                    found = true;
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestMove = new Move(orientation.Rotation, col);
                }
            }
        }

        if (found)
        {
            return bestMove;
        }

        return new Move(0, 0);
    }

    private static double EvaluateState(TetrisGame game, HeuristicWeights weights, PlacementResult placement, int lookaheadDepth)
    {
        var stats = game.GetStats();

        double score = 0.0;
        score += stats.AggregateHeight * weights.AggregateHeight;
        score += stats.MaxHeight * weights.MaxHeight;
        score += stats.HoleCount * weights.Holes;
        score += stats.WeightedHoles * weights.WeightedHoles;
        score += stats.Bumpiness * weights.Bumpiness;
        score += stats.WellDepth * weights.Wells;
        score += stats.RowTransitions * weights.RowTransitions;
        score += stats.ColumnTransitions * weights.ColumnTransitions;
        score += stats.CoveredCells * weights.CoveredCells;
        score += stats.ClearedLinesTotal * weights.ClearedLines;
        score += placement.LinesCleared * weights.ImmediateLineClear;

        if (lookaheadDepth > 0)
        {
            double future = 0.0;
            int count = 0;
            foreach (char nextPiece in TetrisGame.PieceOrder)
            {
                future += EstimateBestFuture(game, nextPiece, weights, lookaheadDepth);
                count++;
            }

            if (count > 0)
            {
                score += (future / count) * weights.LookaheadFactor;
            }
        }

        return score;
    }

    private static double EstimateBestFuture(TetrisGame game, char pieceType, HeuristicWeights weights, int lookaheadDepth)
    {
        var piece = Pieces[pieceType];
        double bestScore = double.NegativeInfinity;
        bool found = false;

        foreach (var orientation in piece.Orientations)
        {
            int maxColumn = game.Width - orientation.Width;
            for (int col = 0; col <= maxColumn; col++)
            {
                if (!game.CanPlace(orientation, col, out int landingRow))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var sim = game.Clone();
                var placement = sim.Place(orientation, col, landingRow);
                if (!placement.Success)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                double score = EvaluateState(sim, weights, placement, lookaheadDepth - 1);
                if (!found || score > bestScore)
                {
                    found = true;
                    bestScore = score;
                }
            }
        }

        return found ? bestScore : -1_000_000.0;
    }

        int AggregateHeight,
        int MaxHeight,
        int HoleCount,
        int WeightedHoles,
        int Bumpiness,
        int WellDepth,
        int RowTransitions,
        int ColumnTransitions,
        int CoveredCells,
        int ClearedLinesTotal);

    private sealed class TetrisGame
    {
        public static readonly char[] PieceOrder = { 'I', 'O', 'T', 'S', 'Z', 'J', 'L' };

        private readonly bool[,] _grid;
        private readonly int[] _columnHeights;

        public TetrisGame(int width, int height)
        {
            Width = width;
            Height = height;
            _grid = new bool[height, width];
            _columnHeights = new int[width];
        }

        private TetrisGame(int width, int height, bool[,] grid, int[] columnHeights, int clearedLinesTotal)
        {
            Width = width;
            Height = height;
            _grid = grid;
            _columnHeights = columnHeights;
            ClearedLinesTotal = clearedLinesTotal;
        }

        public int Width { get; }
        public int Height { get; }
        public int ClearedLinesTotal { get; private set; }

        public TetrisGame Clone()
        {
            return new TetrisGame(Width, Height, (bool[,])_grid.Clone(), (int[])_columnHeights.Clone(), ClearedLinesTotal);
        }

        public bool CanPlace(Orientation orientation, int column, out int landingRow)
        {
            landingRow = -1;
            if (column < 0 || column + orientation.Width > Width)
            {
                return false;
            }

            int row = 0;
            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                int candidate = _columnHeights[column + cell.X] - cell.Y - 1;
                if (candidate > row)
                {
                    row = candidate;
                }
            }

            while (true)
            {
                if (Collides(orientation, column, row))
                {
                    if (row == 0)
                    {
                        return false;
                    }

                    landingRow = row - 1;
                    return !Collides(orientation, column, landingRow);
                }

                row++;
                if (row > Height)
                {
                    landingRow = row - 1;
                    return !Collides(orientation, column, landingRow);
                }
            }
        }

        public PlacementResult Place(Orientation orientation, int column, int row)
        {
            if (row < 0 || Collides(orientation, column, row))
            {
                return new PlacementResult(false, 0, false, 0, 0);
            }

            int wallContacts = 0;
            int supportContacts = 0;
            bool touchedFloor = false;

            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                int x = column + cell.X;
                int y = row + cell.Y;
                if (y < 0 || y >= Height)
                {
                    return new PlacementResult(false, 0, false, 0, 0);
                }

                _grid[y, x] = true;

                if (x == 0 || x == Width - 1)
                {
                    wallContacts++;
                }

                if (y == Height - 1)
                {
                    touchedFloor = true;
                }
                else if (y + 1 < Height && _grid[y + 1, x] && !ContainsCell(orientation, cell.X, cell.Y + 1))
                {
                    supportContacts++;
                }
            }

            RebuildColumnHeights();
            int cleared = ClearFullLines();
            ClearedLinesTotal += cleared;
            RebuildColumnHeights();
            return new PlacementResult(true, cleared, touchedFloor, wallContacts, supportContacts);
        }

        public void ApplyMove(char pieceType, Move move, bool updateState)
        {
            if (!updateState)
            {
                return;
            }

            var orientation = Pieces[pieceType].Orientations.First(o => o.Rotation == move.Rotation);
            if (CanPlace(orientation, move.Column, out int row))
            {
                Place(orientation, move.Column, row);
            }
        }

        public void ApplyExternalResult(string result)
        {
            if (result.StartsWith("cleared_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return;
            }
        }

        public BoardStats GetStats()
        {
            int aggregateHeight = 0;
            int maxHeight = 0;
            int bumpiness = 0;
            int holeCount = 0;
            int weightedHoles = 0;
            int coveredCells = 0;
            int rowTransitions = 0;
            int columnTransitions = 0;
            int wellDepth = 0;

            int[] heights = new int[Width];
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                heights[x] = _columnHeights[x];
                aggregateHeight += heights[x];
                if (heights[x] > maxHeight)
                {
                    maxHeight = heights[x];
                }
                if (x > 0)
                {
                    bumpiness += Math.Abs(heights[x] - heights[x - 1]);
                }
            }

            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                bool seenBlock = false;
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                {
                    if (_grid[y, x])
                    {
                        seenBlock = true;
                    }
                    else if (seenBlock)
                    {
                        holeCount++;
                        weightedHoles += Height - y;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
            {
                bool prevFilled = true;
                for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                {
                    bool filled = _grid[y, x];
                    if (filled != prevFilled)
                    {
                        rowTransitions++;
                    }
                    prevFilled = filled;
                    if (!filled)
                    {
                        bool leftFilled = x == 0 || _grid[y, x - 1];
                        bool rightFilled = x == Width - 1 || _grid[y, x + 1];
                        if (leftFilled && rightFilled)
                        {
                            int depth = 1;
                            for (int yy = y + 1; yy < Height && !_grid[yy, x]; yy++)
                            {
                                depth++;
                            }
                            wellDepth += depth;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!prevFilled)
                {
                    rowTransitions++;
                }
            }

            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                bool prevFilled = true;
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                {
                    bool filled = _grid[y, x];
                    if (filled != prevFilled)
                    {
                        columnTransitions++;
                    }
                    prevFilled = filled;
                    if (filled)
                    {
                        coveredCells += Height - y;
                    }
                }
                if (!prevFilled)
                {
                    columnTransitions++;
                }
            }

            return new BoardStats(
                aggregateHeight,
                maxHeight,
                holeCount,
                weightedHoles,
                bumpiness,
                wellDepth,
                rowTransitions,
                columnTransitions,
                coveredCells,
                ClearedLinesTotal);
        }

        private bool Collides(Orientation orientation, int column, int row)
        {
            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                int x = column + cell.X;
                int y = row + cell.Y;
                if (x < 0 || x >= Width || y >= Height)
                {
                    return true;
                }
                if (y >= 0 && _grid[y, x])
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        private int ClearFullLines()
        {
            int writeRow = Height - 1;
            int cleared = 0;

            for (int readRow = Height - 1; readRow >= 0; readRow--)
            {
                bool full = true;
                for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                {
                    if (!_grid[readRow, x])
                    {
                        full = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (full)
                {
                    cleared++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (writeRow != readRow)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                    {
                        _grid[writeRow, x] = _grid[readRow, x];
                    }
                }
                writeRow--;
            }

            for (int y = writeRow; y >= 0; y--)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
                {
                    _grid[y, x] = false;
                }
            }

            return cleared;
        }

        private void RebuildColumnHeights()
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < Width; x++)
            {
                int height = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < Height; y++)
                {
                    if (_grid[y, x])
                    {
                        height = Height - y;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                _columnHeights[x] = height;
            }
        }

        private static bool ContainsCell(Orientation orientation, int x, int y)
        {
            foreach (var cell in orientation.Cells)
            {
                if (cell.X == x && cell.Y == y)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    private sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly TextReader _reader;
        private readonly char[] _buffer = new char[1 << 16];
        private int _length;
        private int _index;

        public FastScanner(TextReader reader)
        {
            _reader = reader;
        }

        public string NextToken()
        {
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            int ch;
            do
            {
                ch = Read();
                if (ch == -1)
                {
                    return string.Empty;
                }
            } while (char.IsWhiteSpace((char)ch));

            while (ch != -1 && !char.IsWhiteSpace((char)ch))
            {
                sb.Append((char)ch);
                ch = Read();
            }

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            string token = NextToken();
            return int.Parse(token);
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_index >= _length)
            {
                _length = _reader.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _index = 0;
                if (_length == 0)
                {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
            return _buffer[_index++];
        }
    }
}

You are writing Rust code to play Lunar Lander in real-time.

Your Rust lunar lander controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from simple
training environments to very complex landing sites.

Control a lunar lander to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a 2D voxel map and continuous state updates, and must output thrust/turn
commands to land safely on the target.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time. If your code
doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the io buffer fills up, the ship will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes that
async code doesn't have. Multithreaded / asyncio code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Physics:**
- Gravity pulls lander down constantly
- Thrust applies force in lander's facing direction
- Fuel is limited
- Must land softly on target (low velocity)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal numbers):**
Initial map:
```
width height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y target_x target_y
map rows (. = empty, # = obstacle, S = start, T = target, L = landing zone)
```

Then you recieve continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds):
```
x y vx vy angle angular_vel fuel_remaining
```
x and y are in meters, from the worlds top left, and y increases downward.
vx and vy are in m/s.
angle is in radians, 0 is facing up.
angular_vel is in radians per second. + is clockwise, - is counterclockwise.
fuel_remaining is seconds at max_thrust.

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following instructions at a frequency of at least 20hz:
```
thrust turn
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max thrust)
- turn: -1.0 to 1.0 (turning rate, negative = left, positive = right)

To be crystal clear: that's two decimal numbers seperated by a space, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (so it misses 2 consecutive updates), the engine
will automatically cut power. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

Map size can vary from 100x50 to multi-gb maps, so be efficient with memory and processing.

Thrust and gravity are in m/s/s. 100% engine burn burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

Lander size is approximatly 1x1m, and the 2D map grid size is 1m x 1m.

Turn is in radians per second. The lander can not rotate fully around and will clamp rotation to
facing down if attempted.

Y increases downward. Positive vy means moving downward. Gravity is +g.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 2m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries
- Complete landing within time limit

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into obstacle or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed time limit

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to play a 3D Lunar Lander game in real-time.

Your C++ controller will be tested with scenarios ranging from tiny (100m) to huge (100km).
The same code must work for all scales.

Control a lunar lander in full 3D space to safely land on a target pad.
The program receives a terrain file path and continuous state updates via stdin, and must
output thrust/rotation commands to stdout in real-time.

Data is streamed to stdin in real time, and you must write to stdout in real time.
If your code doesn't read from stdin fast enough and the IO buffer fills up, the ship
will likely crash.

Be very careful if writing single threaded / blocking code, this has many failure modes
that async code doesn't have. Multithreaded code is HIGHLY recommended.

**Coordinate System:**
- X: horizontal (East), Y: horizontal (North), Z: UP.
- Gravity acts in the -Z direction.
- All positions are in meters. Velocities in m/s. Angles in radians.

**Physics:**
- Gravity = 1.62 m/s² (lunar) in -Z direction.
- Thrust is along the lander's local "up" axis. When pitch=0 and yaw=0, thrust is
straight up (+Z). Tilting via pitch/yaw redirects thrust.
- Pitch: tilts the lander. +pitch tilts forward, redirecting thrust partially into -X.
Pitch is clamped to [-pi/2, pi/2].
- Yaw: rotates heading around Z.
- Roll: rolls around the thrust axis (cosmetic only, does not affect thrust direction).
- Rotation dynamics: commands apply angular acceleration (2 rad/s² per unit).
Angular rates are damped by 0.95 per tick.
- Fuel: 100% thrust burns 1 unit of fuel per second.

**Input format (stdin):**
Initial header (whitespace separated decimal numbers, except terrain path):
```
width depth height gravity max_thrust fuel
start_x start_y start_z target_x target_y target_z
terrain_file_path
STATE
```

The terrain_file_path is on its own line (the path may contain spaces).
Read the entire line with getline() or equivalent.

**Terrain file format (binary):**
The terrain file defines the 3D world as a binary file. It is a sequence of
uint16_t triplets (little-endian), one per (x, y) cell, stored in row-major order:

```cpp
for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
for (int y = 0; y < depth; y++) {
uint16_t a = read_uint16_le(); // ground rock top
uint16_t b = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock bottom
uint16_t c = read_uint16_le(); // floating rock top
}
}
```

For each column (x, y), the vertical structure is:
- z < a: SOLID ROCK (ground)
- a <= z < b: OPEN AIR
- b <= z < c: SOLID ROCK (floating terrain feature, overhang, arch, etc.)
- c <= z: OPEN AIR

If b == c, there is no floating rock in that column (just ground + open sky).
The file size is exactly width * depth * 6 bytes.

You have a startup grace period to parse this file before state updates begin.
The grace period is 5 seconds plus 10 seconds per gigabyte of terrain file.
For a 100x100 map this is ~5s. For a 100000x10000 map (~6GB) this is ~65s.
You may continue parsing in a background thread after the simulation begins,
but you MUST be reading stdin and writing stdout by then to avoid a crash.

Then continuous state updates (every 0.1 seconds, whitespace separated):
```
x y z vx vy vz pitch yaw roll pitch_rate yaw_rate roll_rate fuel_remaining
```

**Output format (stdout):**
Your code needs to output the following at a frequency of at least 10hz:
```
thrust pitch_cmd yaw_cmd roll_cmd
```
- thrust: 0.0 to 1.0 (fraction of max_thrust)
- pitch_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (pitch angular acceleration command)
- yaw_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (yaw angular acceleration command)
- roll_cmd: -1.0 to 1.0 (roll angular acceleration command)

To be crystal clear: four decimal numbers separated by spaces, followed by a newline.

If your code stalls / freezes for 100ms or more (misses 2 consecutive updates), the
engine will cut thrust automatically. A long freeze and eventually the lander will crash.

**Landing:**
- The target is at (target_x, target_y, target_z) which is just above the terrain.
- You must land within a small radius of the target with total speed < 3 m/s.
- Landing zone radius is approximately max(5, min(width,depth)*0.02) meters.

**Terrain collisions:**
- You collide if you enter any solid cell as defined by the terrain file.
- Out of bounds (x<0, x>=width, y<0, y>=depth, z<0, z>=height) is also a collision.

**Success Conditions:**
- Land on target with |velocity| < 3 m/s
- Stay within landing zone boundaries

**Failure Conditions:**
- Crash into terrain or ground too hard
- Run out of fuel
- Exceed simulation time limit

Architecture: AMD64
CPU: AMD64 Family 23 Model 8 Stepping 2, AuthenticAMD

Memory: 127.87 GB
SIMD: AVX, AVX2, SSE, SSE2, SSE3, SSE4.1, SSE4.2, SSSE3

namespace {

constexpr double kPi = 3.14159265358979323846;
constexpr double kGravity = 1.62;
constexpr double kTick = 0.1;

struct Vec3 {
    double x = 0.0;
    double y = 0.0;
    double z = 0.0;

    Vec3& operator+=(const Vec3& other) {
        x += other.x;
        y += other.y;
        z += other.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vec3& operator-=(const Vec3& other) {
        x -= other.x;
        y -= other.y;
        z -= other.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vec3& operator*=(double s) {
        x *= s;
        y *= s;
        z *= s;
        return *this;
    }
};

Vec3 operator+(Vec3 a, const Vec3& b) { return a += b; }
Vec3 operator-(Vec3 a, const Vec3& b) { return a -= b; }
Vec3 operator*(Vec3 a, double s) { return a *= s; }
Vec3 operator*(double s, Vec3 a) { return a *= s; }
Vec3 operator/(Vec3 a, double s) {
    a.x /= s;
    a.y /= s;
    a.z /= s;
    return a;
}

double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

double norm_sq(const Vec3& v) {
    return dot(v, v);
}

double norm(const Vec3& v) {
    return std::sqrt(norm_sq(v));
}

Vec3 normalized(const Vec3& v) {
    const double n = norm(v);
    if (n < 1e-9) {
        return {};
    }
    return v / n;
}

double clamp(double v, double lo, double hi) {
    return std::max(lo, std::min(hi, v));
}

double wrap_angle(double a) {
    while (a > kPi) {
        a -= 2.0 * kPi;
    }
    while (a < -kPi) {
        a += 2.0 * kPi;
    }
    return a;
}

struct Header {
    int width = 0;
    int depth = 0;
    int height = 0;
    double gravity = kGravity;
    double max_thrust = 0.0;
    double fuel = 0.0;
    Vec3 start;
    Vec3 target;
    std::string terrain_path;
};

struct State {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
    double pitch = 0.0;
    double yaw = 0.0;
    double roll = 0.0;
    double pitch_rate = 0.0;
    double yaw_rate = 0.0;
    double roll_rate = 0.0;
    double fuel_remaining = 0.0;
    bool valid = false;
};

struct Command {
    double thrust = 0.0;
    double pitch_cmd = 0.0;
    double yaw_cmd = 0.0;
    double roll_cmd = 0.0;
};

struct TerrainColumn {
    uint16_t ground_top = 0;
    uint16_t float_bottom = 0;
    uint16_t float_top = 0;
};

class TerrainMap {
public:
    explicit TerrainMap(const Header& header)
        : width_(header.width), depth_(header.depth), height_(header.height),
          target_(header.target), loaded_(false), done_(false) {}

    void load_async(const std::string& path) {
        worker_ = std::thread([this, path]() { load(path); });
    }

    ~TerrainMap() {
        if (worker_.joinable()) {
            worker_.join();
        }
    }

    bool fully_loaded() const {
        return done_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    double target_ground() const {
        return target_ground_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    double clearance_estimate(double x, double y, double z) const {
        if (!loaded_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            return z;
        }
        const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
        const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
        if (ix < 0 || ix >= width_ || iy < 0 || iy >= depth_) {
            return -1.0;
        }
        const auto& c = cells_[index(ix, iy)];
        if (z < c.ground_top) {
            return -1.0;
        }
        double clearance = z - c.ground_top;
        if (c.float_bottom < c.float_top && z >= c.float_bottom && z < c.float_top) {
            return -1.0;
        }
        if (c.float_bottom < c.float_top && z < c.float_bottom) {
            clearance = std::min(clearance, c.float_bottom - z);
        }
        return clearance;
    }

    double sample_ground(double x, double y) const {
        if (!loaded_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
        const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
        if (ix < 0 || ix >= width_ || iy < 0 || iy >= depth_) {
            return static_cast<double>(height_);
        }
        return cells_[index(ix, iy)].ground_top;
    }

private:
    size_t index(int x, int y) const {
        return static_cast<size_t>(x) * static_cast<size_t>(depth_) + static_cast<size_t>(y);
    }

    static uint16_t read_u16(std::ifstream& in) {
        unsigned char bytes[2] = {0, 0};
        in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes), 2);
        return static_cast<uint16_t>(bytes[0] | (static_cast<uint16_t>(bytes[1]) << 8));
    }

    void load(const std::string& path) {
        std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!in) {
            done_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            return;
        }

        cells_.resize(static_cast<size_t>(width_) * static_cast<size_t>(depth_));
        double local_target_ground = 0.0;
        const int tx = static_cast<int>(std::floor(target_.x));
        const int ty = static_cast<int>(std::floor(target_.y));

        for (int x = 0; x < width_; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < depth_; ++y) {
                TerrainColumn c;
                c.ground_top = read_u16(in);
                c.float_bottom = read_u16(in);
                c.float_top = read_u16(in);
                cells_[index(x, y)] = c;
                if (x == tx && y == ty) {
                    local_target_ground = static_cast<double>(c.ground_top);
                }
            }
            if (x % 64 == 0) {
                loaded_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        }
        target_ground_.store(local_target_ground, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        loaded_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        done_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    int width_;
    int depth_;
    int height_;
    Vec3 target_;
    std::vector<TerrainColumn> cells_;
    std::thread worker_;
    std::atomic<bool> loaded_;
    std::atomic<bool> done_;
    std::atomic<double> target_ground_{0.0};
};

class StateQueue {
public:
    void push(const State& s) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            latest_ = s;
            has_state_ = true;
        }
        cv_.notify_one();
    }

    bool wait_and_pop_latest(State& out) {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        cv_.wait(lock, [&] { return has_state_ || closed_; });
        if (!has_state_) {
            return false;
        }
        out = latest_;
        has_state_ = false;
        return true;
    }

    void close() {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            closed_ = true;
        }
        cv_.notify_all();
    }

private:
    std::mutex mutex_;
    std::condition_variable cv_;
    State latest_;
    bool has_state_ = false;
    bool closed_ = false;
};

class Controller {
public:
    Controller(const Header& header, const TerrainMap* terrain)
        : header_(header), terrain_(terrain) {
        landing_radius_ = std::max(5.0, std::min(header.width, header.depth) * 0.02);
    }

    Command step(const State& s) {
        const Vec3 to_target = header_.target - s.pos;
        const double horiz_dist = std::hypot(to_target.x, to_target.y);
        const double speed = norm(s.vel);
        const double target_ground = terrain_ ? terrain_->target_ground() : 0.0;
        const double altitude_agl = s.pos.z - std::max(target_ground, terrain_ ? terrain_->sample_ground(s.pos.x, s.pos.y) : 0.0);

        double approach_speed = clamp(horiz_dist * 0.12, 0.0, 40.0);
        if (altitude_agl < 120.0) {
            approach_speed = clamp(horiz_dist * 0.08, 0.0, 16.0);
        }
        if (horiz_dist < landing_radius_ * 3.0) {
            approach_speed = clamp(horiz_dist * 0.15, 0.0, 4.0);
        }

        Vec3 desired_hvel{};
        if (horiz_dist > 1e-6) {
            desired_hvel.x = to_target.x / horiz_dist * approach_speed;
            desired_hvel.y = to_target.y / horiz_dist * approach_speed;
        }

        const double safe_descent = compute_safe_descent(altitude_agl, horiz_dist, speed);
        const Vec3 vel_error{
            desired_hvel.x - s.vel.x,
            desired_hvel.y - s.vel.y,
            (-safe_descent) - s.vel.z
        };

        Vec3 desired_accel{
            clamp(vel_error.x * 0.9, -8.0, 8.0),
            clamp(vel_error.y * 0.9, -8.0, 8.0),
            clamp(vel_error.z * 1.2, -8.0, 8.0) + header_.gravity
        };

        const double clearance = terrain_ ? terrain_->clearance_estimate(s.pos.x, s.pos.y, s.pos.z) : altitude_agl;
        if (clearance >= 0.0 && clearance < std::max(12.0, speed * 1.5)) {
            desired_accel.z = std::max(desired_accel.z, header_.gravity + 3.5);
            desired_accel.x *= 0.4;
            desired_accel.y *= 0.4;
        }

        const double accel_norm = norm(desired_accel);
        Vec3 thrust_dir = accel_norm > 1e-6 ? desired_accel / accel_norm : Vec3{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
        if (thrust_dir.z < 0.15) {
            thrust_dir.z = 0.15;
            thrust_dir = normalized(thrust_dir);
        }

        double thrust = accel_norm / std::max(header_.max_thrust, 1e-6);
        thrust = clamp(thrust, 0.0, 1.0);
        if (s.fuel_remaining < 5.0 && altitude_agl > 20.0) {
            thrust = clamp(thrust, 0.0, 0.85);
        }

        const double target_pitch = std::asin(clamp(-thrust_dir.x, -1.0, 1.0));
        const double target_yaw = std::atan2(thrust_dir.y, thrust_dir.z);
        const double pitch_cmd = attitude_pd(target_pitch, s.pitch, s.pitch_rate);
        const double yaw_cmd = attitude_pd(target_yaw, s.yaw, s.yaw_rate);
        const double roll_cmd = attitude_pd(0.0, s.roll, s.roll_rate);

        return Command{thrust, pitch_cmd, yaw_cmd, roll_cmd};
    }

private:
    double attitude_pd(double target, double angle, double rate) const {
        const double err = wrap_angle(target - angle);
        return clamp(err * 1.8 - rate * 0.7, -1.0, 1.0);
    }

    double compute_safe_descent(double altitude_agl, double horiz_dist, double speed) const {
        double descent = 2.0;
        if (altitude_agl > 2000.0) {
            descent = 35.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 800.0) {
            descent = 24.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 250.0) {
            descent = 14.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 80.0) {
            descent = 8.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 25.0) {
            descent = 4.5;
        } else {
            descent = 1.6;
        }

        if (horiz_dist < landing_radius_ * 4.0) {
            descent = std::min(descent, 3.0);
        }
        if (horiz_dist < landing_radius_ * 1.5) {
            descent = std::min(descent, 1.8);
        }
        if (speed > 35.0 && altitude_agl < 120.0) {
            descent = std::min(descent, 2.0);
        }
        return descent;
    }

    Header header_;
    const TerrainMap* terrain_;
    double landing_radius_ = 5.0;
};

bool read_header(Header& h) {
    if (!(std::cin >> h.width >> h.depth >> h.height >> h.gravity >> h.max_thrust >> h.fuel)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!(std::cin >> h.start.x >> h.start.y >> h.start.z >> h.target.x >> h.target.y >> h.target.z)) {
        return false;
    }
    std::string path_line;
    std::getline(std::cin, path_line);
    std::getline(std::cin, h.terrain_path);
    if (!h.terrain_path.empty() && h.terrain_path.back() == '\r') {
        h.terrain_path.pop_back();
    }
    std::string state_token;
    std::cin >> state_token;
    return true;
}

std::optional<State> parse_state_line(const std::string& line) {
    State s;
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    if (!(iss >> s.pos.x >> s.pos.y >> s.pos.z
              >> s.vel.x >> s.vel.y >> s.vel.z
              >> s.pitch >> s.yaw >> s.roll
              >> s.pitch_rate >> s.yaw_rate >> s.roll_rate
              >> s.fuel_remaining)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    s.valid = true;
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    Header header;
    if (!read_header(header)) {
        return 0;
    }

    TerrainMap terrain(header);
    terrain.load_async(header.terrain_path);

    StateQueue queue;
    std::atomic<bool> done{false};

    std::thread reader([&]() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
        while (!done.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
            if (line.empty()) {
                continue;
            }
            auto s = parse_state_line(line);
            if (s) {
                queue.push(*s);
            }
        }
        queue.close();
    });

    Controller controller(header, &terrain);
    State state;

    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(6);
    while (queue.wait_and_pop_latest(state)) {
        Command cmd = controller.step(state);
        std::cout << cmd.thrust << ' '
                  << cmd.pitch_cmd << ' '
                  << cmd.yaw_cmd << ' '
                  << cmd.roll_cmd << '\n';
        std::cout.flush();
    }

    done.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (reader.joinable()) {
        reader.join();
    }
    return 0;
}

namespace {

constexpr double kPi = 3.14159265358979323846;
constexpr double kGravity = 1.62;
constexpr double kTick = 0.1;

struct Vec3 {
    double x = 0.0;
    double y = 0.0;
    double z = 0.0;

    Vec3& operator+=(const Vec3& other) {
        x += other.x;
        y += other.y;
        z += other.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vec3& operator-=(const Vec3& other) {
        x -= other.x;
        y -= other.y;
        z -= other.z;
        return *this;
    }

    Vec3& operator*=(double s) {
        x *= s;
        y *= s;
        z *= s;
        return *this;
    }
};

Vec3 operator+(Vec3 a, const Vec3& b) { return a += b; }
Vec3 operator-(Vec3 a, const Vec3& b) { return a -= b; }
Vec3 operator*(Vec3 a, double s) { return a *= s; }
Vec3 operator*(double s, Vec3 a) { return a *= s; }
Vec3 operator/(Vec3 a, double s) {
    a.x /= s;
    a.y /= s;
    a.z /= s;
    return a;
}

double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

double norm_sq(const Vec3& v) {
    return dot(v, v);
}

double norm(const Vec3& v) {
    return std::sqrt(norm_sq(v));
}

Vec3 normalized(const Vec3& v) {
    const double n = norm(v);
    if (n < 1e-9) {
        return {};
    }
    return v / n;
}

double clamp(double v, double lo, double hi) {
    return std::max(lo, std::min(hi, v));
}

double wrap_angle(double a) {
    while (a > kPi) {
        a -= 2.0 * kPi;
    }
    while (a < -kPi) {
        a += 2.0 * kPi;
    }
    return a;
}

struct Header {
    int width = 0;
    int depth = 0;
    int height = 0;
    double gravity = kGravity;
    double max_thrust = 0.0;
    double fuel = 0.0;
    Vec3 start;
    Vec3 target;
    std::string terrain_path;
};

struct State {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
    double pitch = 0.0;
    double yaw = 0.0;
    double roll = 0.0;
    double pitch_rate = 0.0;
    double yaw_rate = 0.0;
    double roll_rate = 0.0;

};

struct Command {
    double thrust = 0.0;
    double pitch_cmd = 0.0;
    double yaw_cmd = 0.0;
    double roll_cmd = 0.0;
};

struct TerrainColumn {
    uint16_t ground_top = 0;
    uint16_t float_bottom = 0;
    uint16_t float_top = 0;
};

class TerrainMap {
public:
    explicit TerrainMap(const Header& header)
        : width_(header.width), depth_(header.depth), height_(header.height),
          target_(header.target), loaded_(false), done_(false) {}

    void load_async(const std::string& path) {
        worker_ = std::thread([this, path]() { load(path); });
    }

    ~TerrainMap() {
        if (worker_.joinable()) {
            worker_.join();
        }
    }

    bool fully_loaded() const {
        return done_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    double target_ground() const {
        return target_ground_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    double clearance_estimate(double x, double y, double z) const {
        if (!loaded_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            return z;
        }
        const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
        const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
        if (ix < 0 || ix >= width_ || iy < 0 || iy >= depth_) {
            return -1.0;
        }
        const auto& c = cells_[index(ix, iy)];
        if (z < c.ground_top) {
            return -1.0;
        }
        double clearance = z - c.ground_top;
        if (c.float_bottom < c.float_top && z >= c.float_bottom && z < c.float_top) {
            return -1.0;
        }
        if (c.float_bottom < c.float_top && z < c.float_bottom) {
            clearance = std::min(clearance, c.float_bottom - z);
        }
        return clearance;
    }

    double sample_ground(double x, double y) const {
        if (!loaded_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            return 0.0;
        }
        const int ix = static_cast<int>(std::floor(x));
        const int iy = static_cast<int>(std::floor(y));
        if (ix < 0 || ix >= width_ || iy < 0 || iy >= depth_) {
            return static_cast<double>(height_);
        }
        return cells_[index(ix, iy)].ground_top;
    }

private:
    size_t index(int x, int y) const {
        return static_cast<size_t>(x) * static_cast<size_t>(depth_) + static_cast<size_t>(y);
    }

    static uint16_t read_u16(std::ifstream& in) {
        unsigned char bytes[2] = {0, 0};
        in.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes), 2);
        return static_cast<uint16_t>(bytes[0] | (static_cast<uint16_t>(bytes[1]) << 8));
    }

    void load(const std::string& path) {
        std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
        if (!in) {
            done_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            return;
        }

        cells_.resize(static_cast<size_t>(width_) * static_cast<size_t>(depth_));
        double local_target_ground = 0.0;
        const int tx = static_cast<int>(std::floor(target_.x));
        const int ty = static_cast<int>(std::floor(target_.y));

        for (int x = 0; x < width_; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < depth_; ++y) {
                TerrainColumn c;
                c.ground_top = read_u16(in);
                c.float_bottom = read_u16(in);
                c.float_top = read_u16(in);
                cells_[index(x, y)] = c;
                if (x == tx && y == ty) {
                    local_target_ground = static_cast<double>(c.ground_top);
                }
            }
            if (x % 64 == 0) {
                loaded_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        }
        target_ground_.store(local_target_ground, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        loaded_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        done_.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    int width_;
    int depth_;
    int height_;
    Vec3 target_;
    std::vector<TerrainColumn> cells_;
    std::thread worker_;
    std::atomic<bool> loaded_;
    std::atomic<bool> done_;
    std::atomic<double> target_ground_{0.0};
};

class StateQueue {
public:
    void push(const State& s) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            latest_ = s;
            has_state_ = true;
        }
        cv_.notify_one();
    }

    bool wait_and_pop_latest(State& out) {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        cv_.wait(lock, [&] { return has_state_ || closed_; });
        if (!has_state_) {
            return false;
        }
        out = latest_;
        has_state_ = false;
        return true;
    }

    void close() {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            closed_ = true;
        }
        cv_.notify_all();
    }

private:
    std::mutex mutex_;
    std::condition_variable cv_;
    State latest_;
    bool has_state_ = false;
    bool closed_ = false;
};

class Controller {
public:
    Controller(const Header& header, const TerrainMap* terrain)
        : header_(header), terrain_(terrain) {
        landing_radius_ = std::max(5.0, std::min(header.width, header.depth) * 0.02);
    }

    Command step(const State& s) {
        const Vec3 to_target = header_.target - s.pos;
        const double horiz_dist = std::hypot(to_target.x, to_target.y);
        const double speed = norm(s.vel);
        const double target_ground = terrain_ ? terrain_->target_ground() : 0.0;
        const double altitude_agl = s.pos.z - std::max(target_ground, terrain_ ? terrain_->sample_ground(s.pos.x, s.pos.y) : 0.0);

        double approach_speed = clamp(horiz_dist * 0.12, 0.0, 40.0);
        if (altitude_agl < 120.0) {
            approach_speed = clamp(horiz_dist * 0.08, 0.0, 16.0);
        }
        if (horiz_dist < landing_radius_ * 3.0) {
            approach_speed = clamp(horiz_dist * 0.15, 0.0, 4.0);
        }

        Vec3 desired_hvel{};
        if (horiz_dist > 1e-6) {
            desired_hvel.x = to_target.x / horiz_dist * approach_speed;
            desired_hvel.y = to_target.y / horiz_dist * approach_speed;
        }

        const double safe_descent = compute_safe_descent(altitude_agl, horiz_dist, speed);
        const Vec3 vel_error{
            desired_hvel.x - s.vel.x,
            desired_hvel.y - s.vel.y,
            (-safe_descent) - s.vel.z
        };

        Vec3 desired_accel{
            clamp(vel_error.x * 0.9, -8.0, 8.0),
            clamp(vel_error.y * 0.9, -8.0, 8.0),
            clamp(vel_error.z * 1.2, -8.0, 8.0) + header_.gravity
        };

        const double clearance = terrain_ ? terrain_->clearance_estimate(s.pos.x, s.pos.y, s.pos.z) : altitude_agl;
        if (clearance >= 0.0 && clearance < std::max(12.0, speed * 1.5)) {
            desired_accel.z = std::max(desired_accel.z, header_.gravity + 3.5);
            desired_accel.x *= 0.4;
            desired_accel.y *= 0.4;
        }

        const double accel_norm = norm(desired_accel);
        Vec3 thrust_dir = accel_norm > 1e-6 ? desired_accel / accel_norm : Vec3{0.0, 0.0, 1.0};
        if (thrust_dir.z < 0.15) {
            thrust_dir.z = 0.15;
            thrust_dir = normalized(thrust_dir);
        }

        double thrust = accel_norm / std::max(header_.max_thrust, 1e-6);
        thrust = clamp(thrust, 0.0, 1.0);
        if (s.fuel_remaining < 5.0 && altitude_agl > 20.0) {
            thrust = clamp(thrust, 0.0, 0.85);
        }

        const double target_pitch = std::asin(clamp(-thrust_dir.x, -1.0, 1.0));
        const double target_yaw = std::atan2(thrust_dir.y, thrust_dir.z);
        const double pitch_cmd = attitude_pd(target_pitch, s.pitch, s.pitch_rate);
        const double yaw_cmd = attitude_pd(target_yaw, s.yaw, s.yaw_rate);
        const double roll_cmd = attitude_pd(0.0, s.roll, s.roll_rate);

        return Command{thrust, pitch_cmd, yaw_cmd, roll_cmd};
    }

private:
    double attitude_pd(double target, double angle, double rate) const {
        const double err = wrap_angle(target - angle);
        return clamp(err * 1.8 - rate * 0.7, -1.0, 1.0);
    }

    double compute_safe_descent(double altitude_agl, double horiz_dist, double speed) const {
        double descent = 2.0;
        if (altitude_agl > 2000.0) {
            descent = 35.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 800.0) {
            descent = 24.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 250.0) {
            descent = 14.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 80.0) {
            descent = 8.0;
        } else if (altitude_agl > 25.0) {
            descent = 4.5;
        } else {
            descent = 1.6;
        }

        if (horiz_dist < landing_radius_ * 4.0) {
            descent = std::min(descent, 3.0);
        }
        if (horiz_dist < landing_radius_ * 1.5) {
            descent = std::min(descent, 1.8);
        }
        if (speed > 35.0 && altitude_agl < 120.0) {
            descent = std::min(descent, 2.0);
        }
        return descent;
    }

    Header header_;
    const TerrainMap* terrain_;
    double landing_radius_ = 5.0;
};

bool read_header(Header& h) {
    if (!(std::cin >> h.width >> h.depth >> h.height >> h.gravity >> h.max_thrust >> h.fuel)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (!(std::cin >> h.start.x >> h.start.y >> h.start.z >> h.target.x >> h.target.y >> h.target.z)) {
        return false;
    }
    std::string path_line;
    std::getline(std::cin, path_line);
    std::getline(std::cin, h.terrain_path);
    if (!h.terrain_path.empty() && h.terrain_path.back() == '\r') {
        h.terrain_path.pop_back();
    }
    std::string state_token;
    std::cin >> state_token;
    return true;
}

std::optional<State> parse_state_line(const std::string& line) {
    State s;
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    if (!(iss >> s.pos.x >> s.pos.y >> s.pos.z
              >> s.vel.x >> s.vel.y >> s.vel.z
              >> s.pitch >> s.yaw >> s.roll
              >> s.pitch_rate >> s.yaw_rate >> s.roll_rate
              >> s.fuel_remaining)) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    s.valid = true;
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    Header header;
    if (!read_header(header)) {
        return 0;
    }

    TerrainMap terrain(header);
    terrain.load_async(header.terrain_path);

    StateQueue queue;
    std::atomic<bool> done{false};

    std::thread reader([&]() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
        while (!done.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) && std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
            if (line.empty()) {
                continue;
            }
            auto s = parse_state_line(line);
            if (s) {
                queue.push(*s);
            }
        }
        queue.close();
    });

    Controller controller(header, &terrain);
    State state;

    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(6);
    while (queue.wait_and_pop_latest(state)) {
        Command cmd = controller.step(state);
        std::cout << cmd.thrust << ' '
                  << cmd.pitch_cmd << ' '
                  << cmd.yaw_cmd << ' '
                  << cmd.roll_cmd << '\n';
        std::cout.flush();
    }

    done.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (reader.joinable()) {
        reader.join();
    }
    return 0;
}

You are writing C# code to calculate an asteroid interception trajectory.

You must write a C# solver that can handle an interception and redirection scenarios, from

**Problem:**
Calculate a spacecraft trajectory to intercept and deflect an asteroid on collision course
with Earth using kinetic impact.

**The solver must output:**
1. Launch window and initial trajectory
2. Mid-course correction burn(s)

**Input format (stdin, whitespace seperated decimal/scientific notation numbers):**
```
num_bodies warning_days impactor_mass delta_v_budget asteroid_mass t0_unix_utc
```
