using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

public static class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        var fs = new FastScanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int n = fs.NextInt();
        int m = fs.NextInt();
        if (n <= 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            Console.WriteLine();
            return;
        }

        var degree = new int[n];
        var edgesU = new int[m];
        var edgesV = new int[m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            int u = fs.NextInt();
            int v = fs.NextInt();
            edgesU[i] = u;
            edgesV[i] = v;
            if (u == v) continue;
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

        var adj = new int[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new int[degree[i]];
        Array.Clear(degree, 0, n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            int u = edgesU[i];
            int v = edgesV[i];
            if (u == v) continue;
            adj[u][degree[u]++] = v;
            adj[v][degree[v]++] = u;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Array.Sort(adj[i]);

        int[] order = Enumerable.Range(0, n).ToArray();
        Array.Sort(order, (a, b) =>
        {
            int cmp = adj[b].Length.CompareTo(adj[a].Length);
            return cmp != 0 ? cmp : a.CompareTo(b);
        });

        var solver = new HybridCliqueSolver(adj, order);
        int[] clique = solver.Solve();

        Array.Sort(clique);
        Console.WriteLine(clique.Length);
        if (clique.Length > 0)
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", clique));
        else
            Console.WriteLine();
    }
}

internal sealed class HybridCliqueSolver
{
    private readonly int[][] _adj;
    private readonly int[] _order;
    private readonly int _n;
    private readonly long _deadline;
    private volatile int[] _bestClique;
    private volatile int _bestSize;

    public HybridCliqueSolver(int[][] adj, int[] order)
    {
        _adj = adj;
        _order = order;
        _n = adj.Length;
        _deadline = Environment.TickCount64 + 280000;
        _bestClique = Array.Empty<int>();
        _bestSize = 0;
    }

    public int[] Solve()
    {
        GreedyWarmStarts();

        if (_n <= 6000)
            CoreExactSearch();
        else
            LargeGraphSearch();

        return _bestClique;
    }

    private void GreedyWarmStarts()
    {
        int tries = Math.Min(_n, _n <= 2000 ? 128 : 64);
        for (int t = 0; t < tries; t++)
        {
            int seed = _order[t];
            var clique = GreedyCliqueFromSeed(seed, t % 4);
            UpdateBest(clique);
            if (TimeExpired()) return;
        }

        var rnd = new XorShift64((ulong)(_n * 11995408973635179863UL + 17UL));
        int randomTries = Math.Min(_n, _n <= 50000 ? 128 : 48);
        for (int t = 0; t < randomTries; t++)
        {
            int idx = (int)(rnd.NextUInt() % (uint)_n);
            var clique = GreedyCliqueFromSeed(_order[idx], 4 + (t % 3));
            UpdateBest(clique);
            if (TimeExpired()) return;
        }
    }

    private void CoreExactSearch()
    {
        int limit = _n <= 400 ? _n : Math.Min(_n, 2500);
        var core = new int[limit];
        Array.Copy(_order, core, limit);

        var candidates = new List<int>(limit);
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++)
        {
            int v = core[i];
            if (_adj[v].Length + 1 <= _bestSize) break;
            candidates.Add(v);
        }

        if (candidates.Count == 0) return;

        var search = new ExactSearch(_adj, _deadline, GetBestSize, UpdateBest);
        search.Run(candidates.ToArray());
    }

    private void LargeGraphSearch()
    {
        int frontier = Math.Min(_n, Math.Max(2000, Math.Min(30000, 500 * (_bestSize + 8))));
        int workers = Math.Min(Environment.ProcessorCount, 8);
        Parallel.For(0, workers, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = workers }, workerId =>
        {
            var local = new List<int>(128);
            for (int i = workerId; i < frontier && !TimeExpired(); i += workers)
            {
                int v = _order[i];
                if (_adj[v].Length + 1 <= GetBestSize()) break;

                local.Clear();
                local.Add(v);
                int candidateCap = Math.Min(_adj[v].Length, Math.Max(256, 32 * (GetBestSize() + 4)));
                var cand = BuildRestrictedCandidates(v, candidateCap);
                ExpandHeuristic(local, cand, 0);

                if (cand.Count <= 140 && local.Count + cand.Count > GetBestSize())
                {
                    var exact = new ExactSearch(_adj, _deadline, GetBestSize, UpdateBest);
                    exact.RunWithPrefix(local.ToArray(), cand.ToArray());
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void ExpandHeuristic(List<int> clique, List<int> candidates, int depth)
    {
        if (TimeExpired() || candidates.Count == 0)
        {
            UpdateBest(clique);
            return;
        }
        UpdateBest(clique);
        if (clique.Count + candidates.Count <= GetBestSize()) return;

        candidates.Sort((a, b) => Score(b).CompareTo(Score(a)));
        int branch = depth == 0 ? Math.Min(12, candidates.Count) : Math.Min(4, candidates.Count);
        for (int i = 0; i < branch && !TimeExpired(); i++)
        {
            int v = candidates[i];
            var nextClique = new List<int>(clique.Count + 1);
            nextClique.AddRange(clique);
            nextClique.Add(v);
            var nextCand = new List<int>();
            for (int j = i + 1; j < candidates.Count; j++)
            {
                int u = candidates[j];
                if (HasEdge(u, v)) nextCand.Add(u);
            }
            ExpandHeuristic(nextClique, nextCand, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    private List<int> BuildRestrictedCandidates(int seed, int cap)
    {
        var cand = new List<int>(Math.Min(cap, _adj[seed].Length));
        foreach (int u in _adj[seed])
        {
            if (_adj[u].Length + 1 <= GetBestSize()) continue;
            cand.Add(u);
        }
        cand.Sort((a, b) => Score(b).CompareTo(Score(a)));
        if (cand.Count > cap) cand.RemoveRange(cap, cand.Count - cap);
        return cand;
    }

    private int[] GreedyCliqueFromSeed(int seed, int mode)
    {
        var clique = new List<int> { seed };
        var candidates = new List<int>(_adj[seed].Length);
        foreach (int u in _adj[seed])
        {
            if (_adj[u].Length + 1 > _bestSize) candidates.Add(u);
        }

        while (candidates.Count > 0 && !TimeExpired())
        {
            int bestIndex = 0;
            long bestScore = long.MinValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
            {
                int v = candidates[i];
                long s = mode switch
                {
                    0 => ((long)_adj[v].Length << 32) - v,
                    1 => ((long)CommonCountEstimate(v, candidates) << 32) + _adj[v].Length,
                    2 => ((long)_adj[v].Length << 20) + CommonCountEstimate(v, candidates),
                    3 => ((long)CommonCountEstimate(v, candidates) << 20) + _adj[v].Length,
                    _ => ((long)_adj[v].Length << 32) + (CommonCountEstimate(v, candidates) ^ (v * 17)),
                };
                if (s > bestScore)
                {
                    bestScore = s;
                    bestIndex = i;
                }
            }

            int chosen = candidates[bestIndex];
            clique.Add(chosen);

            var next = new List<int>();
            for (int i = 0; i < candidates.Count; i++)
            {
                if (i == bestIndex) continue;
                int u = candidates[i];
                if (HasEdge(u, chosen)) next.Add(u);
            }
            candidates = next;
        }

        return clique.ToArray();
    }

    private int CommonCountEstimate(int v, List<int> set)
    {
        int count = 0;
        int[] neigh = _adj[v];
        for (int i = 0; i < set.Count; i++)
        {
            if (set[i] != v && BinarySearch(neigh, set[i])) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    private int Score(int v) => _adj[v].Length;

    private bool HasEdge(int a, int b) => BinarySearch(_adj[a], b);

    private static bool BinarySearch(int[] arr, int value)
    {
        int lo = 0, hi = arr.Length - 1;
        while (lo <= hi)
        {
            int mid = lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1);
            int cur = arr[mid];
            if (cur == value) return true;
            if (cur < value) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid - 1;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private bool TimeExpired() => Environment.TickCount64 >= _deadline;

    private int GetBestSize() => Volatile.Read(ref _bestSize);

    private void UpdateBest(IReadOnlyList<int> clique)
    {
        if (clique.Count <= GetBestSize()) return;
        lock (this)
        {
            if (clique.Count <= _bestSize) return;
            var copy = new int[clique.Count];
            for (int i = 0; i < clique.Count; i++) copy[i] = clique[i];
            _bestClique = copy;
            _bestSize = copy.Length;
        }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the 3-SAT (Boolean Satisfiability) problem, which is NP-Complete.

**What is 3-SAT?**
You have N boolean variables (x1, x2, ..., xN), each of which is either True or False.
You are given M "clauses". Each clause is a constraint containing exactly 3 "literals".
A literal is either:
- A positive integer (e.g. 5) meaning "variable 5 must be True", or
- A negative integer (e.g. -5) meaning "variable 5 must be False".

A clause is **satisfied** if ANY of its 3 literals evaluates to True.
The formula is **satisfiable** if ALL clauses can be satisfied simultaneously
by some assignment of True/False to the variables.

**Example:**
Variables: x1, x2, x3
Clause "1 -2 3" means: x1=True OR x2=False OR x3=True.
If x1=True, x2=True, x3=False → clause satisfied (x1=True is enough).

Your task: find an assignment of True/False to every variable that satisfies
every clause. All test instances are guaranteed to be satisfiable.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_variables num_clauses
lit1 lit2 lit3
lit1 lit2 lit3
...
```
Variables are 1-indexed. Negative literals mean negation.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
SAT
v1 v2 v3 ... vN
```
Where each vi is 1 (True) or 0 (False) for variable i, space-separated.

**Grading:**
- Output "SAT" on the first line, then the assignment on the second line.
- Every clause must be satisfied by your assignment.
- Timeouts, crashes, wrong format, or unsatisfied clauses all score 0.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Handle up to 20M variables and 85M clauses.
3. Complete within 5 minutes.

Write complete, runnable Python code.

import sys
from array import array


def ints_from_stdin():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    num = 0
    sign = 1
    in_num = False
    for b in data:
        if 48 <= b <= 57:
            num = num * 10 + (b - 48)
            in_num = True
        elif b == 45:
            sign = -1
        elif in_num:
            yield sign * num
            num = 0
            sign = 1
            in_num = False
        else:
            sign = 1
    if in_num:
        yield sign * num


def lit_true(lit, assignment):
    v = lit if lit > 0 else -lit
    val = assignment[v]
    return val if lit > 0 else 1 - val


def main():
    it = ints_from_stdin()
    try:
        n = next(it)
        m = next(it)
    except StopIteration:
        return

    a = array('i')
    b = array('i')
    c = array('i')
    pos_count = array('I', [0]) * (n + 1)
    neg_count = array('I', [0]) * (n + 1)

    append_a = a.append
    append_b = b.append
    append_c = c.append

    for _ in range(m):
        x = next(it)
        y = next(it)
        z = next(it)
        append_a(x)
        append_b(y)
        append_c(z)
        if x > 0:
            pos_count[x] += 1
        else:
            neg_count[-x] += 1
        if y > 0:
            pos_count[y] += 1
        else:
            neg_count[-y] += 1
        if z > 0:
            pos_count[z] += 1
        else:
            neg_count[-z] += 1

    assignment = bytearray(n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        assignment[i] = 1 if pos_count[i] >= neg_count[i] else 0

    limit = 8
    for _pass in range(limit):
        changed = False
        unsat = 0
        for i in range(m):
            x = a[i]
            y = b[i]
            z = c[i]
            tx = lit_true(x, assignment)
            ty = lit_true(y, assignment)
            tz = lit_true(z, assignment)
            if tx | ty | tz:
                continue
            unsat += 1

            vx = x if x > 0 else -x
            vy = y if y > 0 else -y
            vz = z if z > 0 else -z

            sx = pos_count[vx] + neg_count[vx]
            sy = pos_count[vy] + neg_count[vy]
            sz = pos_count[vz] + neg_count[vz]

            best_v = vx
            best_s = sx
            if sy < best_s:
                best_v = vy
                best_s = sy
            if sz < best_s:
                best_v = vz
                best_s = sz

            assignment[best_v] ^= 1
            changed = True

        if unsat == 0:
            break
        if not changed:
            break

    out = sys.stdout.write
    out('SAT\n')
    out(' '.join('1' if assignment[i] else '0' for i in range(1, n + 1)))
    out('\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

You are writing Rust code to solve the Subset Sum problem.

Your Rust subset sum solver will be tested with instances ranging from simple to very
complex sets. The same algorithm must work efficiently across ALL problem complexities.

Given a set of integers and a target value, determine if there exists a subset
that sums to exactly the target value. Simple sets (<100 numbers) you can probably
brute force, however this code will also need to run on sets with millions of
numbers. This is NP-Complete and requires sophisticated algorithms for larger instances:
additionally; threading, memory optimization, vectorization and parallelization are all
strongly suggested.

**Input format (stdin, space seperated decimal integers):**
```
num_numbers target
num1 num2 ... numN
```

**Output format (stdout):**
```
YES or NO
[index1 index2 ... indexK] (only if YES, 0-indexed indices of subset elements)
```

**Implementation Hints:**
- Detect set complexity and choose appropriate algorithm
- Use efficient data structures: bitsets, hash sets for DP
- Implement adaptive quality vs speed tradeoffs
- For very large sets, focus on approximation algorithms
- Handle edge cases: empty set, zero target, all numbers add to target.
- Use fast I/O as the input size can approach 1gb.

**Success Criteria:**
- Correctly determine if subset sum exists
- If YES, provide valid subset indices
- Complete within time limit

**Failure Criteria:**
- Incorrect subset sum determination
- Invalid subset indices
- Timeout without conclusion

**Requirements:**
1. Program must compile with rustc
2. Read from stdin, write to stdout
3. Handle variable set sizes and target values
4. Complete within 5 minutes
5. Must handle varying subset sum complexities efficiently

This is a classic NP-hard problem. The test uses planted instances with a known solution for strict pass/fail grading. Subpasses increase the list size and target magnitude.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Item {
    value: i64,
    index: usize,
}

fn main() {
    if let Err(message) = run() {
        eprintln!("{message}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin()
        .read_to_string(&mut input)
        .map_err(|e| format!("failed to read stdin: {e}"))?;
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();

    let n: usize = match it.next() {
        Some(token) => token
            .parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("failed to parse num_numbers: {e}"))?,
        None => {
            println!("NO");
            return Ok(());
        }
    };
    let target: i64 = match it.next() {
        Some(token) => token
            .parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("failed to parse target: {e}"))?,
        None => return Err("missing target".to_string()),
    };

    let mut numbers = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for idx in 0..n {
        let token = it
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing value at position {idx}"))?;
        let value: i64 = token
            .parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("failed to parse value at position {idx}: {e}"))?;
        numbers.push(value);
    }

    if target == 0 {
        println!("YES");
        println!();
        return Ok(());
    }
    if n == 0 {
        println!("NO");
        return Ok(());
    }

    let items: Vec<Item> = numbers
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(index, value)| Item { value, index })
        .collect();

    if let Some(answer) = solve_subset_sum(&items, target) {
        emit_answer(&answer);
    } else {
        println!("NO");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn solve_subset_sum(items: &[Item], target: i64) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    if let Some(answer) = solve_trivial(items, target) {
        return Some(answer);
    }

    if items.len() <= 42 {
        if let Some(answer) = meet_in_the_middle(items, target) {
            return Some(answer);
        }
    }

    let (non_negative, total_positive) = summarize_non_negative(items)?;
    if non_negative {
        if target < 0 || target > total_positive {
            return None;
        }

        if items.len() >= 200_000 {
            if let Some(answer) = try_greedy_positive(items, target) {
                return Some(answer);
            }
            return None;
        }

        if target <= 20_000_000 {
            if let Some(answer) = bitset_subset_sum(items, target as usize) {
                return Some(answer);
            }
        }

        if items.len() <= 8_000 {
            return sparse_positive_dp(items, target);
        }

        if let Some(answer) = try_greedy_positive(items, target) {
            return Some(answer);
        }
        return None;
    }

    if items.len() <= 120 {
        return sparse_signed_dp(items, target, 4_000_000);
    }

    None
}

fn solve_trivial(items: &[Item], target: i64) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    for item in items {
        if item.value == target {
            return Some(vec![item.index]);
        }
    }

    let mut seen: HashMap<i64, usize> = HashMap::with_capacity(items.len().min(1_000_000));
    for item in items {
        if let Some(&other_index) = seen.get(&(target - item.value)) {
            return Some(vec![other_index, item.index]);
        }
        seen.entry(item.value).or_insert(item.index);
    }
    None
}

fn summarize_non_negative(items: &[Item]) -> Option<(bool, i64)> {
    let mut total_positive = 0_i64;
    for item in items {
        if item.value < 0 {
            return Some((false, 0));
        }
        total_positive = total_positive.checked_add(item.value)?;
    }
    Some((true, total_positive))
}

fn meet_in_the_middle(items: &[Item], target: i64) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    let split = items.len() / 2;
    let left = &items[..split];
    let right = &items[split..];

    let mut left_sums = enumerate_half(left);
    let mut right_sums = enumerate_half(right);
    left_sums.sort_unstable_by_key(|entry| entry.0);
    right_sums.sort_unstable_by_key(|entry| entry.0);

    let mut i = 0usize;
    let mut j = right_sums.len();
    while i < left_sums.len() && j > 0 {
        let left_sum = left_sums[i].0;
        let right_sum = right_sums[j - 1].0;
        let sum = left_sum + right_sum;
        if sum == target {
            let mut answer = decode_mask(left, left_sums[i].1);
            answer.extend(decode_mask(right, right_sums[j - 1].1));
            answer.sort_unstable();
            return Some(answer);
        }
        if sum < target {
            i += 1;
        } else {
            j -= 1;
        }
    }
    None
}

fn enumerate_half(items: &[Item]) -> Vec<(i64, u64)> {
    let size = 1usize << items.len();
    let mut sums = Vec::with_capacity(size);
    for mask in 0..size {
        let mut sum = 0_i64;
        for (bit, item) in items.iter().enumerate() {
            if ((mask >> bit) & 1) != 0 {
                sum += item.value;
            }
        }
        sums.push((sum, mask as u64));
    }
    sums
}

fn decode_mask(items: &[Item], mask: u64) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut answer = Vec::new();
    for (bit, item) in items.iter().enumerate() {
        if ((mask >> bit) & 1) != 0 {
            answer.push(item.index);
        }
    }
    answer
}

fn bitset_subset_sum(items: &[Item], target: usize) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    let words = (target / 64) + 1;
    let mut reachable = vec![0_u64; words];
    let mut prev_sum = vec![usize::MAX; target + 1];
    let mut prev_index = vec![usize::MAX; target + 1];
    reachable[0] = 1;

    for item in items {
        let value = item.value as usize;
        if value == 0 || value > target {
            continue;
        }

        let shift_words = value / 64;
        let shift_bits = value % 64;
        let mut newly = vec![0_u64; words];

        for src in 0..words {
            let bits = reachable[src];
            if bits == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let dst = src + shift_words;
            if dst >= words {
                continue;
            }
            newly[dst] |= bits << shift_bits;
            if shift_bits != 0 && dst + 1 < words {
                newly[dst + 1] |= bits >> (64 - shift_bits);
            }
        }

        for idx in 0..words {
            newly[idx] &= !reachable[idx];
        }

        let max_word = target / 64;
        let tail_bits = target % 64;
        if max_word < words && tail_bits != 63 {
            let mask = (1_u64 << (tail_bits + 1)) - 1;
            newly[max_word] &= mask;
            for word in newly.iter_mut().skip(max_word + 1) {
                *word = 0;
            }
        }

        for (word_idx, &word) in newly.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut bits = word;
            while bits != 0 {
                let bit = bits.trailing_zeros() as usize;
                let sum = word_idx * 64 + bit;
                if sum <= target {
                    prev_sum[sum] = sum - value;
                    prev_index[sum] = item.index;
                }
                bits &= bits - 1;
            }
        }

        for idx in 0..words {
            reachable[idx] |= newly[idx];
        }

        if ((reachable[target / 64] >> (target % 64)) & 1) != 0 {
            return Some(reconstruct_positive(target, &prev_sum, &prev_index));
        }
    }

    if ((reachable[target / 64] >> (target % 64)) & 1) != 0 {
        Some(reconstruct_positive(target, &prev_sum, &prev_index))
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn reconstruct_positive(target: usize, prev_sum: &[usize], prev_index: &[usize]) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut answer = Vec::new();
    let mut sum = target;
    while sum != 0 {
        answer.push(prev_index[sum]);
        sum = prev_sum[sum];
    }
    answer.sort_unstable();
    answer
}

fn sparse_positive_dp(items: &[Item], target: i64) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut parent: HashMap<i64, (i64, usize)> = HashMap::new();
    parent.insert(0, (0, usize::MAX));

    for item in items {
        if item.value <= 0 || item.value > target {
            continue;
        }

        let mut additions = Vec::new();
        for &sum in parent.keys() {
            let next = sum + item.value;
            if next > target || parent.contains_key(&next) {
                continue;
            }
            additions.push((next, sum));
        }
        for (next, previous) in additions {
            parent.insert(next, (previous, item.index));
        }
        if parent.contains_key(&target) {
            return Some(reconstruct_sparse(&parent, target));
        }
    }
    parent
        .contains_key(&target)
        .then(|| reconstruct_sparse(&parent, target))
}

fn sparse_signed_dp(items: &[Item], target: i64, max_states: usize) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut parent: HashMap<i64, (i64, usize)> = HashMap::new();
    parent.insert(0, (0, usize::MAX));

    for item in items {
        let keys: Vec<i64> = parent.keys().copied().collect();
        let mut additions = Vec::new();
        for sum in keys {
            let next = sum + item.value;
            if parent.contains_key(&next) {
                continue;
            }
            additions.push((next, sum));
        }
        for (next, previous) in additions {
            parent.insert(next, (previous, item.index));
        }
        if parent.contains_key(&target) {
            return Some(reconstruct_sparse(&parent, target));
        }
        if parent.len() > max_states {
            break;
        }
    }
    None
}

fn reconstruct_sparse(parent: &HashMap<i64, (i64, usize)>, target: i64) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut answer = Vec::new();
    let mut current = target;
    while current != 0 {
        let &(previous, index) = parent.get(&current).expect("target must be reachable");
        answer.push(index);
        current = previous;
    }
    answer.sort_unstable();
    answer
}

fn try_greedy_positive(items: &[Item], target: i64) -> Option<Vec<usize>> {
    let mut filtered: Vec<Item> = items
        .iter()
        .copied()
        .filter(|item| item.value > 0 && item.value <= target)
        .collect();
    filtered.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| b.value.cmp(&a.value).then_with(|| a.index.cmp(&b.index)));

    for start in 0..filtered.len().min(24) {
        let mut remaining = target;
        let mut answer = Vec::new();
        for (pos, item) in filtered.iter().enumerate() {
            if pos < start && item.value == filtered[start].value {
                continue;
            }
            if item.value <= remaining {
                remaining -= item.value;
                answer.push(item.index);
                if remaining == 0 {
                    answer.sort_unstable();
                    return Some(answer);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn emit_answer(indices: &[usize]) {
    println!("YES");
    if indices.is_empty() {
        println!();
        return;
    }
    let mut first = true;
    for index in indices {
        if !first {
            print!(" ");
        }
        first = false;
        print!("{index}");
    }
    println!();
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing C++ code to solve the Steiner Tree problem (NP-Hard).

**Problem:**
Given a weighted undirected graph and a set of terminal vertices, find a minimum-weight
tree that connects all terminals. The tree may include non-terminal (Steiner) vertices.

**Input (stdin):**
```
num_vertices num_edges num_terminals
u v weight (one edge per line, 0-indexed)
terminal_1 terminal_2 ... terminal_K
```

**Output (stdout):**
```
total_weight edge_count
u1 v1
u2 v2
...
```
Edges listed must form a connected, acyclic subgraph that includes all terminals.

Connect a set of important nodes in a weighted graph using the cheapest possible tree of edges. Unlike a minimum spanning tree, the solution may pass through intermediate nodes that aren’t in the required set if doing so saves cost — like building a road network that connects key cities via junctions.

This is NP-hard. The test uses planted instances with a known optimal tree for strict grading. Subpasses increase the graph size.

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <numeric>
#include <queue>
#include <tuple>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to;
    long long w;
    int id;
};

struct InputEdge {
    int u;
    int v;
    long long w;
};

struct PQNode {
    long long dist;
    int v;
    bool operator>(const PQNode& other) const {
        return dist > other.dist;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m >> k)) {
        return 0;
    }

    vector<InputEdge> edges;
    edges.reserve(m);
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        long long w;
        cin >> u >> v >> w;
        edges.push_back({u, v, w});
        graph[u].push_back({v, w, i});
        graph[v].push_back({u, w, i});
    }

    vector<int> terminals(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        cin >> terminals[i];
    }

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << 0 << ' ' << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    if (k == 1) {
        cout << 0 << ' ' << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    if (k > 20) {
        vector<long long> keyDist(n, numeric_limits<long long>::max() / 4);
        vector<int> keyParentVertex(n, -1);
        vector<int> keyParentEdge(n, -1);
        vector<char> inTree(n, 0);
        vector<int> treeVertices;
        vector<int> chosenEdges;

        int root = terminals[0];
        inTree[root] = 1;
        treeVertices.push_back(root);

        auto run_dijkstra_to_tree = [&](int source) {
            const long long INF = numeric_limits<long long>::max() / 4;
            vector<long long> dist(n, INF);
            vector<int> parentVertex(n, -1);
            vector<int> parentEdge(n, -1);
            priority_queue<PQNode, vector<PQNode>, greater<PQNode>> pq;
            dist[source] = 0;
            pq.push({0, source});
            int hit = -1;
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto cur = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (cur.dist != dist[cur.v]) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (inTree[cur.v]) {
                    hit = cur.v;
                    break;
                }
                for (const auto& e : graph[cur.v]) {
                    long long nd = cur.dist + e.w;
                    if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = nd;
                        parentVertex[e.to] = cur.v;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = e.id;
                        pq.push({nd, e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            return tuple<int, vector<int>, vector<int>>(hit, move(parentVertex), move(parentEdge));
        };

        for (int ti = 1; ti < k; ++ti) {
            auto [hit, parentVertex, parentEdge] = run_dijkstra_to_tree(terminals[ti]);
            if (hit == -1) {
                cout << 0 << ' ' << 0 << '\n';
                return 0;
            }
            int cur = hit;
            while (cur != terminals[ti]) {
                int prev = parentVertex[cur];
                int eid = parentEdge[cur];
                if (prev == -1 || eid == -1) {
                    break;
                }
                chosenEdges.push_back(eid);
                if (!inTree[prev]) {
                    inTree[prev] = 1;
                    treeVertices.push_back(prev);
                }
                if (!inTree[cur]) {
                    inTree[cur] = 1;
                    treeVertices.push_back(cur);
                }
                cur = prev;
            }
            if (!inTree[terminals[ti]]) {
                inTree[terminals[ti]] = 1;
                treeVertices.push_back(terminals[ti]);
            }
        }

        sort(chosenEdges.begin(), chosenEdges.end());
        chosenEdges.erase(unique(chosenEdges.begin(), chosenEdges.end()), chosenEdges.end());

        vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> treeAdj(n);
        for (int eid : chosenEdges) {
            const auto& e = edges[eid];
            treeAdj[e.u].push_back({e.v, eid});
            treeAdj[e.v].push_back({e.u, eid});
        }

        vector<char> needed(n, 0);
        for (int t : terminals) {
            needed[t] = 1;
        }

        vector<char> usedEdge(m, 0);
        function<bool(int, int)> prune = [&](int v, int p) -> bool {
            bool keep = needed[v];
            for (auto [to, eid] : treeAdj[v]) {
                if (to == p) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (prune(to, v)) {
                    usedEdge[eid] = 1;
                    keep = true;
                }
            }
            return keep;
        };

        prune(terminals[0], -1);

        long long totalWeight = 0;
        vector<pair<int, int>> answerEdges;
        for (int eid = 0; eid < m; ++eid) {
            if (usedEdge[eid]) {
                totalWeight += edges[eid].w;
                answerEdges.push_back({edges[eid].u, edges[eid].v});
            }
        }

        cout << totalWeight << ' ' << answerEdges.size() << '\n';
        for (const auto& e : answerEdges) {
            cout << e.first << ' ' << e.second << '\n';
        }
        return 0;
    }

    const int fullMask = 1 << k;
    const long long INF = numeric_limits<long long>::max() / 4;

    vector<vector<long long>> dp(fullMask, vector<long long>(n, INF));
    vector<vector<int>> parentVertex(fullMask, vector<int>(n, -1));
    vector<vector<int>> parentEdge(fullMask, vector<int>(n, -1));
    vector<vector<int>> splitMask(fullMask, vector<int>(n, -1));

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        dp[1 << i][terminals[i]] = 0;
    }

    for (int mask = 1; mask < fullMask; ++mask) {
        if ((mask & (mask - 1)) != 0) {
            for (int sub = (mask - 1) & mask; sub; sub = (sub - 1) & mask) {
                int other = mask ^ sub;
                if (other == 0 || sub > other) {
                    continue;
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                    long long lhs = dp[sub][v];
                    long long rhs = dp[other][v];
                    if (lhs == INF || rhs == INF) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long long cand = lhs + rhs;
                    if (cand < dp[mask][v]) {
                        dp[mask][v] = cand;
                        splitMask[mask][v] = sub;
                        parentVertex[mask][v] = -1;
                        parentEdge[mask][v] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        priority_queue<PQNode, vector<PQNode>, greater<PQNode>> pq;
        for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
            if (dp[mask][v] < INF) {
                pq.push({dp[mask][v], v});
            }
        }

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto cur = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            if (cur.dist != dp[mask][cur.v]) {
                continue;
            }
            for (const auto& e : graph[cur.v]) {
                long long nd = cur.dist + e.w;
                if (nd < dp[mask][e.to]) {
                    dp[mask][e.to] = nd;
                    parentVertex[mask][e.to] = cur.v;
                    parentEdge[mask][e.to] = e.id;
                    splitMask[mask][e.to] = -1;
                    pq.push({nd, e.to});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int bestVertex = -1;
    long long bestCost = INF;
    int allMask = fullMask - 1;
    for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
        if (dp[allMask][v] < bestCost) {
            bestCost = dp[allMask][v];
            bestVertex = v;
        }
    }

    if (bestVertex == -1 || bestCost >= INF) {
        cout << 0 << ' ' << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    vector<char> usedEdge(m, 0);
    vector<array<int, 2>> stack;
    stack.push_back({allMask, bestVertex});

    while (!stack.empty()) {
        auto state = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();
        int mask = state[0];
        int v = state[1];

        int sub = splitMask[mask][v];
        if (sub != -1) {
            int other = mask ^ sub;
            stack.push_back({sub, v});
            stack.push_back({other, v});
            continue;
        }

        int pv = parentVertex[mask][v];
        int pe = parentEdge[mask][v];
        if (pv != -1) {
            usedEdge[pe] = 1;
            stack.push_back({mask, pv});
        }
    }

    vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> treeAdj(n);
    for (int eid = 0; eid < m; ++eid) {
        if (!usedEdge[eid]) {
            continue;
        }
        const auto& e = edges[eid];
        treeAdj[e.u].push_back({e.v, eid});
        treeAdj[e.v].push_back({e.u, eid});
    }

    vector<char> needed(n, 0);
    for (int t : terminals) {
        needed[t] = 1;
    }

    vector<char> keptEdge(m, 0);
    function<bool(int, int)> dfsPrune = [&](int v, int p) -> bool {
        bool keep = needed[v];
        for (auto [to, eid] : treeAdj[v]) {
            if (to == p) {
                continue;
            }
            if (dfsPrune(to, v)) {
                keptEdge[eid] = 1;
                keep = true;
            }
        }
        return keep;
    };

    dfsPrune(bestVertex, -1);

    long long totalWeight = 0;
    vector<pair<int, int>> answerEdges;
    for (int eid = 0; eid < m; ++eid) {
        if (keptEdge[eid]) {
            totalWeight += edges[eid].w;
            answerEdges.push_back({edges[eid].u, edges[eid].v});
        }
    }

    cout << totalWeight << ' ' << answerEdges.size() << '\n';
    for (const auto& e : answerEdges) {
        cout << e.first << ' ' << e.second << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}

    }

            vector<long long> dist(n, INF);
            vector<int> parentVertex(n, -1);
            vector<int> parentEdge(n, -1);
            priority_queue<PQNode, vector<PQNode>, greater<PQNode>> pq;
            dist[source] = 0;
            pq.push({0, source});
            int hit = -1;
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto cur = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (cur.dist != dist[cur.v]) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (inTree[cur.v]) {
                    hit = cur.v;
                    break;
                }

                        parentEdge[e.to] = e.id;

You are writing C# code to solve the Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP), which is NP-hard.

**Problem:**
You have N facilities and N locations. You must assign each facility to exactly one

sum over all pairs (i, j): flow[i][j] * distance[p[i]][p[j]]

Your goal is to minimize this total cost.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
N
flow[0][0] flow[0][1] ... flow[0][N-1]
...
flow[N-1][0] ... flow[N-1][N-1]
dist[0][0] dist[0][1] ... dist[0][N-1]
...
dist[N-1][0] ... dist[N-1][N-1]
```
All values are integers. Matrices are N×N. Indices are 0-based in the output.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
total_cost
p0 p1 p2 ... p(N-1)
```
Where p is a permutation of 0..N-1 and p[i] is the location assigned to facility i.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Output a valid permutation.
3. Handle N from very small up to ~2000 within 5 minutes.
4. Heuristics are acceptable for large N; lower cost scores higher.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;

public static class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        var scanner = new FastScanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int n = scanner.NextInt();
        if (n <= 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            Console.WriteLine();
            return;
        }

        int[][] flow = new int[n][];
        int[][] dist = new int[n][];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            flow[i] = new int[n];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                flow[i][j] = scanner.NextInt();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            dist[i] = new int[n];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                dist[i][j] = scanner.NextInt();
            }
        }

        int[] perm = n <= 10 ? SolveExactly(flow, dist) : SolveHeuristic(flow, dist);
        long cost = ComputeCost(flow, dist, perm);

        var writer = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput()) { AutoFlush = false };
        writer.WriteLine(cost.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (i > 0) writer.Write(' ');
            writer.Write(perm[i].ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        }
        writer.WriteLine();
        writer.Flush();
    }

    private static int[] SolveExactly(int[][] flow, int[][] dist)
    {
        int n = flow.Length;
        long[,] flowContrib = new long[n, n];
        long[,] distContrib = new long[n, n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                flowContrib[i, j] = flow[i][j] + flow[j][i];
                distContrib[i, j] = dist[i][j] + dist[j][i];
            }
        }

        int[] facilityOrder = OrderDescendingByWeight(flow);
        int[] locationOrder = OrderAscendingByWeight(dist);

        int[] current = new int[n];
        Array.Fill(current, -1);
        bool[] used = new bool[n];
        long best = long.MaxValue;
        int[] bestPerm = new int[n];

        void Dfs(int depth, long partial)
        {
            if (depth == n)
            {
                if (partial < best)
                {
                    best = partial;
                    Array.Copy(current, bestPerm, n);
                }
                return;
            }

            int facility = facilityOrder[depth];
            for (int candidateIndex = 0; candidateIndex < n; candidateIndex++)
            {
                int loc = locationOrder[candidateIndex];
                if (used[loc]) continue;

                long add = (long)flow[facility][facility] * dist[loc][loc];
                for (int t = 0; t < depth; t++)
                {
                    int otherFacility = facilityOrder[t];
                    int otherLoc = current[otherFacility];
                    add += flowContrib[facility, otherFacility] * dist[loc][otherLoc];
                }

                long next = partial + add;
                if (next >= best) continue;

                current[facility] = loc;
                used[loc] = true;
                Dfs(depth + 1, next);
                used[loc] = false;
                current[facility] = -1;
            }
        }

        Dfs(0, 0L);
        return bestPerm;
    }

    private static int[] SolveHeuristic(int[][] flow, int[][] dist)
    {
        int n = flow.Length;
        long[] facilityWeight = ComputeNodeWeights(flow);
        long[] locationWeight = ComputeNodeWeights(dist);

        int[] facilitiesByWeight = OrderDescending(facilityWeight);
        int[] locationsByWeight = OrderAscending(locationWeight);

        int[] perm = new int[n];
        int[] inv = new int[n];
        for (int rank = 0; rank < n; rank++)
        {
            int facility = facilitiesByWeight[rank];
            int location = locationsByWeight[rank];
            perm[facility] = location;
            inv[location] = facility;
        }

        ImproveByReinsertion(flow, dist, perm, inv, facilityWeight, locationWeight);
        ImproveBySwaps(flow, dist, perm, inv, facilityWeight, locationWeight);
        return perm;
    }

    private static void ImproveByReinsertion(int[][] flow, int[][] dist, int[] perm, int[] inv, long[] facilityWeight, long[] locationWeight)
    {
        int n = flow.Length;
        int sample = Math.Min(n, n <= 200 ? n : 64);
        int[] heavyFacilities = TopKIndices(facilityWeight, sample, descending: true);
        int[] centralLocations = TopKIndices(locationWeight, sample, descending: false);
        bool changed = true;
        int passes = n <= 200 ? 4 : 2;

        for (int pass = 0; pass < passes && changed; pass++)
        {
            changed = false;
            foreach (int facility in heavyFacilities)
            {
                int currentLoc = perm[facility];
                long bestDelta = 0;
                int bestOtherFacility = -1;

                foreach (int candidateLoc in centralLocations)
                {
                    if (candidateLoc == currentLoc) continue;
                    int otherFacility = inv[candidateLoc];
                    long delta = ComputeSwapDelta(flow, dist, perm, facility, otherFacility);
                    if (delta < bestDelta)
                    {
                        bestDelta = delta;
                        bestOtherFacility = otherFacility;
                    }
                }

                if (bestOtherFacility >= 0)
                {
                    ApplySwap(perm, inv, facility, bestOtherFacility);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void ImproveBySwaps(int[][] flow, int[][] dist, int[] perm, int[] inv, long[] facilityWeight, long[] locationWeight)
    {
        int n = flow.Length;
        int facilitySample = n <= 150 ? n : Math.Min(96, n);
        int locationSample = n <= 150 ? n : Math.Min(96, n);
        int[] facilityCandidates = TopKIndices(facilityWeight, facilitySample, descending: true);
        int[] locationCandidates = TopKIndices(locationWeight, locationSample, descending: false);
        var locationSet = new HashSet<int>(locationCandidates);

        bool changed = true;
        int passes = n <= 150 ? 5 : 2;

        for (int pass = 0; pass < passes && changed; pass++)
        {
            changed = false;

            for (int aIndex = 0; aIndex < facilityCandidates.Length; aIndex++)
            {
                int a = facilityCandidates[aIndex];
                long bestDelta = 0;
                int bestB = -1;

                for (int bIndex = aIndex + 1; bIndex < facilityCandidates.Length; bIndex++)
                {
                    int b = facilityCandidates[bIndex];
                    if (!locationSet.Contains(perm[a]) && !locationSet.Contains(perm[b]) && n > 300)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    long delta = ComputeSwapDelta(flow, dist, perm, a, b);
                    if (delta < bestDelta)
                    {
                        bestDelta = delta;
                        bestB = b;
                    }
                }

                if (bestB >= 0)
                {
                    ApplySwap(perm, inv, a, bestB);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static long ComputeSwapDelta(int[][] flow, int[][] dist, int[] perm, int a, int b)
    {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        int n = flow.Length;
        int pa = perm[a];
        int pb = perm[b];
        long delta = 0;

        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
        {
            if (k == a || k == b) continue;
            int pk = perm[k];
            delta += (long)flow[a][k] * (dist[pb][pk] - dist[pa][pk]);
            delta += (long)flow[b][k] * (dist[pa][pk] - dist[pb][pk]);
            delta += (long)flow[k][a] * (dist[pk][pb] - dist[pk][pa]);
            delta += (long)flow[k][b] * (dist[pk][pa] - dist[pk][pb]);
        }

        delta += (long)flow[a][a] * (dist[pb][pb] - dist[pa][pa]);
        delta += (long)flow[b][b] * (dist[pa][pa] - dist[pb][pb]);
        delta += (long)flow[a][b] * (dist[pb][pa] - dist[pa][pb]);
        delta += (long)flow[b][a] * (dist[pa][pb] - dist[pb][pa]);
        return delta;
    }

    private static void ApplySwap(int[] perm, int[] inv, int a, int b)
    {
        int pa = perm[a];
        int pb = perm[b];
        perm[a] = pb;
        perm[b] = pa;
        inv[pa] = b;
        inv[pb] = a;
    }

    private static long[] ComputeNodeWeights(int[][] matrix)
    {
        int n = matrix.Length;
        long[] weights = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            long sum = 0;
            int[] row = matrix[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                sum += row[j];
                sum += matrix[j][i];
            }
            weights[i] = sum;
        }
        return weights;
    }

    private static int[] OrderDescendingByWeight(int[][] matrix)
    {
        return OrderDescending(ComputeNodeWeights(matrix));
    }

    private static int[] OrderAscendingByWeight(int[][] matrix)
    {
        return OrderAscending(ComputeNodeWeights(matrix));
    }

    private static int[] OrderDescending(long[] values)
    {
        int n = values.Length;
        int[] idx = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
        Array.Sort(idx, (a, b) =>
        {
            int cmp = values[b].CompareTo(values[a]);
            return cmp != 0 ? cmp : a.CompareTo(b);
        });
        return idx;
    }

    private static int[] OrderAscending(long[] values)
    {
        int n = values.Length;
        int[] idx = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
        Array.Sort(idx, (a, b) =>
        {
            int cmp = values[a].CompareTo(values[b]);
            return cmp != 0 ? cmp : a.CompareTo(b);
        });
        return idx;
    }

    private static int[] TopKIndices(long[] values, int k, bool descending)
    {
        int[] order = descending ? OrderDescending(values) : OrderAscending(values);
        if (k >= order.Length) return order;
        int[] result = new int[k];
        Array.Copy(order, result, k);
        return result;
    }

    private static long ComputeCost(int[][] flow, int[][] dist, int[] perm)
    {
        int n = flow.Length;
        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            int pi = perm[i];
            int[] flowRow = flow[i];
            int[] distRow = dist[pi];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                total += (long)flowRow[j] * distRow[perm[j]];
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    private sealed class FastScanner
    {
        private readonly Stream _stream;
        private readonly byte[] _buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int _len;
        private int _ptr;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream)
        {
            _stream = stream;
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c;
            do
            {
                c = Read();
                if (c < 0) return 0;
            } while (c <= 32);

            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int value = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return value * sign;
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (_ptr >= _len)
            {
                _len = _stream.Read(_buffer, 0, _buffer.Length);
                _ptr = 0;
                if (_len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return _buffer[_ptr++];
        }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP).

**Problem:**
You have a depot and N customers with coordinates and demands. You must create up to K vehicle
routes starting and ending at the depot. Each customer must be visited exactly once and the sum
of demands on any route must not exceed the vehicle capacity. Minimize total travel distance.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
N K CAPACITY
depot_x depot_y
x1 y1 demand1
x2 y2 demand2
...
xN yN demandN
```

**Output format (stdout):**
```
total_distance
num_routes
route_1
route_2
...
```
Each route line should list customer indices (0-based) in visit order.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Output valid routes that cover all customers exactly once.
3. Respect vehicle capacity on every route.
4. Heuristics are acceptable for large instances; shorter distance scores higher.

Write complete, runnable Python code.
 Prompt Changes:

Plan delivery routes for a fleet of vehicles so that every customer is visited and the total distance travelled is minimised. Each vehicle has a capacity limit, so the AI must decide which customers go on which truck and in what order.

This is the Vehicle Routing Problem, a generalisation of the Travelling Salesman Problem. Subpasses increase the number of customers and vehicles. The baseline uses a simple nearest-neighbour heuristic.

import math
import random
import sys


def read_input():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return None
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    capacity = int(next(it))
    depot = (float(next(it)), float(next(it)))
    customers = []
    for idx in range(n):
        x = float(next(it))
        y = float(next(it))
        demand = int(next(it))
        customers.append((x, y, demand, idx))
    return n, k, capacity, depot, customers


def euclidean(a, b):
    return math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])


def build_distance_matrix(depot, customers):
    points = [depot] + [(x, y) for x, y, _, _ in customers]
    size = len(points)
    dist = [[0.0] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(i + 1, size):
            d = euclidean(points[i], points[j])
            dist[i][j] = d
            dist[j][i] = d
    return dist


def route_distance(route, dist):
    if not route:
        return 0.0
    total = dist[0][route[0] + 1]
    for i in range(len(route) - 1):
        total += dist[route[i] + 1][route[i + 1] + 1]
    total += dist[route[-1] + 1][0]
    return total


def two_opt(route, dist):
    if len(route) < 4:
        return route
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        for i in range(len(route) - 2):
            a = 0 if i == 0 else route[i - 1] + 1
            b = route[i] + 1
            for j in range(i + 1, len(route) - 1):
                c = route[j] + 1
                d = route[j + 1] + 1
                delta = (dist[a][c] + dist[b][d]) - (dist[a][b] + dist[c][d])
                if delta < -1e-9:
                    route[i:j + 1] = reversed(route[i:j + 1])
                    improved = True
                    break
            if improved:
                break
    return route


def nearest_feasible_route(start, unassigned, capacity, demands, dist):
    route = [start]
    remaining = capacity - demands[start]
    unassigned.remove(start)
    current = start
    while True:
        best = None
        best_d = float("inf")
        for customer in list(unassigned):
            if demands[customer] <= remaining:
                d = dist[current + 1][customer + 1]
                if d < best_d:
                    best_d = d
                    best = customer
        if best is None:
            break
        route.append(best)
        unassigned.remove(best)
        remaining -= demands[best]
        current = best
    return route


def build_initial_routes(n, k, capacity, customers, dist):
    demands = [d for _, _, d, _ in customers]
    total_demand = sum(demands)
    min_routes_needed = max(1, math.ceil(total_demand / capacity)) if n > 0 else 0
    if min_routes_needed > k:
        return None

    unassigned = set(range(n))
    routes = []

    seeds_to_use = min(k, n)
    order = sorted(
        range(n),
        key=lambda i: (dist[0][i + 1], demands[i]),
        reverse=True,
    )
    seed_count = max(min_routes_needed, min(seeds_to_use, len(order)))
    for start in order[:seed_count]:
        if start in unassigned:
            routes.append(nearest_feasible_route(start, unassigned, capacity, demands, dist))

    while unassigned:
        progress = False
        for route in routes:
            load = sum(demands[i] for i in route)
            remaining = capacity - load
            if remaining <= 0:
                continue
            last = route[-1]
            best = None
            best_d = float("inf")
            for customer in unassigned:
                if demands[customer] <= remaining:
                    d = dist[last + 1][customer + 1]
                    if d < best_d:
                        best_d = d
                        best = customer
            if best is not None:
                route.append(best)
                unassigned.remove(best)
                progress = True
        if not progress:
            if len(routes) >= k:
                customer = max(unassigned, key=lambda i: demands[i])
                inserted = False
                for route in routes:
                    load = sum(demands[i] for i in route)
                    if load + demands[customer] <= capacity:
                        route.append(customer)
                        unassigned.remove(customer)
                        inserted = True
                        break
                if not inserted:
                    return None
            else:
                start = max(unassigned, key=lambda i: dist[0][i + 1])
                routes.append(nearest_feasible_route(start, unassigned, capacity, demands, dist))

    return routes


def try_relocate(routes, demands, capacity, dist):
    for i, route_a in enumerate(routes):
        load_a = sum(demands[c] for c in route_a)
        base_a = route_distance(route_a, dist)
        for pos, customer in enumerate(route_a):
            new_a = route_a[:pos] + route_a[pos + 1:]
            cost_without = route_distance(new_a, dist)
            demand_c = demands[customer]
            for j, route_b in enumerate(routes):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                load_b = sum(demands[c] for c in route_b)
                if load_b + demand_c > capacity:
                    continue
                base_b = route_distance(route_b, dist)
                best_insert_cost = None
                best_insert_route = None
                for ins in range(len(route_b) + 1):
                    candidate_b = route_b[:ins] + [customer] + route_b[ins:]
                    cand_cost = route_distance(candidate_b, dist)
                    if best_insert_cost is None or cand_cost < best_insert_cost:
                        best_insert_cost = cand_cost
                        best_insert_route = candidate_b
                delta = (cost_without + best_insert_cost) - (base_a + base_b)
                if delta < -1e-9:
                    routes[i] = new_a
                    routes[j] = best_insert_route
                    if not routes[i]:
                        routes.pop(i)
                    return True
    return False


def improve_routes(routes, demands, capacity, dist):
    for idx in range(len(routes)):
        routes[idx] = two_opt(routes[idx], dist)
    for _ in range(50):
        changed = try_relocate(routes, demands, capacity, dist)
        if not changed:
            break
        for idx in range(len(routes)):
            routes[idx] = two_opt(routes[idx], dist)
    return routes


def validate(routes, n, k, capacity, demands):
    if routes is None or len(routes) > k:
        return False
    seen = []
    for route in routes:
        load = sum(demands[i] for i in route)
        if load > capacity:
            return False
        seen.extend(route)
    return len(seen) == n and sorted(seen) == list(range(n))


def fallback_sequential(n, k, capacity, demands):
    routes = []
    current = []
    load = 0
    for customer in sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: demands[i], reverse=True):
        d = demands[customer]
        if d > capacity:
            return None
        if load + d > capacity:
            routes.append(current)
            current = [customer]
            load = d
        else:
            current.append(customer)
            load += d
    if current:
        routes.append(current)
    if len(routes) > k:
        return None
    return routes


def solve():
    parsed = read_input()
    if parsed is None:
        return
    n, k, capacity, depot, customers = parsed
    demands = [d for _, _, d, _ in customers]

    if any(d > capacity for d in demands):
        print("0")
        print("0")
        return

    dist = build_distance_matrix(depot, customers)
    routes = build_initial_routes(n, k, capacity, customers, dist)
    if routes is None:
        routes = fallback_sequential(n, k, capacity, demands)
    if routes is None or not validate(routes, n, k, capacity, demands):
        print("0")
        print("0")
        return

    random.seed(0)
    routes = improve_routes(routes, demands, capacity, dist)
    routes = [route for route in routes if route]
    if not validate(routes, n, k, capacity, demands):
        print("0")
        print("0")
        return

    total = sum(route_distance(route, dist) for route in routes)
    print(f"{total:.10f}")
    print(len(routes))
    for route in routes:
        print(" ".join(map(str, route)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

use std::cmp::Reverse;
use std::io::{self, Read};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Graph {
    n: usize,
    adj: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    closed: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
    degree: Vec<usize>,
}

fn read_graph() -> Graph {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();

    let n: usize = it.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let m: usize = it.next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0);

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::<usize>::new(); n];
    for _ in 0..m {
        let Some(us) = it.next() else { break };
        let Some(vs) = it.next() else { break };
        let mut u: usize = us.parse().unwrap_or(0);
        let mut v: usize = vs.parse().unwrap_or(0);
        if u >= n || v >= n {
            continue;
        }
        if u == v {
            adj[u].push(v);
        } else {
            adj[u].push(v);
            adj[v].push(u);
        }
    }

    for nbrs in &mut adj {
        nbrs.sort_unstable();
        nbrs.dedup();
    }

    let degree: Vec<usize> = adj.iter().map(|nbrs| nbrs.len()).collect();
    let mut closed = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    for v in 0..n {
        let mut c = Vec::with_capacity(adj[v].len() + 1);
        c.push(v);
        c.extend_from_slice(&adj[v]);
        closed.push(c);
    }

    Graph {
        n,
        adj,
        closed,
        degree,
    }
}

fn add_vertex(graph: &Graph, v: usize, in_set: &mut [bool], cover_count: &mut [u32]) {
    if in_set[v] {
        return;
    }
    in_set[v] = true;
    for &u in &graph.closed[v] {
        cover_count[u] += 1;
    }
}

fn greedy_build(graph: &Graph, order: &[usize]) -> Vec<usize> {
    let n = graph.n;
    if n == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let mut in_set = vec![false; n];
    let mut cover_count = vec![0u32; n];
    let mut undominated = n;

    while undominated > 0 {
        let mut best_v = usize::MAX;
        let mut best_gain = 0usize;
        let mut best_deg = 0usize;

        for &v in order {
            if in_set[v] {
                continue;
            }
            let mut gain = 0usize;
            for &u in &graph.closed[v] {
                if cover_count[u] == 0 {
                    gain += 1;
                }
            }
            if gain > best_gain || (gain == best_gain && graph.degree[v] > best_deg) {
                best_gain = gain;
                best_deg = graph.degree[v];
                best_v = v;
            }
        }

        if best_v == usize::MAX {
            break;
        }

        in_set[best_v] = true;
        for &u in &graph.closed[best_v] {
            if cover_count[u] == 0 {
                undominated -= 1;
            }
            cover_count[u] += 1;
        }
    }

    let mut isolated = Vec::new();
    for v in 0..n {
        if cover_count[v] == 0 {
            isolated.push(v);
        }
    }
    for v in isolated {
        add_vertex(graph, v, &mut in_set, &mut cover_count);
    }

    (0..n).filter(|&v| in_set[v]).collect()
}

fn prune_solution(graph: &Graph, mut solution: Vec<usize>) -> Vec<usize> {
    let n = graph.n;
    let mut in_set = vec![false; n];
    let mut cover_count = vec![0u32; n];

    for &v in &solution {
        in_set[v] = true;
        for &u in &graph.closed[v] {
            cover_count[u] += 1;
        }
    }

    solution.sort_unstable_by_key(|&v| (graph.degree[v], v));

    let mut kept = Vec::with_capacity(solution.len());
    for &v in &solution {
        let removable = graph.closed[v].iter().all(|&u| cover_count[u] >= 2);
        if removable {
            in_set[v] = false;
            for &u in &graph.closed[v] {
                cover_count[u] -= 1;
            }
        } else {
            kept.push(v);
        }
    }

    kept
}

fn improve_with_targeted_additions(graph: &Graph, solution: &[usize]) -> Vec<usize> {
    let n = graph.n;
    let mut in_set = vec![false; n];
    let mut cover_count = vec![0u32; n];

    for &v in solution {
        in_set[v] = true;
        for &u in &graph.closed[v] {
            cover_count[u] += 1;
        }
    }

    let mut forced = Vec::new();
    for v in 0..n {
        if cover_count[v] == 0 {
            let mut best = v;
            let mut best_deg = graph.degree[v];
            for &u in &graph.closed[v] {
                if graph.degree[u] > best_deg {
                    best = u;
                    best_deg = graph.degree[u];
                }
            }
            forced.push(best);
        }
    }

    forced.sort_unstable();
    forced.dedup();
    for v in forced {
        add_vertex(graph, v, &mut in_set, &mut cover_count);
    }

    let candidate: Vec<usize> = (0..n).filter(|&v| in_set[v]).collect();
    prune_solution(graph, candidate)
}

fn is_valid(graph: &Graph, solution: &[usize]) -> bool {
    let n = graph.n;
    let mut dominated = vec![false; n];
    for &v in solution {
        if v >= n {
            return false;
        }
        dominated[v] = true;
        for &u in &graph.adj[v] {
            dominated[u] = true;
        }
    }
    dominated.into_iter().all(|x| x)
}

fn solve(graph: &Graph) -> Vec<usize> {
    let n = graph.n;
    let mut order_deg_desc: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
    order_deg_desc.sort_unstable_by_key(|&v| (Reverse(graph.degree[v]), v));

    let mut order_deg_asc: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
    order_deg_asc.sort_unstable_by_key(|&v| (graph.degree[v], v));

    let mut best = prune_solution(graph, greedy_build(graph, &order_deg_desc));
    let alt = prune_solution(graph, greedy_build(graph, &order_deg_asc));
    if alt.len() < best.len() {
        best = alt;
    }

    let improved = improve_with_targeted_additions(graph, &best);
    if improved.len() < best.len() {
        best = improved;
    }

    if !is_valid(graph, &best) {
        let repaired = improve_with_targeted_additions(graph, &best);
        if is_valid(graph, &repaired) {
            best = repaired;
        } else {
            best = (0..n).collect();
        }
    }

    best.sort_unstable();
    best
}

fn main() {
    let graph = read_graph();
    let solution = solve(&graph);

    println!("{}", solution.len());
    if solution.is_empty() {
        println!();
    } else {
        for (i, v) in solution.iter().enumerate() {
            if i > 0 {
                print!(" ");
            }
            print!("{v}");
        }
        println!();
    }
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <numeric>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

class MaximumIndependentSetSolver {
public:
    explicit MaximumIndependentSetSolver(int n) : n_(n), adj_(n, vector<uint64_t>(blocksFor(n), 0)) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v) {
        if (u == v) return;
        setBit(adj_[u], v);
        setBit(adj_[v], u);
    }

    vector<int> solve() {
        if (n_ == 0) return {};
        buildComplement();
        vector<int> all(n_);
        iota(all.begin(), all.end(), 0);
        expand(all, {});
        return best_;
    }

private:
    int n_;
    vector<vector<uint64_t>> adj_;
    vector<vector<uint64_t>> comp_;
    vector<int> best_;

    static int blocksFor(int n) {
        return (n + 63) >> 6;
    }

    static void setBit(vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        bits[pos >> 6] |= 1ULL << (pos & 63);
    }

    static bool testBit(const vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        return (bits[pos >> 6] >> (pos & 63)) & 1ULL;
    }

    void buildComplement() {
        const int blocks = blocksFor(n_);
        comp_.assign(n_, vector<uint64_t>(blocks, 0));
        for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) {
            for (int b = 0; b < blocks; ++b) {
                comp_[v][b] = ~adj_[v][b];
            }
            comp_[v][v >> 6] &= ~(1ULL << (v & 63));
        }
        if (n_ & 63) {
            const uint64_t mask = (1ULL << (n_ & 63)) - 1ULL;
            for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) comp_[v].back() &= mask;
        }
    }

    vector<int> intersectNeighbors(const vector<int>& vertices, int v) const {
        vector<int> res;
        res.reserve(vertices.size());
        for (int u : vertices) {
            if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) res.push_back(u);
        }
        return res;
    }

    vector<int> greedyOrder(const vector<int>& vertices) const {
        vector<int> order = vertices;
        sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
            int da = 0, db = 0;
            for (int u : vertices) {
                da += testBit(comp_[a], u);
                db += testBit(comp_[b], u);
            }
            if (da != db) return da > db;
            return a < b;
        });
        return order;
    }

    void colorSort(const vector<int>& vertices, vector<int>& order, vector<int>& colors) const {
        order.clear();
        colors.clear();
        vector<int> remaining = greedyOrder(vertices);
        vector<int> colorClass;

        int color = 0;
        while (!remaining.empty()) {
            ++color;
            colorClass.clear();
            for (int v : remaining) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (int u : colorClass) {
                    if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) colorClass.push_back(v);
            }

            for (int v : colorClass) {
                order.push_back(v);
                colors.push_back(color);
            }

            vector<int> next;
            next.reserve(remaining.size() - colorClass.size());
            for (int v : remaining) {
                bool chosen = false;
                for (int u : colorClass) {
                    if (u == v) {
                        chosen = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!chosen) next.push_back(v);
            }
            remaining.swap(next);
        }
    }

    void expand(const vector<int>& candidates, vector<int> current) {
        if (candidates.empty()) {
            if (current.size() > best_.size()) best_ = std::move(current);
            return;
        }

        vector<int> order, colors;
        colorSort(candidates, order, colors);

        for (int i = static_cast<int>(order.size()) - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            if (current.size() + static_cast<size_t>(colors[i]) <= best_.size()) return;

            int v = order[i];
            current.push_back(v);
            vector<int> next = intersectNeighbors(candidates, v);
            if (current.size() + next.size() > best_.size()) {
                expand(next, current);
            } else if (current.size() > best_.size()) {
                best_ = current;
            }
            current.pop_back();
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    MaximumIndependentSetSolver solver(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (0 <= u && u < n && 0 <= v && v < n) solver.addEdge(u, v);
    }

    vector<int> independentSet = solver.solve();
    sort(independentSet.begin(), independentSet.end());

    cout << independentSet.size() << '\n';
    for (size_t i = 0; i < independentSet.size(); ++i) {
        if (i) cout << ' ';
        cout << independentSet[i];
    }
    cout << '\n';
    return 0;
}

    explicit MaximumIndependentSetSolver(int n) : n_(n), adj_(n, vector<uint64_t>(blocksFor(n), 0)) {}

        buildComplement();

    }

    vector<vector<uint64_t>> adj_;
    vector<vector<uint64_t>> comp_;
    vector<int> best_;

    static int blocksFor(int n) {

    }

    static void setBit(vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        bits[pos >> 6] |= 1ULL << (pos & 63);
    }

    static bool testBit(const vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        return (bits[pos >> 6] >> (pos & 63)) & 1ULL;
    }

            for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) comp_[v].back() &= mask;
        }
    }

    vector<int> intersectNeighbors(const vector<int>& vertices, int v) const {
        vector<int> res;
        res.reserve(vertices.size());
        for (int u : vertices) {
            if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) res.push_back(u);
        }
        return res;
    }

    vector<int> greedyOrder(const vector<int>& vertices) const {
        vector<int> order = vertices;
        sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {

            for (int u : vertices) {

                db += testBit(comp_[b], u);
            }
            if (da != db) return da > db;
            return a < b;
        });

        }

            if (current.size() + next.size() > best_.size()) {
                expand(next, current);
            } else if (current.size() > best_.size()) {
                best_ = current;
            }
            current.pop_back();
        }
    }
};

    static int blocksFor(int n) {
        return (n + 63) >> 6;
    }

    static void setBit(vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        bits[pos >> 6] |= 1ULL << (pos & 63);
    }

    static bool testBit(const vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        return (bits[pos >> 6] >> (pos & 63)) & 1ULL;
    }

    void buildComplement() {
        const int blocks = blocksFor(n_);
        comp_.assign(n_, vector<uint64_t>(blocks, 0));
        for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) {
            for (int b = 0; b < blocks; ++b) {
                comp_[v][b] = ~adj_[v][b];
            }
            comp_[v][v >> 6] &= ~(1ULL << (v & 63));
        }
        if (n_ & 63) {
            const uint64_t mask = (1ULL << (n_ & 63)) - 1ULL;
            for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) comp_[v].back() &= mask;
        }
    }

    vector<int> intersectNeighbors(const vector<int>& vertices, int v) const {
        vector<int> res;
        res.reserve(vertices.size());
        for (int u : vertices) {
            if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) res.push_back(u);
        }
        return res;
    }

    vector<int> greedyOrder(const vector<int>& vertices) const {
        vector<int> order = vertices;
        sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
            int da = 0, db = 0;
            for (int u : vertices) {
                da += testBit(comp_[a], u);
                db += testBit(comp_[b], u);
            }
            if (da != db) return da > db;
            return a < b;
        });
        return order;
    }

    void colorSort(const vector<int>& vertices, vector<int>& order, vector<int>& colors) const {
        order.clear();
        colors.clear();
        vector<int> remaining = greedyOrder(vertices);
        vector<int> colorClass;

        int color = 0;
        while (!remaining.empty()) {
            ++color;
            colorClass.clear();
            for (int v : remaining) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (int u : colorClass) {
                    if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) colorClass.push_back(v);
            }

            for (int v : colorClass) {
                order.push_back(v);
                colors.push_back(color);
            }

            vector<int> next;
            next.reserve(remaining.size() - colorClass.size());
            for (int v : remaining) {
                bool chosen = false;
                for (int u : colorClass) {
                    if (u == v) {
                        chosen = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!chosen) next.push_back(v);
            }
            remaining.swap(next);
        }
    }

    void expand(const vector<int>& candidates, vector<int> current) {
        if (candidates.empty()) {
            if (current.size() > best_.size()) best_ = std::move(current);
            return;
        }

        vector<int> order, colors;
        colorSort(candidates, order, colors);

        for (int i = static_cast<int>(order.size()) - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            if (current.size() + static_cast<size_t>(colors[i]) <= best_.size()) return;

            int v = order[i];
            current.push_back(v);
            vector<int> next = intersectNeighbors(candidates, v);
            if (current.size() + next.size() > best_.size()) {
                expand(next, current);
            } else if (current.size() > best_.size()) {
                best_ = current;
            }
            current.pop_back();
        }
    }
};

            } else if (current.size() > best_.size()) {

            }
            current.pop_back();
        }
    }
};
