#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <numeric>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

class MaximumIndependentSetSolver {
public:
    explicit MaximumIndependentSetSolver(int n) : n_(n), adj_(n, vector<uint64_t>(blocksFor(n), 0)) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v) {
        if (u == v) return;
        setBit(adj_[u], v);
        setBit(adj_[v], u);
    }

    vector<int> solve() {
        if (n_ == 0) return {};
        buildComplement();
        vector<int> all(n_);
        iota(all.begin(), all.end(), 0);
        expand(all, {});
        return best_;
    }

private:
    int n_;
    vector<vector<uint64_t>> adj_;
    vector<vector<uint64_t>> comp_;
    vector<int> best_;

    static int blocksFor(int n) {
        return (n + 63) >> 6;
    }

    static void setBit(vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        bits[pos >> 6] |= 1ULL << (pos & 63);
    }

    static bool testBit(const vector<uint64_t>& bits, int pos) {
        return (bits[pos >> 6] >> (pos & 63)) & 1ULL;
    }

    void buildComplement() {
        const int blocks = blocksFor(n_);
        comp_.assign(n_, vector<uint64_t>(blocks, 0));
        for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) {
            for (int b = 0; b < blocks; ++b) {
                comp_[v][b] = ~adj_[v][b];
            }
            comp_[v][v >> 6] &= ~(1ULL << (v & 63));
        }
        if (n_ & 63) {
            const uint64_t mask = (1ULL << (n_ & 63)) - 1ULL;
            for (int v = 0; v < n_; ++v) comp_[v].back() &= mask;
        }
    }

    vector<int> intersectNeighbors(const vector<int>& vertices, int v) const {
        vector<int> res;
        res.reserve(vertices.size());
        for (int u : vertices) {
            if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) res.push_back(u);
        }
        return res;
    }

    vector<int> greedyOrder(const vector<int>& vertices) const {
        vector<int> order = vertices;
        sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
            int da = 0, db = 0;
            for (int u : vertices) {
                da += testBit(comp_[a], u);
                db += testBit(comp_[b], u);
            }
            if (da != db) return da > db;
            return a < b;
        });
        return order;
    }

    void colorSort(const vector<int>& vertices, vector<int>& order, vector<int>& colors) const {
        order.clear();
        colors.clear();
        vector<int> remaining = greedyOrder(vertices);
        vector<int> colorClass;

        int color = 0;
        while (!remaining.empty()) {
            ++color;
            colorClass.clear();
            for (int v : remaining) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (int u : colorClass) {
                    if (testBit(comp_[v], u)) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) colorClass.push_back(v);
            }

            for (int v : colorClass) {
                order.push_back(v);
                colors.push_back(color);
            }

            vector<int> next;
            next.reserve(remaining.size() - colorClass.size());
            for (int v : remaining) {
                bool chosen = false;
                for (int u : colorClass) {
                    if (u == v) {
                        chosen = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!chosen) next.push_back(v);
            }
            remaining.swap(next);
        }
    }

    void expand(const vector<int>& candidates, vector<int> current) {
        if (candidates.empty()) {
            if (current.size() > best_.size()) best_ = std::move(current);
            return;
        }

        vector<int> order, colors;
        colorSort(candidates, order, colors);

        for (int i = static_cast<int>(order.size()) - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            if (current.size() + static_cast<size_t>(colors[i]) <= best_.size()) return;

            int v = order[i];
            current.push_back(v);
            vector<int> next = intersectNeighbors(candidates, v);
            if (current.size() + next.size() > best_.size()) {
                expand(next, current);
            } else if (current.size() > best_.size()) {
                best_ = current;
            }
            current.pop_back();
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    MaximumIndependentSetSolver solver(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (0 <= u && u < n && 0 <= v && v < n) solver.addEdge(u, v);
    }

    vector<int> independentSet = solver.solve();
    sort(independentSet.begin(), independentSet.end());

    cout << independentSet.size() << '\n';
    for (size_t i = 0; i < independentSet.size(); ++i) {
        if (i) cout << ' ';
        cout << independentSet[i];
    }
    cout << '\n';
    return 0;
}

import sys


def parse_input() -> tuple[int, list[set[int]]] | None:
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not lines:
        return None

    header = lines[0].split()
    if len(header) != 2:
        return None

    try:
        universe_size = int(header[0])
        set_count = int(header[1])
    except ValueError:
        return None

    if len(lines) < 1 + set_count:
        return None

    sets: list[set[int]] = []
    for i in range(set_count):
        raw = lines[1 + i].split()
        current: set[int] = set()
        for token in raw:
            try:
                value = int(token)
            except ValueError:
                return None
            if value < 0 or value >= universe_size:
                return None
            current.add(value)
        sets.append(current)

    return universe_size, sets


def solve_exact_cover(universe_size: int, sets: list[set[int]]) -> list[int] | None:
    element_to_sets: list[list[int]] = [[] for _ in range(universe_size)]
    for idx, current in enumerate(sets):
        for element in current:
            element_to_sets[element].append(idx)

    if universe_size == 0:
        return []

    for candidates in element_to_sets:
        if not candidates:
            return None

    chosen: list[int] = []
    covered = [False] * universe_size
    used = [False] * len(sets)

    def search(covered_count: int) -> bool:
        if covered_count == universe_size:
            return True

        target = -1
        target_candidates: list[int] | None = None
        best_count = None

        for element in range(universe_size):
            if covered[element]:
                continue

            candidates: list[int] = []
            for set_idx in element_to_sets[element]:
                if used[set_idx]:
                    continue
                current = sets[set_idx]
                valid = True
                for member in current:
                    if covered[member]:
                        valid = False
                        break
                if valid:
                    candidates.append(set_idx)

            if not candidates:
                return False

            count = len(candidates)
            if best_count is None or count < best_count:
                best_count = count
                target = element
                target_candidates = candidates
                if count == 1:
                    break

        assert target != -1 and target_candidates is not None

        # Deterministic ordering: smaller sets first, then lower index.
        target_candidates.sort(key=lambda idx: (len(sets[idx]), idx))

        for set_idx in target_candidates:
            used[set_idx] = True
            chosen.append(set_idx)

            newly_covered: list[int] = []
            for element in sets[set_idx]:
                covered[element] = True
                newly_covered.append(element)

            if search(covered_count + len(newly_covered)):
                return True

            for element in newly_covered:
                covered[element] = False
            chosen.pop()
            used[set_idx] = False

        return False

    if not search(0):
        return None

    chosen.sort()
    return chosen


def main() -> None:
    parsed = parse_input()
    if parsed is None:
        print("NO SOLUTION")
        return

    universe_size, sets = parsed
    solution = solve_exact_cover(universe_size, sets)

    if solution is None:
        print("NO SOLUTION")
        return

    print("SOLUTION")
    print(" ".join(map(str, solution)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    adj_list: Vec<Vec<usize>>,

    side: Vec<i8>, // -1 unassigned, 0 in A, 1 in B
    a_count: usize,
    b_count: usize,
    assigned_mask: u64,
    cut_so_far: i32,
    best_cut: i32,
    best_mask_a: u64,
}

impl Solver {
    fn new(n: usize, edges: &[(usize, usize)]) -> Self {
        let mut adj_mask = vec![0u64; n];
        let mut adj_list = vec![Vec::new(); n];
        for &(u, v) in edges {
            if u == v {
                continue;
            }
            let bu = 1u64 << u;
            let bv = 1u64 << v;
            if adj_mask[u] & bv == 0 {
                adj_mask[u] |= bv;
                adj_mask[v] |= bu;
                adj_list[u].push(v);
                adj_list[v].push(u);
            }
        }

        let mut order: Vec<usize> = (0..n).collect();
        order.sort_by_key(|&v| std::cmp::Reverse(adj_list[v].len()));

        Self {
            n,
            half: n / 2,
            adj_mask,
            adj_list,
            order,
            side: vec![-1; n],
            a_count: 0,
            b_count: 0,
            assigned_mask: 0,
            cut_so_far: 0,
            best_cut: i32::MAX,
            best_mask_a: 0,
        }
    }

    fn popcount(mask: u64) -> usize {
        mask.count_ones() as usize
    }

    fn assign(&mut self, v: usize, s: i8) -> i32 {
        let opposite_mask = if s == 0 {
            self.mask_of_side(1)
        } else {
            self.mask_of_side(0)
        };
        let added_cut = Self::popcount(self.adj_mask[v] & opposite_mask) as i32;
        self.side[v] = s;
        self.assigned_mask |= 1u64 << v;
        if s == 0 {
            self.a_count += 1;
        } else {
            self.b_count += 1;
        }
        self.cut_so_far += added_cut;
        added_cut
    }

    fn unassign(&mut self, v: usize, s: i8, added_cut: i32) {
        self.cut_so_far -= added_cut;
        if s == 0 {
            self.a_count -= 1;
        } else {
            self.b_count -= 1;
        }
        self.assigned_mask &= !(1u64 << v);
        self.side[v] = -1;
    }

    fn mask_of_side(&self, side_value: i8) -> u64 {
        let mut mask = 0u64;
        for v in 0..self.n {
            if self.side[v] == side_value {
                mask |= 1u64 << v;
            }
        }
        mask
    }

    fn lower_bound(&self) -> i32 {
        let rem_a = self.half - self.a_count;
        let mask_a = self.mask_of_side(0);
        let mask_b = self.mask_of_side(1);

        let mut forced = 0i32;
        let mut deltas = Vec::with_capacity(self.n);

        for v in 0..self.n {
            if self.side[v] != -1 {
                continue;
            }
            let to_a = Self::popcount(self.adj_mask[v] & mask_b) as i32;
            let to_b = Self::popcount(self.adj_mask[v] & mask_a) as i32;
            forced += to_a.min(to_b);
            deltas.push(to_a - to_b);
        }

        deltas.sort_unstable();
        let choose_a = rem_a;
        let mut balance_adjust = 0i32;
        for &delta in deltas.iter().take(choose_a) {
            balance_adjust += delta;
        }

        self.cut_so_far + forced + balance_adjust
    }

    fn current_a_mask(&self) -> u64 {
        self.mask_of_side(0)
    }

    fn choose_vertex(&self) -> Option<usize> {
        let mask_a = self.mask_of_side(0);
        let mask_b = self.mask_of_side(1);
        let mut best_v = None;
        let mut best_score = -1isize;

        for &v in &self.order {
            if self.side[v] != -1 {
                continue;
            }
            let score = Self::popcount(self.adj_mask[v] & (mask_a | mask_b)) as isize * 2
                + self.adj_list[v].len() as isize;
            if score > best_score {
                best_score = score;
                best_v = Some(v);
            }
        }
        best_v
    }

    fn dfs(&mut self) {
        if self.a_count > self.half || self.b_count > self.half {
            return;
        }
        if self.cut_so_far >= self.best_cut {
            return;
        }
        let lb = self.lower_bound();
        if lb >= self.best_cut {
            return;
        }

        if self.a_count == self.half && self.b_count == self.half {
            self.best_cut = self.cut_so_far;
            self.best_mask_a = self.current_a_mask();
            return;
        }

        let v = match self.choose_vertex() {
            Some(v) => v,
            None => return,
        };

        let mask_a = self.mask_of_side(0);
        let mask_b = self.mask_of_side(1);
        let cost_a = Self::popcount(self.adj_mask[v] & mask_b) as i32;
        let cost_b = Self::popcount(self.adj_mask[v] & mask_a) as i32;

        let mut branches = [(0i8, cost_a), (1i8, cost_b)];
        if cost_b < cost_a {
            branches.swap(0, 1);
        }

        for &(s, _) in &branches {
            if s == 0 && self.a_count == self.half {
                continue;
            }
            if s == 1 && self.b_count == self.half {
                continue;
            }
            let added = self.assign(v, s);
            self.dfs();
            self.unassign(v, s, added);
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).unwrap();
    let mut it = input.split_whitespace();

    let n: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    let m: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();

    assert!(n % 2 == 0, "n must be even");
    assert!(n <= 64, "this exact solver supports n <= 64");

    let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(m);
    for _ in 0..m {
        let u: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        let v: usize = it.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
        edges.push((u, v));
    }

    let mut solver = Solver::new(n, &edges);

    if n > 0 {
        solver.assign(0, 0);
    }
    solver.dfs();

    let mut part_a = Vec::new();
    for v in 0..n {
        if (solver.best_mask_a >> v) & 1 == 1 {
            part_a.push(v);
        }
    }
    part_a.sort_unstable();

    println!("{}", solver.best_cut);
    for (i, v) in part_a.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 {
            print!(" ");
        }
        print!("{}", v);
    }
    println!();
}

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <numeric>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

struct Solver {
    int n;
    vector<long long> weight;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;

    long long best_value = 0;
    vector<int> best_solution;

    vector<int> color;
    vector<long long> color_weight;

    explicit Solver(int n_) : n(n_), weight(n_), adj(n_), best_solution(n_, 0), color(n_, -1) {}

    long long greedy_coloring_bound(const vector<int>& vertices) {
        int used_colors = 0;
        fill(color.begin(), color.end(), -1);
        color_weight.assign(vertices.size(), 0);

        vector<int> order = vertices;
        sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
            if (adj[a].size() != adj[b].size()) return adj[a].size() > adj[b].size();
            return weight[a] > weight[b];
        });

        for (int v : order) {
            int chosen = 0;
            while (true) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (int to : adj[v]) {
                    if (color[to] == chosen) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) break;
                ++chosen;
            }
            color[v] = chosen;
            if (chosen == used_colors) {
                ++used_colors;
            }
            color_weight[chosen] = max(color_weight[chosen], weight[v]);
        }

        long long bound = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < used_colors; ++i) bound += color_weight[i];
        return bound;
    }

    void branch(vector<int>& candidates, vector<int>& current, long long current_value) {
        if (candidates.empty()) {
            if (current_value > best_value) {
                best_value = current_value;
                best_solution = current;
            }
            return;
        }

        long long upper_bound = current_value + greedy_coloring_bound(candidates);
        if (upper_bound <= best_value) return;

        int pick = candidates[0];
        for (int v : candidates) {
            if (weight[v] > weight[pick]) pick = v;
        }

        vector<int> next_with;
        next_with.reserve(candidates.size());
        vector<char> blocked(n, 0);
        blocked[pick] = 1;
        for (int to : adj[pick]) blocked[to] = 1;
        for (int v : candidates) {
            if (!blocked[v]) next_with.push_back(v);
        }

        current[pick] = 1;
        branch(next_with, current, current_value + weight[pick]);
        current[pick] = 0;

        vector<int> next_without;
        next_without.reserve(candidates.size() - 1);
        for (int v : candidates) {
            if (v != pick) next_without.push_back(v);
        }
        branch(next_without, current, current_value);
    }

    vector<int> solve() {
        vector<int> candidates(n);
        iota(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), 0);
        vector<int> current(n, 0);
        branch(candidates, current, 0);
        return best_solution;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    Solver solver(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> solver.weight[i];
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (u == v) continue;
        solver.adj[u].push_back(v);
        solver.adj[v].push_back(u);
    }

    vector<int> ans = solver.solve();
    long long objective = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (ans[i]) objective += solver.weight[i];
    }

    cout << objective << '\n';
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) cout << ' ';
        cout << ans[i];
    }
    cout << '\n';
    return 0;
}

            if (adj[a].size() != adj[b].size()) return adj[a].size() > adj[b].size();
            return weight[a] > weight[b];
        });

        for (int v : order) {
            int chosen = 0;
            while (true) {
                bool ok = true;
                for (int to : adj[v]) {
                    if (color[to] == chosen) {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (ok) break;
                ++chosen;
            }
            color[v] = chosen;
            if (chosen == used_colors) {
                ++used_colors;
            }
            color_weight[chosen] = max(color_weight[chosen], weight[v]);
        }

        long long bound = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < used_colors; ++i) bound += color_weight[i];
        return bound;
    }

    void branch(vector<int>& candidates, vector<int>& current, long long current_value) {
        if (candidates.empty()) {
            if (current_value > best_value) {
                best_value = current_value;
                best_solution = current;
            }
            return;
        }

        long long upper_bound = current_value + greedy_coloring_bound(candidates);
        if (upper_bound <= best_value) return;

        int pick = candidates[0];
        for (int v : candidates) {
            if (weight[v] > weight[pick]) pick = v;
        }

        vector<int> next_with;
        next_with.reserve(candidates.size());
        vector<char> blocked(n, 0);
        blocked[pick] = 1;
        for (int to : adj[pick]) blocked[to] = 1;
        for (int v : candidates) {
            if (!blocked[v]) next_with.push_back(v);
        }

        current[pick] = 1;
        branch(next_with, current, current_value + weight[pick]);
        current[pick] = 0;

        vector<int> next_without;
        next_without.reserve(candidates.size() - 1);
        for (int v : candidates) {
            if (v != pick) next_without.push_back(v);
        }
        branch(next_without, current, current_value);
    }

    vector<int> solve() {
        vector<int> candidates(n);
        iota(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), 0);
        vector<int> current(n, 0);
        branch(candidates, current, 0);
        return best_solution;
    }
};

You are writing a SPIR-V assembly text fragment shader. The shader will be assembled
with spirv-as (Vulkan 1.0 target) and rendered on a unit sphere.

**Available inputs (from vertex shader):**
```
layout(location = 0) in vec3 worldPos; ; world-space position
layout(location = 1) in vec3 normal; ; world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
layout(location = 2) in vec2 uv; ; texture coordinates in [0,1]
layout(location = 3) in vec3 tangent; ; tangent vector
layout(location = 4) in vec3 color; ; per-vertex color (smoothly varies: typical value: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
```

**Available uniform buffer (DescriptorSet 0, Binding 0):**
```
struct UBO { // std140 layout
mat4 model; // offset 0 (column-major)
mat4 view; // offset 64
mat4 projection; // offset 128
vec4 lightPos; // offset 192 -- typical value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
vec4 cameraPos; // offset 208 -- typical value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
vec4 params; // offset 224 -- typical value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};
```

**Required output:**
```
layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor; RGBA float, will be stored as rgba8unorm
```

**SPIR-V requirements:**
- Start with `; SPIR-V` header comment and version
- Use `OpCapability Shader` and `OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450`
- Use `OpEntryPoint Fragment %main "main"` listing ALL input/output variables used
- Use `OpExecutionMode %main OriginUpperLeft`
- Declare all necessary decorations (Location, DescriptorSet, Binding, Block, Offsets)
- All input variables are `Input` storage class, output is `Output` storage class
- The uniform buffer variable is `Uniform` storage class
- Entry point function name must be "main"

**Write ONLY the complete SPIR-V assembly text.** Do not include any other text or explanation
outside the SPIR-V text.


**Task:** Output a solid red color (vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)).

Test 42: Geometry Shaders (SPIR-V Assembly) Score: 8.91 / 15
Typical Prompt:
You are writing a SPIR-V assembly geometry shader. It will be assembled with
spirv-as (Vulkan 1.0) and rendered using a fixed vertex shader and fragment shader.

**Geometry shader requirements:**
- `OpCapability Geometry`
- `OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450`
- `OpEntryPoint Geometry %main "main"` listing ALL interface variables
- `OpExecutionMode %main ` (InputPoints/InputLines/Triangles/InputLinesAdjacency/InputTrianglesAdjacency)
- `OpExecutionMode %main ` (OutputPoints/OutputLineStrip/OutputTriangleStrip)
- `OpExecutionMode %main OutputVertices ` (max vertices emitted)
- `OpExecutionMode %main Invocations 1`

**Input from vertex shader (per-vertex arrays):**
The input gl_Position is in a gl_PerVertex block (must be decorated with Block + BuiltIn Position).
```
%gl_PerVertex_in = OpTypeStruct %v4float
OpDecorate %gl_PerVertex_in Block
OpMemberDecorate %gl_PerVertex_in 0 BuiltIn Position
; Array size depends on input primitive:
; InputPoints: 1, InputLines: 2, Triangles: 3
; InputLinesAdjacency: 4, InputTrianglesAdjacency: 6
%arr_pv_in = OpTypeArray %gl_PerVertex_in %uint_N
%ptr_in_arr_pv = OpTypePointer Input %arr_pv_in
%gl_in = OpVariable %ptr_in_arr_pv Input
; Access: OpAccessChain %ptr_in_v4 %gl_in %int_i %int_0 -> gl_in[i].gl_Position
```

User-defined inputs are also arrays of the same size:
```
layout(location = 0) in vec3 worldPos[]; ; positions in clip space
layout(location = 1) in vec3 normal[]; ; vertex normals
layout(location = 2) in vec3 color[]; ; per-vertex colors
```

**Output (per emitted vertex):**
The output gl_Position is in a gl_PerVertex block:
```
%gl_PerVertex_out = OpTypeStruct %v4float
OpDecorate %gl_PerVertex_out Block
OpMemberDecorate %gl_PerVertex_out 0 BuiltIn Position
%ptr_out_pv = OpTypePointer Output %gl_PerVertex_out
%gl_out = OpVariable %ptr_out_pv Output
; Store: OpAccessChain %ptr_out_v4 %gl_out %int_0 -> gl_out.gl_Position
```
```
layout(location = 0) out vec3 outColor; ; color for fragment shader
```

**Emit vertices with:** `OpEmitVertex` after storing gl_Position and outColor.
**End primitive with:** `OpEndPrimitive` after emitting a complete strip.

**Available UBO (set=0, binding=0) - accessible from geometry shader:**
Same layout as test 41 (model/view/proj matrices, lightPos, cameraPos, params).

**Write ONLY the complete SPIR-V assembly text for the geometry shader.**


**Input primitive:** InputPoints (1 vertex per invocation, array size 1)
**Geometry:** 25 colored points in a 5x5 grid spread across [-0.8, 0.8].

**Task:** Expand each point into a small colored quad (4 vertices as triangle strip).
1. Read gl_in[0].gl_Position (the point position).
2. Read color[0] (the point's color).
3. Define a half-size: h = 0.04.
4. Emit 4 vertices forming a quad centered on the point:
- (x-h, y-h), (x+h, y-h), (x-h, y+h), (x+h, y+h)
- All with z=0, w=1, and the same color.
5. Output as triangle strip, max 4 vertices.
 Prompt Changes:
Prompt parameters change between subpasses (increasing difficulty)

Typical Prompt:
You are writing an HLSL pixel (fragment) shader for Vulkan. The shader will be
compiled with glslangValidator (-D flag for HLSL mode) targeting Vulkan 1.0,
then rendered on a unit sphere.

**Available inputs (from vertex shader, using Vulkan layout attributes):**
```hlsl
struct PSInput {
[[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0; // world-space position
[[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal : TEXCOORD1; // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
[[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv : TEXCOORD2; // texture coordinates in [0,1]
[[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent : TEXCOORD3; // tangent vector
[[vk::location(4)]] float3 color : TEXCOORD4; // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};
```

**Available constant buffer (set 0, binding 0):**
```hlsl
[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
float4x4 model; // offset 0 (column-major)
float4x4 view; // offset 64
float4x4 projection; // offset 128
float4 lightPos; // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
float4 cameraPos; // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
float4 params; // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};
```

**Required output:**
```hlsl
float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0 // RGBA float, stored as rgba8unorm
```

**HLSL requirements:**
- Use Vulkan-specific attributes: `[[vk::location(N)]]` for inputs, `[[vk::binding(B, S)]]` for UBO
- Entry point must be named `main`
- Return type is `float4` with `SV_Target0` semantic
- Standard HLSL intrinsics are available: normalize, dot, reflect, pow, max, clamp, lerp, etc.
- Use `mul()` for matrix-vector operations if needed

**Write ONLY the complete HLSL source code.** Do not include any other text or explanation
outside the shader source.


**Task:** Output a solid red color (float4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)).

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;
    float4x4 view;
    float4x4 projection;
    float4 lightPos;
    float4 cameraPos;
    float4 params;
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float2 c = float2(input.uv.x * 3.0 - 2.0, input.uv.y * 2.0 - 1.0);
    float2 z = float2(0.0, 0.0);
    int iterations = 20;

    [loop]
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
        float2 zNext = float2(
            z.x * z.x - z.y * z.y + c.x,
            2.0 * z.x * z.y + c.y
        );
        z = zNext;

        if (dot(z, z) > 4.0) {
            iterations = i + 1;
            break;
        }
    }

    float t = iterations / 20.0;
    return float4(t, t * 0.5, 1.0 - t, 1.0);
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing a SPIR-V fragment shader as raw binary data, encoded as a hex string.
The binary will be decoded from hex, validated with spirv-val, and rendered on a unit sphere.

**SPIR-V Binary Format (little-endian 32-bit words):**
Each 32-bit word is 8 hex characters (little-endian byte order).

Header (5 words):
```
03022307 // Magic number 0x07230203 (little-endian)
00000100 // Version 1.0 (0x00010000)
00000000 // Generator (0 = manual)
BBBBBBBB // Bound (max ID + 1)
00000000 // Reserved
```

Instructions follow as: first word = (WordCount << 16) | Opcode, then operands.

**Key opcodes (decimal):**
- OpCapability (17): word_count=2, operand=capability (1=Shader)
- OpExtInstImport (11): result_id, name_string
- OpMemoryModel (14): word_count=3, addressing=0(Logical), model=1(GLSL450)
- OpEntryPoint (15): execution_model=4(Fragment), entry_id, name, interface_vars...
- OpExecutionMode (16): entry_id, mode=7(OriginUpperLeft)
- OpDecorate (71): target, decoration, operands
- OpTypeVoid (19), OpTypeFunction (33), OpTypeFloat (22), OpTypeVector (23)
- OpTypePointer (32), OpVariable (59), OpConstant (43)
- OpFunction (54), OpFunctionEnd (56), OpLabel (248)
- OpLoad (61), OpStore (62), OpReturn (253)
- OpCompositeConstruct (80), OpCompositeExtract (81)
- OpDot (148), OpFMul (133), OpFAdd (129), OpFSub (131), OpFNegate (127)
- OpExtInst (12): GLSL.std.450 ext instructions

**Decoration values:** Location=30, DescriptorSet=34, Binding=33, Block=2, Offset=35

**Available inputs (from vertex shader):**
```
location 0: vec3 worldPos
location 1: vec3 normal
location 2: vec2 uv
location 3: vec3 tangent
location 4: vec3 color
```

**UBO (set=0, binding=0):** mat4 model(0), mat4 view(64), mat4 projection(128),
vec4 lightPos(192), vec4 cameraPos(208), vec4 params(224).

**Required output:** location 0: vec4 outColor

**Write ONLY the complete hex string of the SPIR-V binary.** Each byte as two hex
characters, no spaces or newlines within the hex data. The hex string represents
the raw bytes of the .spv file.

Test 46: N-Body Gravitational Simulation (GLSL Compute) Score: 0.00 / 6
Typical Prompt:
Write a GLSL compute shader for gravitational N-body simulation.

**GLSL Compute Shader Interface:**

```
#version 450

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

// Each body is stored as two consecutive vec4s:
// vec4(position.xyz, mass)
// vec4(velocity.xyz, 0.0)
// So body i starts at index i*2 in the buffer.

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) readonly buffer InputBodies {
vec4 inData[]; // length = N * 2
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 1) buffer OutputBodies {
vec4 outData[]; // length = N * 2
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 2) uniform Params {
uvec4 counts; // counts.x = N (number of bodies)
vec4 physics; // physics.x = dt, physics.y = softening, physics.z = G
};
```

**Task:** Write a compute shader that performs ONE timestep of gravitational
N-body simulation using the leapfrog/Euler integration method. Each invocation
handles one body (gl_GlobalInvocationID.x), reading its position and velocity
from inData and writing updated values to outData. The acceleration should be
computed from all other bodies using:

acc += G * mass_j * (pos_j - pos_i) / (|pos_j - pos_i|^2 + softening^2)^(3/2)

Velocity is advanced by acc * dt and position is advanced by vel * dt. The
shader will be dispatched ceil(N/256) workgroups in X and run multiple times
with ping-pong buffers for the required number of timesteps.

**Critical Requirements:**
- Guard against gl_GlobalInvocationID.x >= N
- Use the softening parameter to avoid singularities
- Skip self-interaction (i == j)
- Write BOTH position+mass and velocity vec4s to output


**Test Configurations:**

Test 47: Hash Mining / Proof of Work (WGSL Compute) Score: 4.00 / 5
Typical Prompt:
Write a WGSL compute shader for hash mining (proof-of-work).

**WGSL Compute Shader Interface:**

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var baseData : array;
@group(0) @binding(1) var result : array;
@group(0) @binding(2) var params : vec4;
// params.x = difficulty, params.y = range_start, params.z = range_size

@compute @workgroup_size(256)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid : vec3) { ... }
```

**Task:** Write a compute shader that searches for a uint32 nonce such that
the custom hash of (baseData XOR nonce) has at least `difficulty` trailing
zero bits in the 64-bit output.

**Hash function (MUST match exactly):**
```
function custom_hash(data[16], nonce) -> (h0, h1):
state[0..15] = data[0..15]
for i in 0..15: state[i] ^= (nonce + i)

// 8 rounds of quarter-round mixing (ChaCha-like)
repeat 8 times:
for each group of 4 consecutive elements (i, i+1, i+2, i+3):
a += b; d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 16)
c += d; b ^= c; b = rotl(b, 12)
a += b; d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 8)
c += d; b ^= c; b = rotl(b, 7)

// Fold 16 words to 2:
h0 = state[0] ^ state[2] ^ state[4] ^ state[6] ^ state[8] ^ state[10] ^ state[12] ^ state[14]
h1 = state[1] ^ state[3] ^ state[5] ^ state[7] ^ state[9] ^ state[11] ^ state[13] ^ state[15]
return (h0, h1) // h0 is low 32 bits
```

**Trailing zero count:** Count trailing zero bits of the 64-bit value [h0 | (h1 << 32)].
That is, count from h0's LSB first; if h0 == 0, add 32 and continue counting from h1.

**Algorithm:**
1. Each thread computes: my_nonce = params.y + gid.x (range_start + thread ID)
2. Guard: if gid.x >= params.z, return (out of range)
3. Compute hash, count trailing zeros
4. If trailing_zeros >= difficulty:
Write result[0]=1u, result[1]=nonce, result[2]=h0, result[3]=h1
(Race writes are acceptable - any valid nonce will be verified on CPU)

**Important WGSL notes:**
- Use `var state : array` for the mutable hash state.
- WGSL rotation: `(x << shift) | (x >> (32u - shift))` — all values must be u32.
- The inner quarter-round loop MUST be unrolled (write out all 4 groups
of state[0..3], state[4..7], state[8..11], state[12..15] explicitly).
- Do NOT use atomics. Plain stores to result[] are sufficient.
- All integer literals must be typed: use `0u`, `1u`, `16u`, `32u` etc.

The shader will be dispatched with ceil(range_size / 256) workgroups.
Only ONE dispatch is performed - find the nonce in a single pass.

Test 48: 2D Fluid Simulation - Lattice Boltzmann (SPIR-V ASM Compute) Score: 0.00 / 5
Typical Prompt:
Write a SPIR-V assembly compute shader for 2D Lattice Boltzmann fluid simulation.

**SPIR-V Assembly Compute Shader Interface:**

The shader uses the D2Q9 Lattice Boltzmann model for 2D fluid simulation.

**D2Q9 velocity directions (index k -> (cx, cy)):**
```
k=0: ( 0, 0) w=4/9 (rest)
k=1: ( 1, 0) w=1/9 (east)
k=2: ( 0, 1) w=1/9 (north)
k=3: (-1, 0) w=1/9 (west)
k=4: ( 0,-1) w=1/9 (south)
k=5: ( 1, 1) w=1/36 (NE)
k=6: (-1, 1) w=1/36 (NW)
k=7: (-1,-1) w=1/36 (SW)
k=8: ( 1,-1) w=1/36 (SE)
```

**Buffer layout:**
- Binding 0 (storage, read-only): float array, length W*H*9
Index = (y * W + x) * 9 + k
- Binding 1 (storage, read-write): float array, length W*H*9 (output, NOT writeonly)
- Binding 2 (uniform): { uvec4(W, H, 0, 0), vec4(omega, 0, 0, 0) }

**Algorithm (per cell at gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy):**
Compute one LBM step (collision + streaming) for each lattice cell. Guard against
out-of-bounds (x >= W or y >= H). For the cell distributions f[0..8], compute
macroscopic density rho and velocity (ux, uy) using the D2Q9 directions. Apply
the BGK collision update with:

cu = cx[k]*ux + cy[k]*uy
feq = w[k] * rho * (1 + 3*cu + 4.5*cu*cu - 1.5*(ux*ux + uy*uy))
f_out = f[k] + omega * (feq - f[k])

Then stream each f_out to the neighbor cell (x+cx[k], y+cy[k]) with periodic
wraparound in both axes. Write to the output buffer at the corresponding
neighbor index for k.

**SPIR-V requirements:**
- OpCapability Shader
- OpExecutionMode with LocalSize 16 16 1
- Use gl_GlobalInvocationID for (x, y)
- Declare runtime arrays for storage buffers with OpDecorate ArrayStride 4
- Use OpSMod or manual modulo for periodic boundary conditions

Test 49: Parallel Prefix Sum (SPIR-V Binary Compute) Score: 0.00 / 5
Typical Prompt:
Write a SPIR-V binary compute shader (hex-encoded) for parallel inclusive prefix sum.

**SPIR-V Binary (hex-encoded) Compute Shader Interface:**

You must produce raw SPIR-V binary encoded as a hex string (no spaces, no 0x prefix).
The binary must start with the SPIR-V magic number 0x07230203.

**Required layout:**
```
Binding 0 (set=0): Storage buffer (read-only) - uint array, length N
Binding 1 (set=0): Storage buffer (read-write) - uint array, length N
Binding 2 (set=0): Uniform buffer - uint4: [N, 0, 0, 0]

Local size: 256 x 1 x 1
```

**Algorithm:** Inclusive prefix sum (scan)
- Input: [a0, a1, a2, a3, ...]
- Output: [a0, a0+a1, a0+a1+a2, a0+a1+a2+a3, ...]

Compute an inclusive scan over the input array. For N <= 256, use a shared-memory
scan within a single workgroup (synchronize as needed). For N > 256, a naive
fallback (each thread sums all previous elements) is acceptable but slow; full
marks require a multi-workgroup scan.

**SPIR-V binary encoding notes:**
- Little-endian uint32 words
- Magic: 0x07230203
- Version: 0x00010000 (1.0)
- Bound: upper bound on all IDs used + 1
- Schema: 0
- OpCapability Shader = [0x00020011, 0x00000001]
- OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450 = [0x00030006, 0x00000001, 0x00000001]
- OpEntryPoint GLCompute = opcode 0x0000000F, execution model 5
- OpExecutionMode LocalSize = opcode 0x00000010, mode 17 (LocalSize)
- OpDecorate Binding = decoration 33
- OpDecorate DescriptorSet = decoration 34
- OpDecorate ArrayStride = decoration 6
- OpDecorate BufferBlock or Block = decoration 2 or 3
- OpTypeInt 32 0 = unsigned int
- OpTypePointer StorageBuffer = storage class 12
- OpVariable StorageBuffer = storage class 12

Encode every uint32 word as exactly 8 hex characters (little-endian).

```
throttle_2: 0.0 (idle) to 1.0 (full thrust) — right engine

```

altitude is climbing - two failures have occured, and you have to pick wisely.
2. **Aerodynamic simulation**: The flight model includes a full aerodynamic model, so
brush up on your knowledge of stalls, asymetric thurst, yaw dampening, and trim.
5. Vne is (~365 KIAS / Mach 0.82).
6. **Persistence**: You may define module-level variables for PID integral terms,
previous values, etc. They persist across calls within a scenario.

historical aviation accidents. The same code is tested against every scenario.

Key facts:
- Wheel speed sensors (4): FL, FR, RL, RR in km/h. Any can fail.
- Gyroscopes (3): yaw rate in degrees/second. Any can fail silently.
- Accelerometers (3): longitudinal and lateral in m/s². Any can fail.
- GPS (2): position in meters, speed in km/h. Can lose signal.
- Lidar (12 beams): range in meters at angles from -90° to +90°.
- Vision (3 independent systems): lane line distances, types (solid/dashed),
obstacle detection (bool + distance + relative speed), speed limit signs,
lane offset, road curvature. ANY can fail or flicker!
- `estimated_mu`: estimated tire-road friction (1.0=dry, <0.3=ice).
- `target_speed_kmh`: desired speed. `target_lane`: desired lane (0-2).
- `*_valid` flags exist but may be WRONG on failed sensors.
- Sensors can FLICKER: randomly return invalid data for a few frames.

**Output:** Return a dict:
```
steering: -1.0 (full left) to +1.0 (full right)
0.0 = straight ahead
throttle: 0.0 (no power) to 1.0 (full power)
brake: 0.0 (no brake) to 1.0 (emergency stop)
```
If you omit a key, the current value is maintained.

**Critical Design Requirements:**
1. **Sensor fusion**: Cross-check redundant sensors. Median/voting for disagreements.
2. **Lane keeping**: Stay centered in lane using vision line distances and lidar.
3. **Speed control**: Maintain target speed, respect speed limits.
4. **Obstacle avoidance**: If obstacle detected, brake and/or lane change.
5. **Traction management**: On low-mu surfaces, reduce speed, gentler inputs.
6. **Graceful degradation**: Handle sensor failures, flickering data.
7. **Persistence**: Module-level variables persist across calls for filtering/PID.

**Test Scenarios (25 total):**
0. Normal highway cruise
1. Gentle curve
2. Slow vehicle ahead
3. Emergency stop — stopped vehicle
4. Cut-in from adjacent lane
5. Ice patch — reduced traction
6. Aquaplaning — very low friction
7. Wheel speed sensor failure (FL)
8. Two wheel speed sensors fail
9. Gyro sensor failure
10. GPS signal lost
11. Vision system 1 failure
12. All vision systems flickering
13. Front lidar beams fail
14. Steering angle sensors disagree
15. Total brake failure
16. Throttle stuck at 30%
17. Road debris
18. Dense traffic
19. Crosswind gust
20. Steering partially jammed
21. Ice + stopped vehicle
22. Flickering sensors in curve
23. Reduced visibility
24. Multi-failure + obstacle

Your single autopilot function must handle ALL scenarios.

Test 53: Spacecraft Orbital Docking Autopilot (Python) Score: 0.00 / 25
Typical Prompt:
Write a Python autopilot to dock a spacecraft with a space station in orbit.

**CRITICAL ORBITAL MECHANICS INSIGHT:**
In orbit, relative motion is COUNTER-INTUITIVE:
- Thrusting TOWARD the target (prograde if behind) raises your orbit → you SLOW DOWN relative to target
- To catch up: thrust RETROGRADE (backward!) to lower orbit → you go FASTER
- Radial thrusts cause oscillation, not direct movement
- Cross-track corrections require thrusts at specific orbital positions
- Near the target (<50m), approximate as linear (CW equations work)
- Far away (>200m), full orbital mechanics dominate

```python
def autopilot_step(state: dict, dt: float) -> dict:
```

Key sensor notes:
- Relative position/velocity in LVLH frame: x=radial (up), y=along-track (velocity dir), z=cross-track
- NEGATIVE y = behind station (most common start). Must CLOSE the y gap.
- Range finders give scalar distance. Radar/lidar give 3D relative pos/vel.
- All sensors can fail silently! Cross-check redundant sensors.
- Docking camera only active within 500m. Gives bearing to docking port.
- Ground station data updates every ~30s (stale but reliable).

**Output:** Return a dict:
```
thrust_x: -1.0 to +1.0 (radial: + = away from Earth)
thrust_y: -1.0 to +1.0 (along-track: + = prograde)
thrust_z: -1.0 to +1.0 (cross-track: + = north)
att_rate_roll: rad/s (max ±0.035)
att_rate_pitch: rad/s (max ±0.035)
att_rate_yaw: rad/s (max ±0.035)
```
Each thrust axis: 220N per thruster, Isp=290s. Fuel is LIMITED (~500 kg).

**Docking Success Criteria:**
- Range < 2m AND relative speed < 0.3 m/s

**Approach Strategy Hints:**
1. Far (>200m): Use Hohmann-like transfer — retrograde to lower orbit if behind
2. Medium (50-200m): Gentle corrections, V-bar approach preferred
3. Close (<50m): Linear regime, direct thrust corrections OK
4. Final (<10m): Very gentle, < 0.1 m/s approach speed

**Test Scenarios (25 total):**

1. V-bar approach — 500m behind
2. V-bar close approach — 50m

21. Cross-track + radar failure
22. Higher orbit — 450km

**ILS Approach Key Concepts:**
- `glideslope_N_dots`: deviation from 3° glideslope (+above/-below), 3 receivers
- `localizer_N_dots`: deviation from runway centerline (+right/-left), 3 receivers
- `radio_alt_ft`: height above ground (critical for flare)
- `dme_N_nm`: distance to runway threshold
- `weight_on_wheels`: True when landed
- `target_vref_kt`: reference approach speed (typically 137kt)
- `decision_height_ft`: minimum altitude to continue approach (200ft CAT I)
- Elevator command 0 = trimmed flight. Positive = pitch up.

**Output:** Return a dict with any of:
```
elevator: -1.0 (nose down) to +1.0 (nose up), relative to trim
aileron: -1.0 (roll left) to +1.0 (roll right)
rudder: -1.0 (yaw left) to +1.0 (yaw right)
throttle_1: 0.0 to 1.0 (left engine)
throttle_2: 0.0 to 1.0 (right engine)
elevator_trim: -1.0 to +1.0
flaps: degrees (0-40)
gear: 0.0 (up) or 1.0 (down)
speedbrake: 0.0 (retracted) to 1.0 (full)
spoiler: 0.0 or 1.0 (ground spoilers, deploy after touchdown)
autobrake: 0.0 to 1.0 (braking force after touchdown)
reverse_1: 0.0 to 1.0 (left engine reverse thrust)
reverse_2: 0.0 to 1.0 (right engine reverse thrust)
```

**Approach Phases:**
1. **Intercept** (>1000ft): Track glideslope and localizer, configure for landing
2. **Approach** (1000ft-200ft): Stabilise on glideslope, speed, config
3. **Flare** (<50ft radio alt): Reduce descent rate, idle thrust
4. **Touchdown & Rollout**: Deploy spoilers, reverse thrust, autobrake

**Go-Around:**
If the approach is unstable or unsafe, abort the landing:
- Apply TOGA thrust (throttle 1.0), pitch up, retract speedbrake
- Climb to 1500ft AGL — this completes the go-around
- The sim will then **restart** from a stable approach position with the
**same failures and weather**. Your autopilot must land on the retry.
- Each go-around costs a **0.1 point penalty** on a perfect landing.
- After **10 go-arounds** the scenario fails (score 0.0).

**Scoring:**
- **1.0** — Normal landing: stopped on the runway, or slowed below 50kt
with >30% runway remaining (pilot takes over to taxi).
Minus 0.1 per go-around.
- **0.5** — Hard landing: touchdown vertical speed 360–600 fpm.
Aircraft needs inspection but is reusable, everyone walks away.
- **0.1** — Minor overrun: aircraft rolls off the end but is caught by the
EMAS arrestor bed (within 150m past runway end). Everyone safe,
aircraft damaged.
- **0.0** — Catastrophic: touchdown >600 fpm, major overrun
beyond EMAS, runway excursion, CFIT, or failure to land. Write-off or
loss of life.

**Test Scenarios (25 total):**

1. Short final — 3nm
2. High on glideslope
3. Low on glideslope
4. Offset from centerline

9. CAT III low visibility

21. Missed approach required
22. Severe turbulence on final
23. ILS signal flickering
24. Engine failure + crosswind + wet runway [Multiple incidents]

Typical Prompt:
Write a C++ chess bot that for any given chess position, returns the best move to make (or the best
move you can find before the timeout).

You receive the chess position as a string in FEN notation, and you must return the move in
disambiguated algebraic notation (including the starting square, piece type, and destination square).

See:
- https://www.chess.com/terms/fen-chess

Here is an example FEN representing the starting position with white to move:
```
rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
```

Here is an example disambiguated algebraic move:
```
pe2e4
```
This represents the king's pawn opening - moving the pawn from e2 to e4.

**Move notation rules:**
- Piece letter (lowercase p for pawn, uppercase N/B/R/Q/K for others) + source square + destination square.
- Use "x" between source and destination for captures: `pe4xd5`
- Promotion: append `/` and the piece letter, e.g. `pe7e8/Q`
- Castling: `O-O` (kingside) or `O-O-O` (queenside).
- En passant: append `ep`, e.g. `pe5xd6ep`
- Check: append `+`, e.g. `Bb4c5+`
- Checkmate: append `#`, e.g. `Qd1h5#`

**Input format (stdin, two lines):**
```
timeout_in_seconds
fen_string
```

**Output format (stdout, one line):**
```
move_in_disambiguated_algebraic
```

timeout_in_seconds will be at least 5. Your code will be compiled with full optimisations and
run on a machine with multiple cores, so threading is encouraged.

const fs = require('fs');
const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

function solve(instance) {
  const depot = instance.depot;
  const packages = Array.isArray(instance.packages) ? instance.packages : [];
  const n = packages.length;
  if (n === 0) {
    return { routes: [] };
  }

  const truckCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number.isFinite(instance.truckCount) ? Math.floor(instance.truckCount) : 1, n));
  const depotX = +depot[0];
  const depotY = +depot[1];

  const pts = new Array(n);
  let sumX = 0;
  let sumY = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = packages[i];
    const x = +p.x;
    const y = +p.y;
    const dx = x - depotX;
    const dy = y - depotY;
    const radius = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    pts[i] = {
      idx: i,
      id: p.id,
      x,
      y,
      dx,
      dy,
      radius,
      angle
    };
    sumX += x;
    sumY += y;
  }

  const centroidX = sumX / n;
  const centroidY = sumY / n;
  const orient = Math.atan2(centroidY - depotY, centroidX - depotX);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let rel = pts[i].angle - orient;
    while (rel <= -Math.PI) rel += Math.PI * 2;
    while (rel > Math.PI) rel -= Math.PI * 2;
    pts[i].relAngle = rel;
  }

  pts.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.relAngle !== b.relAngle) return a.relAngle - b.relAngle;
    if (a.radius !== b.radius) return a.radius - b.radius;
    return a.idx - b.idx;
  });

  const targetSizes = balancedSizes(n, truckCount);
  let routes = buildInitialRoutes(pts, targetSizes);
  routes = optimizeRouteOrder(routes, depotX, depotY);
  routes = improveBoundaries(routes, depotX, depotY);
  routes = optimizeRouteOrder(routes, depotX, depotY);

  return {
    routes: routes.filter(route => route.length > 0).map(route => route.map(p => p.id))
  };
}

function balancedSizes(total, groups) {
  const base = Math.floor(total / groups);
  const extra = total % groups;
  const out = new Array(groups);
  for (let i = 0; i < groups; i++) {
    out[i] = base + (i < extra ? 1 : 0);
  }
  return out;
}

function buildInitialRoutes(sortedPts, targetSizes) {
  const routes = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < targetSizes.length; i++) {
    const size = targetSizes[i];
    const route = new Array(size);
    for (let j = 0; j < size; j++) {
      route[j] = sortedPts[cursor++];
    }
    routes.push(route);
  }
  return routes;
}

function optimizeRouteOrder(routes, depotX, depotY) {
  const out = new Array(routes.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < routes.length; i++) {
    out[i] = optimizeSingleRoute(routes[i], depotX, depotY);
  }
  return out;
}

function optimizeSingleRoute(route, depotX, depotY) {
  const m = route.length;
  if (m <= 2) return route.slice();

  let best = route.slice();
  let improved = true;
  while (improved) {
    improved = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < m - 1; i++) {
      const prev = i === 0 ? null : best[i - 1];
      const a = best[i];
      for (let k = i + 1; k < m; k++) {
        const b = best[k];
        const next = k === m - 1 ? null : best[k + 1];
        const before =
          distNode(prev, a, depotX, depotY) +
          distNode(b, next, depotX, depotY);
        const after =
          distNode(prev, b, depotX, depotY) +
          distNode(a, next, depotX, depotY);
        if (after + 1e-9 < before) {
          reverseSegment(best, i, k);
          improved = true;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  let bestCost = routeCost(best, depotX, depotY);
  for (let shift = 1; shift < m; shift++) {
    const rotated = rotateRoute(best, shift);
    const rotatedCost = routeCost(rotated, depotX, depotY);
    const reversed = rotated.slice().reverse();
    const reversedCost = routeCost(reversed, depotX, depotY);
    if (rotatedCost + 1e-9 < bestCost) {
      best = rotated;
      bestCost = rotatedCost;
    }
    if (reversedCost + 1e-9 < bestCost) {
      best = reversed;
      bestCost = reversedCost;
    }
  }
  return best;
}

function improveBoundaries(routes, depotX, depotY) {
  const result = routes.map(route => route.slice());
  let changed = true;
  while (changed) {
    changed = false;
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < result.length; i++) {
      const left = result[i];
      const right = result[i + 1];
      const best = bestBoundaryAdjustment(left, right, depotX, depotY);
      if (best.changed) {
        result[i] = optimizeSingleRoute(best.left, depotX, depotY);
        result[i + 1] = optimizeSingleRoute(best.right, depotX, depotY);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}

function bestBoundaryAdjustment(left, right, depotX, depotY) {
  const currentCost = routeCost(left, depotX, depotY) + routeCost(right, depotX, depotY);
  let bestCost = currentCost;
  let bestLeft = left;
  let bestRight = right;

  for (let takeLeft = 0; takeLeft <= Math.min(2, left.length); takeLeft++) {
    for (let takeRight = 0; takeRight <= Math.min(2, right.length); takeRight++) {
      if (takeLeft === 0 && takeRight === 0) continue;
      if (takeLeft === left.length && takeRight === right.length) continue;

      const leftKeep = left.slice(0, left.length - takeLeft);
      const leftMove = left.slice(left.length - takeLeft);
      const rightMove = right.slice(0, takeRight);
      const rightKeep = right.slice(takeRight);
      const newLeft = leftKeep.concat(rightMove);
      const newRight = leftMove.concat(rightKeep);

      if (newLeft.length === 0 || newRight.length === 0) continue;

      const optLeft = optimizeSingleRoute(newLeft, depotX, depotY);
      const optRight = optimizeSingleRoute(newRight, depotX, depotY);
      const cost = routeCost(optLeft, depotX, depotY) + routeCost(optRight, depotX, depotY);
      if (cost + 1e-9 < bestCost) {
        bestCost = cost;
        bestLeft = optLeft;
        bestRight = optRight;
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    changed: bestCost + 1e-9 < currentCost,
    left: bestLeft,
    right: bestRight
  };
}

function rotateRoute(route, shift) {
  return route.slice(shift).concat(route.slice(0, shift));
}

function reverseSegment(arr, start, end) {
  while (start < end) {
    const tmp = arr[start];
    arr[start] = arr[end];
    arr[end] = tmp;
    start++;
    end--;
  }
}

function routeCost(route, depotX, depotY) {
  if (route.length === 0) return 0;
  let total = Math.hypot(route[0].x - depotX, route[0].y - depotY);
  for (let i = 1; i < route.length; i++) {
    total += Math.hypot(route[i].x - route[i - 1].x, route[i].y - route[i - 1].y);
  }
  total += Math.hypot(route[route.length - 1].x - depotX, route[route.length - 1].y - depotY);
  return total;
}

function distNode(a, b, depotX, depotY) {
  if (a === null && b === null) return 0;
  if (a === null) return Math.hypot(b.x - depotX, b.y - depotY);
  if (b === null) return Math.hypot(a.x - depotX, a.y - depotY);
  return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
}

const result = solve(data);
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(result));

const fs = require('fs');
const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

const width = data.width | 0;
const height = data.height | 0;
const grid = data.grid || [];
const ignitions = data.ignitions || [];
const towns = data.towns || [];
const cutBudget = Math.max(0, data.cutBudget | 0);

const n = width * height;
const dirs = [1, 0, -1, 0, 1];

function idx(x, y) {
  return y * width + x;
}

function inBounds(x, y) {
  return x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height;
}

const burnable = new Uint8Array(n);
for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
  const row = grid[y] || '';
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    if (row.charCodeAt(x) === 46) burnable[idx(x, y)] = 1;
  }
}

const ignited = new Uint8Array(n);
const ignitionList = [];
for (const p of ignitions) {
  if (!Array.isArray(p) || p.length < 2) continue;
  const x = p[0] | 0;
  const y = p[1] | 0;
  if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
  const id = idx(x, y);
  if (!burnable[id] || ignited[id]) continue;
  ignited[id] = 1;
  ignitionList.push(id);
}

const townValueAt = new Float64Array(n);
for (const town of towns) {
  if (!town) continue;
  const x = town.x | 0;
  const y = town.y | 0;
  if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
  const id = idx(x, y);
  if (!burnable[id]) continue;
  townValueAt[id] += Number(town.value) || 0;
}

function bfsReachable(blocked) {
  const reached = new Uint8Array(n);
  const q = new Int32Array(n);
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ignitionList.length; i++) {
    const s = ignitionList[i];
    if (blocked[s] || reached[s]) continue;
    reached[s] = 1;
    q[tail++] = s;
  }
  while (head < tail) {
    const v = q[head++];
    const x = v % width;
    const y = (v / width) | 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const nx = x + dirs[k];
      const ny = y + dirs[k + 1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idx(nx, ny);
      if (!burnable[ni] || blocked[ni] || reached[ni]) continue;
      reached[ni] = 1;
      q[tail++] = ni;
    }
  }
  return reached;
}

const emptyBlocked = new Uint8Array(n);
const baseFire = bfsReachable(emptyBlocked);

let baseBurnedTownValue = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  if (baseFire[i]) baseBurnedTownValue += townValueAt[i];
}

if (cutBudget === 0 || baseBurnedTownValue <= 0) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const safeComponent = new Int32Array(n);
safeComponent.fill(-1);
const compTownValue = [];
const compCells = [];
const qComp = new Int32Array(n);
let compCount = 0;

for (let start = 0; start < n; start++) {
  if (!burnable[start] || baseFire[start] || safeComponent[start] !== -1) continue;
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;
  qComp[tail++] = start;
  safeComponent[start] = compCount;
  let townSum = 0;
  const cells = [];
  while (head < tail) {
    const v = qComp[head++];
    cells.push(v);
    townSum += townValueAt[v];
    const x = v % width;
    const y = (v / width) | 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const nx = x + dirs[k];
      const ny = y + dirs[k + 1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idx(nx, ny);
      if (!burnable[ni] || baseFire[ni] || safeComponent[ni] !== -1) continue;
      safeComponent[ni] = compCount;
      qComp[tail++] = ni;
    }
  }
  compTownValue.push(townSum);
  compCells.push(cells);
  compCount++;
}

if (compCount === 0) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const frontierSeen = new Uint8Array(n);
const frontierCells = [];
for (let v = 0; v < n; v++) {
  if (!burnable[v] || !baseFire[v]) continue;
  const x = v % width;
  const y = (v / width) | 0;
  let touchesSafe = false;
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    const nx = x + dirs[k];
    const ny = y + dirs[k + 1];
    if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
    const ni = idx(nx, ny);
    if (burnable[ni] && !baseFire[ni]) {
      touchesSafe = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (touchesSafe) {
    frontierSeen[v] = 1;
    frontierCells.push(v);
  }
}

if (frontierCells.length === 0) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const candidates = [];
const candidateCellSets = [];
const candidateCompSets = [];
const dedup = new Map();

function addCandidate(cellList, compList) {

    seenStamp.fill(0);
    bfsStamp = 1;
  }
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;
  queue[tail++] = startIdx;
  seenStamp[startIdx] = bfsStamp;
  distArr[startIdx] = 0;
  parentArr[startIdx] = -1;

  let bestIdx = startIdx;
  let bestScore = scoringFn(startIdx, 0);

  while (head < tail) {
    const cur = queue[head++];
    const dist = distArr[cur];
    const score = scoringFn(cur, dist);
    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      bestIdx = cur;
    }
    if (dist >= maxDist) continue;
    const adj = neighbors[cur];
    for (let i = 0; i < adj.length; i++) {
      const nxt = adj[i];
      if (seenStamp[nxt] === bfsStamp) continue;
      seenStamp[nxt] = bfsStamp;
      distArr[nxt] = dist + 1;
      parentArr[nxt] = cur;
      queue[tail++] = nxt;
    }
  }

  return { target: bestIdx, score: bestScore, path: reconstructPath(bestIdx) };
}

function scoreCell(idx, arrivalStep, horizonFactor) {
  const base = covered[idx] ? 0 : values[idx];
  if (base <= 0) return -arrivalStep * 0.0001;

  let local = base;
  const adj = neighbors[idx];
  for (let i = 0; i < adj.length; i++) {
    const n = adj[i];
    if (n === idx || covered[n]) continue;
    local += values[n] * horizonFactor;
  }

  const revisitPenalty = bestVisitStep[idx] < (1 << 29) ? 0.08 / (1 + bestVisitStep[idx]) : 0;
  return local / (arrivalStep + 1.25) - revisitPenalty;
}

function greedyExpandFrom(startIdx, stepsRemaining, stepOffset) {
  const path = [];
  let current = startIdx;
  for (let s = 0; s < stepsRemaining; s++) {
    const adj = neighbors[current];
    let best = current;
    let bestScore = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < adj.length; i++) {
      const nxt = adj[i];
      const arrival = stepOffset + s + 1;
      const score = scoreCell(nxt, arrival, 0.18) + (nxt === current ? -0.02 : 0);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        best = nxt;
      }
    }
    current = best;
    path.push(current);
    coverCell(current, stepOffset + s + 1);
  }
  return path;
}

function planDrone(startIdx) {
  if (startIdx < 0) return Array.from({ length: maxStepsPerDrone + 1 }, () => [0, 0]);
  const path = [coordsOf(startIdx)];
  coverCell(startIdx, 0);
  let current = startIdx;
  let usedSteps = 0;

  const searchRadius = Math.max(6, Math.min(24, Math.floor(Math.sqrt(cellCount)) + 4));

  while (usedSteps < maxStepsPerDrone) {
    const remaining = maxStepsPerDrone - usedSteps;
    const targetInfo = bfsBestTarget(
      current,
      Math.min(searchRadius, remaining),
      (idx, dist) => scoreCell(idx, usedSteps + dist, 0.22)
    );

    if (targetInfo.path.length <= 1) {
      const tail = greedyExpandFrom(current, remaining, usedSteps);
      for (let i = 0; i < tail.length; i++) path.push(coordsOf(tail[i]));
      break;
    }

    const pathToTarget = targetInfo.path;
    let advanced = false;
    for (let i = 1; i < pathToTarget.length && usedSteps < maxStepsPerDrone; i++) {
      current = pathToTarget[i];
      usedSteps++;
      coverCell(current, usedSteps);
      path.push(coordsOf(current));
      advanced = true;
    }

    if (!advanced) {
      const tail = greedyExpandFrom(current, remaining, usedSteps);
      for (let i = 0; i < tail.length; i++) path.push(coordsOf(tail[i]));
      break;
    }
  }

  while (path.length < maxStepsPerDrone + 1) {
    path.push(path[path.length - 1]);
  }

  return path;
}

const droneOrder = drones.map((drone, idx) => {
  const startIdx = sanitizeStart(drone);
  const startValue = startIdx >= 0 ? values[startIdx] : 0;
  return { idx, startIdx, startValue };
});

droneOrder.sort((a, b) => b.startValue - a.startValue);
const resultPaths = new Array(drones.length);

for (let i = 0; i < droneOrder.length; i++) {
  const item = droneOrder[i];
  resultPaths[item.idx] = planDrone(item.startIdx);
}

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ paths: resultPaths }));

const fs = require('fs');

const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

class MaxHeap {
  constructor(compare) {
    this.compare = compare;
    this.arr = [];
  }

  size() {
    return this.arr.length;
  }

  push(value) {
    const arr = this.arr;
    arr.push(value);
    let idx = arr.length - 1;
    while (idx > 0) {
      const parent = (idx - 1) >> 1;
      if (this.compare(arr[idx], arr[parent]) <= 0) break;
      [arr[idx], arr[parent]] = [arr[parent], arr[idx]];
      idx = parent;
    }
  }

  pop() {
    const arr = this.arr;
    if (arr.length === 0) return null;
    const top = arr[0];
    const last = arr.pop();
    if (arr.length > 0) {
      arr[0] = last;
      let idx = 0;
      for (;;) {
        let best = idx;
        const left = idx * 2 + 1;
        const right = left + 1;
        if (left < arr.length && this.compare(arr[left], arr[best]) > 0) best = left;
        if (right < arr.length && this.compare(arr[right], arr[best]) > 0) best = right;
        if (best === idx) break;
        [arr[idx], arr[best]] = [arr[best], arr[idx]];
        idx = best;
      }
    }
    return top;
  }
}

function solve(machineCount, tasksInput) {
  const n = tasksInput.length;
  if (n === 0) return { schedule: [] };

  const idToIndex = new Map();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) idToIndex.set(tasksInput[i].id, i);

  const tasks = new Array(n);
  const succ = Array.from({ length: n }, () => []);
  const indegree = new Int32Array(n);

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const src = tasksInput[i];
    const deps = Array.isArray(src.deps) ? src.deps : [];
    const depIdx = new Int32Array(deps.length);
    for (let j = 0; j < deps.length; j++) {
      const p = idToIndex.get(deps[j]);
      if (p === undefined) continue;
      depIdx[j] = p;
      succ[p].push(i);
    }
    indegree[i] = deps.length;
    tasks[i] = {
      id: src.id,
      duration: Math.max(0, src.duration | 0),
      deadline: Number.isFinite(src.deadline) ? src.deadline : 0,
      weight: Number.isFinite(src.weight) ? src.weight : 1,
      deps: depIdx
    };
  }

  const topo = new Int32Array(n);
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (indegree[i] === 0) topo[tail++] = i;
  }
  while (head < tail) {
    const u = topo[head++];
    const nexts = succ[u];
    for (let i = 0; i < nexts.length; i++) {
      const v = nexts[i];
      indegree[v]--;
      if (indegree[v] === 0) topo[tail++] = v;
    }
  }

  if (tail !== n) {
    return { order: tasksInput.map((t) => t.id) };
  }

  const revTopo = new Int32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) revTopo[i] = topo[n - 1 - i];

  const bottomLen = new Float64Array(n);
  const succWeight = new Float64Array(n);
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const u = revTopo[k];
    let bestChild = 0;
    let weightSum = 0;
    const nexts = succ[u];
    for (let i = 0; i < nexts.length; i++) {
      const v = nexts[i];
      if (bottomLen[v] > bestChild) bestChild = bottomLen[v];
      weightSum += tasks[v].weight;
    }
    bottomLen[u] = tasks[u].duration + bestChild;
    succWeight[u] = weightSum;
  }

  const depRemain = new Int32Array(n);
  const release = new Float64Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) depRemain[i] = tasks[i].deps.length;

  const machineAvail = new Float64Array(machineCount);
  const finish = new Float64Array(n);
  const schedule = [];

  function priority(idx, nowEstimate) {
    const task = tasks[idx];
    const slack = task.deadline - (nowEstimate + bottomLen[idx]);
    const urgency = slack < 0 ? -slack : 0;
    return (
      urgency * (task.weight + 1) * 1e9 +
      bottomLen[idx] * 1e6 +
      task.weight * 1e4 +
      succ[idx].length * 1e2 +
      succWeight[idx]
    );
  }

  const ready = new MaxHeap((a, b) => {
    if (a.score !== b.score) return a.score - b.score;
    if (a.release !== b.release) return b.release - a.release;
    return String(b.id).localeCompare(String(a.id));
  });

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (depRemain[i] === 0) {
      ready.push({
        idx: i,
        score: priority(i, 0),
        release: 0,
        id: tasks[i].id
      });
    }
  }

  let scheduled = 0;
  while (ready.size() > 0) {
    let bestTask = null;
    let bestMachine = 0;
    let bestStart = 0;
    let bestFinish = 0;
    let bestValue = -Infinity;

    const candidates = [];
    const inspect = Math.min(ready.size(), Math.max(8, machineCount * 2));
    for (let i = 0; i < inspect; i++) {
      const item = ready.pop();
      if (!item) break;
      candidates.push(item);
    }

    for (let ci = 0; ci < candidates.length; ci++) {
      const item = candidates[ci];
      const idx = item.idx;
      const task = tasks[idx];
      for (let m = 0; m < machineCount; m++) {
        const start = Math.max(release[idx], machineAvail[m]);
        const end = start + task.duration;
        const late = Math.max(0, end - task.deadline);
        const value =
          item.score -
          late * (task.weight + 1) * 1e7 -
          start * 10 -
          machineAvail[m] * 0.01;
        if (value > bestValue) {
          bestValue = value;
          bestTask = item;
          bestMachine = m;
          bestStart = start;
          bestFinish = end;
        }
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
      const item = candidates[i];
      if (item !== bestTask) ready.push(item);
    }

    if (!bestTask) break;

    const idx = bestTask.idx;
    machineAvail[bestMachine] = bestFinish;
    finish[idx] = bestFinish;
    schedule.push({
      id: tasks[idx].id,
      start: bestStart | 0,
      machine: bestMachine
    });
    scheduled++;

    const nexts = succ[idx];
    for (let i = 0; i < nexts.length; i++) {
      const v = nexts[i];
      if (finish[idx] > release[v]) release[v] = finish[idx];
      depRemain[v]--;
      if (depRemain[v] === 0) {
        ready.push({
          idx: v,
          score: priority(v, release[v]),
          release: release[v],
          id: tasks[v].id
        });
      }
    }
  }

  if (scheduled !== n) {
    return { order: Array.from(topo, (idx) => tasks[idx].id) };
  }

  schedule.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.start !== b.start) return a.start - b.start;
    if (a.machine !== b.machine) return a.machine - b.machine;
    return String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id));
  });

  return { schedule };
}

const result = solve(
  Math.max(1, data.machineCount | 0),
  Array.isArray(data.tasks) ? data.tasks : []
);

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(result));

type Point = {
  x: number;
  y: number;
};

type Package = Point & {
  id: string | number;
  index: number;
  angle: number;
  radius: number;
};

type InputData = {
  depot: [number, number];
  truckCount: number;
  packages: Array<{ id: string | number; x: number; y: number }>;
};

declare const require: any;
declare const process: any;
const fs = require('fs');
const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input) as InputData;

function dist(a: Point, b: Point): number {
  const dx = a.x - b.x;
  const dy = a.y - b.y;
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

function routeDistance(route: Package[], depot: Point): number {
  if (route.length === 0) return 0;
  let total = dist(depot, route[0]);
  for (let i = 1; i < route.length; i++) {
    total += dist(route[i - 1], route[i]);
  }
  total += dist(route[route.length - 1], depot);
  return total;
}

function insertionCost(route: Package[], pkg: Package, pos: number, depot: Point): number {
  const prev = pos === 0 ? depot : route[pos - 1];
  const next = pos === route.length ? depot : route[pos];
  return dist(prev, pkg) + dist(pkg, next) - dist(prev, next);
}

function bestInsertion(route: Package[], pkg: Package, depot: Point): { cost: number; pos: number } {
  let bestCost = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  let bestPos = 0;
  for (let pos = 0; pos <= route.length; pos++) {
    const cost = insertionCost(route, pkg, pos, depot);
    if (cost < bestCost - 1e-12 || (Math.abs(cost - bestCost) <= 1e-12 && pos < bestPos)) {
      bestCost = cost;
      bestPos = pos;
    }
  }
  return { cost: bestCost, pos: bestPos };
}

function removeCost(route: Package[], idx: number, depot: Point): number {
  const prev = idx === 0 ? depot : route[idx - 1];
  const curr = route[idx];
  const next = idx === route.length - 1 ? depot : route[idx + 1];
  return dist(prev, curr) + dist(curr, next) - dist(prev, next);
}

function twoOpt(route: Package[], depot: Point): void {
  const n = route.length;
  if (n < 4) return;
  let improved = true;
  let passes = 0;
  while (improved && passes < 6) {
    improved = false;
    passes++;
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
      const a = i === 0 ? depot : route[i - 1];
      const b = route[i];
      for (let k = i + 1; k < n - 1; k++) {
        const c = route[k];
        const d = route[k + 1];
        const delta = dist(a, c) + dist(b, d) - dist(a, b) - dist(c, d);
        if (delta < -1e-12) {
          let left = i;
          let right = k;
          while (left < right) {
            const tmp = route[left];
            route[left] = route[right];
            route[right] = tmp;
            left++;
            right--;
          }
          improved = true;
        }
      }
      const c = route[n - 1];
      const d = depot;
      const deltaEnd = dist(a, c) + dist(b, d) - dist(a, b) - dist(c, d);
      if (deltaEnd < -1e-12) {
        let left = i;
        let right = n - 1;
        while (left < right) {
          const tmp = route[left];
          route[left] = route[right];
          route[right] = tmp;
          left++;
          right--;
        }
        improved = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

function relocate(routes: Package[][], depot: Point, truckLimit: number): void {
  if (routes.length <= 1) return;
  let passes = 0;
  let improved = true;
  while (improved && passes < 8) {
    improved = false;
    passes++;
    for (let from = 0; from < routes.length; from++) {
      const source = routes[from];
      if (source.length === 0) continue;
      for (let idx = 0; idx < source.length; idx++) {
        const pkg = source[idx];
        const removalGain = removeCost(source, idx, depot);
        let bestRoute = -1;
        let bestPos = 0;
        let bestDelta = 0;
        for (let to = 0; to < routes.length; to++) {
          if (to === from) continue;
          const target = routes[to];
          const ins = bestInsertion(target, pkg, depot);
          const delta = ins.cost - removalGain;
          if (
            delta < bestDelta - 1e-12 ||
            (Math.abs(delta - bestDelta) <= 1e-12 &&
              (bestRoute === -1 || target.length < routes[bestRoute].length))
          ) {
            bestDelta = delta;
            bestRoute = to;
            bestPos = ins.pos;
          }
        }
        if (bestRoute !== -1) {
          source.splice(idx, 1);
          routes[bestRoute].splice(bestPos, 0, pkg);
          if (source.length === 0 && routes.length > 1 && routes.length > truckLimit) {
            routes.splice(from, 1);
          }
          improved = true;
          twoOpt(routes[bestRoute === from ? from : bestRoute > from ? bestRoute - 1 : bestRoute], depot);
          if (from < routes.length) twoOpt(routes[from], depot);
          break;
        }
      }
      if (improved) break;
    }
  }
}

function buildRoutes(packages: Package[], depot: Point, truckCount: number): Package[][] {
  if (packages.length === 0) return [];
  const routeCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(truckCount, packages.length));
  const ordered = packages.slice().sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.angle !== b.angle) return a.angle - b.angle;
    if (a.radius !== b.radius) return a.radius - b.radius;
    return a.index - b.index;
  });

  const routes: Package[][] = Array.from({ length: routeCount }, () => []);
  for (let i = 0; i < ordered.length; i++) {
    const routeIndex = Math.floor((i * routeCount) / ordered.length);
    routes[routeIndex].push(ordered[i]);
  }

  for (const route of routes) {
    route.sort((a, b) => a.radius - b.radius || a.angle - b.angle || a.index - b.index);
    twoOpt(route, depot);
  }

  const leftovers: Package[] = [];
  for (let i = routes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (routes[i].length === 0) {
      routes.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  if (leftovers.length > 0) {
    for (const pkg of leftovers) {
      let bestRoute = 0;
      let bestPos = 0;
      let bestCost = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      for (let i = 0; i < routes.length; i++) {
        const ins = bestInsertion(routes[i], pkg, depot);
        if (ins.cost < bestCost - 1e-12) {
          bestCost = ins.cost;
          bestRoute = i;
          bestPos = ins.pos;
        }
      }
      routes[bestRoute].splice(bestPos, 0, pkg);
    }
  }

  relocate(routes, depot, routeCount);

  for (const route of routes) {
    twoOpt(route, depot);
  }

  routes.sort((a, b) => {
    const aFirst = a.length === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : a[0].angle;
    const bFirst = b.length === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : b[0].angle;
    if (aFirst !== bFirst) return aFirst - bFirst;
    return routeDistance(a, depot) - routeDistance(b, depot);
  });

  return routes;
}

const depot: Point = { x: data.depot[0], y: data.depot[1] };
const packages: Package[] = data.packages.map((pkg, index) => {
  const dx = pkg.x - depot.x;
  const dy = pkg.y - depot.y;
  return {
    id: pkg.id,
    x: pkg.x,
    y: pkg.y,
    index,
    angle: Math.atan2(dy, dx),
    radius: Math.hypot(dx, dy),
  };
});

const routes = buildRoutes(packages, depot, Math.max(0, Math.trunc(data.truckCount))).map((route) =>
  route.map((pkg) => pkg.id),
);

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ routes }));
