declare const require: any;
declare const process: any;
const fs = require('fs');
const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

type Point = [number, number];

interface Town {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  value: number;
}

interface InputData {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  grid: string[];
  ignitions: Point[];
  towns: Town[];
  cutBudget: number;
}

const parsed = data as InputData;
const width = parsed.width | 0;
const height = parsed.height | 0;
const size = width * height;
const cutBudget = Math.max(0, parsed.cutBudget | 0);

const grid = parsed.grid;
const burnable = new Uint8Array(size);
for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
  const row = grid[y] || '';
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    if (row.charCodeAt(x) === 46) burnable[y * width + x] = 1; // '.'
  }
}

const dirs = [-1, 0, 1, 0, -1];

function inBounds(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  return x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height;
}

function idx(x: number, y: number): number {
  return y * width + x;
}

function xy(index: number): Point {
  return [index % width, (index / width) | 0];
}

function bfsFromSources(blocked: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  const seen = new Uint8Array(size);
  const queue = new Int32Array(size);
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;

  for (const [x, y] of parsed.ignitions) {
    if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
    const start = idx(x, y);
    if (!burnable[start] || blocked[start] || seen[start]) continue;
    seen[start] = 1;
    queue[tail++] = start;
  }

  while (head < tail) {
    const cur = queue[head++];
    const cx = cur % width;
    const cy = (cur / width) | 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const nx = cx + dirs[k];
      const ny = cy + dirs[k + 1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idx(nx, ny);
      if (!burnable[ni] || blocked[ni] || seen[ni]) continue;
      seen[ni] = 1;
      queue[tail++] = ni;
    }
  }
  return seen;
}

const emptyBlocked = new Uint8Array(size);
const threatened = bfsFromSources(emptyBlocked);

const townValueAt = new Float64Array(size);
let totalThreatenedTownValue = 0;
for (const town of parsed.towns) {
  if (!inBounds(town.x, town.y)) continue;
  const t = idx(town.x, town.y);
  if (!burnable[t]) continue;
  townValueAt[t] += town.value;
  if (threatened[t]) totalThreatenedTownValue += town.value;
}

if (cutBudget <= 0 || totalThreatenedTownValue <= 0) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const dist = new Int32Array(size);
dist.fill(-1);
{
  const queue = new Int32Array(size);
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;
  for (const [x, y] of parsed.ignitions) {
    if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
    const start = idx(x, y);
    if (!burnable[start] || dist[start] !== -1) continue;
    dist[start] = 0;
    queue[tail++] = start;
  }
  while (head < tail) {
    const cur = queue[head++];
    const base = dist[cur] + 1;
    const cx = cur % width;
    const cy = (cur / width) | 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const nx = cx + dirs[k];
      const ny = cy + dirs[k + 1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idx(nx, ny);
      if (!burnable[ni] || dist[ni] !== -1) continue;
      dist[ni] = base;
      queue[tail++] = ni;
    }
  }
}

interface Candidate {
  cell: number;
  score: number;
}

function evaluateCandidate(cell: number, blocked: Uint8Array): number {
  if (!threatened[cell] || !burnable[cell] || blocked[cell]) return -1;

  const seen = new Uint8Array(size);
  const queue = new Int32Array(size);
  let head = 0;
  let tail = 0;
  seen[cell] = 1;
  queue[tail++] = cell;
  let enclosedTownValue = 0;
  let touchesBoundary = false;
  let touchesIgnitionSide = false;
  let area = 0;

  while (head < tail) {
    const cur = queue[head++];
    area++;
    enclosedTownValue += townValueAt[cur];
    const cx = cur % width;
    const cy = (cur / width) | 0;
    if (cx === 0 || cy === 0 || cx === width - 1 || cy === height - 1) {
      touchesBoundary = true;
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const nx = cx + dirs[k];
      const ny = cy + dirs[k + 1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idx(nx, ny);
      if (!burnable[ni] || blocked[ni]) continue;
      if (ni === cell) continue;
      if (threatened[ni] && dist[ni] >= 0 && dist[ni] < dist[cell]) {
        touchesIgnitionSide = true;
        continue;
      }
      if (seen[ni]) continue;
      if (dist[ni] >= 0 && dist[ni] < dist[cell]) continue;
      seen[ni] = 1;
      queue[tail++] = ni;
    }
  }

  if (!touchesIgnitionSide) return -1;
  let score = enclosedTownValue;
  if (touchesBoundary) score *= 0.35;
  if (area > cutBudget * 8) score *= 0.7;
  return score;
}

const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
  if (!threatened[i] || !burnable[i]) continue;
  if (townValueAt[i] > 0) continue;
  let frontier = false;
  const cx = i % width;
  const cy = (i / width) | 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    const nx = cx + dirs[k];
    const ny = cy + dirs[k + 1];
    if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
    const ni = idx(nx, ny);
    if (!burnable[ni]) continue;
    if (dist[ni] > dist[i]) {
      frontier = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (frontier) candidates.push({ cell: i, score: 0 });
}

const blocked = new Uint8Array(size);
const firebreaks: Point[] = [];
let budgetLeft = cutBudget;

const initialSample = Math.min(candidates.length, Math.max(256, cutBudget * 64));
for (let i = 0; i < initialSample; i++) {
  const c = candidates[i];
  c.score = evaluateCandidate(c.cell, blocked);
}
candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || dist[b.cell] - dist[a.cell]);

while (budgetLeft > 0) {
  const reevaluateCount = Math.min(candidates.length, Math.max(32, cutBudget * 8));
  for (let i = 0; i < reevaluateCount; i++) {
    candidates[i].score = evaluateCandidate(candidates[i].cell, blocked);
  }
  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || dist[b.cell] - dist[a.cell]);

  const best = candidates[0];
  if (!best || best.score <= 0) break;

  blocked[best.cell] = 1;
  firebreaks.push(xy(best.cell));
  budgetLeft--;

  candidates.shift();
}

const reachableAfterCuts = bfsFromSources(blocked);
const filtered: Point[] = [];
for (const p of firebreaks) {
  const cell = idx(p[0], p[1]);
  let adjacentToReachable = false;
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    const nx = p[0] + dirs[k];
    const ny = p[1] + dirs[k + 1];
    if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
    const ni = idx(nx, ny);
    if (reachableAfterCuts[ni]) {
      adjacentToReachable = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (adjacentToReachable) filtered.push(p);
}

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: filtered }));

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');
const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

type Robot = { id: number; x: number; y: number };
type Job = { id: number; x: number; y: number; priority: number };

const grid: string[] = Array.isArray(data.grid) ? data.grid : [];
const robots: Robot[] = Array.isArray(data.robots) ? data.robots : [];
const jobs: Job[] = Array.isArray(data.jobs) ? data.jobs : [];

const height = grid.length;
const width = height > 0 ? grid[0].length : 0;
const cellCount = width * height;

function cellIndex(x: number, y: number): number {
  return y * width + x;
}

const open = new Uint8Array(cellCount);
for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
  const row = grid[y];
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    if (row.charCodeAt(x) === 46) {
      open[cellIndex(x, y)] = 1;
    }
  }
}

const neighbors: number[][] = new Array(cellCount);
for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    const idx = cellIndex(x, y);
    if (open[idx] === 0) {
      neighbors[idx] = [];
      continue;
    }
    const list: number[] = [];
    if (x > 0) {
      const n = idx - 1;
      if (open[n]) list.push(n);
    }
    if (x + 1 < width) {
      const n = idx + 1;
      if (open[n]) list.push(n);
    }
    if (y > 0) {
      const n = idx - width;
      if (open[n]) list.push(n);
    }
    if (y + 1 < height) {
      const n = idx + width;
      if (open[n]) list.push(n);
    }
    neighbors[idx] = list;
  }
}

let maxRobotId = -1;
for (const robot of robots) {
  if (robot.id > maxRobotId) maxRobotId = robot.id;
}

const assignments: number[][] = Array.from({ length: maxRobotId + 1 }, () => []);

if (jobs.length === 0 || robots.length === 0 || width === 0 || height === 0) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ assignments }));
} else {
  const robotPositions = new Int32Array(robots.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < robots.length; i++) {
    robotPositions[i] = cellIndex(robots[i].x, robots[i].y);
  }

  const jobsSorted = jobs.slice().sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.priority !== a.priority) return b.priority - a.priority;
    if (a.id !== b.id) return a.id - b.id;
    if (a.y !== b.y) return a.y - b.y;
    return a.x - b.x;
  });

  const dist = new Int32Array(cellCount);
  const queue = new Int32Array(cellCount);

  function bfsToTargets(start: number, targets: Set<number>): Map<number, number> {
    dist.fill(-1);
    let head = 0;
    let tail = 0;
    queue[tail++] = start;
    dist[start] = 0;
    const found = new Map<number, number>();
    while (head < tail && found.size < targets.size) {
      const cur = queue[head++];
      const curDist = dist[cur];
      if (targets.has(cur)) {
        found.set(cur, curDist);
      }
      const nextDist = curDist + 1;
      const list = neighbors[cur];
      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        const nxt = list[i];
        if (dist[nxt] === -1) {
          dist[nxt] = nextDist;
          queue[tail++] = nxt;
        }
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  const distinctJobCells = new Set<number>();
  for (const job of jobsSorted) {
    distinctJobCells.add(cellIndex(job.x, job.y));
  }

  const initialDistances = new Map<number, Map<number, number>>();
  for (let i = 0; i < robots.length; i++) {
    initialDistances.set(i, bfsToTargets(robotPositions[i], distinctJobCells));
  }

  const unreachablePenalty = cellCount + width + height + jobs.length + 1;

  for (const job of jobsSorted) {
    const jobCell = cellIndex(job.x, job.y);
    let bestRobot = 0;
    let bestScore = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

    for (let i = 0; i < robots.length; i++) {
      const baseDistances = initialDistances.get(i)!;
      let distance: number;
      if (robotPositions[i] === jobCell) {
        distance = 0;
      } else {
        const known = baseDistances.get(jobCell);
        if (known !== undefined) {
          distance = known;
        } else {
          distance = unreachablePenalty;
        }
      }
      const score = distance * 1_000_000 + assignments[robots[i].id].length;
      if (
        score < bestScore ||
        (score === bestScore &&
          (distance < bestDistance ||
            (distance === bestDistance && robots[i].id < robots[bestRobot].id)))
      ) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestDistance = distance;
        bestRobot = i;
      }
    }

    assignments[robots[bestRobot].id].push(job.id);
  }

  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ assignments }));
}

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');
const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

type Cell = [number, number];

interface DroneInput {
  id: string | number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface InputData {
  probability: number[][];
  drones: DroneInput[];
  maxStepsPerDrone: number;
}

interface DroneState {
  index: number;
  startX: number;
  startY: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  stepsUsed: number;
  path: Cell[];
  component: number;
}

interface Candidate {
  idx: number;
  score: number;
  dist: number;
}

const parsed = data as InputData;
const grid = parsed.probability;
const drones = Array.isArray(parsed.drones) ? parsed.drones : [];
const maxSteps = Math.max(0, parsed.maxStepsPerDrone | 0);

const height = grid.length;
const width = height > 0 ? grid[0].length : 0;
const cellCount = width * height;

function inBounds(x: number, y: number): boolean {
  return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < width && y < height;
}

function idxOf(x: number, y: number): number {
  return y * width + x;
}

function xOf(idx: number): number {
  return idx % width;
}

function yOf(idx: number): number {
  return Math.floor(idx / width);
}

const dirs: Cell[] = [
  [0, -1],
  [1, 0],
  [0, 1],
  [-1, 0],
];

if (height === 0 || width === 0 || drones.length === 0) {
  const emptyPaths = drones.map(() => [] as Cell[]);
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ paths: emptyPaths }));
  process.exit(0);
}

const traversable = new Uint8Array(cellCount);
const values = new Float64Array(cellCount);
for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
  const row = grid[y];
  for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
    const v = row[x];
    const idx = idxOf(x, y);
    if (v !== -1) {
      traversable[idx] = 1;
      values[idx] = typeof v === 'number' && v > 0 ? v : 0;
    }
  }
}

const component = new Int32Array(cellCount);
component.fill(-1);
const componentCells: number[][] = [];
const componentValueSums: number[] = [];
const componentTopCells: number[][] = [];
const queue = new Int32Array(cellCount);

function buildComponents(): void {
  let compId = 0;
  for (let start = 0; start < cellCount; start++) {
    if (!traversable[start] || component[start] !== -1) continue;
    let qh = 0;
    let qt = 0;
    queue[qt++] = start;
    component[start] = compId;
    const cells: number[] = [];
    let valueSum = 0;
    while (qh < qt) {
      const cur = queue[qh++];
      cells.push(cur);
      valueSum += values[cur];
      const cx = xOf(cur);
      const cy = yOf(cur);
      for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
        const nx = cx + dirs[d][0];
        const ny = cy + dirs[d][1];
        if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
        const ni = idxOf(nx, ny);
        if (!traversable[ni] || component[ni] !== -1) continue;
        component[ni] = compId;
        queue[qt++] = ni;
      }
    }
    cells.sort((a, b) => values[b] - values[a]);
    componentCells[compId] = cells;
    componentValueSums[compId] = valueSum;
    componentTopCells[compId] = cells.slice(0, Math.min(cells.length, 96));
    compId++;
  }
}

buildComponents();

const covered = new Uint8Array(cellCount);
const distances = new Int32Array(cellCount);
const parents = new Int32Array(cellCount);
const visitMark = new Int32Array(cellCount);
let bfsToken = 1;

function runBfs(startIdx: number): void {
  bfsToken++;
  if (bfsToken === 2147483647) {
    visitMark.fill(0);
    bfsToken = 1;
  }
  let qh = 0;
  let qt = 0;
  queue[qt++] = startIdx;
  visitMark[startIdx] = bfsToken;
  distances[startIdx] = 0;
  parents[startIdx] = -1;
  while (qh < qt) {
    const cur = queue[qh++];
    const cx = xOf(cur);
    const cy = yOf(cur);
    const baseDist = distances[cur] + 1;
    for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
      const nx = cx + dirs[d][0];
      const ny = cy + dirs[d][1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idxOf(nx, ny);
      if (!traversable[ni] || visitMark[ni] === bfsToken) continue;
      visitMark[ni] = bfsToken;
      distances[ni] = baseDist;
      parents[ni] = cur;
      queue[qt++] = ni;
    }
  }
}

function reconstructPath(targetIdx: number): number[] {
  const path: number[] = [];
  let cur = targetIdx;
  while (cur !== -1) {
    path.push(cur);
    cur = parents[cur];
  }
  path.reverse();
  return path;
}

const droneStates: DroneState[] = drones.map((drone, index) => {
  const sx = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - 1, drone.x | 0));
  const sy = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - 1, drone.y | 0));
  const startIdx = idxOf(sx, sy);
  const validStart = traversable[startIdx] ? startIdx : -1;
  const comp = validStart >= 0 ? component[validStart] : -1;
  if (validStart >= 0) {
    covered[validStart] = 1;
  }
  return {

    startX: sx,
    startY: sy,
    x: sx,
    y: sy,
    stepsUsed: 0,
    path: [[sx, sy]],

  for (let i = 1; i < route.length; i++) {
    const idx = route[i];
    drone.x = xOf(idx);
    drone.y = yOf(idx);
    drone.path.push([drone.x, drone.y]);
    drone.stepsUsed++;
    covered[idx] = 1;
    if (drone.stepsUsed >= maxSteps) break;
  }
}

  if (drone.component < 0) return null;
  const remaining = maxSteps - drone.stepsUsed;
  if (remaining <= 0) return null;

  const top = componentTopCells[drone.component];
  const startIdx = idxOf(drone.x, drone.y);
  runBfs(startIdx);

  let best: Candidate | null = null;
  const sampleLimit = Math.min(top.length, remaining > 24 ? top.length : 48);
  for (let i = 0; i < sampleLimit; i++) {
    const idx = top[i];
    if (covered[idx]) continue;
    if (visitMark[idx] !== bfsToken) continue;
    const dist = distances[idx];
    if (dist <= 0 || dist > remaining) continue;
    const value = values[idx];
    let neighborGain = 0;
    const cx = xOf(idx);
    const cy = yOf(idx);
    for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
      const nx = cx + dirs[d][0];
      const ny = cy + dirs[d][1];
      if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
      const ni = idxOf(nx, ny);
      if (traversable[ni] && !covered[ni]) {
        neighborGain += values[ni] * 0.2;
      }
    }
    const score = (value + neighborGain) / dist;
    if (best === null || score > best.score || (score === best.score && dist < best.dist)) {
      best = { idx, score, dist };
    }
  }

  if (best !== null) return best;

  let fallback: Candidate | null = null;
  const cells = componentCells[drone.component];
  const scanLimit = Math.min(cells.length, 512);
  for (let i = 0; i < scanLimit; i++) {
    const idx = cells[i];
    if (visitMark[idx] !== bfsToken) continue;
    const dist = distances[idx];
    if (dist <= 0 || dist > remaining) continue;
    const score = (covered[idx] ? 0.01 : values[idx] + 0.01) / dist;
    if (fallback === null || score > fallback.score || (score === fallback.score && dist < fallback.dist)) {
      fallback = { idx, score, dist };
    }
  }
  return fallback;
}

function localStep(drone: DroneState): boolean {
  if (drone.stepsUsed >= maxSteps) return false;
  const cx = drone.x;
  const cy = drone.y;
  let bestIdx = idxOf(cx, cy);
  let bestScore = covered[bestIdx] ? -0.05 : values[bestIdx] + 0.05;
  for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
    const nx = cx + dirs[d][0];
    const ny = cy + dirs[d][1];
    if (!inBounds(nx, ny)) continue;
    const ni = idxOf(nx, ny);
    if (!traversable[ni]) continue;
    let score = covered[ni] ? 0 : values[ni] + 0.1;
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const tx = nx + dirs[k][0];
      const ty = ny + dirs[k][1];
      if (!inBounds(tx, ty)) continue;
      const ti = idxOf(tx, ty);
      if (traversable[ti] && !covered[ti]) {
        score += values[ti] * 0.15;
      }
    }
    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      bestIdx = ni;
    }
  }
  drone.x = xOf(bestIdx);
  drone.y = yOf(bestIdx);
  drone.path.push([drone.x, drone.y]);
  drone.stepsUsed++;
  covered[bestIdx] = 1;
  return true;
}

const activeByComponent = new Map<number, DroneState[]>();
for (const drone of droneStates) {
  if (drone.component < 0) continue;
  const list = activeByComponent.get(drone.component);
  if (list) list.push(drone);
  else activeByComponent.set(drone.component, [drone]);
}

for (const [, group] of activeByComponent) {
  group.sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
  let progress = true;
  while (progress) {
    progress = false;
    for (const drone of group) {
      if (drone.stepsUsed >= maxSteps) continue;
      const candidate = chooseCandidate(drone);
      if (candidate !== null) {
        const route = reconstructPath(candidate.idx);
        appendPath(drone, route);
        progress = true;
      } else if (localStep(drone)) {
        progress = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

for (const drone of droneStates) {
  while (drone.stepsUsed < maxSteps) {
    if (!localStep(drone)) break;
  }
}

const paths: Cell[][] = droneStates.map((drone) => drone.path);
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ paths }));

declare const require: any;
const fs = require('fs');
const input: string = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
const data = JSON.parse(input);

type TaskInput = {
  id: string | number;
  duration: number;
  deps?: Array<string | number>;
  deadline?: number;
  weight?: number;
};

type Task = {
  id: string | number;
  duration: number;
  deps: number[];
  children: number[];
  deadline: number;
  weight: number;
  indegree: number;
  remainingDeps: number;
  est: number;
  tail: number;
  level: number;
  avgWeight: number;
  descendantWeight: number;
};

type QueueItem = {
  idx: number;
  version: number;
};

class BinaryHeap<T> {
  private readonly data: T[] = [];
  private readonly compare: (a: T, b: T) => number;

  constructor(compare: (a: T, b: T) => number) {
    this.compare = compare;
  }

  push(value: T): void {
    const arr = this.data;
    arr.push(value);
    let i = arr.length - 1;
    while (i > 0) {
      const p = (i - 1) >> 1;
      if (this.compare(arr[i], arr[p]) >= 0) {
        break;
      }
      [arr[i], arr[p]] = [arr[p], arr[i]];
      i = p;
    }
  }

  pop(): T | undefined {
    const arr = this.data;
    if (arr.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }
    const top = arr[0];
    const last = arr.pop()!;
    if (arr.length > 0) {
      arr[0] = last;
      let i = 0;
      for (;;) {
        const l = i * 2 + 1;
        const r = l + 1;
        let best = i;
        if (l < arr.length && this.compare(arr[l], arr[best]) < 0) {
          best = l;
        }
        if (r < arr.length && this.compare(arr[r], arr[best]) < 0) {
          best = r;
        }
        if (best === i) {
          break;
        }
        [arr[i], arr[best]] = [arr[best], arr[i]];
        i = best;
      }
    }
    return top;
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.data.length;
  }
}

const machineCount = Math.max(1, Number(data.machineCount) | 0);
const inputTasks: TaskInput[] = Array.isArray(data.tasks) ? data.tasks : [];
const n = inputTasks.length;

const idToIndex = new Map<string | number, number>();
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

}

let qTail = 0;

while (qHead < qTail) {

if (topo.length !== n) {

  while (readyHeap.size > 0) {
    const machine = machineHeap.pop()!;
    const item = readyHeap.pop()!;
    if (item.version !== versions[item.idx]) {
      machineHeap.push(machine);
      continue;
    }
    const task = tasks[item.idx];
    const start = Math.max(machineFree[machine], readyTime[item.idx]);
    startTimes[item.idx] = start;
    assignedMachine[item.idx] = machine;
    const finish = start + task.duration;
    finishTimes[item.idx] = finish;
    machineFree[machine] = finish;
    machineHeap.push(machine);
    scheduled++;
    for (let i = 0; i < task.children.length; i++) {
      const childIdx = task.children[i];
      if (finish > readyTime[childIdx]) {
        readyTime[childIdx] = finish;
        versions[childIdx]++;
      }
      tasks[childIdx].remainingDeps--;
      if (tasks[childIdx].remainingDeps === 0) {
        readyHeap.push({ idx: childIdx, version: versions[childIdx] });
      }
    }
    minMachineFree = machineFree[0];
    for (let i = 1; i < machineCount; i++) {
      if (machineFree[i] < minMachineFree) {
        minMachineFree = machineFree[i];
      }
    }
    currentTime = minMachineFree;
  }
}

const schedule = new Array(n);
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  schedule[i] = {
    id: tasks[i].id,
    start: startTimes[i],
    machine: assignedMachine[i],
  };
}

schedule.sort((a, b) => {
  if (a.start !== b.start) {
    return a.start - b.start;
  }
  if (a.machine !== b.machine) {
    return a.machine - b.machine;
  }
  const as = String(a.id);
  const bs = String(b.id);
  return as < bs ? -1 : as > bs ? 1 : 0;
});

process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ schedule }));
